docs.title: Organized NFRs: identity, dynamics and emergence
docs.text: Status: current ontology and admission criteria for organized TNFR objects. The objects are conditional mathematical constructions with declared state, laws and identity. Proofs, finite numerical evidence and open hypotheses retain distinct status. This owner defines how claims about those objects are admitted; the research program selects research.

docs.title: 0. What counts as emergence here
docs.text:
On an unforced continuous segment, the nodal identity

\[\dot{\mathrm{EPI}}=\nu_f\,\Delta\mathrm{NFR}\]

relates form, capacity and pressure. It does not uniquely determine a pressure law, phase evolution, capacity evolution, support, clock or operator schedule. These choices must be stated and justified before interpreting their output. Separately supplied continuous inputs and hybrid jumps retain the extended-row and event accounting; they are not absorbed into this unforced identity. The parameter foundations own the assumptions and available derivations. Existing definitions and defaults are revisable.

A derived consequence of a specified model can be useful without that model being uniquely selected. Conversely, renaming a supplied model, initial pattern or target value does not derive it from nodal dynamics. Distinguish four levels:

Claim Required evidence Insufficient substitute Structural read-out Defined map from a supplied graph state, with domains and unavailable cases A suggestive field or topology name Dynamical consequence Explicit evolution law and assumptions, with proof or source-bound finite trajectory Static resemblance or an imposed endpoint Effective nodal emergence State map, closure or derived memory, and comparison with microscopic evolution Calling an arbitrary partition a macro-NFR Autonomous structural occurrence A justified source, eligibility, timing and event law on the retained state A supplied schedule or an admissible passive event

Mathematical experiments evaluate consequences under specified preparations, laws and numerical budgets. They can test a prediction, expose a counterexample or support a bounded numerical certificate. They do not by themselves provide independent empirical validation. The theory-to-execution map connects these claims to their proof, implementation and test owners.

docs.title: 1. Substrate, formation and identity
Organized objects as mathematical test cases
docs.text:
The primary line of work develops the foundations of TNFR through organized mathematical objects: determine their sufficient state, identity, dynamics, interactions and admissible structural transformations, then establish what those premises imply and what they leave undetermined. The intended outcome is a justified account of the paradigm's capabilities and limits. No external identity is assigned to a pattern from its shape, label or suggestive response.

The organized-source construction supplies one conditional object on which continuous recovery and a grammatical word can be studied with explicit state, work and numerical obligations. The theory catalog routes other models and their proofs. Different complete laws remain distinct test cases; their results cannot be combined solely because both contain an organized pattern.

The existing repertoire of collective properties is not assumed exhaustive. When a more complex organization becomes admissible, reassess its identity, sufficient state and effective dynamics: a lower-level description may omit new relational information. A proposed property needs a defined observation and a control that distinguishes organization-dependent behavior from what the prepared parts already possess. An effective law derived on that domain is compatible with an unchanged fine law; it does not by itself select a new universal microscopic law.

A common substrate could admit distinct, reproducible families of collective organization at different scales. This is stronger than a mere change of scale: the proposed families must have distinguishable dynamics, composition rules and observable responses. A shared substrate does not identify distinct organizations with one another or prove that every level has a sufficient autonomous description.

The engine represents nodes, states and relations as the supplied domain of each model. A finer TNFR realization needs the same explicit reduction obligations as any effective description; see substrate and scale. Objects and their environments belong to the same declared configuration. An unobserved background, zero form and zero pressure are distinct conditions; the environment/pressure contract retains the state or memory required by the actual driver. Neither global connectedness nor the origin of that substrate follows from an interaction certificate.

docs.title: Formation, maintenance and composition
docs.text:
A supplied identity, entry into that identity, persistence under a law, recovery after an intervention and autonomous occurrence are separate claims. An identity criterion states membership or equivalence, its observation domain, error margins and the claimed interval. An observation that is unavailable before a support change cannot be treated as measured absence. A valid preparation or stationary state does not by itself establish acquisition.

The interacting patterns could reorganize into a common composite NFR whose identity depends on their relative position, phase and dynamics. Their shapes and trajectories may change; a finite-lived composite may move or oscillate jointly. This remains a hypothesis. A formation claim requires an independently defined actual-state identity that is initially absent with a margin, then acquired and retained for the declared interval, with relevant constituent and boundary state and a later interaction or response criterion. Attributing that formation specifically to nonlinear interaction additionally requires a matched linear control. Linear acquisition would limit that attribution without invalidating formation under its own law. Conversely, a nonzero superposition defect or extra Fourier modes may describe small deformation or radiation without joint retention. Repeated composite formation could support a hierarchy, but does not guarantee increasing complexity.

The same complete fine law may govern the incoming patterns and a common organization. A single-pattern retention argument does not thereby prove retention of their relation. Two spatial lobes within one carrier band are not independent dynamical constituents merely because an envelope is written as their sum; a collective description must retain the relative and boundary information its identity and evolution consume.

The program overview summarizes available capabilities; each linked model owns its premises and verdict. In particular, a missing sufficient certificate is not proof that an organization cannot exist. Source-dependent exclusions remain constraints on those source classes, not universal exclusions.

docs.title: NFRs participate in the same structural configuration
docs.text:
The programme adopts participation in form as a constitutive requirement: an NFR is an organization of the same structural configuration in which it acts. Its identity and interactions must be represented within that configuration. A proposed effective description must establish how it satisfies this constitutive requirement.

At an effective scale, write y=R(z) for the retained description of a pattern in the fine joint state z. On a smooth fixed-support interval, its rate must be inherited as y_dot=DR(z)*F(z). A closed law in y alone requires the existing closure conditions; otherwise retain boundary state, hidden coordinates or justified memory. Effective interaction must represent the same fine interaction, without counting it again as an independent force exerted by a second copy of the pattern. The collective interaction owner already shows why relations between patterns can carry necessary state. The reduced formed-class ports give a controlled approximation example: a smaller component state transfers to a different receiver with explicit finite error for discarded modes and initial uncertainty. This supplies neither an exact nonlinear quotient nor a complete identity proof; that proof remains a separate obligation.

A larger organization retains the constituent and boundary information its identity and response consume. Removing interchangeable labels is different from removing continuous state. A closed law on an invariant family is also different from an exact quotient on a neighborhood of that family. The collective grammar criteria additionally admit action targets, histories, guards and ordered event effects; continuous closure alone does not discharge those requirements.

docs.title: Localized identity and transport on a supplied support
docs.text:
A basic NFR is the lowest retained level of a declared model, not an established ultimate constituent. The substrate foundation states that distinction. Conditional research can ask whether interactions on a supplied support sustain a localized organization that moves across it while retaining a reproducible identity. Such a claim retains the chosen law and preparation; it does not require that the law be uniquely selected among all compatible models.

Transport of a pattern changes which fixed sites carry it. It differs from internal phase rotation, oscillation within fixed constituent pairs, a redrawn graph layout, relabeling sites or creating a child node. A supplied cycle's winding and a moving maximum are not sufficient identity tests. Formation and transport also differ: transporting a prepared organization does not show its formation from a class lacking that identity.

An admissible transport claim declares the following before its response:

  • Law and background. Retain every consumed coordinate, the full support, capacities, clock, inputs and events, with a specified reference background. An observation window does not remove interactions with its complement. Define a support metric separately from conductance; graph-layout positions have no dynamical meaning without a declared geometric model.
  • Localization. Define a nonnegative observation of departure from the background, its units, spatial width/tail criterion and a nonvanishing signal floor. This observation does not replace signed form in the law or turn a signed storage remainder into a positive local energy. State how multiple peaks, splitting and unavailable centers are handled.
  • Displacement and identity. Use one fixed support reference and a predeclared identity comparison with error bounds over the entire interval. If translations are used as exact dynamical equivalences, verify that their maps preserve support, coefficients and complete dynamics. Profile alignment used only as an observation must retain any mismatch and its error bounds. Preserve displacement in the record. Common phase-origin freedom is not spatial translation. Retain the internal and boundary state needed to distinguish continuing transport from decay followed by unrelated excitation elsewhere.
  • Preparation and robustness. Declare whether the initial class already contains the identity, any supplied directional asymmetry and independent disturbances. Symmetry of both the law and preparation cannot be discarded by a numerical tie-break and then called autonomous direction selection. Admit finite transport, persistent motion and collision as separate claims.

The localized identity owner provides a conditional prepared-transport example. The common-pattern formation contract separates its retained carrier identity from the acquisition of a new common organization. Case-specific results, controls and evaluated responses belong to those owners rather than a cumulative inventory in this ontology.

docs.title: 1.1 NFR formation: definition, birth and collective dynamics
docs.text:
The NFR definition is scale-relative. A node represents a micro-NFR; a coherent region is a candidate macro-NFR. Three distinct questions must be tested:

  • Graph birth: an admitted THOL action creates a child coordinate, its triad and hierarchy metadata. This is an implemented event under a supplied admission and environmental-amplitude rule.
  • Regional formation and persistence: a collection develops and retains a stated identity under surrounding interactions. This need not create vertices. A coherent snapshot, stationary minimum or topology label alone does not demonstrate temporal maintenance.
  • Predictive effective description: retained coordinates, or derived memory with its hidden-initial-state source, predict the declared response. An autonomous law on current aggregate coordinates additionally requires closure on those coordinates. A failed reduction does not refute the region's existence in the full state.

Operators specify transformations of existing state; they are not separate entities whose birth must be simulated. Deriving when a transformation occurs is a further closure problem. Likewise, telemetry does not become a causal law by being used to select an operator. In this structural interpretation, an operator is realized in NFR state or relations; "use" does not require an intentional actor or an additional NFR that commands the transformation. Software callers and configured selectors can request events, but their requests do not establish autonomous occurrence in a proposed ontological realization. Each operator still requires its own live-state and composition conditions.

The operator realization contract distinguishes target, eligibility, request origin and completed action; configured state-dependent selection is a reusable mechanism, not yet a derivation of autonomous occurrence. A continuous NFR evolution also need not be reinterpreted as an unobserved succession of registered discrete events.

The collective-action criterion makes this distinction testable: an NFR description must predict both its continuous response and any claimed event independently of discarded fine labels. Event targets, history and occurrence can require additional retained state even when a continuous quotient already closes. The native full-form formation obstruction also supplies a conditional phase-acquisition budget; it does not turn a storage-passive reset into an autonomous mechanism.

The program overview distinguishes available capabilities and their boundaries; each model retains its positive results and exclusions. The theory-to-execution map locates proofs, code and tests. The ontological obligations can be stated without maintaining a second inventory of preparations:

Claim about an organization Required distinction Formation Show entry from an initial set lacking the claimed identity, then its declared retention and response. Native validated transit and sine prepared acquisition have separate law/domain and uncertainty hypotheses. Maintenance and recovery Admit the initial identity and prove retention over its declared interval; recovery additionally needs a declared intervention and return criterion. These claims do not require that the identity was initially absent. Effective description Prove sufficient collective state, or retain hidden initialization through derived memory. Means, winding and instantaneous rates alone need not close. Interaction and composition Retain environmental influence, relative frames and causal controls. Compatible isolated identities need not remain compatible after attachment. Birth or structural action Admit state/support jumps and their costs separately from occurrence. A configured child, favorable budget or named operator does not derive its own activation.

Failure of a sufficient maintenance certificate does not establish absence of an identity. An observation unavailable before a support change is not a measured absence; declare its cross-support meaning before claiming acquisition. The following linked studies make those distinctions precise on their own laws.

Technical result Scope retained for the formation question Weighted-contact admission Actual word and separately prepared comparison families; canonical execution does not itself establish source-to-identity entry. Permanent registration boundary The closed full-state target with one common circular origin is initially absent throughout admitted neighborhoods. Finite-volume preservation excludes robust permanent capture there; almost-everywhere return does not prove recurrence of a specified nominal point or exclude finite-lived formation. Finite registration and retained episode Separate component invariants exclude the target for the disconnected control and its source boxes. Joined storage and lifted means permit a target and a configuration path, not an integral curve; the tangent construction has its own storage. The frozen sine/tangent central-source episode excludes entry on [0,8], not all time or the surrounding preparation families. Quadratic obstruction The central tangent source cannot register at any time. Its conserved quadratic does not transfer to the sine law, which has no nonzero homogeneous quadratic first integral on an open mean-fixed domain. Losing that obstruction does not establish nonlinear entry. Quartic continuation Formal leading-drift removal increases drift at the actual source and is not uniformly small on its storage domain. This limits the approximation, not every possible formation mechanism. Word-to-flow comparison The same admitted AL/UM/SHA preparation supports distinct periodic continued fields, each maintaining the marked constituents under its own law. This proves compatibility, not common-identity entry or unique constitutive selection.

The law-admission distinction separates those conditional results from a uniquely derived complete dynamics.

Nonlinearity is not a universal definition-level requirement for an NFR. If a linear alternative acquires the same declared organization, that limits attribution of the mechanism to nonlinear terms; it does not erase an otherwise proved formation result. A claim of a new collective NFR still needs a justified identity, source-to-entry evidence, its declared lifetime and continued response with sufficient state and boundary information. Common registration alone supplies neither those temporal facts nor a graph-birth event.

The smooth-sine dynamics owner includes positive acquisition with bounded full-state uncertainty and complementary budget/symmetry exclusions. These coexist with the native law's prepared formation and its differently scoped counterexamples. None selects an initial substrate, preparation or a universal organizing law.

A regional calculation must retain its environmental boundary influence. Recomputing pressure only on an induced subgraph changes the model. The regional balance separates internal dissipation, environmental exchange, source channels and stored-pressure defects on the full graph. Its validity does not select the region or predict its indefinite maintenance.

docs.title: 1.2 Can NFR properties justify a joint law?
docs.text:
They can constrain one when the property has an independent mathematical meaning. Requiring a desired endpoint and choosing a force to attain it would instead prescribe the result. The distinction is particularly important for "resonance", "identity" and "fractality": none alone specifies a differential equation or a conserved quantity.

Attributed property Independent structural requirement What remains to justify Identity through change A declared full-state observation and permitted symmetries; retain information needed to predict its response Its formation, restoration and lifetime under a complete law Relational interaction Explicit support, boundary exchange and response to neighboring state Pressure law, reciprocity and any state-dependent metric Circular phase A circle-valued coordinate, chart boundaries and transformation rules Its clock and relation to form; phase reflection is not automatically a redundancy Nested effective nodes A state map with exact closure, derived memory or controlled error Autonomous region selection and whether the same law survives reduction Resonant internal exchange and response Explicit reciprocal dynamics, storage balance and a declared input/output susceptibility; conditional sine-law foundation Selection of the complete law, autonomous formation and robustness beyond the proved families

The existing scale bridge already supplies one useful positive example. On its reversible pure-EPI domain the inherited regional capacity is nu_eff=boundary_conductance/sum_i(d_i/nu_i). With common fine capacity this is that capacity times the ratio of boundary conductance to total regional degree. Thus internal and boundary structure determine a coarse response factor without fitting a function of EPI. A closed regional clock still requires the intertwining condition; nesting alone cannot remove hidden modes. This is a reused result, not a separate capacity-law campaign.

A second, explicitly conditional route is the cotangent phase/form comparison. It asks whether reversible internal exchange can use the already derived phase metric. Choosing a conjugate-momentum interpretation then forces a geometric pressure correction and a reciprocal phase row. This supplies a testable complete comparison, not a deduction that every NFR must be Hamiltonian or that scalar EPI must be a conjugate momentum. The engine's pressure is revised in that comparison, and held capacity is not claimed to emerge. The integration audit shows that those premises still allow different exchange scales. It also derives an effective scale from the multiplicity of exactly synchronized replicated blocks. This is a concrete connection to nested descriptions, with supplied fine dynamics and grouping; it neither selects the microscopic law nor shows that those groups form autonomously. NFR properties can impose checkable composition requirements without presupposing the desired pattern.

The complete sine law supplies a distinct result: its existing skew exchange and dissipation derive a full-network response theorem near stable critical patterns. Every active collocated structural-work port has a positive finite-frequency gain maximum. This is an actual consequence of those nodal rows, including when free poles are real; it does not assign an auxiliary oscillator. The input/readout remain declared, and the theorem does not turn susceptibility into spontaneous excitation or object formation.

The signed form/phase pair has the faithful cylinder representation (x, exp(i*theta)); it is not by itself a complete nodal or collective state. The representation controls show why replacing that pair by x*exp(i*theta) loses relevant sign and zero-form phase information under the current multichannel law. Retain every additional capacity, support, input and history channel consumed by the chosen law or action; the state foundation owns the closure obligation. A geometric proposal must preserve that information or justify its quotient and pressure; calling the result an NFR does not supply that justification.

docs.title: 1.3 Organization, internal motion and waveform stability
docs.text:
The finite-amplitude internal pulse provides a precise instance of organized internal motion. On the supplied doubled-C5 support, a symmetric preparation evolves periodically under the existing zero-loss reciprocal sine law, with fixed collective mean form and phase. The smaller constituents remain present and active. The motion is endogenous to those complete rows, without adding an external periodic drive or a new primitive pulse variable. Its initial preparation, support and zero-loss premise remain supplied; no birth from equilibrium or universal oscillation is thereby derived.

Which state defines identity matters. The fine labeled state and the exact unordered-pair state have different minimal periods, while the means are constant. These results justify retaining internal information when describing a larger organization. They do not prove autonomous nesting or fractal inheritance at arbitrary scales.

A persistent geometric identity also need not preserve one waveform. The transverse splitting proves orbital instability of sufficiently small nonzero members of that pulse family. The same law still conserves storage: growth of a perturbation away from the prepared waveform is not dissipation or proof that every nearby organization disappears. Conversely, a geometric trapping theorem does not prove synchronization of the internal rhythms. Joint claims must retain the hypotheses of both results; no selected numerical amplitude is certified by the existential small-amplitude theorem.

The joint persistence theorem establishes more than finite survival: every state in its admitted open full-state family preserves geometric organization and active constituents on the fixed conservative doubled C5. Almost every such state also recurs. These conclusions coexist with fragility of an exact common waveform. Support, positive held capacity, the complete law and the prepared family remain hypotheses; this does not prove entry into that invariant family from outside it or autonomous creation of its constituents.

The nonlinear recurrence theorem gives almost-everywhere returns of the full circular state in admitted finite-volume families of the reversible sine law. Recurrence alone does not protect a particular organization. The conservative identity theorem already combines all-state geometric trapping with almost-everywhere nonstationary recurrence for admitted isolated-cycle families. It preserves a stated winding identity without an attracting waveform. This is stronger than a recurrent read-out but remains weaker than a common period, a return time for a selected state or autonomous pattern formation.

docs.title: 1.4 Connections between pulse, resonance, memory and scale
docs.text:
These connections reuse established results under their declared laws. They are not additional research queues or evidence that the organizing concepts uniquely select those laws. The important common requirement is to retain the internal and environmental information consumed by the actual dynamics. The derived-information ledger classifies the reusable quantities. In particular, the paired phase/rate witness shows that even every unweighted phase moment and a separate inventory of rates can miss the association controlling response and work. Retaining that association adds information to an observation, not a new primitive variable. The moving-pair interaction contract also shows why constant collective means can conceal a changing circulation: on the established pulse family, internal motion modulates compensating neighbor currents. A larger pattern can retain active constituents without changing its mean form. The specified preparation and complete law remain premises; this does not establish arbitrary-scale closure. The global pair representation also shows that a vanishing collective phasor need not erase the constituents or their future interaction. Phase product and form/phase association retain their state through cancellation. This is continuity of a supplied pair's description, not a proof that its observed coherent identity persists.

The organized-source asymmetry bound gives a complementary condition under which hidden information becomes progressively less important for an instantaneous prediction. A common quadratic metric controls both hidden form and phase while the surrounding state moves, and it is unchanged by the admitted marked ideal word. This yields a finite deadline for a declared approximation tolerance. Exact equality is only asymptotic, and the result neither closes a lossy state at finite time nor establishes a new NFR identity. Thus a practical collective approximation requires a law, domain and error criterion in addition to a grouping or an exact symmetry. The independent-core comparison also bounds accumulated prediction error when that symmetric core evolves from the matched projected initial state, at unit capacities without events. The projected error is uniformly quadratic in initial hidden amplitude and tends to zero. This gives a conditional reason to discard detail for a specified prediction; the full reconstructed error still includes that detail, and the result does not select a grouping or an NFR identity.

Connection Established result and compatible reuse Missing implication Pulse and internal organization The actual mean-contact balance derives exchange between collective motion and contact deviations on the conservative unit C5/private-leaf support. Certain phase preparations release collective storage and initiate internal form/phase motion. The mean pulse is not generally closed; its lift-dependent remainder is signed. Release and internal growth do not prove the receiver acquires an identity. Resonance and environmental memory The work-port response and causal bridge memory both retain joint form/phase channels and an explicit input/readout or hidden source. Hidden initial state can drive visible response without an added external force. A positive-loss driven gain theorem is not a conservative autonomous oscillation theorem. A two-C6 tangent kernel cannot be used as the nonlinear C5 environment; the reduction method, not its coefficients, transfers. Scale inheritance and moving geometry Replica inheritance retains smaller constituents, the phase-offset criterion identifies compatible collective families, and registered organized interfaces derive changes in the constitutive and reciprocal coefficients. The network theorem retains boundary information when pairwise charts cannot coexist. Exact closure or prepared invariance does not establish spontaneous grouping, attraction, or the same scalar law at arbitrary scales. Different supports retain different inherited coefficients; acquired-state identity requires its own complete-law bound. Formation and finite maintenance Same-orbit formation joins zero winding to a full-state target retaining acute identity for one scaled unit, using both nonlinear corridors, a phase band and complete-field error bounds. Energy-speed windows and moving-reference bounds remain separate tools. The source and target centers are defined by the exact flow, and the source tolerance is formally positive but extremely small. This is conditional existence, not an operational preparation, autonomous selection or indefinite maintenance. Primitive information and constitutive freedom First-resultant sufficiency conditionally selects a sine current, while storage-family controls distinguish a shared identity from potential-dependent response. Supplying the information class, storage or mobility remains an independent premise. Equilibrium geometry and tangent agreement do not select every nonlinear interaction or timescale.

Two controls make the limits concrete. The retained phase-flat collective preparation has enough total storage to clear the necessary phase-path cost, yet its complete frozen response keeps zero receiver winding over its declared horizon. Separately, matched contact-lag multisets can have the same storage and initial collective transfer while their cyclic arrangements have different symmetries. A reflection-invariant arrangement excludes acute unit winding even though internal form and phase begin to grow. The cycle-sector barrier also excludes both low-energy examples independently of that symmetry. Removing a reflection therefore does not make the other preparation a formation candidate. Conversely, a rapid-contact averaging bound can exclude acquisition over a fixed interval despite abundant storage. That conditional cancellation mechanism links pulse rate to effective transfer; it neither establishes a resonant formation band nor selects a new law.

Thus the useful synthesis is retained internal dynamics plus ordered contact geometry, with a compatible full-state maintenance budget. It does not require adding a new primitive pulse, treating resonance as an autonomous input, or assuming that a larger NFR erases its constituents. The research program owns the current gate's status, the next admitted question and any reopening of a deferred dependency.

docs.title: 1.5 Existing objects and readiness for a collective TNFR language
docs.text:
The repository already contains mathematical organizations and sufficient collective descriptions. The remaining question is which declared actions and grammatical contexts those descriptions support. It would be incorrect to report either that no collective NFR has been constructed or that every constructed pattern is already a node of the full operator runtime.

The regional and relational workflows connect these distinctions to the engine. Network.nfr() is a stored-state diagnostic, while relational_cycle_capture() checks a sufficient theorem for one admitted state and law; neither executes formation. step_relational() executes a finite joint step under its explicit model, separately from operator words. Passing a collective description to an observation reader does not install it as an operator target or supply its consumed execution context.

For a collective NFR, the definition requires a declared identity, retained internal state and an interaction model. The foundation ledger distinguishes mathematical state from execution state. Four separate obligations therefore govern a claim of collective grammatical action:

  1. Identity and preparation. Declare what persists, its membership and environment, and whether the identity is supplied, acquired or only a candidate. Finite maintenance and all-time trapping have different scopes.
  2. Sufficient state and law. Retain the information needed for the actual continuous response, with exact closure, derived memory or a stated error bound. Retain or derive capacity and pressure from declared fine premises; factorizing an observed derivative does not derive them. A collective phase may be unavailable at cancellation even though internal state remains.
  3. Admitted transformations and words. Prove that action eligibility, targets, updates and their retained history are well defined on the collective state. Apply the ordered-word descent criterion, including every reachable prefix and any claimed costs or monitors.
  4. Selection and interpretation. A supplied admissible action still requires a rule for autonomous occurrence if that is claimed; see the organized-source timing corollary. An empirical interpretation additionally needs independent preparation and observation.

These are distinct proof obligations, not a demand that every object execute all thirteen operators or that every continuous solution be an operator word. The grammar scope separates mandatory engine contracts from conditional mathematics and configured policies. The two-unit debt, recency windows and monitoring thresholds do not become universal laws merely because an NFR representation is available.

In particular, a software history counter is not evidence that nature has that counter. It is required when claiming equivalence to the corresponding runtime policy. A proposed ontological realization must separately justify which structural information determines action and why that admission or occurrence rule applies. A mathematically valid collective transformation can be studied before this identification, with its supplied premises stated. The registered implementations and foundational hypotheses remain revisable; neither the catalog nor a successful word selects a unique natural law.

Existing constructions satisfy different parts of these obligations. A pure-EPI quotient can inherit exact form dynamics without supplying circular phase or operator history. The unordered pair state retains internal correlations even at phase cancellation; removing labels does not necessarily reduce the continuous dimension. Both are conditional representations, with their own support, capacity and observation premises.

Prepared and acquired organizations also differ. The acquired C9 and outer-winding construction connects an admitted source to an initially absent identity. The localized transport result instead retains a prepared identity for a finite interval. An interaction response, loss of an old identity tube or failure of an invariant-family chart does not by itself establish dissolution or formation of a new NFR. Those claims need an actual identity predicate and its source-to-outcome proof.

The pair word, Resonance word and weighted Coupling continuation provide different conditional operator bridges. Their coefficients, history, work budgets and continuation laws cannot be transferred between models. The organized-source word domain admits ideal Reception → Coherence → Silence compositions on an acute domain, with joint mean/form control and a separate configured capacity limit. Represented stages need their own evidence. None of these supplied words selects its occurrence or proves unrestricted collective grammar realization.

Thus mathematical objects and particular collective actions are available. Readiness is a property of the selected object's sufficient state, identity, action and context. It is neither an all-or-nothing status of TNFR nor a demand to run every registered operator on one organization. The theory-to-execution map locates the complete proof and implementation owners; this admission criterion does not duplicate their result inventory.

The obstruction to unrestricted inheritance is informational. Two identical current nodal states can carry different persistent grammar debt or earlier stabilization history and therefore admit different next tokens. Bounded recent traces need not retain that distinction. Conversely, a continuous quotient can be exact while a member-targeted event fails to descend. The context controls exercise those separate obligations with the existing grammar and pair readers; no new causal law is inferred from those software policies.

A collective execution description must consequently include the state and context actually consumed by the requested action: constituent/port marks, capacity and support, stored versus refreshed pressure, relevant temporal evidence, ordered history and configuration. Monitor baselines require their own preserved observation and geometry. Keeping all that data is a sufficient representation only after the relevant maps and domains have been checked; merely adding metadata fields is not a closure theorem.

Integrated canonical action means that the registered operator, its admission context and its complete-law successor have a common mathematical domain. The ordered-word contract then applies to compositions: each accepted successor must supply the next action's consumed state and evidence. Boundary studies can test loss of that domain, changed identity or a required additional coordinate. They need not wait for every operator to act on one organization. This extends existing canonical components; it neither derives the operator definitions from the nodal row nor explains which admissible events occur spontaneously.

The native collective calculus provides concrete limits of inheritance: equal diagnostic observations need not retain event eligibility, an accepted constituent action can leave a paired-phase chart, and a complete successor can require internal contrasts and associated policy memory. Those outcomes do not establish an NFR identity without a separate maintained predicate.

The aggregate operator owner distinguishes same-factor operator descent from a sufficient representation of subsequent flow. Its restricted Resonance inheritance does not remove capacity/form covariance or derive paired requests. Its native-transition reductions retain configuration, clipping and memory premises; their consensus or upper-rail limits are consequences of those supplied policies. They neither guarantee persistent nonuniform organization nor establish autonomous grouping.

Wave envelopes, modes and structural storage remain legitimate mathematical tools within their declared TNFR laws. A change of vocabulary neither adds an omitted mechanism nor invalidates an existing continuous result. The useful foundation question is whether a retained organization supports the claimed TNFR transformation, with enough state to predict and admit it. The research program owns the single next test of that question.

docs.title: 1.6 Memory, operator history and their retained association
docs.text:
Existing memory results supply useful collective information, but several different constructions must remain distinct when admitting an operator:

Retained information Existing result and use Integration boundary Eliminated constituent or environmental state Derived EPI memory and nonlinear constituent memory retain hidden initialization and causal influence in the visible law A history buffer or operator token does not reproduce that kernel without a realization argument. Equal current means, storage and loss can still conceal different future response Supplied delayed EPI history Exact P5 composition proves finite composition with a declared uniform REMESH map This is a supplied operation on an augmented state. Its sampling, coefficients, clipping and hidden initialization remain premises; recording the REMESH advisory does not execute delayed mixing Admission and lifecycle evidence Ordered-action descent retains measured secants, grammar context, ports and consumed event metadata History must remain associated with its constituent. A copied counter, independent history multiset or reconstructed nodal product cannot replace that evidence Knowledge of prepared hidden state Memory initialization reuses the original source geometry to constrain unresolved moments Preparation knowledge can reduce a forecast enclosure without a new measurement. It neither invents executed history nor turns an outer uncertainty box into the actual prepared image

These are conditional ways to retain predictive information, not four new primitive substances. The selected claim determines which state and evidence are needed. If exact reduction fails, the acquired-parent actuation comparison provides a separate method: carry fine uncertainty under the same supplied input and bound the error of a collective reference. It does not identify that input with a registered operator or transfer its positive-loss C9 coefficients to the conservative pair.

The primary AL/SHA retention criterion illustrates compatible reuse within one model: existing reset work and the capacity-independent identity barrier give a sufficient continuation condition. The complete word theorem separately supplies grammar/lifecycle descent on its explicit domain. The implementation's StructuralIdentity is a declared tolerance-based signature check, not this all-time geometric theorem or a complete NFR definition. Its observation contract requires valid consumed channels; missing evidence cannot certify a match.

The thirteen-operator mechanism map remains the shared integration reference. Named jumps, node advisories, delayed mixing, explicit topology helpers and continuous effective laws have different execution and proof obligations. A complete implementation catalog does not establish that every collective organization realizes all its actions.

The operator studies identify which additional state a claimed action consumes. Their detailed derivations and retained evaluations belong to the linked owners; the distinctions needed for collective interpretation are:

State or action boundary Scoped result and implication Birth, contact and changed capacity Maintained-parent THOL uses genuine parent history and an explicit frozen-isolate successor. The committed UM endpoint has its own inclusion proof, and post-SHA retention separately certifies the changed law. Neither gives the child its parent's temporal baseline. The child's own execution state Acquired samples and OZ support the actual child word. Its level-two descendant remains isolated with no acquired temporal baseline; the word does not establish autonomous growth or a maintained larger organization. Local resultants and stored pressure IL/OZ handoff uses local resultants even when a global circular phase is unavailable. It accounts for actual IL work and OZ erased by immediate constitutive refresh; the separate phase review resolves the original accuracy uncertainty. Executed history remains distinct from the refreshed continuous state. Pressure as independent state Pressure completion adds mean, storage and event-work obligations. Its incompatibility of the old rows, invariant constitutive graph and smooth zero-baseline passive storage does not exclude memory with changed reciprocal reservoirs, phase laws or supplied held intervals. An independently specified pressure law need not make pressure an independent coordinate. Absolute form and local scaling VAL/NUL action can expose a form origin discarded by the continuous translation symmetry. Retain signed form or a declared reference. Failure of its scalar-storage confinement certificate does not itself demonstrate departure. Grammar and future identity The directional counterexample passes live NUL/IL/SHA grammar and finite U6, then leaves its original identity tube. Its exact nominal symmetry reduction does not admit an independent surrounding family. This rejects that retention claim, not every possible identity. Declared identity transformation Contextual identity transition preserves a marked acute winding class on its explicit source domain. Prediction consumes internal coordinates, actual neighbor counts, absolute form and associated context; successor capacities/history remain retained. It is not all-time maintenance or a scalar closure. Incoming mixture and work Reception admits EN/IL/SHA while an unweighted mixture can raise weighted storage. Unchanged instantaneous pressure and form rate coexist with changed phase rates and form acceleration; a compensating source or event selector is not supplied. Lifecycle memory Transition changes phase/capacity according to SHA latency at otherwise equal nodal state. Refresh erases raw jitter, not that reset. A valid event can leave the original acute sector; a separately declared narrower domain retains it. Temporal evidence and Mutation Mutation admission separates general capacity-dependent growth, actual NAV-successor conditions and acquired history. The phase action has its own work and successor-domain obligations; an instantaneous rate supplies no observed secant. Disconnected birth and delayed mixing Hierarchy distinguishes a pressure reset erased by refresh from a birth outside the connected-law domain. A parent reference supplies no edge or child law. Recursivity requires associated historical forms and actual mixing work; its advisory executes neither mixing nor topology replacement. Coupled constituent versus formed composite The small hierarchy-to-contact family uses an explicit frozen-isolate law, actual parent-target UM, positive event work and a disconnected inactive null. Its child responds, but that study supplies neither maintained-parent birth nor a new stable composite identity. Cross-support identity and U6 require explicit observation maps. Maintenance versus birth eligibility The maintained-source obstruction preserves the original count-three contact for all time while every genuine event-free acceleration window stays below the default birth threshold. It excludes neither THOL's pressure action nor birth from another admitted preparation. Capacity and temporal access The common-capacity comparison changes temporal eligibility at the original clock while preserving the same spatial identity. Even a genuine acceleration crossing can leave pressure or grammar blocking the event.

A transformed identity requires an independently specified observation and event map; it cannot be fitted to erase a failed prediction. Retaining history does not by itself install a pressure-memory law or derive an occurrence rule. Keep organization, observation protocol and full hybrid admission together.

docs.title: 2. Geometry and diagnostics do not close the dynamics
docs.text:
The tetrad is a shared diagnostic interface, not a proved complete state. Different capacities or hidden configurations can share its summaries and evolve differently. Its field definitions, distance conventions, availability and threshold scope belong to the field reference and minimal-state boundary.

Graph spectra, phase winding and field symmetries can reveal constraints or suggest effective coordinates. A spectrum of a supplied graph does not derive that graph; a symmetry of an auxiliary field space does not prove that engine trajectories preserve it. The gauge reference and variational reference retain the useful algebra and its bridge obligations. The regime comparison separates diffusion from added inertial models. These tools may test a proposed nodal law; they do not provide missing laws by analogy.

Arithmetic constructions have the same input discipline. Spectral properties of encoded divisibility are properties of that construction, not autonomous generation of its encoded arithmetic carrier. The arithmetic owner and spectral research scope retain those distinctions.

docs.title: 3. Admission before expansion
docs.text:
For the next proposed mechanism, record the supplied state and law, the structural principles that restrict it, the alternatives those principles still permit, and a response that distinguishes the alternatives before evaluation. Preserve counterexamples and null outcomes. A model that needs an added source must expose that source; a closure that loses information must expose the missing state or memory.

The research program selects the next bounded question. Existing conditional laws, formation, controls and memory forecasts are reusable evidence; their presence does not start additional law-selection or contact campaigns.

For structural contact, distinguish three independent obligations:

  • State and causal influence: keep full internal and boundary information, including relative origins. The effective-link criterion requires mutual causal response and restoration of a stated joint geometry. Hidden-node mediation can provide this on supplied fine support. A frozen separator is a causal null even when two regions look aligned.
  • Event and storage: event admission keeps continuous loss separate from support/reset work. Passive pure addition, edge exchange and nodal reorganization are different contracts. A supplied event can preserve a pattern without selecting why or when the event occurs.
  • Complete-law selection: continuous relation comparisons and support-law comparisons retain multiple compatible choices. Neither synchrony, an eligible contact, storage passivity nor a successful prepared response uniquely chooses one.

A sustained shared pulse is not required by the effective-link criterion. A damped collective response, maintained geometry, primitive edge birth and a sufficient composite identity remain different claims. The target is a justified account of the organization's state, inherited dynamics and admitted transformations. Its emergent properties are conclusions to establish under those premises, not identities to impose in advance.

docs.title: Extended Fields and Derived Quantities
docs.text:
Beyond the core structural field tetrad \((\Phi_s, |\nabla\phi|, K_\phi, \xi_C)\), the nodal equation \(\partial\mathrm{EPI}/\partial t = \nu_f \cdot \Delta\mathrm{NFR}(t)\) supports transport fields and derived diagnostic contractions. They add directional and interaction read-outs to a declared graph state; they do not make the tetrad an injective or complete representation of arbitrary TNFR states.

Status: CANONICAL DIAGNOSTIC DEFINITIONS — finite multi-topology validation supports the implemented definitions; completeness and unrestricted conservation claims remain open.

docs.title: 1. Extended transport diagnostics
docs.text: Two flux fields complement the core tetrad with directed neighbor statistics; their read-outs do not select or measure an evolution law by themselves.

docs.title: 1.1 Phase Current (\(J_\phi\))
docs.text:
\[ J_\phi(i) = \frac{1}{|\mathcal{N}(i)|}\sum_{j \in \mathcal{N}(i)} \sin(\phi_j - \phi_i) \] Property Value Definition scope Signed mean sine over unique support neighbors; a directional statistic, not an observed transport rate Sign convention Sign of the summed neighbor sine displacement; zero permits cancellation or antipodal phases and does not establish nodal equilibrium Finite evidence 48 historical samples across WS, BA and grid topologies reported anticorrelation \(r(J_\phi, K_\phi) \approx -0.854\) to \(-0.997\) under that protocol (see §2.2) Engine status Canonical diagnostic definition; no universal correlation theorem

On a regular exact-real chart with nonzero neighbor resultant, J_phi(i)=-|S_i| sin(K_phi(i))/degree_i. Nonzero current and curvature have opposite signs on this chart; that identity does not prescribe the magnitude of a sample correlation. The numerical readers retain their separate trigonometric and angular rounding.

The implementation counts parallel neighbors once and self-loops once, uses successors on directed graphs, and includes zero-conductance edges. Isolates use an explicit zero convention. For reciprocal support, the pair-cost and state-dependent metric identity relates this statistic to canonical phase pressure. A phase evolution law remains a separate premise; none is selected by this read-out.

docs.title: 1.2 \(\Delta\)NFR Flux (\(J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}\))
docs.text:
\[ J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}(i) = \frac{1}{|\mathcal{N}(i)|}\sum_{j \in \mathcal{N}(i)} \left(\Delta\mathrm{NFR}_j - \Delta\mathrm{NFR}_i\right) \] Property Value Definition scope Signed pressure contrast over unique support neighbors; no physical transport-rate factor is supplied Sign convention Positive means the neighbor-average pressure exceeds the node pressure; negative means the reverse Engine status Canonical diagnostic definition

Like the phase current, this contrast uses unique outgoing support neighbors, including zero-conductance edges. It reads stored pressure without refreshing it. Scalar and array paths reuse the stable neighbor-difference reducer: a uniform field has zero contrast even near the binary64 range limit, and signed cancellation is retained. Unrepresentable final values raise. Cached maps are detached from their public returns and bind admitted state and neighbor order. These arithmetic and cache contracts add no pressure law.

docs.title: 1.3 Research-Level Fields
docs.text:
Additional fields under investigation (not yet canonical):

Field Definition Status Phase strain Population variance of neighboring phase-gradient magnitudes Static research statistic; only scale 1 is implemented Phase vorticity Historical name for the mean inverse-length weighted wrapped neighbor displacement Not a curl or cycle winding; nonzero even on a tree Reorganisation strain Population standard deviation of neighboring pressure Static research statistic, not a time derivative or force balance

The legacy vorticity reader uses the shared distance convention: explicit length, then weight fallback, then unit length; parallel lengths combine by minimum. Every consumed inverse distance must be positive and finite. Zero conductance with an explicit positive length remains admissible. Actual topological winding requires an oriented cycle and branch evidence from certify_phase_winding; it cannot be recovered by interpreting this local mean as circulation. Missing pressure uses the common zero default and invalid authoritative pressure is rejected. These definitions introduce no extra nodal evolution law.

Implementation: src/tnfr/physics/extended.py — compute_phase_current(), compute_dnfr_flux().

docs.title: 2. Complex Geometric Field
2.1 Definition
docs.text:
The complex geometric field unifies curvature and transport into a single quantity:

\[ \Psi = K_\phi + i \cdot J_\phi \] Property Expression Magnitude \(\vert \Psi\vert = \sqrt{K_\phi^2 + J_\phi^2}\) Phase \(\arg(\Psi) = \operatorname{atan2}(J_\phi, K_\phi)\)

docs.title: 2.2 Anticorrelation Evidence
docs.text:
The cited finite protocol measured strong anticorrelation between the real and imaginary components:

\[ r(K_\phi, J_\phi) \approx -0.854 \text{ to } -0.997 \]

This is a protocol-specific relationship, not a universal consequence of the definitions. Graph topology, phase distribution and weighting can change it.

docs.title: 2.3 Physical Interpretation
docs.text:
\(\Psi\) unifies two complementary aspects of the geometric sector: - \(\operatorname{Re}(\Psi) = K_\phi\): signed circular mismatch with the neighbor mean; - \(\operatorname{Im}(\Psi) = J_\phi\): signed neighbor sine average.

Both are instantaneous read-outs of primitive phase. Neither supplies a phase velocity or a confinement law. The harmonic coordinate interpretation and its graph-realizability obstructions are owned by the variational note.

The pair can be embedded in the auxiliary rotation/gauge comparison described in GAUGE_SYMMETRY_AND_UNIFICATION.md; forming a complex number alone does not derive a gauge law.

Implementation: src/tnfr/physics/unified.py — compute_complex_geometric_field().

docs.title: 3. Derived diagnostic contractions
docs.text: The named read-outs below are computed from the field tuple \((\Phi_s, |\nabla\phi|, K_\phi, J_\phi, J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}, \xi_C)\). They are algebraic contractions; names such as “charge” or “action” do not by themselves establish conservation, topology or a variational principle.

docs.title: 3.1 Chirality (\(\chi\))
docs.text:
\[ \chi(i) = |\nabla\phi|(i) \cdot K_\phi(i) - J_\phi(i) \cdot J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}(i) \]

Signed handedness diagnostic in the declared field convention. A nonzero value does not by itself prove graph-level parity breaking.

docs.title: 3.2 Symmetry Breaking (\(\mathcal{S}\))
docs.text:
\[ \mathcal{S}(i) = \left(|\nabla\phi|^2 - K_\phi^2\right) + \left(J_\phi^2 - J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}^2\right) \]

Candidate order parameter used by the finite transition diagnostics. \(\mathcal{S} \approx 0\) means that these squared terms balance; a phase transition requires an independently specified finite-size protocol.

docs.title: 3.3 Coherence Coupling (\(\mathcal{C}\))
docs.text:
\[ \mathcal{C}(i) = \Phi_s(i) \cdot |\Psi(i)| \]

Signed product of the source aggregation and local geometric magnitude. It does not measure a dynamical coupling coefficient or demonstrate energy transfer.

docs.title: 3.4 Energy Density (\(\mathcal{E}\))
docs.text:
\[ \mathcal{E}(i) = \Phi_s^2 + |\nabla\phi|^2 + K_\phi^2 + J_\phi^2 + J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}^2 \]

Nonnegative quadratic energy diagnostic per node. It is invariant under the specified auxiliary orthogonal rotations; this scoped algebraic fact is not a general gauge-conservation theorem.

docs.title: 3.5 Action Density (\(\mathcal{A}\))
docs.text:
\[ \mathcal{A}(i) = \Phi_s \cdot |\nabla\phi| + K_\phi \cdot J_\phi + |\nabla\phi| \cdot J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}} \]

Mixed-sector coupling density. Connects potential, geometric, and transport contributions through cross-terms.

docs.title: 3.6 Topological Charge (\(\mathcal{Q}\))
docs.text:
\[ \mathcal{Q}(i) = |\nabla\phi|(i) \cdot J_\phi(i) - K_\phi(i) \cdot J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}(i) \]

The public API retains the historical name “topological charge”. It is a bilinear diagnostic. Grammar compliance alone does not conserve it, and no topological quantization theorem is claimed. Together with \(\tilde{\mathcal{Q}}\), its Euclidean norm is invariant only under the declared auxiliary U(1) rotation.

docs.title: 3.7 Dual Charges
docs.text:
\[ \tilde{\mathcal{Q}}(i) = K_\phi \cdot |\nabla\phi| + J_\phi \cdot J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}} \] \[ \tilde{\chi}(i) = |\nabla\phi| \cdot J_\phi + K_\phi \cdot J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}} \]

Implementation: src/tnfr/physics/unified.py — compute_chirality(), compute_symmetry_breaking(), compute_coherence_coupling(), compute_energy_density(), compute_action_density(), compute_topological_charge().

docs.title: 4. Energy Decomposition
docs.text:
The quadratic energy diagnostic, used as a Lyapunov candidate, decomposes by definition into transport and static-field sectors:

\[ E = \frac{1}{2}\sum_i \mathcal{E}(i) = T + V \]

where:

\[ T = \frac{1}{2}\sum_i \left(J_\phi(i)^2 + J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}(i)^2\right) \qquad\text{(kinetic — transport sector)} \] \[ V = \frac{1}{2}\sum_i \left(\Phi_s(i)^2 + |\nabla\phi|(i)^2 + K_\phi(i)^2\right) \qquad\text{(potential — geometric sector)} \]

Per-node Hamiltonian density: \(H(i) = \frac{1}{2}\mathcal{E}(i)\).

docs.title: 4.1 Two-Sector Structure
docs.text:
Sector Fields Conjugate pair Physical role Geometric \(K_\phi\), \(J_\phi\) Auxiliary pair \((K_\phi, J_\phi)\) via \(\Psi\) Curvature vs transport Potential \(\Phi_s\), \(J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}}\) Auxiliary pair \((\Phi_s, J_{\Delta\mathrm{NFR}})\) Source aggregation vs reorganisation transport

The phase-gradient magnitude appears in the quadratic diagnostic and several cross-products. This algebraic participation does not derive transport from its gradient. The shared normalization boundary also applies before interpreting these sums and products as physical energies.

docs.title: 5. Graph-field probe signatures
docs.text:
compute_element_signature() is a compatibility-named diagnostic over the supplied graph. It reports the \(\xi_C\) estimator, phase-gradient and phase-curvature summaries, and the response of \(\Phi_s\) to an optional declared probe. The default probe runs the valid word [Emission, Coherence, Silence] once on a detached graph copy and defines

\[ \Delta_{\mathrm{probe}}\Phi_s = \max_i |\Phi_s^{\mathrm{after}}(i)-\Phi_s^{\mathrm{before}}(i)|. \]

The input graph is not evolved. The returned synthetic_probe_word and synthetic_step_applied fields identify the intervention. If the probe is disabled, its zero drift is a compatibility sentinel for “not measured,” not evidence of stability: potential_drift_assessed=False and potential_drift_ok=None preserve that unavailability. A resulting signature_class="stable" then reflects only the phase gates; it does not report a passed pressure-drift check. If a performed probe fails that check, the classifier returns "unstable" regardless of the other gates.

Diagnostic policy Value Status Mean $\vert \nabla\phi\vert $ gate \(\pi/16 \approx 0.196\) Selected early-warning threshold; the exact kinematic bound is \(\pi\) Maximum $\vert K_\phi\vert $ gate \(0.9\pi \approx 2.827\) Selected margin within the exact wrapped bound \(\pi\) Probe \(\Phi_s\) drift gate \(\pi/2\) Selected U6 policy, applied only when the probe runs Fitted \(\xi_C\) category relative to \(\sqrt{\vert V\vert }\) Heuristic: localized below \(0.3\sqrt{\vert V\vert }\), extended above \(1.2\sqrt{\vert V\vert }\) Legacy Au-like curvature gate \(0.95\pi \approx 2.985\) Compatibility policy

These outputs are a response signature for a specified graph and intervention. The coherence estimator can return a product-fit length, a dimensionless spectral fallback or an unavailable value. Legacy size-relative categories must not silently identify these branches; the tetrad guide owns their units and provenance requirements. They are not spectral-coherence metrics, physical-element signatures, chemical stability tests, or evidence of autonomous restoring dynamics. The historical compute_au_like_signature() name adds a compatibility boolean from declared thresholds; it does not establish an Au or metallic correspondence.

Implementation: src/tnfr/physics/signatures.py — compute_element_signature(), compute_au_like_signature().

docs.title: 6. Field Hierarchy Summary
docs.text:
Core Tetrad (DIAGNOSTIC)         Extended Transport (DIAGNOSTIC)
├── Φ_s  (structural potential)  ├── J_φ       (phase current)
├── |∇φ| (phase gradient)       └── J_ΔNFR    (ΔNFR flux)
├── K_φ  (phase curvature)
└── ξ_C  (coherence length)
                     ↓
            Complex Unification
            Ψ = K_φ + i·J_φ
                     ↓
         Derived Diagnostic Contractions
         ├── χ  (chirality)
         ├── S  (symmetry breaking)
         ├── C  (coherence coupling)
         ├── E  (energy density)
         ├── A  (action density)
         └── Q  (topological charge)

Dependency chain: The hierarchy above is diagnostic, not a general causal identification theorem: Operator → updated nodal/graph state → structural read-outs → derived contractions. For a fully specified state and graph these functions are deterministic. The read-outs alone need not reconstruct that state or predict its future. See STRUCTURAL_OPERATORS.md §17.5 and example 39.

docs.title: 6.1 Emergent-property audit and useful derived margins
docs.text:
Adding a function of already observed fields does not restore information lost by those fields. Derived quantities are useful when they expose a specific invariant, response or domain boundary; naming another combination does not create an independent state coordinate or an evolution law.

Quantity or property What is available What it does not establish Complex fields, bilinears and energy totals One shared algebraic suite over the captured five base maps New independent degrees of freedom, dynamics, or conservation Cycle winding and branch/U3 margins Existing declared-cycle certificate and period geometry; cycle edges and orientation are required Creation of the cycle, unrestricted preservation or an integer value on an open path Local normalized resultant On the admitted acute cycle, the existing cosine margin bounds it away from zero A nonzero global resultant or a universal synchrony clock Conditional restoring stiffness The same margin bounds the supplied sine law's Hessian and its existing decay rate Stiffness of every pressure or phase law; the Arg-pressure Jacobian is different Effective capacity and memory Existing reduction/quotient and hidden-coordinate owners under their closure hypotheses Identification with primitive capacity or elimination of unresolved history by renaming it THOL record count, record rate and emergence index Retrospective heuristics with an explicit observation/window convention Autonomous generation, mathematical bifurcation, causal efficiency or a persistence certificate Wave spectrum and nodal pulse Auxiliary modal frequencies versus stored capacity/phase summaries Measured oscillations, mode excitation or equality of those two clocks

The positive margin derivation is centralized in the acute-cycle theorem. It reuses phase_radius_upper, cosine_lower_bound and the existing spectral rate bounds; no new adjustable coefficient is introduced. The full configured pressure mixture is admissible there because its capacity/topology gradients vanish under the theorem's common-capacity, fixed-simple-cycle premises.

Snapshot conservation boundary. The tensor facade formerly differentiated charge density along sorted node labels. That operation is neither a graph divergence nor a time derivative: relabeling the same P4 changed the resulting score. conservation_quality is now None, with conservation_sample_available=False and conservation_scope="single_snapshot_no_temporal_balance". Temporal balance still belongs to the existing conservation observer on declared snapshots and times. A zero unavailable score would incorrectly claim a measurement. Array facades retain an explicit nodes order instead of sorting arbitrary node identifiers; composite telemetry reuses one base-field collection.

THOL heuristics retain signed scalar EPI admission and exact intermediate ratios before their approximate cube root, avoiding false zero/infinity from overflow or underflow. An explicit operator counter cannot be advanced merely to accommodate a future-dated record. Their EPI baseline must still match the retained THOL window: eviction does not preserve a lifetime denominator. These arithmetic and provenance repairs do not promote the heuristics into dynamical mechanisms. See emergence controls.

docs.title: 1. The reference comes from the existing nodal channels
docs.text:
The connection studied in THOL birth and transport changes both the weighted EPI walk and the unweighted capacity/phase neighborhoods. Its next evolution can be analyzed by retaining that connected support, positive capacities and phases, then refreshing the canonical pressure before each declared physical step.

Let W be fixed symmetric nonnegative conductance, connected through its positive off-diagonal entries. Let d_i=sum_j W_ij>0, D=diag(d_i), B=D-W, and nu_i>0. Loops follow the shared conductance convention and zero-weight support edges contribute no EPI transport. The existing normalized EPI channel coefficient is e>0. Write the held remaining canonical channels as

\[ F=w_{ u}g_{ u}+w_{\phi}g_{\phi} +w_{\mathrm{topo}}g_{\mathrm{topo}}. \]

Here g_nu and g_topo use the actual unique-neighbor support; g_phi uses the canonical neighbor-phasor argument. Holding these source fields and their channel coefficients makes F constant. It is a decomposition of the existing pressure, with no additional feedback coefficient. Its phase component need not be a linear phase Laplacian.

The nodal equation on this retained state is therefore

\[ \dot x=\operatorname{diag}( u)(-eD^{-1}Bx+F). \]

An exact rational companion can treat finite materialized coefficients as exact real inputs. A live pressure refresh generally differs from this reference by a recorded numerical residual. Neither a stored pressure value nor an operator label establishes that the other channels have been independently identified or held fixed.

docs.title: 2. Compatibility, mean drift and the unique relative profile
docs.text:
Define the positive metric vector h_i=d_i/nu_i, its diagonal matrix H=diag(h_i), total weight Z=sum_i h_i, and weighted mean

\[ m(x)=\frac{h^\top x}{Z}. \]

Symmetry gives 1^T B=0, hence

\[ \frac{d}{dt}(h^\top x)=\mathbf1^\top DF=:b, \qquad \dot m=\bar v:=b/Z. \]

The initial mean is unrestricted. Its exact reference trajectory is m(t)=m(x0)+bar_v*t; the mean is conserved only when b=0.

A zero-pressure stationary EPI exists precisely when

\[ b=\sum_i d_iF_i=0. \]

Indeed its equation is e*B*x=D*F, and the range of a connected symmetric Laplacian is the subspace orthogonal to 1. Positive capacity makes zero rate equivalent to zero pressure in this fixed model. Zero capacity, disconnected positive conductance and changing channels require different conclusions.

For every F, including b!=0, there is a unique centered relative profile z satisfying

\[ eBz=DF-\bar v h,\qquad h^\top z=0. \]

The right-hand side sums to zero by the definition of bar_v, so a solution exists and is unique after fixing its weighted mean. A useful exact computation is the nonsingular rational system

\[ (eB+hh^\top)z=DF-\bar v h. \]

Multiplication by 1^T enforces h^T z=0; the remaining equation is the original profile equation. The rank-one term enforces the algebraic choice of mean and is not part of the nodal pressure or evolution. The existing exact matrix inverse suffices for this bounded solve.

Let

\[ A=e\operatorname{diag}(\nu_i/d_i)B, \qquad u=x-m(x)\mathbf1-z. \]

Then h^T u=0 and direct substitution gives

\[ \dot u=-Au, \qquad x(t)=[m(x_0)+\bar v t]\mathbf1+z+e^{-At}u(0). \]

This separates a retained spatial form, uniform mean drift and relaxing deviations without adding an independent dynamical law. A nonzero z alone does not establish localization or a zero-pressure equilibrium. On the exact drifting profile the pressure is bar_v/nu_i, while the raw Dirichlet energy stays at z^T*B*z/2 because B*1=0. A constant spatial energy therefore does not establish stationarity.

docs.title: 3. Exact relaxation and the finite-chart boundary
docs.text:
The identity H*A=e*B makes A self-adjoint in the positive H metric. Its only zero mode on connected conductance is the uniform vector. The centered error variance and Dirichlet error satisfy

\[ V(u)=\tfrac12u^\top Hu, \qquad \dot V=-e\,u^\top Bu\leq0, \] \[ E(u)=\tfrac12u^\top Bu, \qquad \dot E=-e(Bu)^\top\operatorname{diag}(\nu_i/d_i)(Bu)\leq0. \]

The positive nonuniform spectrum implies u(t)->0 in the exact held model. Thus the relative profile attracts every initial field after matching its initial weighted mean. When b!=0, the complete EPI field continues to drift and does not converge to a stationary state.

This asymptotic statement assumes an unrestricted scalar chart with the same fixed coefficients for all times. If every EPI coordinate must stay within finite bounds [l,r], its positively weighted mean must also stay in that interval. The ideal affine mean therefore cannot remain inside the chart beyond

\[ t>\frac{r-m(x_0)}{\bar v}\quad(\bar v>0), \qquad t>\frac{m(x_0)-l}{|\bar v|}\quad(\bar v<0). \]

Individual nodes may reach a bound earlier; the mean does not control every coordinate. Even b=0 does not ensure that the limiting profile lies inside the configured chart. Clipping changes the endpoint map and contributes a measurable defect. A clipped stationary endpoint need not have zero canonical pressure.

docs.title: 4. Finite refreshed Euler observations and their exact defects
docs.text:
For one declared duration dt>=0, let p be the captured pressure before integration and x_plus the observed endpoint. Define

\[ p_*(x)=-eD^{-1}Bx+F, \qquad \varepsilon_p=p-p_*(x), \] \[ \delta_x=x_+-x-dt\operatorname{diag}( u)p, \qquad \xi=dt\operatorname{diag}( u)\varepsilon_p+\delta_x. \]

The first defect measures pressure realization relative to the declared held model. The second measures the implemented endpoint relative to its actual held pressure, including arithmetic, clipping or a different solver. These definitions give the exact finite identity

\[ x_+=(I-dtA)x+dt\operatorname{diag}( u)F+\xi. \]

Consequently the mean budget is

\[ m(x_+)-m(x)-dt ar v = rac{dt\,d^ op\varepsilon_p+h^ op\delta_x}{Z}. \]

Neither defect is inferred from the other. Their signed mean contributions can cancel, so a small mean error alone is insufficient evidence of an accurate pressure realization or endpoint.

Let P_H=I-1*h^T/Z, Q=I-dt*A, and chi=P_H*xi. Centering the observed endpoint by its own weighted mean gives

\[ u_+=Qu+\chi, \qquad \chi=dtP_H\operatorname{diag}( u)\varepsilon_p+P_H\delta_x. \]

The exact Dirichlet error budget is

\[ egin{aligned} E(u_+)-E(u) ={}&-dt\,e(Bu)^ op\operatorname{diag}( u_i/d_i)(Bu)\ &+ frac12dt^2(Au)^ op B(Au)\ &+(BQu)^ op\chi+ frac12\chi^ op B\chi. \end{aligned} \]

The first term is the dissipative nodal contribution. The next is the finite Euler correction. The remaining terms retain the signed interaction with the observed defect and its quadratic contribution. They must not be discarded merely because the underlying continuous reference is dissipative.

Likewise the weighted variance has the exact identity

\[ V(u_+)-V(u) =-dt\,e\,u^ op Bu+ frac12dt^2(Au)^ op H(Au) +(Qu)^ op H\chi+ frac12\chi^ op H\chi. \]

Over a finite sequence with the same held model, each mean identity and each energy identity telescopes. Centered errors also propagate through the complete matrices Q_k, so defects need not stay in one spatial eigenmode. These are finite observations; a future error bound or a runtime asymptotic theorem needs additional uniform hypotheses.

For the ideal Euler map, the sufficient step condition dt*e*max(nu)<=1 places the spectrum of dt*A in [0,2]. Hence neither V nor E increases when chi=0. Equality can preserve an alternating mode on an even cycle; nonincrease is not automatically strict decay. The observed defect terms remain necessary under this step condition.

docs.title: 5. Reuse, realization and the evidence boundary
docs.text:
forced_support.py supplies derive_forced_support_balance, observe_forced_support_state and observe_forced_support_step. They rebuild public cached fields before using them and check the held node order, conductance, unique support and capacities. Their detached records contain no execution seal. The profile computation reuses _exact_linear_algebra.py. It introduces no alternative EPI integrator. The finite error budget reuses support_transport.py on detached error coordinates with the same conductance and capacity. Its reference error pressure is -e*D^-1*B*u, and its endpoint defect is exactly chi. This is an algebraic observation of transformed data; the error coordinate is not written into live nodes or interpreted as a newly created physical node.

The held non-EPI source must be obtained from the actual canonical channels independently of a fitted pressure residual. In particular, the nonlinear phase contribution must use the shared phasor kernel, retain its represented coefficients and distinguish its realization from the subsequent full multichannel pressure arithmetic. A direct operator pressure write or a stale stored value belongs in the pressure defect and must not silently redefine F.

capture_non_epi_forcing materializes the unit phase channel with the existing fused NumPy kernel, then combines its represented values with the exact support capacity/topology gradients and the effective channel coefficients. It reads the engine's actual cached weight mix without normalizing it again. The fresh full-kernel pressure defect and the stored-minus-fresh pressure residual are reported separately. Their sum is epsilon_p in the finite budget above.

This bridge is restricted to the default NumPy, non-JIT pressure branch with at most 100 directed unique-support entries. It rejects a disabled NumPy branch or a custom pressure callback. Neighbor insertion order and zero-weight phase-support edges are preserved. The materialized phase values define exact reference coefficients; the observer does not prove exact transcendental evaluation, identify another backend or validate future graph states.

The bounded experiment begins with the causally born and canonically connected child from the preceding block. It retains the resulting support, capacities and phases during explicitly refreshed Euler segments. A separately prepared compatible control uses uniform capacity and aligned phase on the same support. A separate prepared boundary control starts near a scalar EPI bound. These comparisons distinguish nonzero forcing, homogeneous relaxation and clipping without changing the birth history of the causal case.

The tests must reject a claimed zero-pressure profile when b!=0, verify the profile equation and its centered gauge, and account for both pressure and endpoint defects at every captured step. They must also keep a clipped mean change distinct from dt*bar_v and preserve all fixed-support assumptions. Agreement over the measured horizon establishes neither spontaneous selection of the held fields nor restoration under later structural events. Those require an admitted policy that actually changes the support, capacities or phases.
