Reception never resets this counter, and AL has priority when both lags exceed their limits. Hence each block receives an AL in every six consecutive successful calls. No assumption about a periodic phase controller or an externally supplied word is needed.

Write Delta_n for the width of the inherited phase lift at call n. These three event types write no phase. The coordinator diameter bound gives

g_min=PHASE_ADAPT['kG_min']>0,       rho=1-g_min in (0,1),
Delta_(n+1)<=rho*Delta_n,
F0=delta*nu*(w_phase/pi_rep)*Delta_0,
||f_n||_infinity<=F0*rho^n,
sum_(n>=0) ||f_n||_infinity<=F=F0/g_min.

Use the stored gain floor, not its nominal pi-based expression. The shared default controller clamps the updated gain above that floor for every branch. The proof only bounds phase forcing; it does not set it to zero or identify it as an emitted form input. Gamma being zero during flow likewise does not remove the separate hybrid Emission jumps.

Within a six-call block, each coordinate has its own AL input at some position. At most five subsequent matrices follow it. Their diagonal entries retain at least

J=b_AL*lambda^5>0

of that input in its original coordinate. All other propagated emission contributions are nonnegative. Products of the stochastic matrices preserve the incoming minimum and bound the negative phase contribution in sup norm. Therefore, for any prefix that keeps the stated affine domain,

min_i M_(6K,i) >= min_i M_(0,i) + K*J
                 - F0*(1-rho^(6K))/(1-rho)
              >= min_i M_(0,i) + K*J - F.

The factor lambda^5 is a conservative self-contribution bound. It requires neither equal lag phases across blocks nor a particular Reception schedule. The phase sum may oppose the increase, but cannot offset an unlimited number of positive six-call contributions.

docs.title: A strict-margin deadline and a separate closed-rail conclusion
docs.text:
Let D be the retained internal-form radius and U=x_max-D. For an initially admitted source define the exact integer bound

K_star=ceil((U-min_i M_(0,i)+F)/J),
N_star=6*K_star.

The initial strict margin ensures K_star>=1. If all N_star calls were margin-preserving, the preceding inequality would imply min_i M_(N_star,i)>=U, contradicting their strict upper margin. The first failed margin check is consequently no later than invocation N_star, unless another premise fails earlier. An event-stage or lower-rail margin may fail much earlier. Equality already exits this certificate, which is why the integer operation is a ceiling rather than a strict round-up. The expression is an upper bound, not the first-exit time or a numerical continuation through that time.

Shrinking a conservative D alone cannot sustain an indefinitely unclipped continuation. While every actual event and flow clip remains inactive, the same affine mean recurrence holds even for nonzero internal contrasts, and the means remain in the closed rails. With

K_closed=floor((x_max-min_i M_(0,i)+F)/J)+1,
N_closed=6*K_closed,

it would instead force min_i M_(N_closed,i)>x_max. The strict inequality matters for this closed-rail argument. It does not require zero fine contrast, but it also does not evaluate the runtime once clipping occurs. Clipping need not destroy every aggregate representation: the exactly paired form sector can still commute. A bounded piecewise continuation has different equations from the affine law proved here.

docs.title: Exact static controls on the retained source
docs.text:
The horizon controls check the matrix mechanism with exact fractions for all 3^5 ordered AL/EN/IL assignments. They distinguish the true held-flow matrix from diffusion of the post-event state and check a negative diagonal beyond the stated monotonicity domain. Actual selector snapshots independently check lag thresholds and priority without executing event or flow sequences. Exact integer controls distinguish the strict-margin ceiling from the closed-rail strict round-up. No long native path or frozen response is replayed to obtain the bound.

For the already declared transition source, use nu=1/2, D=1/64, min M_0=3/16 and Delta_0=1/8 with unchanged defaults. Exact fractions of the resolved represented coefficients give the following displayed approximations and exact integer conclusions:

lambda ~= 0.752823447607,
J      ~= 0.019242248648,
F      ~= 0.074470176894,
K_star=46,       N_star=276,       delta*N_star=17.25,
K_closed=47,     N_closed=282,     delta*N_closed=17.625.

Thus the strict affine certificate cannot survive 276 complete ideal calls on that source. The closed-rail comparison separately excludes 282 calls with all clipping inactive and the other premises retained. These times are structural-clock durations, not laboratory seconds. The arithmetic checks do not certify accumulated floating-point or circular-lift errors; the existing one-call numerical evidence remains at its frozen horizon.

The result identifies a consequence of positive recurrent Emission in this configured native sublanguage. It establishes neither a universal TNFR lifetime nor dissolution, physical identity or failure of a clipped collective model. Valid finite transition results and their earlier admission margins remain intact.

docs.title: Continuation through hard clipping with retained internal spread
docs.text:
Conditional result. The same selected uniform-capacity primary dynamics has an ideal continuation through hard clipping when each block retains its mean M_i and unsigned internal contrast s_i=|d_i|. Means alone do not determine the successor on an actual Emission (AL) clipping branch. The extended description removes independent twin labels; it retains two continuous form coordinates per block and is not another dimension-reducing collective NFR. No new operator, pressure law or executor is introduced.

Keep the support, common positive capacity, paired phases, common kind, duplicated grammar/lag context, complete-pair target order, default selector, one held Euler interval, zero Gamma and REMESH guard of the selected transition. Replace its strict unclipped margin by the exact closed-rail admission

L=x_min, U=x_max, L<U,
L<=M_i-s_i<=M_i+s_i<=U,      s_i>=0.

All other consumed state and temporal evidence must still be valid. The argument concerns ideal stage formulas with resolved represented factors; it asserts neither binary64 permutation invariance nor a validated long trajectory. The previous horizon does not locate the first clipping event or prove that any chosen boundary control is reached from the frozen source.

docs.title: The exact pair projection and its branches
docs.text:
Let c(v)=max(L,min(U,v)) be the existing hard projection. For r>=0, define two observations of a projected pair:

C(a,r)=(c(a-r)+c(a+r))/2,
S(a,r)=(c(a+r)-c(a-r))/2.

They obey S>=0, L<=C-S<=C+S<=U and S<=r. Put v_-=a-r, v_+=a+r. The following branches are identities of this scalar map; overlapping equality boundaries give the same result.

Endpoint domain C(a,r) S(a,r) v_+<=L L 0 v_-<=L<=v_+<=U (L+v_+)/2 (v_+-L)/2 L<=v_-<=v_+<=U a r L<=v_-<=U<=v_+ (v_-+U)/2 (U-v_-)/2 U<=v_- U 0 v_-<=L and U<=v_+ (L+U)/2 (U-L)/2

This is a derived branch description, not a second implementation of the runtime clipping contract. Its shared owner remains structural_clip. Not every algebraic branch is reachable in the selected sector: event clipping is restricted below, and the contraction bound excludes strict opposite-rail saturation by one flow step.

docs.title: Ordered events and the incoming pressure association
docs.text:
At the start of a call, orient each pair for the calculation as

x_(i,-)=M_i-s_i,          x_(i,+)=M_i+s_i,
p_(i,-)=B_i+k*s_i,       p_(i,+)=B_i-k*s_i,
B_i=k*(N_i(M)-M_i)+(w_phase/pi_rep)*(N_i(mu)-mu_i).

This orientation is a representative of an unordered pair. The pressure is independently prepared by the existing map; it is not reconstructed from clipped motion. During the ordered event sweep, let Y_i,T_i be the completed event mean and nonnegative half-difference. With incoming Y_i=M_i for blocks not yet visited, the event rows are

AL: a_i=M_i+b_AL,                  A_i=1,     H_i=1,
EN: a_i=(1-m)*M_i+m*N_i(live Y),    A_i=1-m,   H_i=1,
IL: a_i=M_i,                       A_i=1,     H_i=h,
(Y_i,T_i)=(C(a_i,A_i*s_i), S(a_i,A_i*s_i)).

The two twins are nonadjacent and have identical neighboring pairs. The first twin therefore does not alter the second twin's Reception (EN) inputs. Later blocks consume the completed projected means, including earlier Emission clipping; replacing those means by unclipped event proposals would change the ordered map.

Emission has positive boost and admitted incoming forms, so only its upper clip can be active. It has three event regimes: no active clip when M_i+b_AL+s_i<=U, one-sided clipping when M_i+b_AL-s_i<U<M_i+b_AL+s_i, and full upper saturation when U<=M_i+b_AL-s_i. In contrast, Reception is a convex blend of admitted live forms because 0<m<1. It cannot actively clip outside the common rails in this ideal domain. Coherence (IL) leaves form unchanged and multiplies held pressure by h; it performs no form projection itself. The compact pair formula for IL simply returns its admitted input.

The actual held-pressure flow then gives the raw pair center and signed half-difference

u_i=Y_i+delta*nu*H_i*B_i,
v_i=T_i-z*H_i*s_i,       z=delta*nu*k,
M_i'=C(u_i,abs(v_i)),    s_i'=S(u_i,abs(v_i)).

The subtraction consumes incoming s_i, not the event spread T_i. The raw constituent values are u_i-v_i and u_i+v_i, associated with the initially lower and upper form respectively. v_i can be negative: full Emission saturation has T_i=0, yet held pressure can recreate a spread and reverse that ordering during flow. Replacing s_i by T_i would lose this response. Taking abs(v_i) in the final symmetric pair projection is legitimate; discarding the incoming association before forming v_i is not. A mid-call continuation would need to retain the incoming held pressure information explicitly.

These formulas reproduce the fine constituent map, rather than a newly refreshed pressure step. In particular the stored rates remain nu*H_i*(B_i +/- k*s_i) even when clipping changes realized motion. Neither their constituent values nor their mean generally equal the observed endpoint secants after clipping.

docs.title: Complete-call closure and its limits
docs.text:
Independent twin exchanges preserve the same pairs and support. Choices remain default Coherence except for the retained lag overrides, because uniform capacity keeps fresh Si above the default upper threshold. Common nonempty grammar admits the same selected glyphs, and shared kind removes Reception's dependence on constituent kind selection. Saturated Emission still records its glyph, advances its local ordinal and resets its lag, even when it changes no form.

Neither event clipping nor integration changes primitive phases or capacity in this sublanguage. Duplicated phases and grammar proportions therefore give the same phase-controller inputs as before; common gains and the phase hull are preserved. Snapshot capacity adaptation still has the globally uniform capacity as a fixed point, independently of unequal Si, qualification and stability counters. The short-history REMESH guard also remains in force.

Let q_s retain the former primary context together with (M_i,s_i). The preceding formulas define a unique ideal primary map F_s satisfying

q_s(F_f(state))=F_s(q_s(state))

for every admitted completion in this domain. Its forms stay in the closed rails by construction. Complete histories, old rates, clipping telemetry and individual adaptation decisions remain outside this claim; their validity is still required where execution consumes them. In particular, a changed event form can restart timestamped history while a saturated unchanged twin retains its earlier samples. That difference does not affect this selected primary map, but matters for other operators. Independent twin exchange is not arbitrary relabeling, nor a quotient of every complete runtime output. The inherited execution restrictions still apply to any iterated use of the map.

The unchanged ordinary coarse runtime is the invariant slice s_i=0. It uses c(a_i) for each event and c(Y_i+delta*nu*H_i*B_i) for flow. On that slice these are exactly the extended map above. With nonzero spread, equality can hold on some branches, including the previous unclipped domain, but it does not hold universally.

docs.title: A branch-specific obstruction to means alone
docs.text:
An exact family separates the descriptions under actual default factors. Use uniform incoming means M_i=U-b_AL, uniform phase, nu=1/2, delta=1/16 and the admitted common context with lag choices AL,EN,IL,IL,IL. Then every incoming B_i=0. Compare zero internal spread with s_0=epsilon, all other spreads zero, where 0<epsilon<min(b_AL,U-L-b_AL). These are conditional in-rail boundary states, not acquired sources or evaluated trajectories.

At block zero, Emission produces the pair U-epsilon,U, so Y_0=U-epsilon/2 and T_0=epsilon/2. Since the default 0<z<1/2, the held-flow endpoints are

U-(1-z)*epsilon,      U-z*epsilon.

Both are in the rails, and the successor mean is U-epsilon/2. The ordinary coarse successor is instead U. At adjacent block one, live Reception propagates the difference: its mean is below the coarse mean by m*epsilon/4; its zero incoming mean pressure does not remove it. Thus a continuously variable internal spread changes the complete-call mean with every other retained mean/context fixed. Some information about that spread is necessary on this branch. This local necessity does not assert a globally minimal coordinate system or identify an emergent NFR.

docs.title: Internal spread contracts even at clipping
docs.text:
Hard projection is monotone and one-Lipschitz. The event spread satisfies 0<=T_i<=A_i*s_i, and the final projection gives

s_i'<=abs(T_i-z*H_i*s_i)
    <=max(z*H_i,abs(A_i-z*H_i))*s_i.

The default bounds established in the horizon proof give 0<z<min(1/2,1-m) throughout the positive capacity domain. For AL, the last maximum is 1-z. For EN the event never clips, so its sharper factor is 1-m-z. For IL the factor is 1-z*h. Hence, for the fixed common positive capacity of a continuation,

s_i'<=q*s_i,       q=1-z*h in (0,1),
s_(n,i)<=q^n*s_(0,i)

on every admitted ideal prefix. There is no capacity-independent strict contraction floor as nu approaches zero. The same bound and s_i<=(U-L)/2 imply abs(v_i)<(U-L)/2; strict simultaneous clipping to opposite rails cannot occur in the flow of this sector. The generic branch table above does not manufacture such an event.

This contraction concerns the two constituents within each block. It does not determine the limiting block means, establish tracking by one ordinary coarse trajectory, or prove a persistent nonuniform organization. Small local discrepancy cannot replace a cumulative comparison argument.

docs.title: Static controls and evidence boundary
docs.text:
The clipping controls compare independent exact constituent formulas with the pair map on fixed partial-saturation, full-saturation and zero-spread cases, including all 32 independent twin orientations. Separate branch controls exercise the shared scalar clip contract. The family above tests a specified difference in final means and its propagation through live Reception; full saturation tests pressure-induced spread recovery and order reversal. Radius bounds are checked against constituent half-differences. Separate lower- and upper-rail flow cases check the active projection and its mean correction.

These are algebraic controls and isolated scalar/proposal checks. Native trajectory execution and frozen response replay are blocked. They do not extend the earlier one-call numerical response or certify when the original source enters clipping. The result resolves the continuation question for this configured primary model; it does not derive clipping, the selector or these constitutive choices as unique laws of TNFR.

docs.title: Upper-rail limit of the selected native sector
docs.text:
Conditional theorem. Every indefinitely admitted ideal continuation of the clipped uniform-capacity sector satisfies x_(i,-) -> U, x_(i,+) -> U and therefore M_i -> U. No persistent nonzero form contrast within or between blocks survives in this sector. The conclusion follows from the unchanged positive recurrent Emission (AL), convex Reception (EN), held-pressure flow, hard rails and decaying phase forcing. It is a saturation result for this supplied policy, not an exclusion of other TNFR organizations or constitutive laws.

Keep all preceding execution and admission premises, including common positive capacity, fixed delta=1/16, paired phases in the common short lift, strict admitted grammar, complete-pair event order and REMESH abstention. The theorem is conditional on indefinite ideal admission; it does not assert indefinitely representable clocks, histories or binary64 arithmetic. No native trajectory or frozen response is evaluated here.

docs.title: Fine deficits retain both pressure stages
docs.text:
Use individual constituent indices j, not only block means. Write

R=U-L>0,       y_j=U-x_j in [0,R],       D_n=max_j y_(n,j),
b=b_AL>0,     z=delta*nu*k,              lambda=1-m-z>0.

N_j denotes the mean over the four fine neighbors. Because the support has unit conductance and is regular, the EPI pressure and Reception use this same averaging map. Its phase contribution remains the admitted paired-phase term. The phase bound supplies

F_n=F0*rho^n,
F0=delta*nu*(w_phase/pi_rep)*Delta_0,       0<rho<1.

The form displacement f_(n,j) contributed by phase pressure in a held step has abs(f_(n,j))<=F_n, since its retention H_j is either one or h<1. This is a forcing bound, not an assumption that the phase term vanishes at a finite call. No internal-spread approximation is used in this proof.

The event sweep acts on deficits as follows:

AL: y_j^E=max(y_j-b,0),
EN: y_j^E=(1-m)*y_j+m*N_j(live event deficits),
IL: y_j^E=y_j.

Every target is visited once. Emission cannot increase a deficit, and Reception is convex, so every live event deficit is at most the incoming D_n. The subsequent held-pressure flow is exactly

y_j'=clip_[0,R](y_j^E-z*H_j*y_j+z*H_j*N_j(incoming y)-f_(n,j)).

The neighbor values in the event and flow terms belong to different stages. Clipping an Emission event does not refresh the prepared pressure.

docs.title: One-call bounds without a monotone-map assumption
docs.text:
The complete clipped map is not generally order-preserving. For example, use the default rails [-1,1], zero internal spread, uniform phase and neighbors of block zero at form zero and the default positive boost. Compare its incoming forms M_a=U-b/2 and M_b=U-b/4 under the same AL request. Both events saturate at U, while their incoming mean pressures are -k*M_a and -k*M_b. The resulting in-rail flow forms are U-z*M_a and U-z*M_b; increasing the input decreases that output by z*b/4. Thus the unclipped stochastic matrix cannot simply be reused as a global clipped-map comparison.

Instead, bound each actual scalar row. At Emission, separate the two branches y_j>=b and y_j<b before final projection. They give

y_j'<=max(D_n-b,z*D_n)+F_n <= a*D_n+F_n,
a=max(1-b/R,z) in (0,1).

Indeed, the first branch is bounded by (1-z)*D_n+z*D_n-b, and the second by z*D_n. Since D_n<=R, D_n-b<=(1-b/R)*D_n. The maximum is nonnegative, so projection to [0,R] preserves the upper bound, including when the unprojected deficit is negative.

For Reception and Coherence respectively, the same stage distinction gives

EN: y_j'<=lambda*y_j+(1-lambda)*D_n+F_n,
IL: y_j'<=(1-z*h)*y_j+z*h*D_n+F_n.

Both coefficients retaining the target's incoming deficit are positive and at least lambda: 1-z*h>=1-m-z. The right-hand sides are nonnegative, so the final projection is again harmless for these upper bounds. In particular all three cases imply

D_(n+1)<=D_n+F_n.

This estimate allows temporary increases in the largest deficit; it does not assume that every form increases at every call.

docs.title: A strict improvement in every six-call block
docs.text:
Fix a block of six calls starting at n, and define its accumulated forcing allowance

E_j=sum_(r=0)^(j-1) F_(n+r),       E_0=0.

The running maximum is bounded by D_(n+j)<=D_n+E_j. The actual lag policy gives each constituent exactly one accepted Emission in those six calls, even from an arbitrary admitted initial lag. If its Emission is at offset j, its next deficit satisfies

y_(n+j+1)<=a*(D_n+E_j)+F_(n+j)
         <=D_n+E_(j+1)-(1-a)*D_n.

There are at most five later calls in the block, and none is another Emission at that target. For either of the remaining choices, a gap g below the running allowance is retained by at least lambda*g. The next forcing contribution is included in the next allowance. Thus every constituent ends the block at most D_n+E_6-(1-a)*lambda^5*D_n, and

D_(n+6)<=Q*D_n+sum_(r=0)^5 F_(n+r),
Q=1-(1-a)*lambda^5 in (0,1).

This argument uses the true per-target lag recurrence and scalar row bounds. It does not require synchronized lag phases, conservation of total form, or monotonicity of the complete transition. In particular it remains valid when an Emission saturates and held pressure subsequently moves the same form away from the rail.

docs.title: Convergence along an indefinitely admitted ideal continuation
docs.text:
Set tau=rho^6 and A=F0*sum_(r=0)^5 rho^r. Iterating the block bound gives, for K>=1,

D_(6K)<=Q^K*D_0+A*sum_(j=0)^(K-1) Q^(K-1-j)*tau^j.

For Q!=tau the sum is (Q^K-tau^K)/(Q-tau); when Q=tau it is K*Q^(K-1). Both tend to zero because 0<Q,tau<1. The K=0 sum is empty. For intervening calls 0<=r<6,

D_(6K+r)<=D_(6K)+F0*rho^(6K)*sum_(j=0)^(r-1) rho^j.

Consequently D_n -> 0 along the entire admitted continuation, proving the stated constituent and block-mean limits. The internal spread contraction is consistent with this result but was not needed to replace fine dynamics by an approximate mean law.

The phase coordinator preserves nested closed lift intervals with width at most rho^n*Delta_0. Their intersection is one angle, so all primitive phases converge to that common lifted angle. Common capacity remains fixed. The specified pressure therefore tends to zero as both form and phase differences vanish.

At exactly uniform upper-rail form and common phase, the primary nodal coordinates remain stationary under each selected AL/EN/IL event and held flow. The nominal Emission proposal still adds b; its realized clipped form increment is zero. Operator occurrences, lag counters, runtime ordinals and the structural clock can continue advancing. The theorem neither identifies the complete execution state with a fixed point nor erases its retained policy memory.

docs.title: Static evidence and research consequence
docs.text:
The limit controls check the two Emission branches, the separate incoming/live neighbor bounds, the nonmonotone saturated control, six-call allowance propagation and both forms of the geometric convolution. These are exact static comparison calculations, not executed histories. The upper-rail primary state has separate stationary-coordinate checks. Runtime and integrator execution are blocked, and earlier evaluated responses remain unchanged.

This closes the limiting-organization question for this configured sector. It excludes a persistent nonuniform form or primitive-phase pattern there, but not finite transients, retained support, semantic identity or policy memory. It gives no finite saturation time or laboratory prediction and does not certify asymptotic binary64 behavior. A sustained organization outside this conclusion must fail at least one of the declared premises; changing one merely to obtain a preferred result would require a separate model and justification.

docs.title: Capacity adaptation preserves saturation in a nonzero neighborhood
docs.text:
Conditional theorem. The preceding upper-rail limit is robust to a derived nonzero range of initial fine capacities, with the actual capacity adaptation enabled. All adaptation gates eventually qualify permanently; capacities converge to a common positive value, fine forms to U, and primitive phases to one common lifted angle. Gate qualification is proved before consensus is used. This excludes persistent form/phase contrast in this larger sector; it does not identify particles or a universal TNFR law.

Retain the preceding doubled unit C5, direct native default policy, delta=1/16, zero Gamma, hard rails, paired phases in the common short lift, common kind, duplicated grammar/lag contexts, complete-pair event order, strict admission and REMESH abstention. Replace uniform capacity by

0 < v_- <= nu_j(0) <= v_+ <= V < VF_MAX,
epsilon=v_+-v_-,
alpha*v_-/v_+ > si_hi.

Here V is a fixed conservative upper envelope, alpha the resolved Si capacity weight, and si_hi the common default selection/adaptation threshold. Capacities may differ within pairs. Retain all consumed fine state, including valid nonnegative stability counts. This is a fine-state theorem, not an extension of the smaller uniform-capacity quotient.

Use the resolved represented coefficients as exact constants in the ideal model, rather than replacing them by intended decimal or symbolic values:

c=w_vf>0,  k=w_epi>0,  ell=w_phase/pi_rep,
Z=delta*V*k,  lambda=1-m-Z>0,
a=max(1-b/(U-L),Z),  Q=1-(1-a)*lambda^5,
C(V)=c*(1+6*Z/(1-Q)).

The default parameters give 0<Z<min(1/2,1-m) and 0<a,Q<1 throughout this capacity range. The additional sufficient restriction is strict:

C(V)*epsilon < EPS_DNFR_STABLE.

It is not a necessary boundary of convergence. Failure of this sufficient inequality leaves the behavior undecided.

docs.title: Invariant selection with arbitrary eligible adaptation subsets
docs.text:
The actual capacity adapter proposes (1-mu)*nu_j+mu*N_j(nu) from one immutable snapshot at eligible nodes and leaves the other capacities unchanged. Its admitted coefficients make every proposal convex. Thus any subset of eligible writes preserves the initial capacity hull; this does not yet prove consensus or conservation of the initial mean.

Fresh Si has nonnegative components and satisfies Si_j>=alpha*nu_j/max_l(nu_l)>=alpha*v_-/v_+>si_hi. The default selector therefore proposes Coherence (IL); the retained lags override it only by Emission (AL) or Reception (EN). These three direct events preserve capacity. This establishes an induction across complete calls: selection preserves the hull before adaptation, and adaptation preserves it afterward. No later selection or successful adaptation is assumed in advance. Unequal capacities or stability counts do not break paired choices in this high-Si sector. Phase coordination consumes no capacity and preserves the inherited paired-phase contraction.

docs.title: A pressure bound before permanent qualification
docs.text:
At each call, the held flow uses its own incoming capacity, with z_(n,j)=delta*nu_(n,j)*k<=Z. The pressure capacity channel is the signed neighbor contrast c*(N_j(nu)-nu_j), not a normalized contrast. Hull preservation bounds its magnitude by c*epsilon under every eligible mask. Keep D_n=max_j(U-x_(n,j)) and the preceding phase diameter bound Delta_n<=rho^n*Delta_0. The two form forcing allowances are

F_n=delta*V*ell*Delta_0*rho^n,
G=delta*V*c*epsilon.

The pressure retained by a selected event is multiplied by H_j=1 or h<1. The fine-deficit proof therefore applies with variable z_(n,j)<=Z: Emission gives at most a*D_n+F_n+G; subsequent Reception or Coherence retains a target's gap below the running allowance by at least lambda. Every constituent still has one accepted Emission in every six-call window. Consequently, for every starting call n,

D_(n+6) <= Q*D_n + sum_(r=0)^5 F_(n+r) + 6*G.

Iterate on each of the six residue classes. The initial term and geometric phase convolution vanish; the constant forcing sum is bounded by 6*G/(1-Q). Thus

limsup_(n->infinity) D_n <= 6*G/(1-Q).

No additional allowance for intervening calls is needed because the same recurrence holds on every residue class. Neither capacity convergence nor a nonempty eligible mask has been used.

The freshly prepared pressure satisfies

max_j abs(p_(n,j)) <= k*D_n+c*epsilon+ell*Delta_n.

Indeed, all incoming forms lie in [U-D_n,U], so their difference from a neighbor mean is at most D_n, not 2*D_n. Regular support removes the topology contrast. Applying the preceding bound gives

limsup_(n->infinity) max_j abs(H_j*p_(n,j)) <= C(V)*epsilon
                                                   < EPS_DNFR_STABLE.

This is the pressure actually consumed by adaptation: prepared pressure after its glyph retention, without refresh after flow or phase coordination. The adapter also consumes the incoming prepared Si, whose strict floor already holds. The strict limiting pressure margin implies that from some finite call onward both gates qualify at every node on every call. An equality at the threshold would not suffice: the abstract sequence EPS_DNFR_STABLE+1/(n+1) approaches the threshold without ever passing. This is a counterexample to that limiting inference, not a native response.

docs.title: Permanent averaging and a vanishing forcing remainder
docs.text:
Qualification increments each stability count; a successful write does not reset it. After at most VF_ADAPT_TAU further qualifying calls, all nodes therefore update on every call. With mu=VF_ADAPT_MU and the fixed fine neighbor-mean matrix N, the ideal recurrence becomes

nu_(n+1)=P*nu_n,        P=(1-mu)*I+mu*N.

On the doubled unit C5, P is doubly stochastic. The entries of P^2 in each row have four classes:

Target relative to the row node Count Entry Same node 1 (1-mu)^2+mu^2/4 Its twin 1 mu^2/4 Adjacent blocks 4 mu*(1-mu)/2 Nonadjacent blocks 4 mu^2/8

For the actual default 0<mu<4/5, all entries are at least eta=mu^2/8>0. Subtracting eta from every entry leaves a nonnegative matrix with each row sum 1-10*eta. Its constant component cancels in differences, proving directly

osc(P^2*nu) <= (1-10*eta)*osc(nu),       0<1-10*eta<1.

Hence capacities converge to one positive value in the initial hull. Double stochasticity preserves the mean once full updating starts. The limit is that mean, not necessarily the initial mean: earlier partial writes need not conserve total capacity. No externally selected target capacity or physical scale follows.

Now the actual width epsilon_n=osc(nu_n) tends to zero. Replace G in the six-call bound by the actual per-call allowance G_n=delta*V*c*epsilon_n. Both phase and capacity forcing vanish. For each residue class, a recurrence with uniform Q<1 and a vanishing nonnegative remainder tends to zero: split its geometric convolution into a finite initial part and a tail bounded by the remainder supremum divided by 1-Q. Therefore D_n->0. The inherited nested phase intervals converge to one angle, and the complete prepared pressure tends to zero.

docs.title: An explicit nonzero neighborhood without source search
docs.text:
Set v0=1/2 and use the conservative envelope Vbar=1. Compute Cbar from C(Vbar) above and define

r_star=min(v0/2,
           v0*(alpha-si_hi)/(2*(alpha+si_hi)),
           EPS_DNFR_STABLE/(4*Cbar)).

Every term is positive under the unchanged defaults. For any fine initial capacities in [v0-r_star,v0+r_star], the lower endpoint is positive and the upper is at most 3/4<Vbar<VF_MAX. The second term leaves a strict Si margin; the width is at most 2*r_star, so the limiting pressure bound is at most half the stability threshold. The construction admits arbitrary fine forms within the inherited rails and retains the other phase, grammar, history and execution premises. It selects no response, trajectory, natural scale or new law.

The capacity robustness controls check the derived threshold with exact represented coefficients, masked hull and mean behavior, isolated actual counter/write transitions and the exact averaging contraction. They do not execute a native trajectory or replay earlier frozen evidence. The proof is conditional on indefinitely admitted ideal execution. Finite arithmetic can reach rounding stasis; indefinite counter/clock representability, a finite consensus time, full runtime stationarity, collective formation and physical identification remain outside this result.

docs.title: Native collective calculus
docs.text: This owner combines conditional moment identities, finite admission margins and bounded collective observations for the general native operator runtime. The source and branch studies own the underlying preparations and counterexamples. These are detached mathematical descriptions of the declared execution path, not a new runtime or a derived occurrence law. The aggregate transition owner separately proves a restricted lossy reduction under the actual uniform-capacity native policy, retaining its admission margins and discarded-output boundary. The research program remains the sole research queue.

docs.title: Conditional collective calculus for five native operators
docs.text:
Emission (AL), Reception (EN), Coherence (IL), Resonance (RA) and Transition (NAV) share an exact conditional event-plus-held-flow description on doubled C5. Unequal constituent forms are allowed. The event mean and internal contrast have distinct roles; the complete native state also retains constituent-associated memory. This synthesis reuses the block descent, four-operator extension, Transition map and correlated Reception results. It does not assert that the default selector realizes every assignment of these operators.

Domain and request origin. Keep the block-descent execution premises: unit undirected doubled C5, consecutive nonadjacent twins, whole-pair order, default mixed pressure/Si and direct glyph execution, strict live grammar, hard clipping, live built-in zero Gamma and one Euler substep delta=1/16. No external nodes, custom callbacks, optional mathematics engine or optional Resonance tracking are included. Automatic REMESH must independently abstain; insufficient retained stable_frac history is one sufficient reason. It is not removed from the law. Each node receives exactly one effective request.

Forms are finite admitted signed scalars (including admitted uniform-real BEPI), with common nonempty semantic kind. Capacities are positive and paired; primitive phases are paired and admit an inherited common lift of width less than pi. Every proposed event and flow form lies strictly inside its rails. Post-Resonance capacities also lie inside their rails: integration uses the amplified value before the later clamp. Consumed histories, counters, rates, clocks, normalized diagnostics and produced arithmetic retain their admission. The equations below are ideal-real identities over represented coefficients, not universal binary64 enclosures.

Both effective requests in each pair must agree and pass their own live grammar, identity and operator gates. Retain their actual origin, including selection preparation and the increment-before-comparison AL/EN lag priority. A supplied paired transcript can test the algebra conditionally; it is neither a default-selector witness nor a derived occurrence law. Prepared requests can differ within a pair because its pressures and Si differ. Rejection is sequential: a successful first twin or earlier pair is not rolled back by a later rejection. The theorem concerns successful complete calls.

Prepared pressure. Write each incoming pair as

x_(2i)=M_i-d_i,                  x_(2i+1)=M_i+d_i,
N_i(z)=(z_(i-1)+z_(i+1))/2,
B_i=w_phase*(N_i(theta)-theta_i)/pi_rep
    +k*(N_i(M)-M_i)+b*(N_i(V)-V_i),
p_(2i)=B_i+k*d_i,                p_(2i+1)=B_i-k*d_i.

Here k=w_epi>0, b=w_vf, and the common arc justifies the neighbor-resultant midpoint. Regular support makes degree contrast zero. Preparation fixes this independent pressure before any event. Its actual global normalization peak is P=max_i(abs(B_i)+k*abs(d_i)), with divisor one only when P=0. Si also consumes individual absolute pressure, paired capacity divided by its maximum, and circular phase offset. The diagnostics are generally non-affine; means alone do not determine selection or stability qualification.

One ordered event table. Initialize live means, phases and capacities with M,theta,V, then process blocks 0..4. Each block is still at its incoming state when its pair begins; earlier pairs have updated its neighbors. Denote its event mean by Y_i, event contrast by A_i*d_i, event capacity by U_i, and event phase by phi_i. Let H_i be its pressure multiplier and g_i,zeta_i the extra pressure mean/contrast. The following are moment identities, not a parallel operator registry:

Registered action Y_i A_i H_i g_i zeta_i Emission (AL) M_i+e 1 1 0 0 Reception (EN) (1-m)*M_i+m*N_i(live Y) 1-m 1 0 0 Coherence (IL) M_i 1 h 0 0 Resonance (RA) (1-r)*M_i+r*S_i 1-r 1 0 0 Transition (NAV) M_i 1 1-eta eta*sigma_i*V_i+xi_bar_i xi_delta_i

Use the actual default factors e=AL_boost, m=EN_mix, h=IL_dnfr_factor, r=RA_epi_diff, eta=NAV_eta. Except for Resonance, U_i=V_i and phi_i=theta_i. Live neighbor averages include earlier event changes but never refresh B_i or its incoming contrast. Nonadjacent twins share the same live neighbor input, so their two fine proposals yield these moments. Equality holds after each complete pair, not at its singleton prefix.

For Resonance, with the actual U3 limit L and current paired phases, define

J_i={j in {i-1,i+1}: abs(wrap(phi_j-phi_i))<=L},
S_i=mean_(j in J_i)(live Y_j),
alpha_i=Arg(sum_(j in J_i) exp(i*phi_j)),
phi_i=theta_i+c*wrap(alpha_i-theta_i),
U_i=(1+a*I(abs(S_i)>T))*V_i.

Here c=RA_phase_coupling, a=RA_vf_amplification, and T is the represented runtime amplification trigger. Require nonempty J_i; the common arc then makes the selected resultant defined. Recompute this subset at the live prefix. Pairwise phase equality selects whole adjacent blocks, but it does not justify selecting every neighbor or freezing the preparation-time subset. Both fine sign identities must pass, not merely the mean sign identity. Zero is neutral under the actual sign contract; the common kind remains explicit. Amplification reads the selected signed mean, not mean absolute constituent magnitude. Outside this domain an empty subset rejects, and an undefined resultant requires the engine's separate phase policy; neither is an arbitrary assigned angle.

For Transition use the default nonstrict random path, with common strict prepared pressure sign sigma_i:

sigma_i*B_i>k*abs(d_i),
xi_bar_i=(xi_(2i)+xi_(2i+1))/2,
xi_delta_i=(xi_(2i+1)-xi_(2i))/2,
abs(xi_bar_i)+abs(xi_delta_i)<=NAV_jitter.

Each innovation is its actual target-associated stream input. Both fine nonidentity gates require eta*(sigma_i*V_i-p_n)+xi_n!=0. Common sign alone does not prove them. The native zero-pressure branch takes positive sign; it is outside this strict-sign sector, not an engine defect. Opposite signs require the two sign contributions separately. Averaging innovations gives the displayed observation, not a replacement RNG law or permission to resample one collective draw.

Held flow and sufficient means. Every row has

q_bar_i=H_i*B_i+g_i,
q_delta_i=-H_i*k*d_i+zeta_i,
M_i_next=Y_i+delta*U_i*q_bar_i,
d_i_next=(A_i-delta*U_i*H_i*k)*d_i+delta*U_i*zeta_i,
rate_bar_i_next=U_i*q_bar_i,
rate_delta_i_next=U_i*q_delta_i.

Subtract the associated prior stored rate and divide by delta to obtain each acceleration moment. The held pressure contains incoming d_i, not event contrast A_i*d_i; replacing the contrast factor by A_i*(1-delta*U_i*H_i*k) changes the model. Post-event capacity U_i is used before later adaptation. Integration does not recompute pressure or Si.

Conditionally on the same admitted paired requests, common Transition signs, innovation means and retained phase/capacity inputs, form/rate means factor through incoming means. Live Resonance subsets, amplification and phase rows then agree by ordered induction. This is useful observation sufficiency; internal contrasts still determine fine reconstruction and joint admission. It does not eliminate histories, old rates, counters, stream association or the actual grammar context. A finite composition uses these rows only while each successor is re-admitted. It is not a complete bare-node stochastic realization or an invariant five-operator sector.

Temporal records and phase policy. Each same-time event form jump is

jump_(2i)=Y_i-M_i-(A_i-1)*d_i,
jump_(2i+1)=Y_i-M_i+(A_i-1)*d_i.

History restarts precisely for the constituent with a realized nonzero jump; its flow endpoint is then appended with the existing four-entry cap. For an EN pair with live neighbor mean n and M_i=n+d_i, the even form already equals n and is unchanged, while the odd form changes by -2*m*d_i. The analogous RA witness has m replaced by r, with its separate admission. Thus a common glyph need not give common temporal-reset status. Do not replace the two admitted histories by one block history. Prior rate association also remains necessary, as the Reception same-form/different-rate witness shows.

The post-event phase coordinator uses the actual full fine glyph histories to compute disruptor load, and the retained global gains and phase resultant. Unequal traces may not be replaced by one representative trace. Given this actual load, paired phases have identical local/global updates. Default gain rails keep the common lifted arc convex and phases paired. This retains primitive circular phase and its inherited lift, not a phase derived from form. Different gain/load branches are allowed; their inputs must remain available.

Capacity exit and hidden counters. Let s_n be the incoming individual stability count and use fresh prepared Si with held post-event pressure:

chi_n=I(Si_pre_n>=si_hi and abs(q_n)<=EPS_DNFR_STABLE),
s_n_next=s_n+1 if chi_n else 0,
due_n=I(s_n_next>=tau),
W_i=N_i(U),
v_n_next=U_i+mu*due_n*(W_i-U_i),          n in {2i,2i+1}.

W comes from the immutable post-event capacity snapshot; fixed-point and hull guards remain in force. In this unclipped ideal-real domain the successor capacity half-contrast is exactly

dV_i_next=mu*(due_(2i+1)-due_(2i))*(W_i-U_i)/2.

Consequently capacity pairing survives exactly when this product vanishes. Equal due flags suffice, but are not necessary at a neighbor fixed point. Zero mixing also annihilates the product algebraically; default mixing is positive. Equal no-write flags do not imply equal qualification or counts: from zero counts, one qualifying constituent can reach one while the other stays zero, with neither write due. A later unequal due decision with nonzero mixing and W_i!=U_i leaves the paired-capacity domain. This is a declared exit, not a contradiction of the form map already evaluated with U_i. Retain both counters even when the capacity values happen to remain paired.

The analytical controls compare independently written fine-node sweeps and collective rows, including live neighbor inputs and held-pressure timing. Detached boundary controls retain Resonance subset/identity/amplification, Transition sign/nonidentity, clipping, split temporal resets and split qualification/write decisions. Production runtime, pressure, selection, operator and integrator evaluation are blocked. The result supplies a reusable conditional calculus without a new trajectory or engine API. It does not prove autonomous request selection, repeated-call retention, formation or physical identification.

docs.title: Finite internal-contrast retention with admission margins
docs.text:
The five-operator calculus gives a finite retention criterion once its actual request and admission boundaries are included. A contracting form contrast alone is insufficient: normalized selection, sign identity, temporal resets and adaptation have independent boundaries. This result concerns transverse form differences at fixed block means, primitive phases and capacities, under that calculus's complete law. It supplies neither an invariant domain for all time nor autonomous formation.

Reference and comparison. Fix a finite independently admitted reference segment, its complete state, structural clock, whole-pair order, grammar, request origin and post-event policies. Its physical form is pair constant, with means M_i; retain every constituent's own history, rate and counter. The comparison has the same means, phases and capacities but forms M_i-d_i,M_i+d_i, with abs(d_i)<=D_i. Its actual temporal histories must end at these forms and pass their own admission. Corresponding glyph traces, debt, prior-Coherence flags, operator ordinals, AL/EN lags, stability counts and global phase gains agree with the reference; they need not agree between the two constituents. Initial rate differences remain associated and are used to reconstruct acceleration. All other calculus premises still apply.

For Transition (NAV), keep each declared innovation mean xi_bar_i and bound the associated half-difference by Z_i, with abs(xi_bar_i)+Z_i<=NAV_jitter. The reference's duplicated mean input is an algebraic comparison within that amplitude domain. It is not automatically a seed-realizable native path. An actual stochastic claim must independently retain and admit each target's stream and draws; do not replace them by a new collective RNG. The concrete reference below uses only Resonance (RA) and Coherence (IL), so it consumes no innovations. Other conditional words retain their supplied origin unless native occurrence is separately proved.

Prepared selection margins. Let B_i be the reference's independently computed pressure, P0=max_i(abs(B_i)) and Dmax=max_i D_i. For P0>0, the exact correlation between pair pressures gives

p_(2i)=B_i+k*d_i,                p_(2i+1)=B_i-k*d_i,
P=max_i(abs(B_i)+k*abs(d_i)),
P0<=P<=P0+k*Dmax,
rho0_i=abs(B_i)/P0,
abs(abs(p_n)/P-rho0_i)<=E_i=k*(D_i+Dmax)/P0.

To prove the last bound, separate the numerator change, at most k*D_i, from the denominator change, at most k*Dmax; use P>=P0 and abs(B_i)<=P0. This does not assume a fixed maximizing node. Intersect [rho0_i-E_i,rho0_i+E_i] with [0,1] to obtain rho_lo,rho_hi. All nonpressure Si terms are identical, so abs(Si_n-Si0_i)<=gamma*E_i. Equivalently, the sharper endpoints are Si0_i-gamma*(rho_hi-rho0_i) and Si0_i-gamma*(rho_lo-rho0_i); call them S_lo,S_hi. These are sufficient enclosures, not independent freedom for Si and pressure.

Retained lag counts first determine the actual higher-priority requests: increment both counts, then force Emission (AL) when its strict lag limit is exceeded, otherwise Reception (EN) when its strict limit is exceeded. Matching counts proves the same override; it does not waive prepared-state admission. Without an override, sufficient conditions for the default selector are:

Reference request Sufficient comparison inequalities Coherence (IL) S_lo>=si_hi Resonance (RA) S_lo>si_lo, S_hi<si_hi, rho_hi<=dnfr_hi Transition (NAV) S_lo>si_lo, S_hi<si_hi, rho_lo>dnfr_hi

These reproduce the actual precedence and strictness; in the intermediate Si band, equality at the pressure threshold selects Resonance. The default path does not apply the parametric selector's score, acceleration decision, hysteresis or soft filters. It still admits and normalizes old acceleration. A possible low-Si request, Mutation abstention or unresolved interval exits this sufficient five-request certificate. It is not silently substituted by Coherence. Original grammar records remain admitted, and live grammar still checks each effective request. No threshold is retuned to obtain agreement.

Live event margins. At block i, previous complete pairs already have their reference means. Consequently all live EN neighbor means, RA selected means and paired phase inputs agree exactly. In particular, a zero selected mean can stay exactly zero under these correlated form perturbations; an arbitrary independent perturbation estimate would discard that information. Live U3 subsets, resultant angles and capacity amplification branches agree with the reference, including an inactive amplification boundary. They must be recomputed at each reference prefix, rather than frozen at preparation.

Use Y_i,A_i,U_i,H_i from the shared event rows. The following sufficient conditions admit both fine proposals:

  • Resonance: abs(M_i)>D_i, M_i*Y_i>0 and abs(Y_i)>abs(A_i)*D_i, with the common retained kind and admitted U3. These nonzero sign margins are sufficient, not necessary. A sign-neutral zero reference form or proposal does not itself give a positive transverse admission radius.
  • Transition: abs(B_i)>k*D_i retains the common strict sign sigma_i. With G_i=eta*(sigma_i*V_i-B_i)+xi_bar_i, require abs(G_i)>eta*k*D_i+Z_i. This keeps both fine pressure changes nonzero; common pressure sign alone does not do so.
  • Form rails: the incoming interval M_i+[-D_i,D_i], event interval Y_i+[-abs(A_i)*D_i,abs(A_i)*D_i] and the flow interval below must all lie strictly inside the admitted rails. Reference post-event capacities and the later capacity proposals must also remain in their declared domain.

No pair transaction is inferred. The margins admit each singleton prefix; failure of a later check does not imply native rollback of an earlier action.

Contrast propagation. Set Z_i=0 outside Transition. Prepared pressure is held through the event and form flow, so

lambda_i=A_i-delta*U_i*H_i*k,
d_i_next=lambda_i*d_i+delta*U_i*xi_delta_i,
D_i_next=abs(lambda_i)*D_i+delta*U_i*Z_i.

The input half-difference is zero for the other four actions. For a finite sequence of admitted calls, write a_(t,i)=abs(lambda_(t,i)) and b_(t,i)=delta*U_(t,i)*Z_(t,i). Induction gives

D_(N,i) = (product_(t=0..N-1) a_(t,i))*D_(0,i)
          +sum_(s=0..N-1) b_(s,i)*product_(t=s+1..N-1) a_(t,i).

An empty product is one. If throughout this finite admitted segment a_(t,i)<=a<1 and b_(t,i)<=b, then D_(N,i)<=a^N*D_(0,i)+b*(1-a^N)/(1-a). This is a conditional finite bound, not a proof that the required branches persist indefinitely. Transition differences supply forcing; even with contracting multipliers, a nonzero forcing budget need not yield convergence to exact constituent equality. Positive capacity alone does not give a horizon-independent rate: some multipliers approach one as capacity approaches zero.

Memory and capacity margins. Let J_i=Y_i-M_i. If J_i!=0, the inequality abs(J_i)>abs(A_i-1)*D_i makes both event jumps nonzero, preserving the reference's reset status. If J_i=0 and A_i=1, both jumps vanish identically. If J_i=0 and A_i!=1, an unknown nonzero contrast can change the reset mask; the matching-history certificate abstains unless this is separately resolved. It does not discard or replace the fine histories. Admitted histories then restart/append by the actual rules, with the existing retention cap.

After the event, write Q_i=H_i*k*D_i+Z_i. The held fine pressures lie in q_bar_i+[-Q_i,Q_i]. The adaptation qualification is certified true when S_lo>=si_hi and abs(q_bar_i)+Q_i<=EPS_DNFR_STABLE; it is certified false when S_hi<si_hi or abs(q_bar_i)-Q_i>EPS_DNFR_STABLE. Otherwise this bound leaves qualification unresolved. The original pressure/Si correlation may support a sharper independent proof; an unresolved enclosure is not an observed execution failure.

Certified matching qualification and the retained individual counts give the same next counts and due decisions as the reference. The immutable capacity snapshot and neighbor means therefore give its same capacity proposals. Reference pairing must itself satisfy the previously derived mu*(due_odd-due_even)*(W-U)=0 condition. Equal capacities alone never replace the counts. Identical glyph traces and global gains give the same phase controller load, branch and updates, preserving the paired phases. REMESH abstention and all requested output/history records remain separately checked.

Finite induction and meaning of failure. At each call, certify prepared selection first, then every live event, flow rails, temporal update and adaptation. Update the reference and contrast bound only after these checks. The shared means, phases, capacities and retained policy context then supply the next induction premise. Store the earliest unresolved boundary if any; do not extrapolate the formula beyond it. Such an outcome rejects this certificate, not every possible collective description. Actual rejection, changed selection and a conservative inconclusive bound remain distinct.

An admitted box with unequal constituents. Reuse the existing live Resonance prefix source with q=15/128, means (q,q,-q,-1/2,-q), capacities (1/4,1/4,1,1,1), zero phases and its original supplied AL/IL/EN context, lags, rates and zero stability counts. Vary only five independent signed half-contrasts in [-1/4096,1/4096]. This is a different domain from unrestricted independent form perturbations: every neighboring complete pair retains its mean.

Let epsilon=k/4096. Exact represented-coefficient bounds give P0>0.0701, epsilon<0.000045 and ratio error below 0.0013 on the whole box. For this source, direct ratio endpoints

max(0,abs(B_i)-epsilon)/(P0+epsilon)
    <=rho_n<=min(1,(abs(B_i)+epsilon)/P0)

give RA ratios below 0.007, RA Si strictly between 0.4307 and 0.4309, and IL Si above 0.94. The original lags force neither AL nor EN. The actual default requests are therefore RA/RA/IL/IL/IL uniformly, before any response is evaluated. Fine corner/axis controls check the algebra independently; these uniform rational inequalities, not corner sampling of non-affine Si, admit the complete box.

The first live RA neighbor mean remains exactly zero. The second becomes -r*q/2, so the first amplification stays inactive and the second active throughout the box. Both fine proposals exceed 0.09, retain their original positive sign/kind, and have event jumps below -0.018. Coherence has no form jump. All event/flow forms have absolute value below 0.6, and all post-event capacities remain interior. Adaptation qualification is false at the RA targets because Si is too low, and false at IL targets because held pressure magnitude exceeds 0.026; thus all counts remain zero. The matched traces preserve phase load/gains and zero phases. No innovation is consumed, and the separately insufficient REMESH history still abstains.

The five contrast factors are positive and strictly below 0.992 (approximately 0.8379833,0.8378694,0.9913168,0.9913168,0.9913168). The comparison consequently retains exactly the reference's terminal block means, phases and capacities, with a strictly smaller bound on internal form differences. Fine pressures, histories, rates and accelerations keep their constituent association. This is a one-call ideal-real box certificate using an existing source; it makes no claim that its successors retain those requests indefinitely or that every box member is a newly acquired state.

The zero-pressure boundary. The positive-peak hypothesis cannot be discarded from the general ratio estimate. Set phases to zero, V=(1/4,1/4,1,1,1) and M_i=-(b/k)*V_i. All forms are negative and interior, and the independent law gives B_i=0 exactly. At zero contrast, each low-capacity pair has rho=0 and Si=alpha/4+beta+gamma, approximately 0.43109; without a lag override, its default request is Resonance. With any sufficiently small nonzero d_0 alone, the peak is k*abs(d_0), both block-zero ratios are one, and Si=alpha/4+beta, approximately 0.37279. Both requests at block zero become Transition; other pairs retain their previous requests. The means, phases, capacities and supplied context have not changed. This proves ideal-real selection discontinuity, not an arbitrarily small binary64 witness or an executed alternative response.

Zero peak does not make every request unstable. A fixed lag override retains its request when the other gates still admit. Likewise, if the nonpressure Si contribution already satisfies alpha*V_i/max(V)+beta*phase_score>=si_hi, the default request remains Coherence for every pressure ratio in [0,1]. Uniform positive capacities and zero phases give this robust case under the defaults. Request robustness alone still does not certify temporal or adaptation branches. These two controls separate a source-specific decision margin from an assumed universal continuity of the normalization policy.

The detached retention controls retain production-execution guards and unchanged earlier source producers. They check uniform enclosures, fine ordered prefixes, associated memory, finite forced-contrast products and explicit boundary failures. No new native trajectory, observation model, occurrence law or engine API is introduced.

docs.title: Joint form and capacity calculus across the adaptation exit
docs.text:
The five-operator description extends through unequal-capacity adaptation if it retains the signed form and capacity contrasts with their constituent association. The new term is the covariance of event capacity and held pressure. It affects the collective mean, including its response to Transition (NAV) innovations. This extends the earlier capacity-feedback identities and joint admission to the shared event calculus; it does not turn an invertible coordinate change into a reduced model.

Domain and sufficient coordinates. Keep the shared calculus's execution premises, including doubled C5, unit conductances, nonadjacent twins, whole-pair order, one direct request per constituent, default preparation/policies, held event pressure, live built-in zero Gamma and one Euler substep delta=1/16. Keep paired primitive phases on their common arc, the common semantic kind, actual request origin, grammar and all associated histories, rates, counters and streams. Automatic REMESH must independently abstain. Supplied conditional transcripts are not default-selection or fixed-seed occurrence certificates.

Replace paired capacities by

x_(2i)=M_i-d_i,                  x_(2i+1)=M_i+d_i,
v_(2i)=V_i-e_i,                  v_(2i+1)=V_i+e_i.

Both capacities must be strictly positive and interior to their rails; in particular V_i>abs(e_i). Zero capacity is admitted by the engine under its own contracts but is outside this theorem. All individual event and flow forms, amplified capacities and adapted capacities remain unclipped and admitted. Exact formulas below are ideal real over represented coefficients; concrete floating execution also needs representable arithmetic. These four coordinates reconstruct the pair's four scalar values exactly. No physical degree of freedom has been eliminated by naming them collective moments.

Fresh pressure and selection. With N_i(z) the adjacent-block mean, the independently supplied mixed law becomes

B_i=w_phase*(N_i(theta)-theta_i)/pi_rep
    +k*(N_i(M)-M_i)+b*(N_i(V)-V_i),
C_i=k*d_i+b*e_i,
p_(2i)=B_i+C_i,                  p_(2i+1)=B_i-C_i,
P=max_i(abs(B_i)+abs(C_i)),       Vmax=max_i(V_i+abs(e_i)).

Neighbor contrasts cancel because each adjacent block contributes both constituents with equal multiplicity. Own capacity contrast still enters pressure. For the corresponding even/odd signs, prepared Si is

phase_term_i=beta*(1-abs(N_i(theta)-theta_i)/pi_rep),
Si_(2i)=alpha*(V_i-e_i)/Vmax+phase_term_i
        +gamma*(1-abs(B_i+C_i)/(P or 1)),
Si_(2i+1)=alpha*(V_i+e_i)/Vmax+phase_term_i
          +gamma*(1-abs(B_i-C_i)/(P or 1)).

Both normalizers therefore require the joint fine association. Rebuild these fields from admitted primitive state before selecting, retain the actual lag priority and validate each live request. Equal means do not imply equal constituent requests. The earlier form-only robustness bounds cannot simply be reused with nonzero e: their capacity and pressure premises have changed.

Shared event rows. Reuse Y_i,A_i,H_i from the five-operator table: event form is Y_i-/+A_i*d_i, and H_i multiplies prepared pressure. Emission (AL), Reception (EN) and Coherence (IL) retain their original rows. Reception and Resonance (RA) still use the ordered live neighbor form means. Let

f_i=1+a*I(abs(S_i)>T) if the request is RA, otherwise 1,
U_i=f_i*V_i,                    E_i=f_i*e_i,
q_bar_i=H_i*B_i+g_i,
q_delta_i=-H_i*C_i+zeta_i.

U_i,E_i are the event capacity mean and half-contrast. Outside Transition, g_i=zeta_i=0. Resonance retains the same live whole-block U3 subset, selected form mean S_i and phase proposal. Its two capacities acquire the same factor, rather than becoming equal. Admit both sign identities (M_i-d_i)*(Y_i-A_i*d_i)>=0 and (M_i+d_i)*(Y_i+A_i*d_i)>=0, the common kind, nonempty subset and every individual post-amplification capacity. Mean identity alone remains insufficient. The first twin does not change the second's live neighbors.

For default nonstrict random Transition with common strict pressure sign,

sigma_i*B_i>abs(C_i),
g_i=eta*sigma_i*V_i+xi_bar_i,
zeta_i=eta*sigma_i*e_i+xi_delta_i,
abs(xi_bar_i)+abs(xi_delta_i)<=NAV_jitter.

The extra eta*sigma_i*e_i is required because each target uses its own capacity. Define G_i=eta*(sigma_i*V_i-B_i)+xi_bar_i and J_i=eta*(C_i+sigma_i*e_i)+xi_delta_i; the two pressure changes are G_i-J_i,G_i+J_i. Both must be nonzero. Opposite or zero prepared signs need their separate native branches, not this common-strict-sign formula. Innovations remain the actual associated inputs; a mean draw cannot replace their target-dependent contribution.

Held flow and the missing mean term. After every complete event pair, the independent fine products give

rate_bar_i=U_i*q_bar_i+E_i*q_delta_i,
rate_delta_i=U_i*q_delta_i+E_i*q_bar_i,
M_i_next=Y_i+delta*rate_bar_i,
d_i_next=A_i*d_i+delta*rate_delta_i.

Subtract associated old rate moments and divide by delta for acceleration. The pressure contrast contains incoming C_i, not the post-event form or capacity contrast. Current flow uses U_i-/+E_i; later adaptation must not be inserted early. Stored Si remains the preparation value even if Resonance has changed the live maximum capacity. A cache update is not a Si refresh.

For Emission, Reception, Coherence and Resonance, the mean rate is f_i*H_i*(V_i*B_i-k*e_i*d_i-b*e_i^2). This recovers the old Coherence covariance and variance terms with the correct event-specific multiplier. For Transition, the expanded mean rate is

(1-eta)*(V_i*B_i-k*e_i*d_i-b*e_i^2)
+eta*sigma_i*(V_i^2+e_i^2)+V_i*xi_bar_i+e_i*xi_delta_i.

Thus capacity variance has a different coefficient in this action. In particular, swapping the two innovations at fixed admitted state and fixed innovation mean reverses xi_delta_i; the corresponding mean-form difference is 2*delta*e_i*xi_delta_i. Innovation means alone were sufficient only in the paired-capacity sector. This is a conditional input-association result, not a new stochastic law or a claim that both assignments occur at one seed.

The exact error of discarding the covariance term in one admitted flow is delta*E_i*q_delta_i. If only abs(d_i)<=D_x, abs(e_i)<=D_v are retained, the default nonnegative factors imply

abs(mean_error)<=delta*f_i*D_v*(H_i*(k*D_x+b*D_v)+Zeta),
Zeta=0 outside NAV; Zeta=eta*D_v+Z_input for NAV,
abs(xi_delta_i)<=Z_input.

This is a useful conditional one-call bound that need not reconstruct each constituent. It does not propagate the next mean domain, admit the next request or assert that independent marginal extremes are jointly realizable.

Phase, memory and adaptation. The native coordinator reads paired phases, actual full glyph histories and global gains, without a capacity-driven free angular advance. The five admitted events and this coordinator therefore preserve phase pairing despite unequal capacities. This is a property of the declared native law; the separate capacity-driven phase model has different premises. Common-arc/resultant admission still applies.

Temporal event jumps remain Y_i-M_i-/+(A_i-1)*d_i; retain each actual reset, sample value, clock and old rate. Compute qualification from individual fresh Si and held post-event pressure, update each count, then obtain due flags a_minus,a_plus. Set a_bar=(a_minus+a_plus)/2, a_delta=(a_plus-a_minus)/2 and W_i=N_i(U) from the immutable event-capacity snapshot. The final writer is exactly

V_i_next=U_i+mu*(a_bar*(W_i-U_i)-a_delta*E_i),
e_i_next=E_i+mu*(a_delta*(W_i-U_i)-a_bar*E_i).

Fixed-point and hull guards remain in force. Unequal due flags can create capacity contrast from zero. When both are due the contrast becomes (1-mu)*E_i; when neither is due it remains E_i. Equal flags alone do not erase it. Counts do not reset after a successful write. The next preparation uses these new capacities and flow forms, not the old stored pressure or a capacity substituted into the preceding flow rate.

Admitted entry and limits. The existing positive joint-admission source supplies a conditional entry through this boundary: its first call's node-two/node-three due split creates e_1=mu*epsilon/4, with epsilon=1/1024. Fresh Si/pressure and retained lag and grammar state admit its second all-Coherence call. Applying the joint rows to that already-declared source recovers its independent fine forecast, including active capacity writes, associated rates/history and the nonzero mean gap between opposite internal form assignments. No response is rerun to manufacture a new preparation or occurrence claim.

The joint-calculus controls compare independent fine sweeps with all five joint moment rows, live phase and neighbor inputs, held pressure and post-flow adaptation. They retain the actual-source continuation separately from supplied mixed transcripts, and test the capacity-innovation association and covariance-error bound. Production runtime, pressure, selector, operator and integrator evaluation are blocked. The result supplies sufficient exact coordinates across the former capacity exit. It neither proves mean-only closure, a smaller complete NFR state, unlimited retention, autonomous formation nor physical identification.

docs.title: Bounded prediction from a lossy collective observation
docs.text:
The joint moment identities permit a genuinely lossy one-call observation: retain intervals for the two means and upper bounds for the two internal contrasts, without retaining their signed values. The prediction is a set of possible successors. Its width and unresolved decisions matter separately; an enclosing interval is not a unique response or a smaller complete NFR.

Preparation and information boundary. Keep the complete law, support, whole-pair order and successful-call premises of the joint calculus. For each pair retain

M_i in X_i,             V_i in N_i,
abs(d_i)<=D_xi,         abs(e_i)<=D_vi.

Here N_i is a capacity interval; write neighbor_i(z) for the adjacent-block mean. Retain exact paired primitive phases and their inherited common arc, actual supplied grammar/lag context, node-associated sets of possible counts, global gains and target-associated innovation constraints. Old rates and temporal sample values may be represented by associated envelopes. Any nonempty admitted history ends at its fine lift's actual current form; empty histories remain explicit and supply no measured trigger evidence. This is a premise on the family, not permission to invent independent samples. The predictor consumes neither exact signed contrasts nor exact history endpoints from which to recover them. Fine lifts are evaluated only after freezing the observation, protocol and output budget.

The proposed requests retain their origin. For actual default occurrence, certify the fresh selection and lag precedence uniformly. A supplied paired transcript instead asserts the requests and still has to pass every live grammar, identity, nonidentity, support and state gate. Passing such a transcript does not prove that the default selector would choose it. Supplied selector requests remain subject to the batch's Emission/Reception lag overrides; the retained effective transcript must agree with those overrides.

Fresh normalization from retained data. Form the interval pressure mean B_i from X,N and the exact phase row. Let minabs(J)=min_(z in J)|z| and maxabs(J)=max_(z in J)|z|. For the nonnegative default pressure weights,

R_i=k*D_xi+b*D_vi,
p_n in B_i+[-R_i,R_i],                   n in {2i,2i+1},
P_lo=max_i minabs(B_i),
P_hi=max_i(maxabs(B_i)+R_i),
Vmax_lo=max_i N_i.lo,
Vmax_hi=max_i(N_i.hi+D_vi).

These bounds follow from the exact correlated peaks P=max_i(|B_actual_i|+|k*d_i+b*e_i|) and Vmax=max_i(V_i+|e_i|), where the actual scalar pressure mean B_actual_i belongs to B_i. A contrast radius supplies no positive lower bound for its realized value. When P_lo>0, divide the pressure magnitude enclosure by the peak bounds and intersect the ratio with [0,1]. If zero peak remains possible, use [0,1], except that P_hi=0 gives the exact ratio zero. Bound each capacity ratio from N_i+[-D_vi,D_vi] and the positive capacity-maximum interval. Insert these bounds and the exact phase score into the fresh Si formula. This admits requests with the actual strict/inclusive thresholds; it does not freeze a maximizing node or assume affine normalized diagnostics.

Ordered event admission. Use interval arithmetic on the shared event rows, updating live form-mean intervals in order. Reception (EN) consumes the live adjacent means. Resonance (RA) recomputes its whole-block U3 subset from the live paired phases and its selected form-mean interval S_i. Amplification is inactive if maxabs(S_i)<=T, active if minabs(S_i)>T. Otherwise this fixed-branch certificate is unavailable; it must not choose one branch from a fine witness. The same requirement applies to unresolved request, sign and identity gates. An unresolved temporal reset instead needs associated alternative history records or an unavailable history certificate. A more elaborate event union is possible but is not supplied by a silently selected branch.

For Transition (NAV), admit a common strict sign with min(sigma_i*B_i)>R_i. With retained innovation mean interval Ibar_i and half-difference bound Z_i, require maxabs(Ibar_i)+Z_i<=NAV_jitter. Its nonidentity changes lie in

G_i+[-Jmax_i,Jmax_i],
G_i=eta*(sigma_i*N_i-B_i)+Ibar_i,
Jmax_i=eta*(k*D_xi+(b+1)*D_vi)+Z_i.

Excluding zero admits both changes. This sufficient symmetric bound is not an assertion that every mean/difference combination is realizable by a fixed seed. Keep the original target association and declared input domain. Both Resonance sign identities and every individual incoming, event, flow and capacity rail require uniform admission. A failed enclosure can be conservative; it is not itself a native rejection witness.

Mean and contrast bounds. Let Y_i,A_i,H_i,f_i be the admitted interval event mean and exact branch factors. Write n_i=1 for Transition and zero otherwise, with Ibar_i=0,Z_i=0 outside Transition. Define

Qbar_i=H_i*B_i+n_i*eta*sigma_i*N_i+Ibar_i,
Cov_i=f_i*[-H_i*k*D_xi*D_vi,H_i*k*D_xi*D_vi]
      +f_i*(n_i*eta*sigma_i-H_i*b)*[0,D_vi^2]
      +f_i*[-D_vi*Z_i,D_vi*Z_i],
X_i_next=Y_i+delta*(f_i*N_i*Qbar_i+Cov_i),
D_xi_next=maxabs(A_i-delta*f_i*H_i*k*N_i)*D_xi
    +delta*f_i*maxabs(H_i*(B_i-b*N_i)
                     +2*n_i*eta*sigma_i*N_i+Ibar_i)*D_vi
    +delta*f_i*maxabs(N_i)*Z_i.

Terms multiplied by n_i=0 vanish without requiring a pressure sign for the other actions. The covariance includes both the signed capacity-variance coefficient and capacity-input uncertainty. These equations enclose the exact fine products algebraically. Replacing them by a product of mean capacity and mean pressure would discard a consumed term. Independent interval extrema provide an enclosure, not simultaneous attainable values.

Associated policies and temporal evidence. Use the prepared Si enclosure and held post-event pressure to classify each stability qualification as true, false or unresolved. Update each node's count set accordingly, then derive its possible due flags using the original threshold. With U_i=f_i*N_i, D_Ei=f_i*D_vi, W_i=neighbor_i(U), each possible due pair gives a_bar=(a_minus+a_plus)/2, a_delta=(a_plus-a_minus)/2 and

N_i_candidate=U_i+mu*a_bar*(W_i-U_i)
              +[-mu*abs(a_delta)*D_Ei,mu*abs(a_delta)*D_Ei],
D_vi_candidate=abs(1-mu*a_bar)*D_Ei
               +mu*abs(a_delta)*maxabs(W_i-U_i).

Take the capacity hull and largest contrast radius over those pairs. This reuses the joint-admission owner and preserves unresolved count outcomes instead of replacing them by false. The Cartesian enumeration is a safe outer bound; shared pressures may forbid some enumerated combinations. Recheck positive capacity, rails and the fixed-point/hull writer premises. Adaptation follows the current form flow.

The admitted event jumps determine each temporal reset. A reset sample lies in the individual event-form envelope; otherwise preserve the associated prior sample envelopes. Append the individual flow endpoint envelope with the original timestamps and retention cap. Old-rate envelopes and the new rate enclosure bound acceleration. They do not prove arbitrary combinations of samples and rates consistent, or admit a future Mutation trigger. Paired phase continuation uses its own retained glyph-load/gain evidence, without inserting capacity as a free phase advance. Automatic REMESH still requires its independently declared abstention. This output is a scoped observation certificate, not a complete restart record.

Frozen one-call classes and budget. The detached enclosure controls freeze three observations before evaluating any fine lift. Keep the shared default represented coefficients, source/support order 0..9, clock t=1, one call with delta=1/16, zero built-in Gamma and the original no-REMESH premise. The source convention is common kind seed, empty incoming temporal histories, zero old acceleration, the admitted EN trace with prior Coherence, and associated rates, debt, ordinals, lags and count sets. Old rates remain declared state; empty history supplies no measured trigger evidence.

  1. Supplied five-action transcript. Use Emission (AL), Reception (EN), Coherence (IL), Transition (NAV), Resonance (RA) in block order. Retain mean intervals of radius 2^-16 around the joint-calculus transcript's form and capacity means, its absolute form/capacity contrast bounds and paired phases (0,1/8,1/4,1/8,0). Innovation constraints are abs(xi_bar)<=NAV_jitter/4, abs(xi_delta)<=NAV_jitter/2, a rectangle inside the admitted amplitude diamond. This is a supplied input domain, not a fixed-seed realization. All five event maps are covered conditionally; default occurrence is not claimed for this transcript.
  2. Actual default selection. Reuse the live-prefix source means (q,q,-q,-1/2,-q), q=15/128, capacity means (1/4,1/4,1,1,1), zero phases and associated context/rates. Keep these means exact but discard all ten signed internal form/capacity contrasts, retaining only D_xi=D_vi=1/4096. Fresh interval Si/ratios admit RA/RA/IL/IL/IL uniformly. The first live RA selected mean stays exactly zero and does not amplify; the second is -r*q/2 and amplifies. Exact means here are substantive: an independent mean envelope around the first zero signal could leave its amplification branch unresolved. No adaptation qualifies in this class.
  3. Actual ambiguous adaptation. Reuse the joint-admission observation with all form means 1/8, capacity means (1+epsilon,1,1,1,1), epsilon=1/1024, D_x0=59/8192, other form radii zero, and zero capacity radii. Node zero's incoming count is zero; all other counts are four. Default requests are all Coherence, while node one's due decision remains unresolved. The enclosure must preserve both outcomes.

All three must have maximum successor form-mean interval width below 1/200, form half-contrast radius below 1/20, capacity-mean interval width below 1/100, and strict individual source/event/output rails. These budgets are fixed before fine controls, not selected from their errors. The shared 128-bit outward dyadic interval kernel encloses ideal-real arithmetic over represented coefficients. Exact fine containment adds no tolerance; this is not a universal binary64 execution certificate.

The outward calculations give the following displayed approximations. The exact interval endpoints in the controls, not rounded table entries, supply the certificates.

Frozen class Largest form-mean width Largest form radius Largest capacity-mean width Largest capacity radius Supplied five-action transcript 0.000352828 0.0311475 0.0000317319 0.00812335 Actual RA/RA/IL/IL/IL 1.64472e-9 0.000243106 0 0.000253855 Actual ambiguous all-IL 5.87748e-39 0.00713955 0.000048828125 0.000048828125

The exact uniform bound on the actual RA/IL class's deviation from the conditional product-of-means form prediction is below 1e-9 (approximately 9.35272e-10). Its mean enclosure is narrow despite ten discarded signed coordinates. Internal capacity differences can grow under RA amplification; form-radius contraction alone is not complete-state contraction.

For the ambiguous class, two admissible lifts with opposite d_0 have the same retained observation but distinct node-one adaptation decisions. Their terminal first-block capacity means differ by mu*epsilon/2. Any single common capacity-mean prediction must err by at least mu*epsilon/4 on one of them. This is an information obstruction, not merely interval overestimate; the enclosing union remains useful without selecting a hidden branch.

The controls evaluate a fixed 32/4/2 list of exact fine lifts after the three coarse certificates. Their finite inclusion checks are separate from the uniform interval proof. Boundary controls preserve a possible zero pressure peak, unresolved Transition sign and actual lag-override priority. A single shared phase-origin interval retains phase correlations after coordination; individual temporal envelopes retain right=left+delta*rate at times 1,17/16. Arbitrary Cartesian combinations are not declared valid histories. These results establish bounded one-call prediction and its limits. Reusing the successor description for another call still needs its own admission; complete collective NFR identity, formation and physical identification remain separate questions.

docs.title: Finite composition with the propagated collective memory
docs.text:
A useful one-call enclosure need not supply an admissible next input. The second call consumes the evolved physical observation, histories and policy state. Restoring the initial context or reconstructing a representative fine state would answer a different question. This result studies two calls of the existing actual Resonance (RA)/Coherence (IL) class using only its first abstract successor.

Composition criterion. Let A contain the admitted mean intervals, contrast bounds and associated context. Write Lift(A) for the fine states that satisfy these bounds and their retained relations. In particular, an individual history endpoint and the live form are the same variable, not independent values drawn from overlapping intervals. The latest flow relation's velocity is also that constituent's retained rate coordinate; equal marginal rate intervals alone do not establish this association. Configuration, support, node order, clock and the actual complete law remain fixed. If the detached observer F proves

every s in Lift(A) admits the declared complete call T,
T(Lift(A)) is a subset of Lift(F(A)),

and proves the same statements again on F(A), then T(T(Lift(A))) is contained in Lift(F(F(A))). This follows by set inclusion and induction. The second observer may enclose more states than are reachable; all consumed decisions must still be admitted on its declared family. Neither one representative lift nor agreement of marginal means proves this inclusion. The exact ordered-action criterion has stronger equality obligations; a bounded successor set does not establish an exact smaller node or a uniquely determined collective response.
