Source and numerical protocol. Retain the previous actual RA/RA/IL/IL/IL observation: means (q,q,-q,-1/2,-q), q=15/128, capacity means (1/4,1/4,1,1,1), zero paired phases and form/capacity contrast radii 1/4096. All ten signed contrasts remain discarded. Use its unchanged associated rates, grammar, counts, kinds and empty initial histories, default represented coefficients and no additional input. The fixed horizon is two complete calls from t=1 with delta=1/16, ending at t=9/8.

Before evaluating fine controls, require every final form-mean and capacity-mean interval width below 1e-7, every form contrast radius below 1/4096, every capacity contrast radius below 1/3500, and strict individual rails throughout. These are cumulative endpoint budgets, not an extra local tolerance or a budget reset after the first call. The shared outward dyadic 128-bit kernel encloses ideal-real arithmetic over represented coefficients. Fine inclusion is exact, without an added tolerance. Keep the already frozen one-call producer unchanged.

What the successor must retain. The second preparation reads the first output's mean/radius bounds and rebuilds pressure, both normalization peaks and Si. Stored first-call pressure or Si cannot stand in for this preparation. The retained old-rate interval gives the next acceleration through (new_rate-old_rate)/delta. The old-acceleration envelope also remains admitted although the default selector does not use acceleration to choose its mark. An unknown diagnostic is not replaced by zero.

Carry each constituent's trace, persistent U2 debt, prior Coherence flag, operator ordinal, kind, lag counts and stability-count set. The actual batch increments lags before applying its Emission/Reception priority. Traces from the first call already contain the new event. For this sector, Resonance leaves debt unchanged and Coherence reduces it by one down to zero. Replacing Coherence's decrement by an unconditional reset would be incorrect outside the source's zero/one debt stratum. Runtime invocation ordinals have their own provenance and are not physical time or constituent operator counts. With the source's initially absent runtime marker, the two calls use ordinals zero and one and leave the next ordinal two; constituent operator ordinals instead advance 3 -> 4 -> 5.

Retain the first coordinator's gains and common phase-origin observation, with its relative phases. In this source every phase stays exactly zero, so the shared origin is exactly zero as well. The gain recurrence nevertheless continues from the first output rather than restarting at configured initial gains. The complete updated traces contain no disruptors; the stable branch has phase resultant one and zero disruptor load. This scoped composition does not establish a general phase-rotation quotient for dispersed phases.

The second event is applied to a state whose recorded endpoint already matches its live form. A uniformly nonzero Resonance form jump at 17/16 restarts that constituent's temporal record at the new event form; the subsequent flow adds its endpoint at 9/8. Coherence leaves form unchanged at the event and preserves its first two samples, then appends the new one. Thus the final RA records have times (17/16,9/8) and the IL records have times (1,17/16,9/8), within the four-sample limit. Each retained flow segment keeps its actual sample/rate association. These predicted envelopes are not measured evidence for a future Mutation trigger.

The abstract successor retains envelopes for the successive whole-support snapshots written by native REMESH-history sampling. The admitted runtime has no callback adding stability samples; its initially empty stable_frac remains empty, so the automatic REMESH policy abstains on both calls before reading delayed form values. Declaring that abstention does not remove REMESH from the law or promise it indefinitely.

Re-admitting the second call. Use the same interval pressure/Si, live-neighbor, covariance and adaptation identities as the one-call owner. The second call's input is its propagated observation, never an initial-state adapter with substituted traces, time, acceleration or histories. Both fresh requests and live operator gates must pass over the whole abstract family. The actual second requests remain RA/RA/IL/IL/IL. The first live selected-mean interval is now strictly negative, separated from the amplification trigger; the first RA therefore changes from inactive amplification to active amplification. The second RA also amplifies. Their live inputs are recomputed in order; freezing the first-call amplification pattern would omit a real event-capacity factor from the second form flow.

Both RA targets remain below the Si stability threshold. The IL targets' held pressures stay outside the adaptation band. Hence every qualification is false and each stability count remains zero. This is a re-admitted decision, not an assumption that unchanged counts waive capacity adaptation. The amplified capacities are used by the current held-pressure flow before the later writer. Covariance continues to affect means despite the small enclosure widths.

Concrete bounds and controls. The second preparation has pressure peak between 0.0691967 and 0.0692554. RA pressure ratios are below 0.032; their Si intervals remain strictly inside the default middle band, while the other blocks have Si above 0.941. The two ordered RA selected-mean intervals are contained respectively in (-0.010904808,-0.010904804) and (-0.018872395,-0.018872390), strictly beyond the magnitude trigger. These whole-family bounds precede the fine controls.

At t=9/8, the largest form-mean interval width is below 3.094e-9, the largest form contrast radius below 0.000242093, and the largest capacity contrast radius below 0.000263956. Capacity means remain point intervals, approximately (0.259947184,0.270290154,1,1,1). The exact outward endpoints, not these rounded displays, verify every predeclared budget. Increasing capacity contrast under amplification remains compatible with decreasing form contrast; no complete-state contraction is claimed.

The composition controls freeze the source, complete law, both abstract outputs and budgets before evaluating four independent exact paths. Their initial contrasts are d_i=s_d*(-1)^i/4096, e_i=s_e*(-1)^i/4096, with independent signs s_d,s_e in {-1,1}. Each second fine call continues its own first endpoint, rates and history. Their inclusion checks validate the implementation of the interval argument; four paths alone do not prove the continuous domain. Runtime, production pressure, selector, operator and integrator evaluations remain disabled in this new owner. Earlier producers remain unchanged.

The observer binds each current-form and rate coordinate to its corresponding history relation. Missing, stale or reassigned records reject this detached admission; it never reconstructs hidden values or restarts with initial defaults. An unavailable certificate is not an executed failed runtime call and consumes no native invocation ordinal. Reusing initial phase gains could leave the zero-phase endpoint unchanged while giving the wrong policy state; the controls therefore check the actual gain recurrence separately. Likewise, restoring initial rates changes the acceleration calculation even when mean form remains enclosed. These are consumed-state distinctions, not extra physical laws.

The result establishes reusable bounded collective information across this two-call source class, including a changed live event branch. It retains constituent-associated policy and temporal state; it does not establish indefinite retention, a minimal autonomous NFR, newly formed organization, general dispersed-phase closure or physical identification.

docs.title: Relative phases for the complete native call
docs.text:
The common phase origin can be removed from the admitted five-operator map without removing its relative phases or constituent-associated context. This is an exact symmetry reduction of the declared ideal circular model. It is not a proof that an arbitrary rotated binary64 graph executes identically, or that the remaining state constitutes a smaller autonomous NFR.

Model and equivalence. Retain the joint-calculus domain: doubled C5, consecutive nonadjacent twins, paired primitive phases, positive individual capacities, admitted signed forms and common kind, fresh default pressure/Si, direct ordered glyphs, zero live Gamma and held Euler flow. Keep all rails, grammar, clock, history and independently inactive REMESH premises. Every effective pair request must agree. Its origin is either the fresh admitted default selector or an explicitly supplied transcript; these are different inputs. Exclude anchored callbacks, additional phase writers and optional tracking that consumes absolute phases.

For this theorem the circular operations use mathematical radians and their true period 2*pi. Configured finite coefficients, including the pressure normalization pi_rep, retain their represented values as exact real parameters. On an inherited common lift of width less than pi, all selected phasor targets use the representative in that lift. Default Resonance phase coupling lies in [0,1]; coordinator gains are nonnegative with sum at most one. Their convex proposals stay in the same lifted hull. This separates the ideal circular law from modulo normalization with a represented period and from materialized trigonometric arithmetic.

Write theta_i=beta+r_i, with beta=theta_0 and r_0=0. Let H retain the consumed non-phase state: individual rates and acceleration, kinds, associated temporal samples, grammar traces/debt/prior-Coherence flags, operator and runtime ordinals, lags, stability counts, phase gains and controller history, random inputs/stream progress and REMESH history/abstention evidence. The complete law, support, node order and clock are also retained. Define

Q(s)=(M,d,V,e,r,H),
rho_a(s): theta_i -> theta_i+a for every constituent,
          all retained non-phase state and associated inputs unchanged.

The equivalence is one shared rotation of every participating primitive phase, not independently rotating blocks or deleting their relative state. For the admitted successful call T, its consumed semantic-state map obeys T(rho_a(s))=rho_a(T(s)). Consequently Q(T(s)) depends only on Q(s) and the retained input, defining T_relative(Q(s))=Q(T(s)). A declared coherent lift is a chart for this statement; raw centered extrema need not describe that chart after rotation. This quotient removes one common angle from the five paired phases. It retains the joint form/capacity moments and all their constituent associations. Arbitrary graph dictionaries, absolute-angle debug logs and untransformed trigonometric caches are not this state equivalence.

Fresh preparation and live events. The pressure phase term is w_phase*(N_i(r)-r_i)/pi_rep. The other channels, both normalization peaks, individual absolute pressures and capacity ratios are unchanged. The Si phase term also uses relative offsets. Thus fresh default selection, its incremented lag priority and all grammar decisions have the same admitted inputs. Stored old acceleration still requires admission even when the base selector does not use it to choose a mark.

Emission (AL), Reception (EN), Coherence (IL) and Transition (NAV) on this direct native path have no phase write. Their form/pressure actions depend only on retained invariant quantities. Reception still reads live ordered neighbor forms; Coherence still leaves primitive phase unchanged. Transition retains each constituent's own capacity and innovation, including their association and stream progress.

For Resonance (RA), initialize live offsets y=r. At every ordered prefix,

J_i={j in {i-1,i+1}: abs(y_j-y_i)<=L},
S_i=mean_(j in J_i)(live Y_j),
a_i=mean_(j in J_i)(y_j),
y_i <- (1-c)*y_i+c*a_i.

These expressions use the admitted common lift. The selected adjacent blocks have equal multiplicity, so their circular mean is exactly the lifted midpoint (or the one selected phase). Nonempty selection and the open-semicircle domain exclude an undefined resultant. Recompute J_i at each live prefix: it may gain a neighbor during the event batch. The scoped compatible-edge retention result excludes losing an already compatible edge under these default paired events; it does not replace the live subset with its initial value. A common rotation preserves every U3 inequality, both fine sign/kind identity gates, the selected signed form mean and the capacity-amplification decision. The phase proposal gains precisely the same common rotation. Induction over the ordered pairs proves event equivariance without freezing their subsets. This proof does not admit arbitrary unequal requests inside a pair or supply rollback for a rejected sequential prefix.

Coordinator and its retained policy. After the events, write l_i(y)=N_i(y) and choose the global target representative b(y) in the same common interval. The global resultant magnitude is

R(y)=abs(sum_i exp(1j*y_i))/5.

The twin multiplicity cancels in this expression. Rotating all phases multiplies the phasor sum by one unit complex factor, so R is invariant. Disruptor load depends on the actual updated traces and is also invariant. The configured controller therefore selects the same branch, updates the same incoming gains and appends the same state/R/load/gain records. Its global angle need not be calculated to advance the relative coordinates:

r_i_next=(1-kG-kL)*(y_i-y_0)+kL*(l_i(y)-l_0(y)),
beta_next=beta+(1-kG-kL)*y_0+kG*b(y)+kL*l_0(y).

The first row is closed on retained relative phases and policy state; r_0_next=0. The second row reconstructs an absolute lift only if its initial origin is supplied. Global coupling still changes relative dynamics through its coefficient; cancellation of the common target does not remove global coupling. Nor does it remove R or the gain history needed by the next invocation. The policy acts per call, not per unit of physical time.

Conditional phase-resource consequence. Let D_j be the lifted phase diameter before call j. Every admitted Resonance update is a convex move inside the current hull, including a move with a newly compatible neighbor. The other four events, held form flow and capacity adaptation leave phase unchanged. The coordinator then gives

D_(j+1) <= (1-kG_j)*D_j,
D_N <= D_0*product_(j=0..N-1)(1-kG_j) <= q^N*D_0,
q=1-m < 1,  m=the represented default adaptive global-gain floor.

The last bound assumes the default enabled adaptive policy. The hull step and the coordinator diameter theorem prove the result by induction for any successful segment remaining in the five-action domain. Unequal evolving capacities do not defeat it because they supply no free phase advance on this native path. The phase chart is preserved; admission of later identities, rails, selections and histories is a separate obligation. Infinite successful invocation count is not proved.

This extends the earlier uniform-capacity reachable IL/AL/EN restriction to the admitted live five-action class. Along an infinite admitted ideal sequence with the gain floor, the diameter tends to zero. This excludes a uniform positive lower bound, not positive diameter at every finite invocation: D_N=q^N*D_0 is positive for every finite N when D_0>0 and 0<q<1. It does not exclude persistent form/capacity organization or finite identity. Binary64 defects retain their separate ledger. An identity requiring a fixed positive phase margin eventually leaves that identity domain if the admitted sequence continues. Maintaining such a margin would require a justified departure from these contraction premises, not necessarily strict diameter increase after a complete call. The observable admission separates that obligation from Mutation admission and phase recharge.

Flow, adaptation and memory. Every event form, capacity and held pressure is unchanged by the rotation. The nodal products, covariance contribution, form endpoints and accelerations are therefore unchanged. Event jumps reset exactly the same individual temporal records, and each history endpoint and flow-rate relation retains its association with the live constituent. The clock is unchanged. This is not a phase-derived clock or a time change.

Adaptation reads the unchanged prepared Si and post-event held pressure, updates the same stability counts and due flags, and uses the same immutable capacity snapshot. Thus both capacity moments, including any contrast created by unequal due flags, are invariant. Grammar records, lags, ordinals, whole-support EPI snapshots and the independently empty stability series have the same updates. These component identities complete the whole-call proof; the earlier pressure or coordinator symmetry alone did not establish it.

Caches containing absolute trigonometric components are not invariant physical records. They must be transformed consistently or rebuilt from the admitted primitive phase. The quotient does not authorize reusing a stale cache, replacing retained memory with initialization defaults, or treating an absolute phase log as an invariant observation.

What the quotient cannot predict. Signed forms, capacities, pressures, Si, event decisions, relative phases, R and the retained non-phase histories factor through Q. An absolute phase reading or the signed real/imaginary components of a phasor sum generally do not. A callback selecting a mark from an absolute phase threshold introduces an external reference; it needs that reference as retained state/input and its own covariance argument. The present exclusion is substantive, not a declaration that every callback is unphysical.

Relative phase cannot be discarded with the origin. Keeping the same forms, capacities and context but changing a nonconstant r changes fresh phase pressure; it can also change Si, live U3 subsets and the controller. Likewise, restarting incoming phase gains can preserve a synchronized endpoint while giving the wrong next controller state. Origin reduction does not resolve these distinct state-sufficiency obligations. A future physical sensor may require an external phase reference even when the internal model does not.

Numerical boundary. A binary64 implementation is not an exact action of the continuous rotation group. Forming float(theta+a) can change a gap before any operator runs. Subsequent trig reduction, branch representatives, represented-period normalization and summation introduce separate defects. The runtime's signed circular difference and centered phase storage also use different endpoint conventions. Even exact arithmetic with a represented 2*pi_rep modulo cannot be identified with true-radian periodicity across all branch crossings. The regular lifted identities above do not waive any of these implementation boundaries.

For a claimed numerical comparison, retain the chosen lifts, backend and every realization defect, with independent margins for U3, resultants, selection, identity, amplification and controller thresholds. At a decision boundary, a small angular discrepancy can change a discrete branch; an endpoint tolerance alone does not establish equivalent calls. This section supplies neither a uniform roundoff bound nor permission to replace the native executor by an origin-centered implementation.

Frozen controls. The detached owner prepares two origin-free forecasts before six independent fine lifted controls: one complete call for each source at origins -7/4,0,5/2, with exact comparisons and no tolerance. Both sources have nonzero relative phase. The source, law, context, input, horizon and output protocol digest is bad6429813ae9fdcd07b8cd904862429a26bbd2f518818e37585ff6b6540e1bb.

The joint five-action transcript retains its supplied request origin: fresh default selection on that source would instead give Coherence everywhere. Its updated trace load is 1/10; exact cosine-tail bounds certify the stable controller branch. Its phase diameter falls from 1/4 to approximately 0.212219. The separate unchanged neighbor-gain source has actual fresh RA/RA/IL/IL/IL requests. Its live RA subsets are first (4,), then (0,2) after the earlier phase change. Exact resultant-square bounds inside (0.2547626,0.2547695) and zero disruptor load certify the dissonant controller branch. The event diameter 2.998046875 contracts to approximately 2.165845 or less. Rounded displays are not the exact comparisons.

Both complete-call sources have no capacity qualification; a separate admitted static adaptation control checks dependence on the retained input and unequal due flags. Prefix hulls, fresh/default requests, identities, amplification, held products, reset/debt masks and associated temporal/rate records have their own checks. Absolute readings, omitted relative phases and binary64 materialization supply distinct counterexamples to stronger claims. No new native scientific execution occurs and earlier producers stay unchanged. The proof supplies the all-origin ideal symmetry; finite controls check its algebra and retained-state implementation. No physical identification, formation or indefinitely admitted execution follows.

docs.title: Mutation admission and the complete phase-renewal obligation
docs.text:
Mutation (ZHIR) supplies a phase-changing event that is absent from the five-action hull argument. Its request, temporal eligibility, grammar, physical proposal and the remaining live call have independent obligations. The following bounded analytical study separates them. It proves an admitted Mutation prefix followed by a later Resonance identity obstruction, and a distinct conditional renewal map whose simple history acquisition is excluded. These results cannot be combined into a successfully executed renewing organization.

Actual native boundary. Reuse the same ideal circular doubled-C5 law, joint coordinates, default represented coefficients, strict direct-glyph grammar, zero Gamma and held Euler flow with delta=1/16. The added pressure event is the default non-noise Dissonance (OZ) primitive: it multiplies stored pressure by its configured factor when abs(p)>1e-9; its separate near-zero branch assigns 0.1. Do not replace that piecewise law by a universal multiplier. The declared source below stays strictly on the multiplying branch. It changes no form, capacity or phase at the event.

Mutation requires active capacity, a live signed two-sample EPI secant strictly above the default represented threshold, and target-local grammar. Both the retained recent handler for U4a and the recent destabilizer/prior Coherence requirements for U4b matter. A lifetime prior-Coherence flag is not a recent handler. The five earlier actions cannot create a canonical destabilizer: Transition (NAV) contributes to the phase controller's configured disruptor load but is not a U2/U4b destabilizer.

Fresh default selection requests Mutation only if the high-Si branch has not already applied, Si<=si_lo, and abs(p)/P<=dnfr_hi. The divisor is one when the pressure peak is zero. With positive capacities, the necessary low-pressure-branch bound is

Si >= alpha*(nu/vmax)+beta*(1-abs(phase_offset)/pi_rep)
      +gamma*(1-dnfr_hi).

This excludes some capacity/phase domains but not all heterogeneous states. The default selector admits old acceleration independently even though its base choice does not use it. AL/EN lag priority can still replace that base request. Missing, stale or subthreshold temporal evidence instead causes the native Mutation abstention and a Coherence request before grammar. Valid evidence with invalid grammar reaches strict rejection; these are not the same outcome.

The signed direct Mutation proposal retains form, capacity and stored pressure and changes only primitive phase and its own telemetry. Write its ideal signed increment as s*copysign(1,p_stored), with s=ZHIR_theta_shift_factor*pi_rep/4. This uses exact real arithmetic over represented factors. The default binary64 multiplication yields 1/4; that rounded scalar and the ideal product need not be identical. Signed zero has the primitive's explicit copysign convention. Neither direction nor magnitude is inferred from the positive historical secant.

General renewal test. Let y be the final admitted event-phase lift and let the controller recompute its branch and gains from y and the actual updated glyph load. On the paired common-arc domain, put

A(g)y=(1-kG-kL)*y+kL*N(y),
osc(z)=max_i(z_i)-min_i(z_i),
D_out=osc(A(g)y).

The omitted global target is a common additive term. For the declared diameter observation, strict one-call renewal is exactly D_out>D_in. This criterion needs every event, flow and policy boundary to be admitted before it describes a completed call. A proposed phase pulse or a favorable event-only diameter is insufficient. A common phase increment alone is not renewal. Positive diameter is also not necessary for every possible form/capacity organization, nor does its renewal establish sustained form work, formation or a physical identity.

On doubled C5 this bound can be sharpened without another trajectory. Let a_g=1-kG-kL. The default gain rails give a_g>=kL/2. Rows of A have mass 1-kG, diagonal entry a_g and two neighbor entries kL/2. Adjacent rows overlap by kL, while nonadjacent rows overlap by kL/2. The exact oscillation contraction coefficient is therefore

tau=1-kG-kL/2,
osc(A(g)y)<=tau*osc(y).

The bound is sharp over real phase vectors, including vectors inside the common-arc domain after a sufficiently small rescaling. For one whole-pair Mutation theta -> theta+s*e_k, with all other event-phase rows inert, osc(A(g)e_k)=a_g and hence

D_out <= tau*D_in+a_g*abs(s).

Strict renewal consequently requires a_g*abs(s)>(kG+kL/2)*D_in. This necessary resource condition is not sufficient: the geometry, sign, controller and full execution must still agree. Use the actual post-event gains. If another event changes phase, rebuild its live proposal instead of treating this single-shift formula as the entire call.

Frozen source and preparation. The analytical source family is

M=(a,0,-9/10,9/10,0),   abs(a-19/20)<=1/4096,
V=(27/50,27/50,6,6,27/50),   d=e=0,
r=(0,3/2,0,3,3/2).

Keep all ten node kinds seed, supplied initial traces (AL,IL,EN), prior Coherence true, zero debt, constituent ordinal three and zero lags/stability counts. Initial temporal histories are empty at t=1; old rates and accelerations are zero. These are explicit preparation data, not a claim that the engine generated this initial organization. The retained IL handler is essential: importing the earlier EN-only trace would reject the first OZ despite its prior-Coherence flag. The earlier source is not rewritten.

Fix support/order 0..9, default controller gains, empty REMESH stability history and the existing no-callback/no-math-engine premises. Allow the two first-call Transition inputs independently in the full configured jitter amplitude interval. Their target association is retained; this input family does not claim that one seed realizes every combination. The declared horizon is at most two calls, stopping at the first live rejection. No request, threshold, initial form or clock is adjusted after evaluating the control.

First complete call: acquisition of conditional evidence. Fresh preparation uniformly selects OZ/OZ/IL/IL/NAV by block. All target-local grammar checks pass; lags do not override. The first two pressure multipliers and the two Transition inputs then act on the held prepared pressure. No event changes form. The flow therefore predicts two associated samples for each constituent, (1,x_initial) and (17/16,x_endpoint), without a jump being mistaken for continuous growth.

For the first pair, the exact domain certificate places the sampled secant inside (0.1339,0.1341), strictly above the default 0.1 threshold. The first call also appends its own OZ, creating the missing recent destabilizer and debt one. This is a conditional forecast of the recorder's output from the same admitted flow, not measured native evidence inserted into a graph. An actual later execution must consume its actual records. The general Mutation-history contract does not permit replacing those records by the predicted nodal product.

All first endpoints stay inside the form rails. The held pressures remain outside the capacity-adaptation band, so qualification is false, counts remain zero and capacities do not change. Exact cosine-tail bounds give R^2 inside (0.23555,0.23557), certifying the dissonant phase-controller branch with the actual load 3/20. Its relative map supplies the next phases without evaluating an absolute global angle. All consumed memory, gains, rates, input progress and REMESH sampling/abstention are retained.

Second preparation and accepted prefix. Refresh pressure and Si from the first endpoint. The prospective batch is ZHIR/RA/IL/IL/NAV. For the first pair, the certificate has fresh pressure inside (0.0842,0.0846), Si inside (0.2403,0.2404) and normalized pressure inside (0.1156,0.1162). Its live positive history, active capacity, recent IL/OZ context and debt allowance admit Mutation on both constituents. Lags advance to two without forcing another mark. Each accepted Mutation changes phase by the positive s, appends its mark, raises debt to two and advances its operator ordinal. Form, capacity, pressure, rate and the associated EPI history stay unchanged.

The next block has Si inside (0.2540,0.2541) and normalized pressure inside (0.0496,0.0498), so its fresh default request is Resonance (RA). Its first constituent, fine node two, still has a strictly negative form below -0.008828. Both neighboring blocks remain U3-compatible after Mutation; their live selected form mean lies inside (0.1188,0.1192). The actual Resonance blend proposes a strictly positive form inside (0.01149,0.01154). Thus the sign-preservation clause rejects the proposal throughout the declared source/input domain. Kind preservation and phase compatibility cannot waive the independent sign clause.

This is a live identity obstruction, not a grammar rejection, undefined phase, missing Mutation evidence or numerical solver failure. The same compatible subset and sign failure occur if the preceding phase reset is omitted in a detached counterfactual. Mutation is therefore not established as the cause of this failure. The fresh selector proposes an action whose live identity gate does not admit it; a base request is not an admission certificate.

Partial-call accounting. The native sequential path preserves the two accepted Mutation events. The failing Resonance commits no form, phase, capacity or glyph history. Later targets are not executed. There is no second flow, coordinator, adaptation or terminal REMESH snapshot, and no second-call Transition input is consumed. Physical time remains 17/16; all first-call EPI records, old rates and incoming phase gains remain. Second preparation has already refreshed pressure/Si and incremented every node's lag counters. The runtime invocation ordinal would still record the admitted failed invocation; a detached certificate consumes no runtime ordinal. This chronology is not all-target rollback.

The accepted phase prefix itself narrows the diameter, but no complete second-call diameter or renewed organization is available. Continuing its algebra past the rejected event would silently replace the specified law. The eight fixed fine controls use the endpoints of the initial-form interval and both independent first-call innovation intervals. They check the whole-domain forecast; their number does not prove its interval inequalities. The detached owner blocks production execution and preserves the earlier frozen producers.

Separate conditional renewal and its history obstruction. A second static family illustrates why the preceding rejection is not a universal geometric impossibility. On the same support let

M=(1/8,0,3/4,-3/4,0),   V=(1/64,1,1,1,1),   d=e=0,
r=(1/10,0,0,0,0).

Its fresh default base choices are ZHIR/IL/IL/IL/IL, with positive pressure at the first pair. Without qualifying history, the actual selector abstains from Mutation and requests Coherence. Conditional on separately admitted Mutation evidence and grammar, the increment increases the sole phase maximum to 1/10+s. The default gain rails give 1-kG-kL>0.6816 and 1-kG-kL>kL/2, so the resulting diameter is (1-kG-kL)*(1/10+s)>0.2385>1/10 for every admitted default controller branch. No extra low-disruptor-load premise is needed. This is a conditional action/geometry calculation; no qualifying temporal record is supplied and no Mutation is executed on that source.

Indeed, let P_bound=w_phase+2*w_epi+w_vf*VF_MAX. Under the same admitted form/capacity rails and a common lift narrower than pi_rep, fresh pressure satisfies abs(p)<=P_bound. For a target held at capacity 1/64, with no form jumps between samples and at most the declared multiplying OZ pressure event before its held flow,

abs(secant) <= (1/64)*OZ_dnfr_factor*P_bound < 0.031 < xi.

The separate near-zero OZ branch also lies below this bound. The simple history-producing route therefore cannot supply the required trigger on this conditional renewing source. Different past capacities, inputs, laws or sampling histories need their own provenance and rate argument. The prospective phase benefit cannot manufacture missing evidence.

Finally, Mutation's primitive always retains branch-specific telemetry. The signed mode includes absolute before/after angles and quadrant labels; these do not descend through the common-origin quotient even though the physical circular shift does. Retain their reference or report them as reference-dependent readouts. Public/staged Mutation has additional lifecycle effects and is not the direct route used here. The two complementary obstructions leave successful complete renewal open, with its missing joint conditions identified rather than hidden in a favorable operator name.

docs.title: Joint history and renewal: a reflection-sector obstruction
docs.text:
The previous study leaves a joint question: can a predecessor supply the history that admits Mutation (ZHIR), while the next complete call renews the relative-phase diameter? A declared family now has a negative answer. This is an analytical exclusion of a continuum of preparations, not a failed sampled trajectory or a universal obstruction to TNFR organizations.

Complete question and frozen scope. Keep the preceding native direct law, doubled-C5 support, whole-pair order, represented defaults, zero Gamma, held Euler delta=1/16, initial gains and supplied (AL,IL,EN) context. Initial debt, lags, stability counts, rates and accelerations are zero; temporal records are empty at t=1. Prior Coherence is true, constituent ordinals are three, and callbacks, math engine and initial REMESH stability history are absent. The preparation's origin remains supplied.

One target pair has capacity u; all four other pairs have the same capacity W, with 0<u<W<=VF_MAX. All capacities remain fixed over the two-call horizon: from zero counts, even qualifying nodes cannot reach the default adaptation threshold of five. Their counts need not remain zero. Because each other pair has the network maximum capacity, its Si is at least alpha, above the default high cut, so its fresh base choice is Coherence (IL). Lags one and two do not override. This removes the earlier Resonance obstruction through an explicit source restriction, without changing the selector or weakening an identity contract.

The target must first receive freshly selected Dissonance (OZ), then freshly selected and temporally admitted Mutation. No word is imposed to obtain those actions. All forms and both unclipped flow endpoints must lie within the default rails. Renewal means D2>D1, comparing the second completed call with its own incoming diameter, not with the initial preparation. The initial, first coordinated and post-Mutation phase states consumed by the second coordinator must all admit the common-lift calculation.

General necessary inequalities with arbitrary phase orientation did not decide this question. Before any source evaluation, the decision domain was restricted explicitly to reflection-symmetric block coordinates

M=(x,y,z,z,y),             (x,y,z) in [-1,1]^3,
theta=(D,a,0,0,a),        0<=a<=D<=3<pi,
nu=(u,W,W,W,W),           0<u<W<=VF_MAX,
d=e=0.

A common absolute phase origin may be retained separately. The target is initially at a phase maximum. Freeze eighteen algebraic outer regions: two directions of the second Mutation, three first controller branches, and three second branches. Each second gain update starts from the first updated gains. No sampled sources, candidate scans, native responses or additional horizons belong to this protocol. An outer region may include unrealizable controller branches; excluding it is still sufficient. This avoids needing trigonometric branch selection to establish the obstruction.

Shared gap and pressure identities. Write pressure weights as (k,b,w), Si weights as (alpha,beta,gamma), d_p=w/pi_rep, OZ multiplier as f and IL retention as ell. For controller j write (G_j,L_j) for its updated global/local gains and A_j=1-G_j-L_j. These are configured quantities, not additional TNFR laws. The common global target cancels from phase gaps.

Let H=D-a. After the first coordinator define h as target-minus-neighbor phase and t as neighbor-minus-far phase. The exact paired map gives

h=(A1-L1/2)*H+(L1/2)*a,
t=(L1/2)*H+A1*a,
D1=h+t.

The gain rails preserve h,t>=0. With det=A1*(A1-L1/2)-L1^2/4>0, set

c_a=(A1-L1/2)/det,
c_t=L1/(2*det),
c_h=A1/det-1,
a=c_a*t-c_t*h,
H-h=c_h*h-c_t*t.

All three coefficients are positive for the admitted default gain updates. Reflection and the regular support also give p0+2*p1+2*p2=0. On the nonzero multiplying OZ branch, putting lambda=delta*k*W*ell and mu=delta*k*u*f yields the exact two-boundary row

p0_next=(1-mu-lambda/2)*p0-lambda*p2+d_p*(H-h).

Here p0_next is freshly computed pressure at the next boundary, not a pressure reconstructed from the response. The two associated flow samples would have secant u*f*p0; its required strict lower bound is xi. This identity applies only when the first OZ uses its multiplying branch and no form clipping changes the endpoint. Its tiny-pressure branch is handled separately below.

Let c be the default normalized-pressure cut. The second Mutation base choice requires rho<=c and low Si. Consequently

u <= U(h)=VF_MAX*(r0+r1*h),
r0=(si_lo-beta-gamma*(1-c))/alpha,
r1=beta/(alpha*pi_rep).

Both coefficients are positive here. Keep pressure and Si weights separate in this derivation, even when their configured values agree. Missing actual history would still cause selector abstention; these necessary inequalities do not certify execution by themselves.

Positive increment. Suppose the second pressure selects the positive increment s. After the event the phase gaps are (h+s,t), so the completed coordinator has diameter

D2=A2*(h+s)+(A2+L2/2)*t.

Strict renewal therefore requires

(G2+L2)*h+(G2+L2/2)*t < A2*s,
h < h_max=A2*s/(G2+L2),
t < T-J*h,
T=A2*s/(G2+L2/2),   J=(G2+L2)/(G2+L2/2).

The first flow endpoint's form rails give -k+d_p*t/2<=p2_next<=k+d_p*t/2. Combined with pressure zero-sum and the normalized-pressure cut, nonnegative p0_next satisfies p0_next<=kappa*(k+d_p*t/2), where kappa=c/(1-c/2). This also covers a zero pressure peak: then every fresh pressure is zero and the divisor-one selector convention does not invalidate the inequality. The first rails similarly give p2<=k+d_p*a/2.

Use lambda_max=delta*k*VF_MAX*ell, and define

n0=k*(kappa+lambda_max),
nt=d_p*(kappa/2+lambda_max*c_a/2+c_t),
nh=d_p*(lambda_max*c_t/2+c_h),
N0=n0+nt*T,              N1=nh+nt*J,
den_min=1-lambda_max/2-delta*k*f*U(h_max).

The exact certificates have den_min>0. A positive acquired secant then obeys

u*f*p0 <= f*VF_MAX*(r0+r1*h)*(N0-N1*h)/den_min,
0<=h<=h_max.

If the numerator is nonpositive, positive acquisition is already impossible. Otherwise its concave quadratic has an exact maximum at an endpoint or its rational vertex. Across all nine gain pairs that maximum gives u*f*p0<0.037<xi. No source choice or unresolved phase-controller branch inside the declared sector can supply the required trigger on this branch. An independent certificate using the weaker oscillation condition h+t<T also leaves a strictly positive quadratic gap to xi in every cell.

Negative increment. If D1>=s, lowering the target by s keeps all event phases in the incoming hull. The coordinator's strict oscillation contraction then excludes renewal. Thus renewal with a negative increment requires h+t<s, and in particular u<=U(s).

For p0_next<=0, the pressure identity, inverse gap map and first form rails give the necessary bound

u*f*p0 <= f*U(s)*[lambda_max*k
                  +d_p*(lambda_max*c_a/2+c_t)*s]
             /[1-lambda_max/2-delta*k*f*U(s)]
          < 0.008 < xi.

All three possible first gain updates satisfy it; the second gain branch is irrelevant to the hull argument. Include zero pressure with either declared signed-zero direction in the corresponding case. Neither zero pressure nor a zero network peak leaves a missing boundary case.

The actual small-pressure OZ branch. When abs(p0)<=1e-9, direct OZ assigns its represented literal 0.1; it does not multiply p0. The same selection and renewal constraints, independently of the transport identity, give u<=U(h_max) in the positive-increment cells and u<=U(s) in the negative-increment cells. These imply secants below 0.076 and 0.026, respectively, still below xi. The equality boundary at the small-pressure cut belongs to this branch. Thus the exclusion applies to the complete piecewise OZ law, not just its multiplying part.

Result and retained limits. In this reflection sector, no two-call preparation can simultaneously acquire the required Mutation history, select/admit the target event and complete a strict diameter renewal under the declared law. Even relaxing the first selector and grammar inequalities does not remove the contradiction; restoring them cannot create a witness. The family cannot repair its missing trigger by extending a predicted history, suppressing a gate or continuing an unavailable execution.

The exact certificate owner checks the eighteen outer regions, gain carry, positive denominators, coefficient identities, quadratic extrema, signed-zero/peak boundaries and the separate OZ fallback. Production execution is guarded. Algebraic basis controls verify identities; they are not sampled physical preparations. No fine response, new temporal record or completed call is reported. All inequalities concern the ideal real model over represented constants; they are not an unproved bit-for-bit statement about floating-point paths.

The obstruction does not cover asymmetric block states, targets away from the initial phase maximum, different capacity layouts, clipped histories, other words or longer horizons. Nor does it exclude organizations sustained without this diameter-renewal criterion. It identifies incompatible joint requirements of this declared preparation and policy, not a new universal law or a physical identification.

Reflection matters to the pressure-peak bound. Without it, the target transport row still uses the mean far pressure (p2+p3)/2, by the same regular-support zero-sum identity. However, opposite pressure contrasts can increase the actual network maximum without changing that mean. Its bound cannot be transferred from a reflected mean to the full pressure peak. Independent phase contrasts also affect extrema and the resultant consumed by the gain controller. Retaining these quantities is necessary when using the calculation outside the reflection sector.

docs.title: Arbitrary paired geometry with a uniform-capacity environment
docs.text:
Removing reflection does not remove the joint obstruction under the same two-call protocol. The following conditional theorem allows all five paired forms and phases to vary independently. It concerns acquisition followed by one strict phase-diameter renewal, not equilibrium, all NFR maintenance or physical geometry.

Declared domain and decision budget. Keep the preceding support, law, context, default coefficients, initial gains, clock and horizon. Forms range over [-1,1]^5; the initial phase lift has oscillation at most three radians, and the target need not be an extremum. Capacities are still (u,W,W,W,W), with 0<u<W<=VF_MAX, and within-pair contrasts remain zero. Require both unclipped flow endpoints in the form rails and the common phase chart at every consumed boundary, including after Mutation (ZHIR). The requested sector remains freshly selected OZ/IL/IL/IL/IL followed by ZHIR/IL/IL/IL/IL, with an acquired positive secant above xi. Preparation is supplied; predicted records cannot replace an actual later recorder. The source-width bound and default gains also imply 3*(1-G1)+s<pi_rep: the first coordinator and subsequent single-pair shift stay within a common arc. No unexamined circular branch is introduced.

Before calculation, freeze eighteen direction/gain outer cells. A reserved partition allowed at most 7,200 regions: those eighteen cells, twenty ordered renewal witnesses, ten signed pressure-peak owners and two local-gap signs. No source evaluation, parameter scan or optimizer was authorized by that partition alone. The coarse inequalities below close all eighteen cells, so the larger partition and any optimizer are unused. No native research response or independent fine response is evaluated.

What asymmetry changes. Write the paired pressure as

p=(p0, p_near+d_near, p_far+d_far, p_far-d_far, p_near-d_near).
P=max(abs(p0), abs(p_near)+abs(d_near), abs(p_far)+abs(d_far)).

The peak depends on the retained contrasts. Replacing it by a peak of means would change selection. The first and second controller resultants also consume the full phase state. The outer cells allow all three target branches at each update, with the actual preceding gains carried forward; excluding even this relaxation does not require evaluating a resultant.

Nevertheless the target transport row still closes in paired means. Let y be the first coordinated phase lift, and define

h=y0-(y1+y4)/2,
t=(y1+y4-y2-y3)/2,
D1=osc(y).

Use H and a for the same two signed mean gaps before the first coordinator. Unlike the reflected case, h, t, H and a can be negative, and h+t is not the diameter. The same two-by-two restriction and its inverse remain exact:

H-h=c_h*h-c_t*t,
a=c_a*t-c_t*h,
p0_next=(1-mu-lambda/2)*p0-lambda*p_far+d_p*(H-h).

The last identity uses p0+2*p_near+2*p_far=0, fixed capacity and the multiplying OZ branch. The meanings of lambda, mu, d_p, c_a, c_t and c_h are those derived above. Arbitrary antisymmetric components cancel from this mean identity, but not from the peak or controller.

The affine phase pressure is valid on the admitted common arc: each fine node has two equally repeated neighboring block phases whose circular resultant has their lift midpoint as its angle. This is ideal-circle algebra; no exact binary64 trigonometric covariance is inferred.

General geometric restrictions. The exact C5 oscillation bound gives

D2 <= (1-G2-L2/2)*D1+A2*s,
D2>D1  =>  D1<T=A2*s/(G2+L2/2).

For a positive shift, the column carrying the impulse is (A2,L2/2,0,0,L2/2). Only eight ordered output pairs can have a favorable impulse difference. If the renewed maximum is on an adjacent row, renewal forces D1<(L2*s/2)/(G2+L2/2)<s. If it is on the target, translate the incoming lift to minimum zero. For h>=0, its coordinated row is at most (1-G2)*D1-L2*h, hence renewal requires A2*s>G2*D1+L2*h>=(G2+L2)*h. For h<0, the target obeys y0<=D1+h, giving abs(h)<s instead. Reversing the lift proves the corresponding negative-shift statements.

Thus an outward shift, whose direction agrees with the sign of h, requires abs(h)<H_max=A2*s/(G2+L2); an inward shift requires abs(h)<s. All admitted gain pairs have H_max>s. The Si argument consequently gives u<=U(abs(h)) using the same r0 and r1, now without reflection. In particular u<0.752 throughout the renewing domain. The literal small-pressure OZ branch therefore has secant below 0.076<xi, including its closed threshold boundary, independently of any multiplied-pressure transport identity.

These restrictions concern the full incoming diameter. Comparing an output pair only with its own incoming gap would not prove renewal. Also, an event remaining inside the old phase hull cannot renew the diameter after the strictly contracting coordinator. A phase pulse alone is not the observation.

Bounds retaining the complete pressure peak. At any non-target block, the endpoint rails and common lift give

abs(p_i_next) <= B(D1)=2*k+b*VF_MAX/2+d_p*D1.

Only the two adjacent blocks have a capacity-contrast contribution; the bound covers them and the far blocks. If the positive target pressure is not zero, its low normalized-pressure ratio prevents it from owning the peak. Hence p0_next<=c*B(D1) for the positive-shift case. If the whole peak is zero, the same inequality holds with the actual divisor-one convention. This bound replaces the reflection-specific peak estimate; it never drops the antisymmetric pressure contribution.

The first rails still imply p_far<=k+d_p*a/2. Independently of reflection, t<=D1 and h+t<=D1. These inequalities allow positive upper bounds before replacing the actual lambda by its maximum. Set

lambda_max=delta*k*VF_MAX*ell,
K=lambda_max*c_a/2+c_t,
S=lambda_max*c_t/2+c_h,
C0=c*(2*k+b*VF_MAX/2)+lambda_max*k,
den(v)=1-lambda_max/2-delta*k*f*v.

All used denominators are strictly positive. The four orientation cases can now be excluded by scalar bounds over the declared gain cells:

Mutation direction and local gap Necessary acquired secant bound Positive, h>=0 <0.091 Positive, h<0 <0.089 Negative, h>=0 <0.030 Negative, h<0 <0.078

For the first row, use t<=D1-h, D1<T and 0<=h<=H_max. A positive history-producing pressure satisfies

u*f*p0 <= f*U(h)*[C0+d_p*(c+K)*T-d_p*(K+c_h)*h]/den(U(H_max)).

Its numerator is a concave quadratic in h, so endpoint and rational-vertex evaluation certifies the bound for the whole interval. A nonpositive pressure numerator already excludes the positive trigger.

For the second row put z=-h<s. Using t<=T in the mean transport gives the sufficient upper bound

u*f*p0 <= f*U(s)*[C0+d_p*((c+K)*T+S*s)]/den(U(s)) < 0.089.

For the third row 0<=h<s and p0_next<=0; discard the latter nonpositive term, use the positive far-pressure upper bound and obtain

u*f*p0 <= f*U(s)*[lambda_max*k+d_p*K*T]/den(U(s)) < 0.030.

The final row needs the capacity/phase relation instead of maximizing them independently. With z=-h>=0, nonpositive fresh target pressure and form rails require b*(W-u)+d_p*z<=2*k. Put R(z)=r0+r1*z; low Si gives u/W<=R(z)<1. Consequently

u <= R(z)*(2*k-d_p*z)/(b*(1-R(z))),
0<=z<=H_max.

Bound u by the exact maximum of the concave numerator on this interval, divided by b*(1-R(H_max)). Call this bound u_star; every gain cell has u_star<0.292. The independent transport bound then gives

u*f*p0 <= f*u_star*[lambda_max*k+d_p*(K*T+S*H_max)]/den(u_star)
          < 0.078.

This proof retains the correlation between capacity and the signed phase pressure. The simpler independent bound u<=U(H_max) is too loose for this case. Both possible signed-zero directions are included by the non-strict pressure inequalities; zero local gap is also covered.

Conclusion and execution boundary. Every multiplying-branch bound is below 0.091<xi, and the fallback bound is below 0.076<xi. Therefore no preparation in this entire arbitrary-paired-geometry domain can both acquire the required Mutation history and complete strict second-call phase-diameter renewal. This conclusion already holds after relaxing some first-selection and grammar constraints, so restoring them cannot create a witness.

The general certificate owner freezes the constant certificates before independent coefficient and optimization checks. It verifies general five-coordinate pressure transport, retained peaks, signed-gap geometry, gain carry, positive denominators and the separate OZ fallback. Production execution is guarded; no preparation, temporal record, completed call or optimizer result is reported. The earlier reflection and admission producers remain unchanged. All arithmetic belongs to the ideal real model over represented coefficients.

The result removes the freedom of paired forms and phases as an escape within this protocol. It still assumes a uniform-capacity environment, the declared pressure and selection laws, one OZ acquisition interval, unclipped forms, the common chart and this diameter observation. It does not exclude other operator histories, longer organizations or maintenance that does not require this particular renewal. No material geometry or fundamental physical property is identified by the exclusion.

docs.title: Heterogeneous capacities: retained association and a necessary spread
docs.text:
Unequal surrounding capacities change the target transport even when the support, pressure law and operators are unchanged. The following calculation retains those terms and excludes a finite neighborhood of the equal-capacity environment. It does not exhibit an acquired organization or identify a physical geometry.

Domain and prospective budget. Retain the preceding arbitrary paired forms and phases, doubled C5, represented defaults, strict grammar, supplied context, empty initial temporal history and two-call horizon. Replace the capacity vector by (u,v1,v2,v3,v4), with 0<u<=VF_MAX and 0<=vi<=VF_MAX. The actual maximum is V=max(u,v1,v2,v3,v4)>0. Both unclipped endpoints, every consumed common phase chart and all live-event obligations remain required. The requested sectors are freshly selected Dissonance (OZ) and then acquired Mutation (ZHIR) at the target, with high-Si Coherence (IL) on every surrounding pair at both boundaries. These are selection conditions, not an imposed operator word. Capacity adaptation remains inactive over this horizon from the declared initial counts.

Before coefficient evaluation, freeze the eighteen carried-gain/direction cells and a single neighborhood width eta0=1/16. No other width, tuning, source search, optimizer, native trajectory or finer partition belongs to this decision budget. Algebraic coordinate and tensor-basis controls check identities rather than physical preparations.

What must be retained. Let n and F be the near and far capacity means, and C the covariance of source capacity and freshly computed source pressure over the two neighboring pairs:

n=(v1+v4)/2,              F=(v2+v3)/2,
C=(v1*p1+v4*p4)/2-n*(p1+p4)/2
 =(v1-v4)*(p1-p4)/4,
lambda_n=delta*k*ell*n,   mu=delta*k*f*u.

The pressure in C precedes the first IL multiplication and flow. Neither the held post-event pressure nor the refreshed next-boundary pressure can replace it. The regular-support identity p0+2*p_near+2*p_far=0 still holds. The exact target row, on the multiplying OZ branch, is now

p0_next=(1-mu-lambda_n/2)*p0-lambda_n*p_far
        +delta*k*ell*C+d_p*(H-h).

With source form means M_near and M_far, the far pressure is

p_far=k*(M_near-M_far)/2+b*(n-F)/2+d_p*a/2.

Thus both capacity contrast and its pressure association survive in the target row. In particular, equal neighboring capacities can make C vanish while n-F remains nonzero. Also, the maximum V used by Si is a different observation from either mean. Retaining only capacity and pressure means does not determine this transport term.

Define the signed capacity contribution J and the positive denominator A:

J=delta*k*ell*[b*n*(n-F)/2-C],
A=1-mu-lambda_n/2,
A*p0=p0_next+lambda_n*[k*(M_near-M_far)/2+d_p*a/2]
     +J-d_p*(H-h).

Here A is positive throughout the default capacity rails. A negative C assists the removal of initial target pressure, holding the other terms fixed; positive C has the opposite sign. This is a pressure-transport identity, not an energy reservoir or a new microscopic law.

The required positive secant u*f*p0>xi, together with the source form rails, implies the necessary joint resource inequality

J > A*xi/(u*f)-p0_next-lambda_n*[k+d_p*a/2]+d_p*(H-h).

For the positive Mutation direction use p0_next<=c*P_next; for the negative direction use p0_next<=0. The complete pressure peak P_next must be retained. The right-hand side can be negative: this argument does not assert that J or its covariance component must independently be positive. Satisfying the inequality does not supply grammar, temporal evidence, selection or renewal.

Actual Coherence selection. At each of the two fresh boundaries every surrounding pair must satisfy

alpha*vi/V + beta*(1-abs((L*theta)_i)/pi_rep)
           + gamma*(1-rho_i) >= si_hi.

The full peak defines rho, including its zero-peak convention. The other two terms are nonnegative on the admitted chart and are bounded above by beta and gamma. Therefore vi/V>=(si_hi-beta-gamma)/alpha>0 is necessary; a zero-capacity surrounding pair cannot belong to this high-Si sector. This coarse floor is not equivalent to the full mask. Conversely alpha*vi/V>=si_hi is sufficient for the base IL choice, with the declared lags and history still retained.

A finite excluded neighborhood. Define

eta=(V-min(v1,v2,v3,v4))/V,
0<=eta<=eta0=1/16,
epsilon0=eta0*VF_MAX,
P_bar=2*k+b*VF_MAX+3*d_p.

All source pressures are bounded by P_bar using the source form rails, capacity rails and phase width three. The entire neighborhood satisfies

abs(C)<=epsilon0*P_bar/2,
n-F<=epsilon0,
abs(p_i_next)<=2*k+b*VF_MAX/2+b*epsilon0/2+d_p*D1,  i!=0.

For the last bound, each far capacity row is at most eta*V in magnitude; each adjacent row is at most (1+eta)*V/2. The bound thus retains every non-target pressure contrast. Since alpha*(15/16)>si_hi, all four surrounding high-Si base choices actually follow at both boundaries within this neighborhood. No missing selection mask is silently replaced by IL.

The coordinator does not consume capacity. Hence the previously derived geometric restrictions remain valid: D1<T, outward abs(h)<H_max and inward abs(h)<s, with actual gains carried between the two updates. Target low Si gives u<=U(abs(h)); the OZ literal fallback again has secant below 0.076<xi, independently of the multiplying-branch identity.

The additional pressure numerator can be bounded before dividing:

R_minus=delta*k*ell*epsilon0*(P_bar+b*VF_MAX)/2,
R_plus=R_minus+c*b*epsilon0/2.

The two terms in R_minus cover adverse covariance and far capacity contrast; the extra term in R_plus covers the enlarged non-target pressure peak. Positive-shift bounds require R_plus, while negative-shift bounds use R_minus. These are rederived joint bounds, not a subtraction of the old numerical gap from a covariance term alone.

The negative outward case additionally changes its capacity bound. With z=-h>=0, nonpositive fresh target pressure requires b*(n-u)+d_p*z<=2*k. Since n>=(1-eta0)*V and u/V<=R(z), it follows that

u <= R(z)*(2*k-d_p*z)/(b*(1-eta0-R(z))).

The denominator is positive on 0<=z<=H_max; a negative numerator would already contradict u>0. Let u_eta be the maximum of the concave numerator on that interval divided by b*(1-eta0-R(H_max)). Exact endpoint/vertex evaluation gives u_eta<0.315. The old uniform capacity bound cannot be reused without this correction.

Use the previously defined K, S, C0, T and den(v), recomputed from the same admitted coefficients. Let B_out be the exact positive-outward scalar quadratic bound in the preceding proof. The following bounds cover all four orientations. For the positive-outward row, a nonpositive old numerator is discarded upward before bounding the added resource; it no longer alone excludes acquisition. A positive old numerator uses B_out, which is positive.

Direction and local gap Necessary acquired secant upper bound Positive, h>=0 B_out+f*U(H_max)*R_plus/den(U(H_max)) < 0.096 Positive, h<0 f*U(s)*[C0+d_p*((c+K)*T+S*s)+R_plus]/den(U(s)) < 0.087 Negative, h>=0 f*U(s)*[lambda_max*k+d_p*K*T+R_minus]/den(U(s)) < 0.031 Negative, h<0 f*u_eta*[lambda_max*k+d_p*(K*T+S*H_max)+R_minus]/den(u_eta) < 0.085

All denominators remain positive. These are ideal-real inequalities over represented coefficients, not an assertion of bitwise trigonometric equivariance. Both shift directions, zero local gap, zero pressure peak and the literal OZ threshold boundary are included.

Result. Every bound is strictly below xi=0.1. Consequently any successful acquired renewal in the declared heterogeneous sector must have eta>1/16: at least one surrounding capacity must be strictly below 15*V/16. This is a necessary spread, not an optimal threshold, a universal constant or a sufficient condition for renewal. The general high-Si floor further requires eta<=1-(si_hi-beta-gamma)/alpha. The resulting interval is only a necessary domain; it does not establish that any source in it is jointly admissible.

The capacity-budget certificate checks the generalized transport and covariance on coefficient bases, the uniform limit, pressure envelopes, actual Coherence floor and all eighteen carried-gain cells. It preserves the earlier producers and guards native execution. No source, new history or completed trajectory is claimed. The retained association is a dynamical dependency; it does not by itself establish a smaller autonomous NFR, formation or sustained organization.

docs.title: Joint-source constraints select the remaining renewal orientation
docs.text:
The heterogeneous resource budget does not permit its pressure, capacity and phase extrema to be realized independently. Enforcing their common source excludes every positive Mutation (ZHIR) increment, every inward increment and every renewal whose new extreme is owned by an adjacent pair within the declared two-call protocol. The remaining negative outward target-extreme case is unresolved; this result is a necessary orientation, not a jointly admitted source or a full-domain impossibility theorem.

Unchanged domain and finite calculation. Keep the complete heterogeneous domain above, including arbitrary five paired forms/phases, capacity rails, both actual high-Si Coherence (IL) masks, the default selector and gains, strict grammar, empty initial temporal history and the supplied context. All pressure fields must arise from the same source and its declared flow. Retain the unclipped source/endpoints and common phase charts. Successful acquisition on the multiplying Dissonance (OZ) branch requires p0>0 and an independently acquired positive secant above xi. The separate literal fallback remains below xi throughout the renewing domain. These are ideal common-lift certificates with represented coefficients; they do not assert exact binary64 wrap equivariance.

The prospective budget contains eighteen carried-gain/direction cells, exact source identities, signed-row support bounds and piecewise polynomial certificates. It contains no source search, optimizer, linear-programming run or native response. A declared extension used degree-at-most-three Bernstein bounds only at natural geometric/capacity breakpoints for the negative outward case. Its failure to exclude that case is retained below; no adaptive subdivisions or posterior threshold changes followed.

The source fixes the covariance. Put m=(si_hi-beta-gamma)/alpha; the admitted default coefficients give m>1/3. Both surrounding high-Si masks imply vi>=m*V. Write near and far capacity contrasts as e and e_far, and use r and s for the corresponding contrasts in another coordinate. The freshly computed source pressure contrast is

e_p=k*(s_x/2-r_x)+b*(e_far/2-e)+d_p*(s_theta/2-r_theta),
C=e*e_p.

It cannot be chosen independently after the forms and phases have been fixed. With zeta=delta*k*ell, the recovered target numerator contains zeta*(n*p_far-C). Its source-form coefficients, in order (x1,x4,x2,x3), are

(k/4)*(n+2*e, n-2*e, -n-e, -n+e).

Since 2*abs(e)<=n, their exact absolute row sum is k*n. The phase and capacity association therefore does not supply an additional freely chosen form contribution. The capacity contribution is b times

Q_capacity=n*(n-F)/2+e^2-e*e_far/2.

Both far-capacity coefficients are nonpositive. Its upper bound places the far capacities at m*V, then keeps the near capacities jointly: the three endpoint types, up to reflection, are (m*V,m*V), (V,m*V) and (V,V). Convexity gives this endpoint support; it is not a scan of preparations. The actual IL masks can make those extrema unattainable, which only makes the necessary relaxation more permissive.

Joint renewal geometry. Let y denote the first coordinated lift, h=y0-(y1+y4)/2 and D=osc(y). For a positive increment whose renewed maximum is on the target, set delta_top=max(y)-y0. A necessary inequality retains the distance from the target to the old maximum:

G2*D+(1-G2)*delta_top+L2*h < A2*s.

For h>=0, write a for the near mean above the incoming minimum and b_phase=D-a=delta_top+h. Then

a>=0, b_phase>=h, a+b_phase<T,
b_phase+G2*a<A2*(s+h).

When the relevant linear support is nondecreasing in a at fixed D, taking delta_top=0 enlarges its upper bound and relaxes the last constraint. This is a support maximization, not an assumption that the original target was an extremum. It leaves

a<=a_max(h)=min(T-h, [A2*s-(G2+L2)*h]/G2),
0<=h<=H_max.

The two affine branches meet at h=T/2. Also min(a_max(h),h) equals h on the first branch and a_max on the second. This joint polygon is strictly stronger than maximizing D and h separately. An adjacent renewed extreme instead requires D<s; that separate case does not use the target-extreme constraint. Negative directions follow by reflecting the phase lift, with the corresponding pressure sign retained.

Keep the signed pressure peak in the same phase calculation. Define

K=zeta*n*c_a/2+c_t,       S=zeta*n*c_t/2+c_h,
E_theta=c_a+c_t/2,       F_theta=c_t+(1+c_h)/2.

The inverse first coordinator gives the recovered phase numerator

d_p*[K*t-S*h+zeta*e*(E_theta*r_y-F_theta*s_y)].

For the next pressure peak, retain each of the eight signed non-target rows rather than separately assigning its phase contribution D:

(L*y)1=(h-t)/2-r_y+s_y/2,
(L*y)4=(h-t)/2+r_y-s_y/2,
(L*y)2=t/2+r_y/2-3*s_y/2,
(L*y)3=t/2-r_y/2+3*s_y/2.

Adding the selected signed row multiplied by c to the recovered phase expression gives A*t+B*h+C_r*r_y+C_s*s_y, with A nonnegative in all declared cells. If the far mean is f_phase, then t=a-f_phase and abs(s_y)<=min(f_phase,D-f_phase). Exact far support is

sup[-A*f_phase+C_s*s_y]=D*max(abs(C_s)-A,0)/2.

Let R_peak=max(abs(C_s)-A,0)/2 and raise A to A_prime=max(A,abs(C_r)). Since a is nonnegative, this is an upper bound. It makes near support monotone in a at fixed D, as required above. The remaining phase bound is

(A_prime+R_peak)*a_max(h)+(B+R_peak)*h
    +abs(C_r)*min(a_max(h),h).

The endpoint form contribution to a non-target peak is at most 2*k; its capacity contribution is bounded using the heterogeneous rails, not the old equal-capacity value. In particular (1-m/2)*V bounds every non-target capacity contrast. All source, capacity and phase support terms retain their coefficients before taking the maximum over endpoint types.

For outward positive h, discarding the favorable term -zeta*n*c_t*h/2 permits S=c_h in an upper bound. This alone does not make every absolute-value expression monotone in V. The full numerator support is convex in V; endpoint support at zero and VF_MAX must be checked before replacing the actual maximum. Zero here is an algebraic bounding endpoint, not an active-capacity preparation. The required rate is then bounded with the admitted U(h) and a positive denominator. Each natural phase branch gives an exact scalar quadratic certificate.

Excluded orientations. Recomputed coefficient certificates give:

Mutation increment and renewed extreme Necessary acquired secant bound Positive, outward, target maximum <0.095 Positive, inward, target maximum <0.094 Negative, inward, target minimum <0.032 Either direction, adjacent extreme <0.053 OZ literal fallback, any orientation <0.076

Every bound is below xi=0.1. Inward cases retain abs(h)<s; adjacent cases retain D<s; both keep the same source pressure and capacity constraints. Zero local gap is covered by the inward bounds. A zero next pressure peak does not erase Si admission: its actual zero-ratio convention is retained, while both possible signed-zero increment directions are included in the respective necessary inequalities.

The remaining question is open. Any successful route in this protocol must use a negative Mutation increment, have h<0, and place the renewed minimum on the target. Its first acquired positive secant requires p0>0; the second selected pressure must satisfy p0_next<=0. This need not be a strict sign reversal because negative signed zero is included. Neither the history requirement nor the current pressure can be substituted for the other.

The same coefficients give R(H_max)<m, so every surrounding capacity exceeds the target capacity u. With z=-h>0, the fresh target pressure p0_next<=0 requires the post-flow form contrast

x0_next-(x1_next+x4_next)/2 >= [b*(n-u)+d_p*z]/k > 0.

Thus a still-possible target is below its neighbors' mean in phase and above their mean in form, while retaining lower capacity. This is a necessary compatibility condition, not a constructed state or a new constitutive law.

For this outward negative case, writing z=-h gives the exact restriction

n<=n_bar(z)=min(VF_MAX, U(z)+(2*k-d_p*z)/b).

The finite cubic attempt joined this with source capacity support and the renewal polygon. Its rational Bernstein upper envelope exceeds 0.157 in the worst cell and therefore does not exclude the required rate 0.1. That is an inconclusive upper bound, not an attained rate, an admissible source or evidence of renewal. No finer partition or response was evaluated.

The remaining actual IL masks still couple near capacity to geometry and pressure. For example, averaging the second near masks gives n/V>=m+beta*abs(h-t)/(2*alpha*pi_rep), even after discarding the nonnegative pressure penalty. The owner of the actual maximum V and the common source/endpoint form rails also remain unresolved joint constraints. They cannot be replaced by a favorable covariance or independent extrema.

The joint-orientation certificate retains the closed orientations and the inconclusive negative outward attempt separately. Earlier producers remain unchanged. This is progress on the declared acquisition/renewal mechanism; formation, maintenance, equilibrium and physical identification remain separate questions.

docs.title: Same-source feasibility with retained pressure peaks
docs.text:
The remaining negative-outward renewal question is still open. Two finite algebraic attempts below retain more of the shared source, but neither certifies exclusion or supplies a feasible source. An exact pressure-coordinate reduction now exposes the remaining compatibility problem directly, including all three form boundaries. It preserves the complete two-call domain above; no threshold, support, history or horizon changes, source search or native response belongs to this calculation.

Actual capacity ownership. Because u/V<R(H_max)<m, the target cannot own the maximum capacity. A maximum must occur at a near or far pair; ties can belong to both cases. This is an exhaustive decomposition of the same domain, not a selection of prepared capacity profiles. If a near pair owns V, then n>=(1+m)*V/2, and the negative fresh target pressure gives

u <= min(VF_MAX*R(z), R(z)*(2*k-d_p*z)/(b*((1+m)/2-R(z)))).

All denominators are positive. In either ownership case, n>u also requires z<2*k/d_p. If a far pair owns V, the same-source capacity resource obeys Q_capacity<=(1-m)*V^2/4. To see this, reflect the cycle so v2=V and maximize over v3 at m*V. The four near-capacity corner values, divided by V^2, are

-m*(1-m)/4, (1-m)^2/8, 3*(1-m)^2/8, (1-m)/4.

Coordinatewise convexity and m>1/3 give the stated bound. The stronger fixed-mean expression keeps

Q_capacity <= n^2/2+e^2-V*((1+m)*n-(1-m)*abs(e))/4,
abs(e) <= min(n-m*V,V-n).

The frozen first attempt combined the coarse ownership bounds with the renewal polygon over nine carried gain pairs. Its worst acquired-rate upper bounds are approximately 0.10994 for a near maximum and 0.17459 for a far maximum. Both exceed xi; neither is an attained rate. The exact failed calculations remain with the certificate rather than being replaced by a favorable interpretation.

The first pressure peak remains associated with the acquired history. On the multiplying branch, successful history requires p0>0. The actual default Dissonance (OZ) selection also requires p0/P0>c, where c=dnfr_hi and P0 is the first full pressure peak. Hence P0<p0/c. This comparison is strict; hysteresis and score overrides belong to the separate parametric selector, and strict grammar cannot substitute OZ. The declared lag priorities cannot create an OZ request either.

Write q=p_next. Before zero-sum elimination, the same-source target row is

q0=(1-delta*k*f*u)*p0
   +zeta*(v1*p1+v4*p4)/2-d_p*(c_h*z+c_t*t).

Because n>0, its near contribution is strictly greater than -zeta*n*p0/c. This couples the allowed pressure transport to the very pressure that must generate the positive secant; the two cannot be maximized independently.

Put B(z)=(2*k-d_p*z)/b, R(z)=r0+r1*z, and J(z,t)=m+r1*abs(z+t)/2-R(z). The second near Coherence (IL) masks and fresh target pressure imply

n<=u+B(z),        u<=R(z)*B(z)/J(z,t).

These use the actual t of the source. A phase value chosen solely to maximize another bound cannot be charged to the IL mask. If t<-z, replacing t by -z raises the phase numerator and removes a nonnegative IL penalty, giving a valid upward relaxation. The renewal geometry also gives t<=A2*(s+z). With t>=-z, the resulting acquired-rate envelope is

f*d_p*R*B*(c_h*z+c_t*t)
---------------------------------------------------------------
[m+r1*(z+t)/2-R]*(1-zeta*B/c)-(delta*k*f+zeta/c)*R*B.

The frozen certificate proves the substituted denominator positive. At fixed z the numerator and denominator are affine in t, so their ratio is bounded by its two endpoint values. These have cubic numerators and quadratic denominators in z. Exact rational Bernstein bounds on the declared natural intervals give a positive denominator margin above 0.17749, but the threshold-gap coefficients do not certify exclusion. The resulting conservative rate envelope remains above xi. This second attempt is also inconclusive. No subdivision, alternative envelope, source evaluation or threshold adjustment followed it.

Exact source coordinates and all fifteen form rails. Let L=N-I on the five-cycle, with indices modulo five. On zero-sum pressure, the inverse on the mean-zero subspace is

(Q*p)i=-4*p_i/5+2*(p_(i-2)+p_(i+2))/5,
L*Q=Q*L=I-1*1^T/5.

For fixed capacities v and a source phase lift theta, the declared pressure law p=L*(k*x+b*v+d_p*theta) is equivalent to

sum(p)=0,
a0=(Q*p-b*v-d_p*theta)/k,
x0=a0+eta*1.

This inverts the supplied constitutive pressure law before evolution; it does not reconstruct pressure from an evaluated form derivative. The common form offset eta is a free source coordinate subject to the form rails. With F1=diag(f,ell,ell,ell,ell) and the first relative coordinator y,

a1=a0+delta*diag(v)*F1*p,
q=p+delta*k*L*diag(v)*F1*p+d_p*L*(y-theta),
a2=a1+delta*diag(v)*F2*q,
F2=diag(1,ell,ell,ell,ell).

Mutation changes phase without a form jump. Its terminal flow still uses the selected, held q, not a pressure refreshed after the phase event. Thus the three form boundaries are xj=aj+eta*1. For the fifteen coordinates of (a0,a1,a2), a single offset exists exactly when

max(a0,a1,a2)-min(a0,a1,a2)<=2,
eta in [-1-min(a0,a1,a2), 1-max(a0,a1,a2)].

Separate offset choices at each boundary would admit inconsistent histories. The associated first-flow secant remains u*f*p0; the second endpoint is retained for complete-call rails, not a second Mutation trigger. Since the admitted capacities are positive, the exact weighted balances are

sum_i (x1_i-x0_i)/(v_i*F1_ii)=delta*sum_i p_i=0,
sum_i (x2_i-x1_i)/(v_i*F2_ii)=delta*sum_i q_i=0.

These identities constrain one source and its evolution. They neither admit an event nor establish conservation of unweighted form.

Conditional linear feasibility; the parameter domain remains open. Fix capacities and primitive relative phases, admit their common charts, and determine the actual two controller branches and complete phase renewal. Then four independent source pressures and eta suffice for the remaining source/flow constraints. The three forms and q above are affine in these five unknowns. Retaining eta uses thirty linear rail inequalities.

For a positive pressure peak P with fixed owner j and sign sigma, impose P=sigma*p_j>0 and -P<=p_i<=P. Define, at each selection boundary, S_i=alpha*v_i/V+beta*(1-abs((L*theta)_i)/pi_rep)+gamma. The surrounding high-Si masks are the two linear inequalities gamma*p_i<=(S_i-si_hi)*P and -gamma*p_i<=(S_i-si_hi)*P. Source target selection, its positive secant, and successor target selection similarly retain

(S0_initial-si_lo)*P0-gamma*p0<=0,
p0>c*P0,             u*f*p0>xi,
p0>OZ_TINY,
(S0_next-si_lo)*P1+gamma*q0<=0,
q0<=0,               -q0<=c*P1.

There are nine possible signed source-peak owners: positive target or either sign at a non-target pair. When P1>0, c<1 excludes the target as its owner, leaving eight signed non-target choices. Thus each fixed admitted parameter configuration has at most 72 linear nonzero-peak systems, plus nine separate q=0 outer systems. Ties may overlap. At q=0, retain the actual zero-ratio Si tests; multiplying by a zero peak would erase them.

Here OZ_TINY is the actual multiplying-branch cutoff. Strict inequalities require exact positive slack or a verified witness, not a solver tolerance. A common slack must use fixed declared scales for pressure and rate units; separate exact margins avoid that extra convention. Rational capacities and relative phases, with admitted controller branches and represented law coefficients, give rational systems; arbitrary fixed real parameters need not. A constructive negative action requires q0<0 or a separate proof that the fresh represented producer yields negative zero. An assigned algebraic zero cannot supply that sign bit. Both directions may still be retained in an exclusion domain.

This is a reduction of the conditional pressure/form problem. The capacities, phases and their admissible controller branches remain joint parameters; the full problem has not become a solved linear program. No linear solver or source was evaluated. The source-constraint certificate retains the failed envelopes and checks the inverse, transport, shared offset and weighted balances independently. These are conditional compatibility restrictions of the declared model. Autonomous occurrence, formation and selection of a fundamental law remain separate questions.

docs.title: Exact conditional pressure-system compilation
docs.text:
The private research compiler implements the preceding reduction for the unchanged paired unit five-cycle, two-call Dissonance (OZ)/Coherence (IL) then Mutation (ZHIR)/Coherence (IL) protocol. It is a detached algebraic instrument. It selects no source, installs no execution law and evaluates neither a native trajectory nor a linear program.

NativeMutationSlice supplies five capacities, five primitive phase lifts and two declared controller branches. compile_native_mutation_slice re-admits those primitives and rebuilds the law from fresh owned defaults.
