This changes the subsequent nodal rate under the same held target pressure; it is not only a different instantaneous form blend.

Keep the same support, capacities, node order, supplied context, clock, seed, one-substep budget and defaults. Let A=15/16, target block form B=-21/32, and both middle blocks have form -A. Target phases are two; phases in blocks one and four are zero on even nodes and two on odd nodes; middle phases are one. In each adjacent block, the low/high-phase forms are (A,0) in the inactive preparation and (0,A) in the active preparation. Both retain the full-neighbor mean A/2 at the targets, the same unordered form inventories, all block means, capacities, phases and common kind seed.

Write e=0,1 for the inactive/active preparation and H=(B-A)/2=-51/64. The independent full-support fresh-pressure algebra gives

z = 9*k/8 + 3*b/4 - w/P,
p_target = z,
p_high = k*(H-e*A)-3*b/8-w/(2*P),
p_low = k*(H-(1-e)*A)-3*b/8+3*w/(2*P),
p_middle = 3*k*A/4,               peak_e=-p_high.

The target pressure is identical across preparations, with 8/1000<z<9/1000. The pressure peaks differ, so fresh target Si also differs:

Si_target(e)=alpha/4+beta*(1-1/P)+gamma*(1-z/peak_e).

Both target Si values lie strictly between 37/100 and 38/100, and both normalized target pressures lie below 3/100. All other Si values exceed alpha+beta*(1-3/(2*P))>85/100. The actual native selector thus requests RA on the first pair and IL elsewhere in both cases. This comparison does not claim identical Si or identical full-network pressure.

At either target, the two high-phase neighbors have zero phase gap and the two low-phase neighbors have gap two. Since 0<L<2, the live U3 subset is again exactly nodes (3,9). Its form mean is e*A, not the all-neighbor mean A/2. Both RA phase proposals equal the existing target phase two; the two nonadjacent events have unchanged propagation inputs. The event law gives

X_e=(1-r)*B+r*e*A < 0,             u_e=(1+e*a)/4,
rate_e=u_e*z,                     x_target_next=X_e+delta*u_e*z.

The selected zero mean leaves capacity unchanged; the selected positive mean exceeds the shared represented trigger and activates its default boost. Both events preserve sign and established kind. All endpoint forms are strictly inside the scalar rails. Other nodes retain their initial forms through IL and then use their own held pressure h*p_n with capacity one. Every held pressure magnitude exceeds the stability threshold, so no adaptation write can explain the different target capacities or rates. In particular,

rate_active-rate_inactive = a*z/4,
x_active_next-x_inactive_next = r*A+delta*a*z/4.

These ideal differences are approximately 0.00008275353679 and 0.1492129312447 respectively. Using the full-neighbor mean would incorrectly activate the boost in the zero-selected-mean preparation. The same initial target pressure can therefore produce distinct post-event nodal rates through RA's actual capacity law, without replacing pressure or rescaling the clock.

The unchanged post-event phases contain four nodes at two, four at one and two at zero. Their global resultant magnitude is

R = sqrt((4+6*cos(1))^2+(2*sin(1))^2)/10,
R_lo < R < R_hi.

There are no disruptors. The phase controller consequently takes its transition branch, not the stable branch of the earlier small-cone source. Alternating-series rational bounds for sin(1) and cos(1) establish these strict thresholds before execution. Both preparations share all phase inputs, so their coordinator outputs agree. The fresh neighbor angles are 1 at targets and middle nodes, and 3/2 at adjacent nodes. With global angle psi=1+atan2(2*sin(1),4+6*cos(1)), the ordinary common-lift coordinator row (1-kG-kL)*theta_n+kG*psi+kL*local_mean_n gives a separately budgeted finite phase forecast. No stable-branch coefficient is transferred from the earlier family.

The capacity-association controls freeze both preparations, configurations and all predictions before four native calls across scalar/NumPy paths. They check fresh pressure/Si, actual requests/subsets, all form/capacity writes, held-pressure rates, phase branch, history and adaptation/REMESH abstention, with the same declared 1e-14 absolute finite allowance. Together the two association studies resolve the single-event information question for their admitted sources. They do not establish a complete collective state, an interacting-target batch closure, formed identity, autonomous occurrence or physical identification.

docs.title: An accepted Resonance prefix changes a later capacity branch
docs.text:
The native selector prepares all requests before the ordered event loop, but each Resonance (RA) reads its live compatible neighbors. These two boundaries cannot be identified. An earlier RA can change a later requested RA's capacity branch even when every phase stays zero and all neighbors remain compatible. This is more specific than the previously established dependence of sequential form mixing on target order.

Admitted source family. Retain doubled C5, node order 0..9, consecutive twins, common kind seed, supplied AL → IL → EN context, zero AL/EN lags and adaptation counters, strict grammar, seed 17, t=1, delta=1/16, live zero Gamma and the default laws. Initial rates remain the declared block values (i-2)/8. Let all phases be zero and set

q in [7/64,1/8],
M=(q,q,-q,-1/2,-q),               V=(1/4,1/4,1,1,1).

This is a correlated source family: in particular M_2=M_4=-M_0=-M_1. It is not an unconstrained open set in the full native state. No source history, order or occurrence law is derived by specifying these coordinates.

With normalized form/capacity pressure weights k,b, define

z=3*b/8-k*q,                      P=k*(1/2-q),
p=(z,z,-P/2-z,P,-P/2-z).

Here P denotes this family's pressure peak, not the phase normalizer used above. All phase-pressure terms vanish. Exact rational bounds on the represented defaults give P>0 and abs(z)/P<27/1000. Consequently max_i abs(p_i)=P, because abs(-P/2-z)<(1/2+27/1000)*P<P. For separately resolved Si weights alpha,beta,gamma, the first two blocks have

Si_RA=alpha/4+beta+gamma*(1-abs(z)/P),
42/100 < Si_RA < 44/100.

The remaining blocks have Si at least alpha+beta>94/100. Thus the actual default selector requests RA at nodes zero through three and Coherence (IL) at nodes four through nine throughout this interval. All selector margins are strict. Si is retained and pressure is not recomputed during the event loop; RA retains its target pressure and IL applies its declared factor.

Live block recurrence. For pair-constant primitives and consecutive twin targets, twins see the same neighboring blocks. An action at the first twin does not change the second twin's inputs, since the twins are nonadjacent. An admitted RA therefore preserves that block's pair equality. In ideal-real arithmetic, each block action can be written using the current neighbor block forms and phases: re-admit the compatible blocks, take their equally weighted means/resultant, and apply the actual form, phase, identity and capacity laws. Later blocks consume these updated values. This conditional recurrence retains the admitted context and order; it is not a simultaneous initial-snapshot map or a complete collective state for arbitrary events.

For this family all four neighbors are compatible at every RA event. Write r,a for the default form-mixing and capacity-amplification factors and T=Q(RA_RUNTIME_AMPLIFICATION_TRIGGER) for the represented trigger. Initially the neighbor form means of both RA blocks are zero. The first RA block gives

m_0=(q-q)/2=0,
Y_0=(1-r)*q,                      u_0=1/4.

Its phase remains zero and its capacity does not increase. The later block instead reads

m_1=(Y_0-q)/2=-r*q/2,
Y_1=q*(1-r-r^2/2),                u_1=(1+a)/4.

Uniformly, abs(m_1)>8/1000>T. The negative selected mean activates the implemented absolute-value trigger; positive mean is not required. Both proposals remain strictly positive, retain kind seed and lie strictly inside the scalar rails. Therefore the full RA prefix is admitted. The later amplification is caused by the accepted earlier form jump, not by a new selector decision, capacity adaptation or an inserted operator.

Complete call and discriminator. IL retains the other pressures by its factor h and leaves their primitive form/capacity unchanged. The complete Euler form prediction is

x_0_next=(1-r)*q+delta*z/4,
x_1_next=q*(1-r-r^2/2)+delta*(1+a)*z/4,
x_2_next=x_4_next=-q+delta*h*(-P/2-z),
x_3_next=-1/2+delta*h*P.

The rates are the displayed time-increment coefficients and the capacities are (1/4,(1+a)/4,1,1,1). All endpoint forms satisfy abs(x)<3/5. The coordinator has resultant one and zero disruptor load, takes its stable branch and leaves every phase zero. The RA blocks fail capacity-adaptation qualification because their retained Si is below si_hi=1/2, even where their pressure lies inside the separate stability band. Other held pressure magnitudes exceed 1/50. All adaptation counts remain zero, with no adaptation write; short temporal histories also retain REMESH abstention.

A hypothetical pre-batch form snapshot would keep the later selected mean zero and incorrectly predict both Y_1_stale=(1-r)*q and u_1_stale=1/4. The actual-minus-stale differences are

event form:     -r^2*q/2,
nodal rate:      a*z/4,
terminal form:  -r^2*q/2+delta*a*z/4.

The terminal difference is strictly below -1/1000 on the whole source interval. At q=15/128, z is positive and nonzero, so the capacity change also gives a nonzero rate difference. At a source where z=0, the same capacity-branch distinction persists but its immediate form-rate difference vanishes; capacity does not override the nodal product.

The supplied block-one U2 debt remains one after RA; Resonance is neutral in that ledger. IL blocks discharge their supplied debt. Successful completion of this native call is not completion of every grammatical obligation or permission to discard its context on a subsequent call.

Form uncertainty without exact cancellation. Keep phase, capacity, support, kind, context, order and every law fixed, but perturb each initial nodal form independently by at most epsilon=T/2. For ideal-real arithmetic, every fresh pressure changes by at most eta=2*k*epsilon, and so does its graph-wide absolute maximum. With zeta=max(abs(z(7/64)),abs(z(1/8))) and P_min=3*k/8, the perturbed RA pressure ratio is bounded by (zeta+eta)/(P_min-eta)<27/1000; the same strict selector branches remain. The maximum-capacity IL blocks retain their independent Si lower bound.

Every sequential unclipped RA form update is a convex row, so its sup-norm error remains at most epsilon throughout the accepted prefix. The first block's selected mean is therefore in [-epsilon,epsilon], strictly inside the inactive trigger band. The later selected mean stays within epsilon of -r*q/2, whose magnitude remains above T. Positive target identity, scalar rails and adaptation rejection retain their separate margins. Thus capacities, phases and branch choices agree with the nominal source, and

max_n abs(x_n_next_perturbed-x_n_next_nominal)
    <= (1+2*delta*k)*epsilon < 41*epsilon/40.

This supplies a form-only enclosure with independent constituent errors. It does not preserve exact twin equality or produce a quotient of every perturbed source. Its narrow width is set by the implemented amplification threshold; it is not a physical preparation tolerance. The ideal enclosure and the finite nominal binary64 check remain separate claims.

The live-prefix controls freeze nominal q=15/128, both scalar/NumPy configurations and all forecasts before two native calls. Independent rational algebra certifies the family and nominal form/rate/capacity response; finite binary64 comparisons retain a separate absolute 1e-14 allowance. Observers record every prepared request, live subset, selected mean, ordered jump, held pressure, phase/capacity policy and history. This closes a bounded adjacent-RA capacity-branch question under supplied order. It does not prove autonomous ordering, general changing-U3 closure, repeated-call maintenance, formed identity or physical identification.

docs.title: A restricted Resonance prefix cannot remove existing phase compatibility
docs.text:
There is also a geometric obstruction to one possible later rejection. Consider the ideal RA/IL event prefix, before the global/local phase coordinator, on doubled C5 with pair-constant phases, consecutive complete twin actions, fixed U3 limit 0<=L<=pi/2 and RA phase factor 0<=c<=1. Every action is assumed admitted in its other consumed state and grammar conditions. Each target has at most two distinct neighboring block phases, with equal multiplicities. No assumption about their form means replaces those conditions.

Put the target at phase zero on its local circular lift. If both neighbor blocks are compatible, write their offsets a,b in [-L,L]. Their normalized resultant is

cos((a-b)/2) * exp(i*(a+b)/2).

Unless it vanishes at opposite boundary offsets, its lifted angle is (a+b)/2. After RA the offsets relative to the moved target become

a_next=(1-c/2)*a-(c/2)*b,
b_next=(1-c/2)*b-(c/2)*a.

Each row's absolute coefficients sum to one, so both offsets remain in [-L,L]. If their previous clearances are mu_a=L-abs(a) and mu_b=L-abs(b), the first clearance is at least (1-c/2)*mu_a+(c/2)*mu_b, and symmetrically for the second. If only one block is compatible, its offset becomes (1-c)*a, retaining at least its old clearance. An undefined selected mean leaves the target phase fixed.

Each first twin leaves the second's neighbor inputs unchanged; completing the pair preserves pair-constant phases. Direct IL leaves phases unchanged. Induction therefore preserves every already compatible edge through this restricted event prefix. A later RA with an initially nonempty compatible set cannot lose its U3 admission solely through those earlier phase jumps. This does not prevent an independent identity or grammar rejection.

Incompatible edges may enter the set. For example, the ideal local offsets 1 and 8/5 have only the first block admitted at the default gate. The RA shift is c; the second gap becomes 8/5-c<pi/2 for the default factor. This illustrates geometric possibility, not fresh native selection or an admitted complete call with that preparation.

The retained pair geometry, equal multiplicities and event boundary are essential hypotheses. This proof does not apply to internally dispersed neighbor phases, interleaved twins, arbitrary neighbor multiplicities, another phase-changing operator or the subsequent coordinator. It is an ideal-real statement; binary64 wrapping/resultants need an error allowance smaller than the propagated strict clearance. Equality at U3 does not acquire a universal floating-point guarantee from the affine inequality. The live-prefix controls also check the affine extremal and margin identities independently of native responses; no phase-loss trajectory is evaluated or inferred.

docs.title: Resonance can enlarge a later target's live compatible neighborhood
docs.text:
An admitted Resonance (RA) phase jump can make an existing, previously excluded neighbor compatible with a later target. Its form then enters the later propagation mean. This changes the response even when both requests were prepared together and both capacity branches remain active. Support edges are retained; the changing object is the U3 propagation subset.

Source and selection. Retain the preceding doubled-C5 support, consecutive twins in node order 0..9, kind seed, supplied AL → IL → EN context, zero selector lags and adaptation counters, strict grammar, seed 17, t=1, delta=1/16, live zero Gamma and unchanged default laws. The prior block rates are (i-2)/8, with zero acceleration and empty temporal histories. Write P=Q(math.pi) for the represented pressure normalizer and L=P/2 for the U3 limit. The correlated pair-homogeneous preparation family is

A=15/16,                       epsilon in [1/2048,1/512],
M=(A,-A,A,0,-A),               V=(1/4,1/4,1,1,1),
theta=(0,L+epsilon,2*epsilon,3,L-epsilon).

These are supplied coordinates and grammar memories. Their formation or selection is not derived. The nominal epsilon=1/1024 has exactly materializable primitive coordinates. The family below uses ideal-real arithmetic on represented law coefficients; finite execution is checked separately with the frozen absolute 1e-14 allowance.

All initial phases lie in [0,3], narrower than a semicircle. Neighbor resultants are defined and their common-lift angles are (L,epsilon,(L+epsilon+3)/2,(L+epsilon)/2,3/2). With normalized pressure weights k,b,w for form, capacity and phase, respectively, fresh pressure is

p_0=-2*k*A+3*b/8+w/2,
p_1= 2*k*A+3*b/8-w/2,
p_2=-3*k*A/2-3*b/8+w*(L+3-3*epsilon)/(2*P),
p_3=w*((L+epsilon)/2-3)/P,
p_4=3*k*A/2-3*b/8+w*(3/2-L+epsilon)/P.

Exact rational endpoint bounds, extended by affine dependence on epsilon, place these in (.057,.059), (-.015,-.013), (.27,.28), (-.54,-.53) and (.21,.22), respectively. Thus the global absolute peak is -p_3. Both first-block pressure ratios are below .12, strictly below the default selector threshold. Independently resolved Si weights give both target indices in (.33,.34); the capacity-one blocks have Si at least alpha>.75. Therefore the actual prepared requests are RA at nodes zero through three and Coherence (IL) at nodes four through nine. Si is retained and pressure is not recomputed during the event loop; RA retains its target pressure and IL applies its factor h. Global selection does not supply U3 admission.

Two ordered live actions. Initially block zero admits only block four, while block one admits only block two. Their included gaps are L-epsilon and excluded gaps L+epsilon, with strict margins on both sides. For the default RA form, capacity and phase factors r,a,c, the first pair gives

selected_mean_0=-A,
Y_0=(1-2*r)*A > 0,              u=c*(L-epsilon),
capacity_0_star=(1+a)/4.

The negative selected mean activates the absolute-value capacity trigger. The twins are nonadjacent, so their consecutive actions read identical inputs. Block zero's new phase makes it compatible with block one: the clearance is u-epsilon>.12 throughout the source interval. When the later pair executes, its selected set has grown from two nodes to all four:

selected_mean_1=(Y_0+A)/2=(1-r)*A,
selected_phase_1=(u+2*epsilon)/2,
Y_1=-(1-r)^2*A < 0,
v=(1-c)*(L+epsilon)+c*(u+2*epsilon)/2
 =(1-c)*L+epsilon+(c^2/2)*(L-epsilon),
capacity_1_star=(1+a)/4.

Both selected form means are uniformly far above the amplification threshold in magnitude. The positive first and negative second target forms retain their signs, all neighbors retain kind seed, and the proposals lie inside the scalar rails. Each live RA therefore passes its separate identity and grammar conditions. The newly admitted forms and phases, not a changed request or refreshed pressure, account for the second response.

A hypothetical calculation that freezes only the initial compatible sets would retain block two alone for the later target. It predicts Y_1_stale=-(1-2*r)*A and v_stale=(1-c)*L+(1+c)*epsilon. Consequently

Y_1-Y_1_stale=-r^2*A,
v-v_stale=c*(u-2*epsilon)/2 > 0.

Both calculations amplify the same capacity. With the same held pressure, the terminal form difference remains exactly -r^2*A, approximately -.02374715 for the represented defaults. This discriminator isolates the changed live subset; it does not require a capacity-branch change.

Complete-call successor. If h is the direct IL pressure-retention factor, the post-event and integration rows are

Y=((1-2*r)*A,-(1-r)^2*A,A,0,-A),
V_star=((1+a)/4,(1+a)/4,1,1,1),
p_held=(p_0,p_1,h*p_2,h*p_3,h*p_4),
rate_i=V_star_i*p_held_i,        x_i_next=Y_i+delta*rate_i.

All terminal forms satisfy abs(x)<.96. Capacities remain admitted, all held-pressure magnitudes exceed the separate adaptation stability threshold, and the RA targets also have Si below si_hi=1/2. Counts stay zero without an adaptation write. Short histories retain REMESH abstention. RA is U2 neutral, so the supplied block-one debt remains one; IL blocks discharge their supplied debts. Successful execution does not close every grammatical obligation for a future invocation.

The post-event phases are Phi=(u,v,2*epsilon,3,L-epsilon), in the common arc [2*epsilon,3]. To certify the coordinator's own branch, pair the phasors at 2*epsilon and 3, and bound the other three by one:

R <= (3+2*cos(3/2-epsilon))/5 < 63/100 < R_lo.

The strict middle inequality follows from the degree-eight alternating Taylor upper bound for cosine at 3/2-1/512, which is below 3/40. There are no disruptors. The actual coordinator branch is dissonant; that policy label does not mean that Dissonance (OZ) executes. The global gain moves toward kG_max with up, while the local gain moves toward (kL_min+kL_max)/2 with down. Their resulting values K_G,K_L are positive with sum below one. For

Psi=arg(sum_j exp(i*Phi_j)),     ell_i=(Phi_(i-1)+Phi_(i+1))/2,
theta_i_next=(1-K_G-K_L)*Phi_i+K_G*Psi+K_L*ell_i,

every angle stays in the same common arc. The absolute-angle forecast uses an independent elementary-trigonometric evaluation with the declared finite allowance; the family branch inequality is an analytical certificate.

The gained block-zero/block-one compatibility also survives this coordinator. Put D=v-u, with 0<D<L. Their local-target difference has magnitude (D+L-3*epsilon)/2<L. The common global target cancels in their difference, giving the exact rational forecast

theta_1_next-theta_0_next
  =(1-K_G-K_L)*D+K_L*(ell_1-ell_0),
abs(theta_1_next-theta_0_next) < (1-K_G)*L < L.

This retains the gained edge only. It neither makes all edges compatible nor invokes another RA or selector decision.

The neighbor-gain controls freeze both nominal configurations and complete forecasts before two native calls, one scalar and one NumPy. They observe prepared requests, actual live subsets, ordered writes, held-pressure integration, coordinator and retained context against the independent predictions. The changing-subset mechanism belongs to the existing runtime; no selector, factor or evolution law is replaced. The result is a conditional one-call response, not general native closure, formation, autonomous ordering or physical identification.

docs.title: Sufficient state and a native five-node realization of one RA/IL call
docs.text:
The preceding Resonance (RA) and Coherence (IL) results compose into a conditional complete-call reduction. On the domain below, one existing native call on a five-node unit C5 realizes the ideal block response of doubled C5. Each reduced node represents two nonadjacent twins, and each reduced edge lifts to the four unit edges between its endpoint blocks. No new selector, integrator or operator is needed. This is a symmetry of a supplied execution family, not formation of a collective NFR or a claim that every organized object admits this reduction.

Execution domain. Fix the existing default pressure/Si laws, default selector, direct glyph path, hard clipping, strict grammar, live built-in zero Gamma, default Euler integration and one substep delta=1/16 at a declared structural time, with use_Si=True and apply_glyphs=True. Process reduced nodes in order 0..4, and fine nodes in the corresponding consecutive-pair order 0..9. Keep the seed and the actual node/neighbor orders for reproducible finite execution. There are no external nodes, custom callbacks, optional mathematics engine or optional RA coherence/metric tracking. Automatic REMESH remains enabled but its separate stable_frac history has fewer than the required default 25 samples; this call produces no additional such sample, so the gate abstains.

Use signed scalar forms inside their rails, positive capacities inside their rails and a common nonempty semantic kind. Every RA proposal must avoid a strict nonzero sign reversal, retain that kind and have finite post-amplification capacity inside the rails. All physical scalars, clocks, grammar records and consumed histories pass their own admission. Concrete floating execution also requires representable produced arithmetic; finite inputs alone do not guarantee a finite terminal acceleration. The phase representatives admit one common circular lift in an arc of width less than pi. Equal positive multiplicities then give defined full-neighbor, selected-neighbor and global resultants. U3 still requires a nonempty compatible subset at each live RA; the common arc alone does not supply that condition.

The prepared mark at every block must be RA or IL, including the actual lag policy. An AL or EN override, or a base request for OZ, ZHIR or NAV, exits this two-operator domain. Such an exit is not a grammar rejection of that mark. All subsequent RA/IL grammar and identity gates remain live. This defines a partial one-call map; its successor need not satisfy the next call's selector or lag conditions.

Retained state and output. The reduction keeps associated coordinates, not independent marginal inventories:

Retained input Role in the call Per-block form x_i, phase theta_i, capacity v_i, kind Fresh pressure/Si, live U3 and RA propagation/identity, flow and phase/capacity policies Per-block AL/EN lag counts Increment-before-comparison forcing; a base RA or IL request alone is insufficient Normalized grammar trace, U2 debt, prior-Coherence flag and operator ordinal Live admission and successor context; RA retains debt and IL reduces it Associated stability count s_i Capacity qualification duration and the actual write decision Prior stored form rate r_i and admitted temporal EPI history Terminal acceleration and separate before-event/after-event/flow records Current global phase gains, clock and invocation ordinal The actual coordinator, time update and runtime bookkeeping Retained output archives and insufficient REMESH stability history Record continuation and the independently justified absence of delayed mixing

Support, multiplicity, order and complete configuration are fixed model inputs. Initial stored pressure and Si are refreshed before selection; they are not independent causal coordinates for this path. Initial acceleration is read and normalized during selector preparation, although the default base-choice formula does not use it. Its admission, including represented normalization, cannot be skipped. Within that admitted domain the successful endpoint is independent of its old value: integration replaces it using the retained prior rate. A rejected call can retain that old acceleration, so reconstructing its complete failed-state telemetry requires retaining it.

Previous phase-controller telemetry is output history, not feedback in the next branch decision. The evolving gains and post-event glyph load are feedback. Rebuildable caches, wall-clock timings and array workspaces are excluded observations, not extra physical coordinates. This projection is neither a checkpoint format nor a proof of a minimal state for other paths.

A bounded grammar memory. Default glyph retention is seven entries. Every accepted RA/IL action gives

H_i_next = suffix_6(H_i) concatenated with g_i,
debt_i_next = debt_i                  if g_i=RA,
              max(0,debt_i-1)         if g_i=IL,
prior_IL_i_next = prior_IL_i or (g_i=IL),
operator_step_i_next = operator_step_i+1.

Thus six retained old glyphs suffice for the successful successor trace and the coordinator's subsequent load observation, whose window is fifty but sees at most seven entries per node here. For RA/IL, U1a needs only whether the incoming trace is empty, U2 needs authoritative debt, and U4 is inapplicable. Empty history with exactly zero form rejects either mark; RA cannot preserve debt above the configured capacity, whereas IL may reduce an over-capacity debt. U3 reads current physical state separately.

This memory reduction applies after all original identifiers and ledger values have been admitted. Preserve the normalized lifetime operator step, which is at least the original trace length, and the prior-Coherence flag; truncating first would change reconstruction or hide invalid history. Older entries remain necessary if the requested output includes the original rejected trace. No average of constituent histories replaces their required within-block association.

One explicit block map. Let ell_i be the common-lift mean of the two neighboring block phases, d_i=wrap(ell_i-theta_i), V=max_i v_i and P=max_i abs(p_i). With independently resolved normalized pressure and Si weights, fresh rows are

p_i = w_phase*d_i/pi
      + w_epi*((x_(i-1)+x_(i+1))/2-x_i)
      + w_vf*((v_(i-1)+v_(i+1))/2-v_i),
Si_i = alpha*v_i/V + beta*(1-abs(d_i)/pi)
       + gamma*(1-abs(p_i)/(P or 1)).

Both supports are regular, so their degree-contrast pressure is zero despite their different degrees, two and four. Equal multiplicity preserves every displayed mean and maximum. With no lag override, the actual default selector chooses IL when Si_i>=si_hi, or RA when si_lo<Si_i<si_hi and abs(p_i)/(P or 1)<=dnfr_hi. Other branches exit the stated sector. These are configured policies, not consequences of the nodal differential identity.

Initialize live variables (y,phi,u,q)=(x,theta,v,p). Let h be IL_dnfr_factor and L the retained default U3 limit. At the next block i, IL writes q_i=h*q_i and leaves y_i,phi_i,u_i unchanged. For RA let

J_i = {j in {i-1,i+1}: abs(wrap(phi_j-phi_i))<=L},
m_i = mean_(j in J_i)(y_j),     a_i = Arg(sum_(j in J_i) exp(i*phi_j)).

Require J_i nonempty and the separate live grammar/identity gates. Using the actual default factors r,c,a and represented amplification trigger T, the accepted RA rows are

y_i <- clip((1-r)*y_i+r*m_i),
phi_i <- phi_i+c*wrap(a_i-phi_i)          modulo 2*pi,
u_i <- (1+a)*u_i if abs(m_i)>T, else u_i,
q_i <- q_i.

These means use the updated prefix, including newly compatible neighbors. Neither preparation nor selection freezes J_i. Apply the history rows above and increment both nonforced lag counts once. Twins have equal local context and no internal edge; acting on the first changes none of the second's inputs. Its identical accepted action therefore restores paired state. Induction over complete pairs proves this ordered recurrence. It does not assert pair constancy at intermediate singleton prefixes.

After the complete batch, the default one-substep form update is

f_i=u_i*q_i,                    x_i_next=clip(y_i+delta*f_i),
stored_dEPI_i=f_i,              stored_d2EPI_i=(f_i-r_i)/delta.

Pressure remains q_i and Si remains the pre-batch value. The canonical clamp centers phase representatives before coordination. The rail hypothesis on u matters: without it, integration consumes the amplified capacity before the later capacity clamp, and a second capacity stage must be modeled.

The coordinator computes R=abs(sum_i exp(i*phi_i))/5 and the normalized disruptor load from the appended block traces. Duplicating every phasor and every trace leaves both ratios unchanged. It therefore selects the same branch, smooths/clamps the same retained gains and applies the same wrapped global/local phase update. Its default gain rails imply positive gains with sum below one, so the common lifted phase arc is preserved. Stored raw phase representatives still follow the canonical-centering and wrapped-difference conventions; a circular equivalence is not permission to invent a new lift.

Finally, with the retained fresh Si and post-event pressure,

s_i_next = s_i+1 if Si_i>=si_hi and abs(q_i)<=EPS_DNFR_STABLE, else 0,
v_i_next = (1-mu)*u_i+mu*(u_(i-1)+u_(i+1))/2   if s_i_next>=tau,
           u_i                               otherwise.

This is the immutable-snapshot capacity proposal, with the implementation's fixed-point and hull guards. It neither refreshes pressure nor changes the already stored rate to v_i_next*q_i. Equal counts and neighbor snapshots give equal twin writes, including when adaptation is active. The temporal recorder admits the old samples, restarts on a same-time form jump and appends the flow endpoint; all these operations commute with duplication. Clock and invocation ordinal advance once, not once per represented constituent.

Native realization and limits. Let D duplicate the retained five-node state and lift its ring edges to the doubled support, and let F_5,F_10 denote the ideal complete native calls on this domain. The preceding rows prove, for the declared physical/local-memory observations,

F_10(D(s)) = D(F_5(s)).

Graph-wide phase records agree without duplication. Node-keyed temporal and REMESH EPI archives lift their keys, while extensive glyph counts and node counts scale by two. Fine labels, _node_sample, support and cache shapes are not literally the five-node values. Both graphs use the full node sample because their sizes are below fifty. Default graph validation retains its range/provenance conditions; uniform duplication also preserves the mean sigma vector. Its normalized norm gate is unchanged.

At a live grammar or identity rejection, both ideal paths reach the same rejected block after the same completed block prefix. Neither rolls that prefix back. The accepted-call equation does not reconstruct discarded old telemetry or claim transactional behavior on failure. Selection outside RA/IL, unsupported histories or another execution path requires separate admission, even if the native engine can execute it.

The equality is an ideal-real theorem, not a universal binary64 identity. In particular, the bare ring's pressure owner takes its certified two-neighbor phase path, whereas four-neighbor accumulation takes another floating path. Strict branch margins and an independently specified numerical allowance remain necessary; retaining a seed does not equate those arithmetic reductions.

The native block-descent controls reuse the live-prefix, neighbor-gain, active-capacity-adaptation and U3-rejection preparations. They fix all fine/reduced inputs, unchanged independent forecasts, observation projection and budgets before execution. This checks the existing motor as its own reduced realization against the earlier independent formulas, including changing U3 subsets and active later policies. No benchmark speedup, repeated-call invariant domain, autonomous source or physical interpretation follows merely from the smaller representation.

docs.title: Four-operator composition and the first selected exit
docs.text:
The preceding reduction extends conditionally to Emission (AL), Reception (EN), Coherence (IL) and Resonance (RA). This extends the admitted event map; it does not prove that native selection keeps its successors in that domain. Retain the same complete law, support, ordered pairs, associated memory and numerical admission. Re-admit each call from its actual predecessor, including the evolving phase gains and fresh pressure/Si.

Additional event rows. With the resolved default boost b and Reception mix m, the direct native glyphs add the live-prefix rows

AL: y_i <- clip(y_i+b),
EN: y_i <- (1-m)*y_i+m*(y_(i-1)+y_(i+1))/2.

Reception reads the current full-support neighbors, not the U3 subset, and does not require a preceding Emission source. Here its snapshot uses track_sources=False. Direct Emission does not install the public class's lifecycle metadata. Both rows preserve phase, capacity, stored pressure and the common nonempty kind; append the actual glyph with its provenance and increment the operator ordinal. Both retain U2 debt. Their live grammar and state admission remain necessary. Unlike Resonance's identity gate, these rows do not impose a general prohibition on a nonzero form sign change.

Two consecutive nonadjacent twins read identical inputs, so the pair induction and subsequent flow/controller reduction still apply. Coherence retains its pressure factor; Resonance retains its live U3 and amplification branches. Temporal recording follows the actual form change: an unchanged clipped Emission or no-op Reception does not create a jump merely by its label. The common phase arc persists under these four events and the default coordinator, but this alone does not admit a later Resonance subset.

Actual lag policy. For incoming Emission/Reception lags a,e, first set A=a+1,E=e+1. The native effective request and successor lags are

A>5:           AL, (0,min(E,3)),
A<=5 and E>3:  EN, (A,0),
otherwise:     prepared base request, (A,E).

Emission has priority over Reception. A forced request replaces the base choice for this purpose; an unused outside-sector base choice is not an exit. From zero lags, completed sector calls give (1,1), (2,2), (3,3), forced Reception with (4,0), (5,1), then forced Emission with (0,2). This is conditional invocation bookkeeping, not a physical occurrence law. Six calls are an observation horizon, not a closed grammatical word.

Prospective second-call certificate. Keep the unchanged nominal neighbor-gain preparation, seed 17, initial time 1, step 1/16, zero lags and the default complete law. Its first-call request is RA RA IL IL IL. Let X,V,Phi be the independently derived final forms, final capacities and pre-coordinator event phases, and K_G,K_L its new gains. Those quantities are rational in the represented coefficients. Write ell_i=(Phi_(i-1)+Phi_(i+1))/2. The first coordinated phase is

theta_i_next = z_i+K_G*Psi,
z_i = (1-K_G-K_L)*Phi_i+K_L*ell_i.

The common global angle Psi cancels from every next neighbor offset:

d_i_next = (z_(i-1)+z_(i+1))/2-z_i.

All phases remain in one arc narrower than pi, so each circular neighbor mean is its declared lifted midpoint. Therefore the next fresh pressure and Si follow exactly from the previous block formulas with X,V,d_next, without evaluating an inverse trigonometric function or measuring a native response. With P=max_j abs(p_j) for this new pressure, exact rational inequalities give

0.380 < Si_0 < 0.381,    abs(p_0)/P < 0.005,
0.376 < Si_1 < 0.377,    0.235 < abs(p_1)/P < 0.237,
min(Si_2,Si_3,Si_4) > 0.84,
abs(p_1)/P-dnfr_hi > 0.1.

The first two Si values lie strictly between the configured cuts 1/4,1/2; the remaining three exceed the upper cut. Lags increment to two, below both forcing limits. Thus the exact ideal second request is RA NAV IL IL IL: Transition (NAV) exits the four-operator sector with a strict normalized-pressure margin. This calculation uses independent source and law data; it does not reconstruct pressure from observed motion.

Frozen finite protocol. The composition controls prepare fine and five-node graphs for scalar and NumPy paths before any native response. They retain a six-attempt horizon and a maximum of 24 invocations. The first call and second fresh diagnostics use the unchanged independent forecast with absolute allowance 1e-14. Both coarse trajectories and their declared observations are frozen before either fine trajectory; cross-support comparison allows 2e-14 per ordinate and requires exact decisions/discrete memory. No source sweep, forced word or tolerance adjustment is part of this protocol.

A test-local observer captures the actual batch preflight, forced requests and every nonforced selector result. Immediately before the final outer resolver returns, it checks the complete ordered effective batch. Any outside-sector mark stops the whole batch before its first event, including an earlier supported mark. This is earlier than the Mutation prelude and live grammar gates, but after fresh pressure/Si and lag increments. An all-forced batch contains only admitted-sector AL/EN requests. The stop is separate from grammar rejection, numerical-domain failure or a solver defect; it changes no production selector or operator.

Finite result and retained boundary. All four trajectories complete call one and stop on call two with the predicted RA NAV IL IL IL block requests: eight native invocations, below the frozen maximum. First-call outputs and second fresh diagnostics agree with the independent forecasts within 1e-14; fine/coarse comparisons pass the fixed 2e-14 allowance. Decisions and retained discrete memory agree exactly. No second-call Resonance prefix, Transition, forced Reception or forced Emission is executed by this protocol.

At the stop, fresh pressure/Si and both lag counts of two remain. The invocation ordinal is two, while physical time remains 17/16. Form, phase, capacity, rate, acceleration, stability counts, grammar, evolved phase gains and their archives retain the completed first-call values. The same-time left-boundary flow record does not alter temporal samples. Selector cleanup runs; no second integration, coordination, adaptation or REMESH append occurs. An empty stable_frac still supplies no automatic REMESH event, independently of the existing EPI archive.

This closes the six-attempt sector question by an early selected exit. The conditional four-operator reduction remains valid; the unchanged source does not reach its conditional fourth/sixth-call lag events in that sector. It is neither a grammar failure nor evidence against every collective description. The existing Transition obstruction and mean/contrast prediction identify why target-associated innovations and internal contrasts may matter, but their different source coefficients and verdicts cannot be transferred here.

A genuine second-call continuation must start from the completed first-call predecessor with its retained histories, gains and random-stream progress. Calling the motor again on the protocol-stopped graph instead consumes a third ordinal and advances the lags again. Keep that stopped response distinct; it is not a restartable representation of the unevaluated second call. The observation records are not complete checkpoints. A later protocol must freeze the actual predecessor or explicitly account for its preparation replay.

docs.title: A collective form prediction beyond pair equality
docs.text:
The selected Transition (NAV) exit need not prevent a collective observation from being predicted. Continue the unchanged neighbor-gain source from its completed first call, retaining the full native law and associated state. This question concerns its genuine second RA NAV IL IL IL block batch, not a third invocation on the preceding protocol-stopped graph. The declared observations are the five form means and signed within-pair contrasts at time 9/8, together with the physical and memory channels needed to audit their mechanism. No bare-C5 default execution is assumed to realize them.

Admission before response. Write X_i,V_i,Theta_i for the first-call block endpoint and p_i,Si_i for the next independently calculated fresh diagnostics. The second-selection certificate fixes the actual requests without using a new response. Retain strict grammar, pair-contiguous order, seed 17, node-associated random streams, duration delta=1/16, live zero Gamma and the existing inactive REMESH gate.

Resonance (RA) on block zero admits both adjacent blocks, one and four. Their U3 clearances exceed 0.42. Its live selected mean and proposed form are

m_0 = (X_1+X_4)/2,            -0.796 < m_0 < -0.795,
Y_0 = (1-r)*X_0+r*m_0,         0.411 < Y_0 < 0.412,
U_0 = (1+a)*V_0,               0.270 < U_0 < 0.271.

Thus Resonance preserves the positive target form sign and common kind, amplifies capacity within its rails, and retains pressure p_0. The twins are nonadjacent and see the same inputs, so this accepted prefix remains pair-equal. Other blocks keep Y_i=X_i,U_i=V_i. Transition then changes only the two block-one pressures. Its preceding Resonance neighbor action does not refresh their prepared pressure or alter their own capacity.

Let xi_- and xi_+ be the actual innovations at nodes two and three, respectively. With default eta=1/2, NAV_STRICT=False, NAV_RANDOM=True, positive fresh p_1, and jitter amplitude j,

B = (1-eta)*p_1+eta*V_1,
q_(2) = B+xi_-,                 q_(3) = B+xi_+,
q_(0)=q_(1)=p_0,
q_(2i)=q_(2i+1)=h*p_i          for i=2,3,4.

Here h is the retained Coherence (IL) pressure factor. Uniformly for |xi_-|,|xi_+|<=j, the block-one held pressures lie in (0.134,0.215) and differ from the incoming pressure by more than 0.045. This separately admits Transition's nonidentity postcondition. Every resulting Euler form stays inside its rails; no clipping changes the following equations.

Mean and contrast rows. Define

xi_bar=(xi_-+xi_+)/2,          xi_delta=(xi_+-xi_-)/2,
M_i=(x_(2i)+x_(2i+1))/2,      d_i=(x_(2i+1)-x_(2i))/2.

The complete second-call form observation is

M_0_next = Y_0+delta*U_0*p_0,             d_0_next=0,
M_1_next = X_1+delta*V_1*(B+xi_bar),      d_1_next=delta*V_1*xi_delta,
M_i_next = X_i+delta*V_i*h*p_i,           d_i_next=0   (i=2,3,4).

The five form means consume the innovation mean, while the internal form contrast consumes its signed difference. Hence the admitted mean prediction does not require equal constituent responses. At the event, Transition creates a pressure contrast xi_delta; subsequent nodal evolution creates rate contrast V_1*xi_delta and form contrast delta*V_1*xi_delta. Equal incoming rates give acceleration contrast V_1*xi_delta/delta. These are different observations at different stages, not a direct Transition form jump.

Two symbolic innovation pairs with the same mean and different differences produce the same five form means but different internal forms. This is a conditional algebraic distinction within the admitted amplitude box; it does not assert that one fixed seed realizes every pair or assign a physical noise distribution. Replacing both innovations by one common sample removes this contrast and can also change the mean. A bare node's single seeded draw is not the original two-target innovation mean.

The generated means and contrasts also retain a joint budget. If M_1_det=X_1+delta*V_1*B, then

abs(xi_bar)+abs(xi_delta)=max(abs(xi_-),abs(xi_+))<=j,
abs(M_1_next-M_1_det)+abs(d_1_next)<=delta*V_1*j.

The image of the innovation amplitude box is a diamond-shaped enclosure for these mean/contrast observations. Independent marginal bounds would admit combinations outside that joint image. This correlation is available for subsequent admission; the fixed seed selects one point and does not establish reachability of the entire enclosure or an invariant-domain theorem.

The subsequent policies remain part of the model. Let z be the rational relative phase from the preceding certificate. After Resonance the phase vector has a common origin plus

psi=(z_0+c*((z_1+z_4)/2-z_0), z_1,z_2,z_3,z_4).

Transition and direct Coherence do not change phase. Pairwise differences therefore give the origin-independent exact identity

R^2=(5+2*sum_(i<k) cos(psi_i-psi_k))/25.

Rational alternating-series cosine bounds certify 0.719<R<0.720, strictly between the configured phase-order cuts. The block traces are EN RA RA, EN RA NAV, and EN IL IL on each of the three remaining blocks. Transition counts toward the coordinator's disruptive-glyph load, giving 1/15; it remains neutral for U2 debt. That load is below the lower load cut. The coordinator consequently selects its transition branch and moves the retained gains toward their configured midpoints. Its resulting gains are approximately K_G=0.06141231186574749, K_L=0.14166901183551323. The final phase diameter is below 2.024, and the pair phases remain equal. Absolute phase readouts still require a declared global-angle evaluation; the rational relative-phase certificate does not replace it.

All held pressure magnitudes exceed the stability tolerance, so inherited zero stability counters remain zero and no capacity adaptation write occurs. In particular, the rate observation uses the post-Resonance capacity. Each node retains its common kind, actual grammar history and prior-Coherence flag; block one retains U2 debt one and the other blocks retain zero. Operator ordinals advance to five, AL/EN lags to two, and the runtime ordinal to two. Only block zero has a same-time form jump at 17/16 and resets its temporal form history. Transition retains its prior form samples and appends the flow endpoint; its label alone cannot supply a measured form jump.

Frozen numerical protocol. The Transition contrast controls declare two first-call preparation replays followed by two genuine second-call responses, one scalar and one NumPy. Both complete forecasts and configurations precede every native call. Each preparation is checked against its unchanged independent forecast before the actual completed graph continues; copied observation records are evidence, not replacement checkpoints. No stopped graph is reused, and no coarse trajectory or third call is evaluated.

The first draw at each of offsets two and three is reconstructed independently with the existing standard-library BLAKE2b/Random oracle. Expected values do not call the production jitter implementation. The equations above are ideal-real identities over represented inputs; the finite native comparison uses a fixed absolute allowance 1e-14 for each ordinate and mean/contrast observation, including acceleration. Actual draws, marks and discrete memory must agree exactly. Alternative innovation associations are analytical controls, not additional native responses or replacement laws.

Finite result. Both genuine second calls complete the predicted native batch. The independently reconstructed first draws are approximately xi_-=0.02188843323, xi_+=-0.01430477745; their actual binary64 values and target/stream associations agree exactly. The form difference is predicted as x_3-x_2=-0.0005880201996622686, with signed half-contrast d_1=-0.0002940100998311343. Both native paths match all declared ordinates and mean/contrast observations within the unchanged 1e-14 allowance. Phase/capacity remain paired; the observed coordinator branch, disruptive load, grammar, histories and absent adaptation writes match their forecasts.

This gives a source-specific collective form prediction after exact pair equality is lost. It retains the actual two-target innovation law and the joint enclosure. It does not supply a complete reduced default-engine state, prove closure under another selected batch, or establish acquired collective identity. In particular, future selection consumes normalized individual pressures, so a successful mean forecast does not authorize discarding the contrast before re-admitting the next call.

docs.title: Uniform admission beyond the first internal contrast
docs.text:
The preceding innovation diamond admits one further complete ideal-real call uniformly. Transition (NAV) is selected on blocks zero and one, and Coherence (IL) on the other three. This is an analytical consequence of the same supplied law, selector and grammar context. No third native response is evaluated.

Joint source state. Let C be the second endpoint's deterministic form means, obtained by setting its innovation mean to zero. Retain its paired capacities V, phases, support, order, clock, gains, grammar and zero stability counters. At time 9/8, the admitted forms are

M_1=C_1+u,             M_i=C_i (i!=1),
d_1=d,                d_i=0   (i!=1),
x_(2i)=M_i-d_i,       x_(2i+1)=M_i+d_i,
abs(u)+abs(d)<=rho,    rho=delta*V_1*j,     delta=1/16.

Here j is the unchanged Transition amplitude and 0.000646<rho<0.000647. This is the exact affine image of the prior amplitude box. The ideal-real seed-17 forecast supplies one member, not reachability of every member with that seed. Its earlier finite native comparison remains separate. The input law and associated random-stream progress remain declared.

Associate prior rates and histories with each member. If B_previous is the previous deterministic block-one held pressure, its incoming fine rates are V_1*B_previous+(u-d)/delta and V_1*B_previous+(u+d)/delta. Their accelerations use the preceding first-call rates. Temporal endpoints are C_1+u-d and C_1+u+d; their earlier samples remain associated with the same preparation. These are forward-map identities, not pressure inferred from a response. Keeping the nominal rates at nonnominal diamond points would invalidate the next acceleration and temporal evidence.

Phase frame and selection. Write N_i(a)=(a_(i-1)+a_(i+1))/2 on C5. From the previous phase certificate, with relative event phases psi and its transition-branch gains K_G,K_L, the second endpoint has relative phases

z_i=(1-K_G-K_L)*psi_i+K_L*N_i(psi).

Both global-angle contributions are common origins and cancel. The exact rational frame has diameter below 1.605<pi; each two-neighbor resultant therefore uses the midpoint on that lift. Relative offsets and phase order need no approximate absolute-angle evaluation. With the represented pressure weights k=w_epi, b=w_vf, w=w_phase and normalization pi_rep,

B_i=w*(N_i(z)-z_i)/pi_rep+k*(N_i(M)-M_i)+b*(N_i(V)-V_i),
p_(2i)=B_i+k*d_i,       p_(2i+1)=B_i-k*d_i,
P=max_i(abs(B_i)+k*abs(d_i)).

Regular degree contrast vanishes. Each primitive pressure is affine in (u,d). At all four diamond vertices, its block signs are (-,+,-,-,+) and block three has the strictly largest magnitude. The same strict linear inequalities therefore hold on the convex hull. Thus P=-B_3 is constant, in (0.268,0.269), and individual normalized magnitudes are affine throughout. Capacity and relative-phase terms of Si are fixed, so Si is affine as well. Vertex bounds give

0.13843 < abs(p_j)/P < 0.13888  (j=0,1),
0.58473 < abs(p_j)/P < 0.58562  (j=2,3),
0.399 < Si_j < 0.400           (j=0,1),
0.377 < Si_j < 0.379           (j=2,3),
Si_j > 0.874                  (j=4,...,9).

The smallest Transition pressure-cut clearance exceeds 0.0054. These bounds give the uniform base batch NAV NAV IL IL IL. Incremented lags are three, so neither strict lag override applies. This default selector applies no parametric soft-repeat filter; live grammar permits repeated Transition. Transition is U2-neutral and consumes no new U3 coupling gate; Coherence retains the existing stabilization context. The effective requests are therefore admitted without substitution throughout the diamond.

Event and flow map. Each Transition pair receives its actual two target-associated innovations xi_(i,-),xi_(i,+). Set their mean and signed half-difference to xi_bar_i,xi_delta_i; each pair obeys abs(xi_bar_i)+abs(xi_delta_i)<=j. With default mix 1/2 and Coherence factor h, the held-pressure means and contrasts are

qbar_0=(B_0-V_0)/2+xi_bar_0,    qdelta_0=xi_delta_0,
qbar_1=(B_1+V_1)/2+xi_bar_1,    qdelta_1=-k*d/2+xi_delta_1,
qbar_i=h*B_i,                  qdelta_i=0       (i=2,3,4).

These events change pressure only. They consume the prepared rows; there is no post-event pressure refresh. The held-pressure Euler step gives

M_i_next=M_i+delta*V_i*qbar_i,
d_i_next=d_i+delta*V_i*qdelta_i,
d_0_next=delta*V_0*xi_delta_0,
d_1_next=(1-delta*V_1*k/2)*d+delta*V_1*xi_delta_1.

Rate means/contrasts are V_i*qbar_i,V_i*qdelta_i. Acceleration subtracts the associated incoming rates before division by delta. Once admitted, the mean rows consume the incoming means and innovation means. Exact internal differences determine fine state; their joint bounds remain part of this admission certificate.

Every row above is affine on the product of the old diamond and four future innovation intervals. Its extrema are therefore certified by their 64 input vertices. The Transition held pressure and its change from prepared pressure are both negative on block zero and positive on block one; Coherence held pressures have signs (-,-,+). These fixed signs make their absolute-value lower bounds affine too. Every Transition nonidentity gap and held-pressure magnitude exceeds 0.011, above the configured stability tolerance. All unprojected Euler forms remain inside their rails; block ranges fit respectively within (0.408,0.410), (-0.659,-0.655), (0.954,0.955), (-0.056,-0.055) and (-0.911,-0.910). Stability counters stay zero and capacity adaptation writes nothing. The exact affine image retains correlations; these convenient marginal ranges are not a replacement source for future admission.

Phase and memory. Exact alternating cosine bounds on the fixed z yield 0.830<R<0.831. Post-append block traces are EN RA RA NAV, EN RA NAV NAV and EN IL IL IL on each remaining block. Their disruptive load is 3/20, below the configured lower cut. The coordinator consequently selects its stable branch and moves both gains toward their configured minima, giving approximately K_G=0.05365395977, K_L=0.12545426230. The final phase diameter is below 1.519<pi; phases and capacities remain paired. Absolute phase is retained through the inherited common lift: if Theta_i=Omega+z_i and A(z) is its resultant angle, the declared absolute row is Theta_i_next=Omega+(1-K_G-K_L)*z_i+K_G*A(z)+K_L*N_i(z), using the new gains. The prior strict common arc admits this row. Relative certificates do not evaluate or discard its common origin, or replace phase by a form-derived angle.

At 19/16, runtime ordinal is three, operator ordinals six and both lags three. Prior-Coherence flags remain true; block-one debt is one and other debts zero. No event resets form history: append the endpoint with the existing four-entry retention cap. Block zero has three samples, the others four. The REMESH form record receives its third snapshot; absent stable_frac history still prevents automatic REMESH. Phase-policy records append their actual branch, order, load and gains. Targets zero/one consume draw index zero, targets two/three index one; their resulting draw counts are one and two, respectively. No other target consumes jitter.

The analytical controls use exact represented coefficients, independent affine rows and cosine bounds. They block production runtime, pressure, selector, operator and integrator evaluation. They certify the ideal-real domain and formula, not a universal binary64 enclosure or a newly observed trajectory. The resulting image is generated by 64 input vertices; these need not be distinct extreme output vertices. This finite admission result supplies neither an invariant family, an autonomous collective occurrence law, a bare-node stochastic realization nor physical identification.

docs.title: Reception on the generated correlated collective family
docs.text:
Reception (EN) admits the entire preceding generated image at its actual lag-forced boundary. Its five terminal form means factor through the incoming five means, with the retained phase/capacity state and event order. Fresh individual diagnostics and acceleration still consume additional information. This is a finite ideal-real composition theorem under the unchanged complete law, not a new native trajectory or a complete mean-only engine state.

Source and preparation. At 19/16, take the exact affine image from the contrast-domain theorem. Its six input coordinates are the preceding (u,d) diamond and four subsequent innovations, each in [-j,j]. Keep their joint domain and associated rates, histories, grammar, stream progress, support and node order. The 64 input vertices generate its affine form image; independent marginal intervals do not replace that image. The ideal-real seed-17 forecast is one member. The amplitude-domain theorem does not assert that every member occurs under that fixed seed.

Write the incoming form means/contrasts as M_i,d_i, and paired capacities as V_i. Only d_0,d_1 can be nonzero. If z is the preceding relative phase frame and K_G3,K_L3 its stable gains, the present relative frame is

z3_i=(1-K_G3-K_L3)*z_i+K_L3*N_i(z).

Its common origin is retained separately on the inherited lift. Its diameter is below 1.290<pi; each neighbor-resultant offset is N_i(z3)-z3_i. The prepared pressure is independently specified by the unchanged mixed law:

B_i(M)=w*(N_i(z3)-z3_i)/pi_rep
       +k*(N_i(M)-M_i)+b*(N_i(V)-V_i),
p_(2i)=B_i+k*d_i,              p_(2i+1)=B_i-k*d_i.

The affine pressure rows have fixed block signs (-,+,-,-,+) throughout the domain, and every magnitude exceeds 0.072. Both block-one pressures exceed every other block's pressure magnitude by more than 0.00018. Consequently the normalization peak is now

P=B_1+k*abs(d_1),               0.2014<P<0.2021.

Its maximizing twin can change within the family. Individual Si therefore contains a piecewise-rational normalization; it is not an affine image of the input coordinates. Positive peak and capacity bounds admit finite fresh diagnostics. Bounds on normalized ratios must retain the maximum or use justified enclosures, rather than assuming affine Si extrema at the 64 vertices.

Actual occurrence and admission. Selector preparation precedes the lag override. Both lags increment from three to four. Emission's higher-priority condition remains false (4<=AL_MAX_LAG=5), and Reception's strict condition holds (4>EN_MAX_LAG=3), so all ten effective requests are Reception. The retained grammar admits these requests and preserves prior Coherence and U2 debt. The direct-glyph route consumes finite signed target/neighbor forms; it adds neither the public class's separate ceilings nor an emission-source or U3 prerequisite. These configured lag rules justify the requests on this path; they are not a derived autonomous occurrence law.

Ordered event and held flow. Reuse the Reception identity, re-admitting its premises on this nonzero-phase source. With m=EN_mix, initialize Y=M, then perform in block order i=0,...,4

Y_i <- (1-m)*Y_i+m*(current Y_(i-1)+current Y_(i+1))/2.

Consecutive twins are nonadjacent and share the same live neighbor mean at their own events. Thus the event form means are Y and contrasts (1-m)*d. This equality holds at completed pair boundaries; the intermediate single-node prefix is retained in the fine proof. With all operands inside their rails and 0<m<1, each event blend remains interior. The event changes no pressure, phase, capacity or stored rate. In particular, the later flow retains the prepared pressure contrast -k*d, not the post-event form contrast.

The complete form/rate map is

M_i_next=Y_i+delta*V_i*B_i(M),
d_i_next=(1-m-delta*V_i*k)*d_i,
rate_bar_i_next=V_i*B_i(M),
rate_delta_i_next=-V_i*k*d_i.

Here delta=1/16. Subtract the associated incoming rate means/contrasts and divide by delta to obtain acceleration. Each contrast factor lies strictly between zero and one; this single contraction does not establish indefinite retention. No new innovation is consumed.

The ordered fine prefix and the five-block sweep give identical affine coefficient rows. Signed vertex inequalities then certify every event jump and unprojected flow endpoint over the joint domain. All jumps have block signs (-,+,-,-,+) and magnitude above 0.015. Terminal forms fit within (0.119,0.121), (-0.367,-0.364), (0.667,0.668), (-0.084,-0.083) and (-0.675,-0.674), respectively. These displayed ranges summarize admission; the calculation retains the exact correlated rows.

Two wrong timing substitutions have uniformly separated predictions on this same domain. At block one, the ordered terminal mean is more than 0.034 below the simultaneous-mixing prediction. At block zero, refreshing pressure after the Reception batch would raise the terminal mean by more than 0.00168. Neither substitute is the admitted native map. In particular, multiplying (1-m) by (1-delta*V_i*k) gives the wrong contrast coefficient.

Sufficient observation and retained memory. The terminal mean formula uses only M, fixed V,z3, the declared coefficients, order and clock once the family is admitted. Two members with the same means but different internal contrasts therefore have identical terminal means and different fine pressure, form and diagnostic records. The internal domain remains part of the admission certificate; mean prediction alone does not authorize arbitrary lifts.

Even all instantaneous forms do not determine the next stored acceleration. Let D=1-delta*V_1*k/2, and choose s=rho/2. Compare the zero input with the admissible alternative

u=0, d=s, xi_(0,-)=xi_(0,+)=0,
xi_(1,-)= D*s/(delta*V_1),
xi_(1,+)=-D*s/(delta*V_1).

The prior Transition map gives identical incoming forms because its block-one contrast is D*s+delta*V_1*xi_delta_1=0. Its incoming rate contrast differs by -s/delta. Reception and its flow consequently give the same forms and rates, but acceleration contrasts differ by s/delta^2. This is an exact amplitude-domain witness, not a claim that both inputs occur at seed 17. The consumed rate/history association cannot be replaced by the form snapshot.

Post-event policies and records. Reception leaves primitive phase fixed. Exact alternating cosine bounds give 0.888<R<0.889. Appending Reception to the retained traces yields six disruptive glyphs among fifty, hence load 3/25, below the lower cut. The coordinator again selects its stable branch, with new gains approximately K_G4=0.04713038776, K_L4=0.11182017030. For incoming phase Omega3+z3_i, the complete absolute row remains

Theta_i_next=Omega3+(1-K_G4-K_L4)*z3_i
             +K_G4*Arg(sum exp(i*z3))+K_L4*N_i(z3).

The inherited common lift admits the resultant angle. Relative certificates need not evaluate it; the common origin remains retained. Final phase diameter is below 1.229, and phases remain paired. Every held-pressure magnitude exceeds the stability tolerance, so counters remain zero and capacities stay unchanged without a write. No joint phase/capacity closure is inferred beyond this admitted boundary.

All form jumps are nonzero, so each temporal history restarts at its own right-hand Reception form at 19/16, then appends the flow endpoint at 5/4. The resulting secant excludes the jump and equals the held flow rate. Operator ordinals become seven, runtime ordinal four, and lags become since_AL=4,since_EN=0. Prior-Coherence flags, common kind and U2 debt remain; only block one has debt one. Target-associated random records are unchanged: targets zero/one retain one draw, targets two/three two, and others none. The fourth REMESH form snapshot is appended; absent stable_frac history still prevents automatic REMESH. Phase-policy records append their new values.

The analytical controls reuse the prior guarded source certificate and independently compare fine prefixes, collective rows and counterpredictions. Production execution remains disabled. The result distinguishes a sufficient finite mean observation from the larger state needed for diagnostics and history. It does not certify a universal binary64 enclosure, complete collective NFR identity or autonomous formation. The affine form/rate image must not be confused with the generally non-affine normalized diagnostics.

docs.text:
This reference owns the parameter ledger, units and cross-channel dependencies. Detailed proofs have one topical owner in the reading map below. The research program alone defines active research; these notes are not parallel task queues.

Read the ledger below for definitions, then the note answering the current question. Section numbers remain stable across this family so earlier mathematical references can still be located. No proof is duplicated here.
