\[ G_{E,3}=\tfrac1{12}(L_eP_Ey)^Tu^{\circ3},\qquad |G_E-G_{E,3}|\le\tfrac1{240}\sum_j|(L_eP_Ey)_j|\,|u_j|^5. \tag{22} \]

Writing q=u-sin u, the exact incidence decomposition is

\[ G_E=\tfrac12\sum_{\{j,k\}\subset E,\,j\sim k} (y_j-y_k)(q_j-q_k) +\tfrac12\sum_{j\in E,\,k\notin E,\,j\sim k} y_j(q_j-q_k). \tag{23} \]

Internal pairs in the first sum are unordered and counted once. Thus G_E is not solely boundary inflow: it is the change of the structural storage rate caused by replacing the tangent pressure by actual sine pressure. The linear comparison still satisfies an exact structural ledger, H_E'=I_E-D_E-G_E, when all terms are evaluated on its own linear state.

The matched preparation map gives G_E(Sz)=-G_(J_e E)(z). For J_e E=E this is an exact sign reversal, while H_E and the local loss match initially. It does not preserve the two full trajectories or their later current.

docs.title: 6. A strictly signed nominal phase control
docs.text:
Sign reversal alone permits a zero insertion. A finite exact witness within (3) avoids this ambiguity. Take the nominal source r=0, psi=pi/2 and the two-edge region E={-1,0} modulo N, which is invariant under j -> -j-1. This small region measures a local rate; it is distinct from the radius-96 acquisition screen.

Put f_j=f(j), g_j=f(j-512) and c=1/sqrt(2). Define

\[ A_0=f_0-cf_1>0,\qquad B_0=cg_1>0,\qquad U=cf_1,\qquad V=f_2-cf_1<U. \tag{24} \]

These inequalities follow from the source, without a numerical fit. The positive Fourier weights give f_1<=f_0, so A_0>=(1-c)f_0>0. Their nonzero frequencies satisfy |2*pi*m/N|<=15*pi/512<pi/4, hence f_1>cf_0 and 2cf_1>f_0>=f_2, proving V<U. The Fejer formula gives g_0=0 and g_1>0: its numerator at the antipodal offset is proportional to sin(pi/64)^2, and its denominator is nonzero.

Evenness and the exact carrier values at nodes 0, +/-1 and +/-2 give

\[ \begin{array}{ll} y_{-1}=a(A_0-B_0),&y_0=-a(A_0+B_0),\\ u_{-1}=a(U-B_0),&u_0=a(U+B_0),\\ u_{-2}=a(V+B_0),&u_1=a(V-B_0). \end{array} \tag{25} \]

Let q(t)=t-sin(t), q_(U,+/-)=q(a(U+/-B_0)) and likewise for V. Substitution into (21) yields

\[ \begin{split} G_E(z_{\pi/2}^0)=\frac a2\{& A_0[3(q_{U,-}-q_{U,+})+(q_{V,-}-q_{V,+})]\\ &-B_0[(q_{U,-}+q_{U,+})-(q_{V,-}+q_{V,+})]\}<0. \end{split} \tag{26} \]

Indeed q is strictly increasing: its derivative 1-cos(t) is nonnegative and vanishes only at isolated points, with no constant interval. Because a,B_0>0, each difference in the first bracket is negative. Since U>V, each q value in the second U sum exceeds its corresponding V value, so the second bracket is positive. Therefore

\[ G_E(z_{-\pi/2}^0)=-G_E(z_{\pi/2}^0)>0. \tag{27} \]

The two preparations have exactly equal initial total norm, exact storage, global loss and reflected regional storage. Nevertheless the actual sine pressure changes this structural regional storage rate above the same-state linear value in one preparation and below it in the other. This is a strict local, initial nonlinear distinction. It does not imply positive total regional growth, an attractive force, screen entry, restoration, lifetime or acquired NFR identity. No robust sign over the nonzero error ball, or sign of the screen insertion N_W, has been proved by this witness. In particular, B_0>0 comes from the remote Fejer lobe's nonzero tail: the witness already has local overlap initially. A strict nominal sign need not dominate the admitted arbitrary source error or the linear contribution. It does not establish newly acquired contact.

docs.title: 7. Matched histories retain transport and comparison state
docs.text:
Let z be a full-law solution and ell the tangent solution (20), with the identical admitted primitive preparation z(0)=ell(0). The same screen observation has the exact difference

\[ V_W(z(T))-V_W(\ell(T)) =\int_0^T[\mathcal L_W(z)-\mathcal L_W(\ell) +\mathcal N_W(z)]\,d\tau. \tag{28} \]

The linear transport terms are evaluated on different evolving states and do not cancel. Integrating only the initial or future N_W omits this feedback. Conversely, the structural regional-storage difference is

\[ H_E(z(T))-H_E(\ell(T)) =\int_0^T[I_E(z)-I_E(\ell)-D_E(z)+D_E(\ell)+G_E(\ell)]\,d\tau. \tag{29} \]

Here G_E is evaluated on ell because its structural ledger in (23) differs from the full-law ledger. Equations (28) and (29) concern different observations and cannot substitute for each other.

A separate-history control requires an explicit primitive split, including an allocation of the admitted source error. If z_A and z_B evolve independently under (1), their sum s=z_A+z_B is an observation on the common support. It need not solve (1). With u_A=Dtheta_A, u_B=Dtheta_B, define

\[ \mathcal N_W^{\rm sep}(z_A,z_B) =(DB_W(x_A+x_B))^T [u_A-\sin u_A+u_B-\sin u_B]. \tag{30} \]

One declared split covering the whole source class is z_A(0)=a*exp(i*k*j)*f(j)+r/2 and z_B(0)=a*exp(i*(k*j+psi))*f(j-512)+r/2. It gives the exact total preparation (3), with each assigned error at most delta/2. This equal assignment is comparison metadata, not an inferred physical partition. Other splits require their own retained initial metadata and bounds.

For a matching initial sum, the actual and separate observed screen gaps obey

\[ V_W(z(T))-V_W(s(T)) =\int_0^T[\mathcal L_W(z)-\mathcal L_W(s) +\mathcal N_W(z)-\mathcal N_W^{\rm sep}(z_A,z_B)]\,d\tau. \tag{31} \]

At one supplied shared state, the nonlinear insertion difference is

\[ \mathcal N_W(z_A+z_B)-\mathcal N_W^{\rm sep}(z_A,z_B) =4(DB_W(x_A+x_B))^T \left[\sin\frac{u_A}{2}\sin\frac{u_B}{2} \sin\frac{u_A+u_B}{2}\right]. \tag{32} \]

This reuses the exact mixed sine identity. The cross terms in V_W(s) are retained; replacing it by V_W(z_A)+V_W(z_B) would change the observable. Likewise the initial structural cross storage is generally nonzero:

\[ H_E(z_A+z_B)-H_E(z_A)-H_E(z_B) =\sum_{j\in E}\left[y_{A,j}y_{B,j} +4\sin\frac{u_{A,j}}2\sin\frac{u_{B,j}}2 \cos\frac{u_{A,j}+u_{B,j}}2\right]. \tag{33} \]

Its evolved difference must retain each history's current and loss. The split is supplied preparation information, not a unique nonlinear decomposition or proof of autonomous constituent identities.

docs.title: 8. Bounded result and remaining formation obligations
docs.text:
The admitted source supplies two separated concentrations with an initially absent total-field screen. Equations (15)-(17) give the exact necessary prefix work for that screen; (21)-(27) prove a strictly signed nonlinear local rate distinction for two exactly resource-matched nominal phases. The static controls check these algebraic and source statements without evaluating a prepared trajectory or reserved response.

This establishes a bounded conditional compatibility result and its comparison boundary. It does not establish that the positive local insertion can overcome the screen deficit, that the full-law history passes a screen which the linear or separate controls fail, or that any resulting concentration maintains a new relation. A future formation discriminator still needs those actual-state transport estimates, a separate signal floor, a justified retention interval and a continued-response condition. The exact balances identify that missing signed work; they do not admit a trajectory, parameter sweep or long-horizon calculation by themselves.

docs.title: Source resources for localized mobile identities
docs.text: Scope: a conditional source-to-target obstruction under the same complete positive-loss sine law as the prepared transport theorem. No trajectory, response search, source reconstruction or physical measurement is evaluated. This result identifies a missing preparation resource for one class of mobile identities; it does not exclude every moving organization. The research program owns closure and subsequent admission.

docs.title: 1. Complete law and an independent source class
docs.text:
Keep the labeled unit cycle C_N, held unit capacities, beta one, positive coefficients e,w, no inputs or events, and clock tau=w*t/pi from the law owner. With A=L/2 and sigma=pi*e/w, both complete rows are

\[ x'=-\sigma Ax+\tfrac12 S(\theta),\qquad \theta'=Ax. \]

Retain real phase lifts relative to the supplied uniform zero background. As before, z=x+i theta denotes two real state channels. The source class is

\[ z(0)=(u,0)+r_0,\qquad u\in\mathbb R^N,\qquad \|u\|_2\le M,\qquad \|r_0\|_2\le\epsilon,\qquad M>0. \tag{1} \]

The nominal phase is uniform. Its zero lift fixes the background origin; it does not infer phase from form. The independent error covers both channels at every site, including common means. No zero-mean source is assumed.

The real profile u is otherwise arbitrary: it can already contain localization, spatial asymmetry, a spectral envelope or several peaks. Thus this class lacks the nominal form/phase correlation of a one-sided carrier, not necessarily all spatial organization. Its definition uses no desired final coordinates, backward evolution or fitted source. The ontology contract keeps these different formation claims separate.

For N divisible by four, Q>=2 and Q-1<N/4, define the disjoint Fourier bands, with indices interpreted modulo N,

\[ B_+=\{N/4+m:|m|<Q\},\qquad B_-=-B_+. \]

Use the unitary discrete Fourier transform and its orthogonal projectors P_+,P_-. A target v has norm a>0 and support entirely in either one of these bands. This includes every translated or internally rotated Fejer reference of the prepared theorem. Allowing all such vectors makes the obstruction independent of that particular envelope. Fourier orientation is not a new primitive phase, topological winding, charge or particle label.

docs.title: 2. The actual damped tangent preserves opposite-band balance
docs.text:
Linearize the actual law at the uniform background:

\[ J_\sigma=\begin{pmatrix}-\sigma A&-A\\A&0\end{pmatrix}. \]

At wave number k, lambda(k)=1-cos(k)=lambda(-k). The two real modal functions f_k,g_k are defined by

\[ \binom{f_k(\tau)}{g_k(\tau)}= \exp\!\left[\tau\lambda(k) \begin{pmatrix}-\sigma&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}\right]\binom{1}{0}. \]

They are the same at k and -k, including overdamped and critically damped cases. Let z_lin be this actual tangent launched from (u,0). Since u is real, u_hat(-k)=conj(u_hat(k)), while

\[ \widehat z_{\rm lin}(k)=(f_k+i g_k)\widehat u(k),\qquad \widehat z_{\rm lin}(-k)=(f_k+i g_k)\overline{\widehat u(k)}. \]

Their magnitudes agree. Consequently

\[ \|P_+z_{\rm lin}(\tau)\|_2=\|P_-z_{\rm lin}(\tau)\|_2. \tag{2} \]

This statement uses actual positive loss; it needs no conservative comparison or dispersion-error allowance. It also needs no spatial reflection symmetry of u. Real form alone does not imply a reflection-even spatial profile.

For any state y satisfying (2), write the common band norm as r. If v has norm a and is supported in B_+, orthogonality and the reverse triangle inequality give

\[ \|y-v\|_2^2\ge(r-a)^2+r^2 =2(r-a/2)^2+a^2/2\ge a^2/2. \tag{3} \]

The other band is identical. Components outside both bands only increase the distance. Removing common form/phase origins does not remove this lower bound, since neither band contains the zero Fourier mode.

docs.title: 3. Transfer to the complete nonlinear trajectory
docs.text:
The shared contractive tangent and cubic remainder give ||R(theta)||_2<=(4/3)||theta||_2^3. In ||z||_2<=2M, Duhamel's formula yields, for every 0<=tau<=T,

\[ \|z(\tau)-z_{\rm lin}(\tau)\|_2 \le\delta=\epsilon+\frac{32}{3}TM^3. \tag{4} \]

If delta<M, continuity closes the bootstrap: contraction gives ||z_lin||<=M, so at a putative first exit the actual norm is instead bounded by M+delta<2M. This also admits the initial state because epsilon<M. The complete smooth sine law supplies finite-time continuation. Retain 2M<pi/2 for the small lifted-phase chart; for the calculator's integer T>=1, delta<M already implies this condition.

Combining (3) and (4) proves the uniform lower separation

\[ \boxed{\quad\|z(\tau)-v\|_2\ge a/\sqrt2-\delta\quad} \tag{5} \]

for every source in (1), every time in the interval and every norm-a target in either declared band. Entry into a target tube of radius eta*a is therefore excluded when a/sqrt(2)-delta>eta*a. A failed sufficient test does not prove entry, and an unclosed bootstrap supplies no nonlinear separation certificate. Balance (2) is not asserted as a nonlinear invariant.

docs.title: Fixed source and target budgets
docs.text:
Keep the prepared theorem's actual law, N=1024, Q=16, a=2^-12 and T=256. Supply M=a, epsilon=M/1000 and target tolerance eta=1/25. Then

\[ \frac\delta a=\frac1{1000}+\frac1{6144}<\frac2{1000},\qquad \frac1{\sqrt2}>\frac{707}{1000}. \]

The source remains more than 141a/200 from every one-band norm-a target, well outside the a/25 identity tube, throughout the interval. This excludes even an instantaneous acquisition of that identity, hence also its later retention within the same interval. The result covers arbitrary nominal form profiles; it is stronger than testing one failed impulse or one guessed source.

A directional target has an appropriate correlation between both channels. For example, x_j=b*cos(kj) and theta_j=b*sin(kj) give z_j=b*exp(ikj), which occupies just one nonzero band. This is a boundary control outside the phase-flat class, not an acquisition proof. Supplying phase norm without the appropriate correlations is not sufficient either. Different envelopes, two-sided targets, larger source resources or longer nonlinear evolution retain separate questions.

docs.title: 4. An independent exact reflection restriction
docs.text:
For the reflection j -> -j on the same cycle, both full nonlinear rows are equivariant. If the complete actual initial state, including its retained real phase lifts, is reflection-even, uniqueness preserves that symmetry for all forward time. Thus rho_j=x_j^2+theta_j^2 satisfies rho_j=rho_{-j}. Whenever a window W and its reflection are disjoint, each contains at most half the total rho. For zero total rho the signal-floor requirement fails instead.

This excludes concentration above 24/25 in one such window at any amplitude for those declared continuous lifts. Circular phase symmetry alone does not imply equality of squared lifts chosen on different sheets. The frozen center c=-tau and radius 96 have disjoint reflected windows for 96<tau<=256 on C_1024. The restriction does not apply to arbitrary spatially asymmetric u in (1), nor to arbitrary errors that break reflection symmetry. It permits two counterpropagating concentrations.

The existing symmetry owner already requires complete support/capacity equivariance and actual-state symmetry; its involution controls retain these premises. No new event selector or symmetry-breaking rule is installed by this argument.

docs.title: 5. Computation and research interpretation
docs.text:
The private source calculator in _localized_identity_transport.py re-admits scalar source/target budgets and actual model coefficients. It shares the absolute cubic remainder and exact clock conversion with the prepared reader, while keeping the source verdict distinct. The source proof has no packet-dispersion term or conservative-loss penalty. Reported separations are available only after the actual nonlinear bootstrap closes. The static controls derive modal balance, the geometric distance, a correlated-phase boundary case and the finite budgets without evaluating a response.

The scientific result is a necessary preparation restriction for a specified family, not failure of the emergence hypothesis. A full-state directional organization is information that cannot be supplied by an arbitrary small phase-flat form preparation on this horizon. Localization itself can already be present in such a source, and bilateral motion remains possible. A new formation claim must identify which property is absent initially and allow the corresponding complete-law symmetries. The distinction also prevents an analyst-chosen waveform from becoming a definition of every possible NFR.

docs.title: Finite organized contact under the harmonic alternative
docs.text: This owner develops the own-law interaction question declared at e2b2e647 in the execution plan. The actual five-child hosts are supplied by the alternative outer-acquisition theorem. The prior sine registration theorem provides a comparison and reusable proof method; its source, observation inverse and contact certificate are not premises for the alternative.

docs.title: 1. Complete law and the frozen prepared family
docs.text:
Use only deformation one of the canonical constitutive family:

\[ V_1(a)=1-\cos a+\frac{(1-\cos9a)^2}{6\,9^4},\qquad j_1(a)=\sin a+\frac{\sin9a-\tfrac12\sin18a}{2187}. \tag{1} \]

The supplied smooth full-circle law on each current support is

\[ x_\tau=\tfrac14(-Lx+\gamma S_1(\theta)),\quad \theta_\tau=\tfrac\gamma4Lx,\quad S_{1,i}=\sum_{k\sim i}j_1(\theta_k-\theta_i),\quad \gamma=\frac1{1023\pi},\quad \tau=\frac{1023}{1024}t. \tag{2} \]

Every form is signed, every capacity is held at one, and phase means use declared continuous lifts. The form row supplies pressure independently of the observed response. Both rows retain the quarter factor when contact changes degrees. Original-time conversion multiplies both by 1023/1024. The declared structural units are not identified with laboratory units. There is no continuous forcing or event after the final contact. This is a detached conditional proof; it installs no runtime law or operator word.

Retain the complete frozen preparation and its separate event/reading roles:

  • The two host families are the actual outer-one source and paired outer-zero control under (2), at the unchanged outer-formation deadline 200. Re-admit all ten primitive error allowances in [0,1e-10], their five independent class-one C9 recoveries, original common form shifts and actual residuals. There is no reset to a limiting carrier or substitution of a sine source.
  • Carry each host through the unchanged sequential history: five blocks with four windows of \(h_o=1/100000\), total \(T=1/5000\), and phase jumps \(+\epsilon k_c,-2\epsilon k_c,+\epsilon k_c\) at local times \(h_o,2h_o,3h_o\), where \(\epsilon=1/10\) and \(k_c[b,j]=\delta_{bc}-1/5\). Retain its 25 receiver-child mean-form readings, each with arbitrary error at most 1e-15. These readings are passive observations of that supplied history; no sine inverse is applied.
  • Independently recover one original class-one donor C9 under the same law, with its two primitive error allowances in [0,1e-10], zero common form and common phase origin \(\beta\). Formation duration 200 and recovery dwell \(2\cdot10^{13}\) in the quarter-factor clock give the unchanged allowance \(q=10^{-70}\). Synchronize its preparation to end at contact, with no additional waiting, freezing or resetting. The full original source family retains all 96 relative error directions.
  • Supply 45 same-slot edges from host 9*c+j to donor 45+j, preserving every coordinate. The resulting graph has 54 nodes and 144 unit edges: 90 host, nine donor internal and 45 contacts. Host degree is five and donor degree seven. Keep the same donor residual member and \(\beta\) in each paired comparison.
  • Read the donor mean signed form at contact times zero and \(h=1/1000\), with arbitrary errors at most \(\eta=10^{-10}\) each. For every outer-one source and every \(\beta\), require absolute observed increment below 1e-8. For every outer-zero source, require some \(\beta\) giving absolute increment above 3e-7 for every permitted reading error. No error independence is assumed.

Here \(\beta\) ranges over separately supplied primitive preparations. It is not a scan along one trajectory, an inferred orientation or an autonomous alignment mechanism. Its reference is the host's conserved zero lifted phase mean. The joined form total is exactly zero; its lifted phase total is \(9\beta\). The histories retain both equalities.

The identity observations are six internal winding-one C9 cycles and the nine host outer slot-cycle windings. No identity is assigned to a new contact loop. Common form/phase translations and joint support/mark relabelings retain their complete-law meanings; rotating only the donor after contact is not a symmetry of the joined state. The supplied events need separate operator admission and occurrence arguments before any registered collective action can be claimed.

docs.title: 2. Carrying the own-law hosts through all observation events
docs.text:
Use fresh own-law resource bounds from the original source. Write \(\alpha=2\pi/9\), \(\psi_j=\alpha(j-4)\), and let \(R,Z\) bound the full form and phase deviations from each source's own carrier at the deadline. The outer-one carrier satisfies

\[ |X_c|\le f_x,\qquad \Phi_c\in P_c:=4(c-2)/\pi+[-f_\theta,f_\theta]. \tag{3} \]

The actual host has \(\theta_{c,j}=\psi_j+\Phi_c+z_{c,j}\), with \(|z_{c,j}|\le Z\). For the outer-zero control use the exact nominal carrier \(X=0,\Phi=0\) and its own transported residuals. The uniform full-fine comparison giving \(R,Z\) also applies to that control; it does not identify the actual residual states of the two histories. Admit the unchanged coarse form allowance \(X=1/100\) by checking \(f_x+R<X\). Let \(O\) bound the absolute inherited outer gaps of both actual sources: take the maximum of the own-law outer endpoint gap intervals and \(2Z\).

The actual current and derivative obey

\[ |j_1|\le J:=1+1/1458,\qquad |j_1'|\le K:=1+2/243. \tag{4} \]

Let \(g\) be the outward upper bound on \(\gamma\). During the entire degree-four host history, heat contraction and the unchanged form at every phase event give

\[ B_o=X+gJT,\qquad \|x\|_\infty\le B_o,\qquad m=2gB_oT,\qquad D_o=2m. \tag{5} \]

The quantity m bounds each coordinate's continuous phase drift after removing only the explicit cumulative commanded offset. It retains all drift and backaction between blocks. The four commanded offsets within each block are \(0,+\epsilon k_c,-\epsilon k_c,0\). Thus every commanded outer gap has magnitude at most \(\epsilon\), including both sides of the middle jump. The final command vanishes, but the evolved state does not reset.

Each event changes 18 outer gaps and no internal gap or form. Its actual storage jump is the sum of the differences of \(V_1\) on those edges. The derivative bound J therefore gives

\[ |W_{\rm event}|\le18J|\Delta q|,\quad \max|W_{\rm event}|\le36J\epsilon<4,\quad \sum_{k=1}^{15}|W_k|\le36J<40. \tag{6} \]

No signed cancellation pays for these events. Sufficient identity margins for the complete word are

\[ \alpha-2Z-D_o>0,\quad \pi/2-\alpha-2Z-D_o>0,\quad \pi/2-O-\epsilon-D_o>0. \tag{7} \]

These retain the actual reached-source gaps directly, without applying the old inverse to an unknown alternative-law source. The vertex commands telescope around each marked cycle, and the strict margins hold throughout each segment and on both sides of every jump. Internal winding one and the respective outer windings therefore survive the entire history.

At the final word endpoint, the host offsets lie in \(P_c+[-Z-m,Z+m]\), or \([-Z-m,Z+m]\) for the control. The donor has \(\theta_{D,j}=\psi_j+\beta+z_{D,j}\), with \(\|x_D\|_2,\|z_D\|_2\le q\) and both residual sums exactly zero. The independently acquired donor's isolated rigid translation leaves both rows and its storage unchanged. This justifies the family over \(\beta\) without replaying a response or adding a waiting interval.

docs.title: 3. Full reaction, storage and retained boundary information
docs.text:
Orient each new edge from host to donor and put \(u_{c,j}=x_{D,j}-x_{H,c,j}\), \(\delta_{c,j}=\theta_{D,j}-\theta_{H,c,j}\). Its contributions to the host form and phase rows are

\[ f_{c,j}=\tfrac14(u_{c,j}+\gamma j_1(\delta_{c,j})),\qquad g_{c,j}=-\tfrac\gamma4u_{c,j}. \tag{8} \]

The donor receives the opposite sums over c in both rows. Hence it reacts dynamically and is not a prescribed signal. The full contact storage is \(H_B=\sum_{c,j}[u_{c,j}^2/2+V_1(\delta_{c,j})]\). Its derivative is \(\sum[u_{c,j}u'_{c,j}+j_1(\delta_{c,j})\delta'_{c,j}]\). Together with both regions' internal storage and their actual reaction terms this yields

\[ H_{\rm all}=\tfrac12x^TLx+\sum_eV_1(\theta_b-\theta_a),\qquad H_{\rm all}'=-\tfrac14\|Lx\|_2^2. \tag{9} \]

Odd current also conserves both joined totals. Global bounded current derivative gives complete regular flow for every supplied relative origin, without requiring acuteness of the new contact edges.

On the exact carrier \(x_{c,j}=X_c\), \(\theta_{c,j}=\psi_j+\Phi_c\) for six children, internal currents cancel. Both rows close on the five-cycle with its donor hub, with the same quarter factor and actual current \(j_1\). Its twelve coordinates have pullback storage \(6V_9+(9/2)X^TL_{W_6}X+9\sum_{e\in W_6}V_1(\Phi_b-\Phi_a)\), where \(V_9=9(1-\cos\alpha)\). This carrier does not replace the full reached source or supply an error-free reduced state.

Let \(H_{c,j}=\theta_{H,c,j}-\psi_j\) at contact. Retain the marked same-slot moments, excluding the donor's supplied rigid origin:

\[ Q_n=\frac19\sum_{c,j}\exp\{in(z_{D,j}-H_{c,j})\},\quad |Q_n|\le5, \qquad n\in\{1,9,18\}. \tag{10} \]

The complete initial contact phase sum is exactly

\[ \mathcal A_\beta(0)=\operatorname{Im}(e^{i\beta}Q_1) +\frac{\operatorname{Im}(e^{9i\beta}Q_9)}{2187} -\frac{\operatorname{Im}(e^{18i\beta}Q_{18})}{4374}. \tag{11} \]

These moments suffice for this static phase term. Their future derivatives consume phase/form correlations through \(\delta'=(\gamma/4)[(Lx)_D-(Lx)_H]\); no autonomous moment evolution or hidden-state reconstruction from the 25 earlier readings is asserted. For the finite bound below retain the two higher harmonics as a proved uniform remainder \(d=5/1458\) in (11), rather than silently using a sine current.

docs.title: 4. A finite response bound for the actual joined law
docs.text:
For the donor mean form \(R_D=(1/9)\sum_jx_{D,j}\), internal donor currents cancel and the exact zero joined form total removes the unknown host form distribution. For every fine state in this source family,

\[ R_D'=-\tfrac32R_D-\tfrac\gamma4\mathcal A_\beta(t),\quad \Psi_D'=\tfrac{3\gamma}{2}R_D,\quad R_D(0)=0, \quad \mathcal A_\beta(t)=\tfrac19\sum_{c,j}j_1(\delta_{c,j}(t)). \tag{12} \]

Set \(B=B_o+7gJh/4\), admitting \(q<B_o\). Heat contraction on the actual joined support gives \(\|x(t)\|_\infty\le B\). Host and donor phase rates are bounded by \(5gB/2\) and \(7gB/2\), respectively. Each contact gap changes by at most \(6gBt\), so \(|\mathcal A_\beta(t)-\mathcal A_\beta(0)|\le30gKBt\). Also \(|\mathcal A_\beta|\le5J\); variation of constants in (12) gives \(|R_D(t)|\le5gJt/4\). Keeping both damping and nonlinear phase motion,

\[ \left|R_D(h)-R_D(0)+\tfrac{\gamma h}{4}\mathcal A_\beta(0)\right| \le E:=\tfrac{15}{16}gJh^2+\tfrac{15}{4}g^2KBh^2. \tag{13} \]

The bound is uniform over the complete original source family and every \(\beta\). It uses the actual 54-node law and reaction, not the sine remainder or an onset slope substituted for a finite response.

For \(e=Z+m+q\), the fundamental quadratures obey

\[ \operatorname{Re}Q_1\in C_w=\sum_c\cos(P_{w,c}+[-e,e]),\qquad \operatorname{Im}Q_1\in S_w=-\sum_c\sin(P_{w,c}+[-e,e]), \tag{14} \]

docs.title: 1. Complete law, identity and retained preparation
docs.text:

\[ W(a)=\frac{(1-\cos9a)^2}{6\,9^4},\quad V_1(a)=1-\cos a+W(a),\quad j_1(a)=\sin a+\frac{\sin9a-\tfrac12\sin18a}{2187}. \tag{1} \]

docs.text:

\[ V_1''(a)=\cos a+\frac{c-\cos18a}{243} =\cos a+\frac{(1-c)(2c+1)}{243}. \tag{9} \]
