The two coordinate directions separate under the actual matching contacts. Internal cycle currents cancel, intraparent currents depend on \(B\), and outer currents depend on \(\Delta\). Consequently, both pairs \((w,D)=(v,B)\) and \((u,\Delta)\) obey

\[ w_\tau=-\tfrac12w-\tfrac\gamma2\sin D,\qquad D_\tau=\tfrac\gamma2w. \tag{4} \]

This follows by substituting into both fine rows, so smooth uniqueness preserves the separated family. In the slow clock, put \(\varepsilon=\gamma^2\) and \(Y=-w/\gamma\). Both rows transform to

\[ D_s=-Y,\qquad \varepsilon Y_s=\sin D-Y, \qquad (D(0),Y(0))=(d,0), \quad d\in\{1/2,1/20\}. \tag{5} \]

The form coordinate is retained as \(Y\); replacing the second row by \(Y=\sin D\) would be a different, approximate law.

docs.title: 2. Source admission and full fine-state error
docs.text:
Rebuild four independent copies of the isolated own-law recovery at deformation zero from the original 1e-10 allowances. Each carries its actual state after the unchanged formation and recovery times, with \(\|r_c(0)\|_2,\|z_c(0)\|_2\le q=10^{-70}\), winding one and both residual means zero. Translating the four disconnected phase origins does not change their internal storage or dynamics. These translations supply new preparation information and do not assert autonomous registration.

For the joined state set \(r=x-x^*\) and \(z=\theta-\theta^*\). Then \(\|r(0)\|_2,\|z(0)\|_2\le2q\). The source retains 64 independent fine residual directions: eight zero-mean coordinates in each channel of each child. It is not the earlier 68-direction parentwise residual ball. After attachment only the global means are conserved; no child mean is reset.

The fixed support obeys

\[ \lambda_2(L)>1/3,\qquad \|L\|_2\le8. \tag{6} \]

Indeed its eigenvalues are sums of those of \(C_9,K_2,K_2\). The C9 gap is \(2-2\cos(2\pi/9)>104/243>1/3\), using \(2\pi/9>2/3\) and the cosine Taylor bound. Degree four gives the upper bound eight. For any two lifted phase states, the mean-value edge Hessian gives \(\|S(\theta)-S(\theta^*)\|_2\le8\|z\|_2\), even without acute gaps. Its possibly signed conductances have magnitude at most one.

Integrating the form row first and substituting it into the phase row yields the exact identity

\[ \begin{split} z(\tau)={}&z(0)+\gamma(I-e^{-L\tau/4})r(0)\\ &+\frac{\gamma^2}{4}\int_0^\tau (I-e^{-L(\tau-t)/4})[S(\theta(t))-S(\theta^*(t))]dt. \end{split}\tag{7} \]

Both matrix norms \(\|e^{-Lt/4}\|_2\) and \(\|I-e^{-Lt/4}\|_2\) are at most one. Gronwall therefore gives \(\|z(\tau)\|_2\le2q(1+\gamma)e^{2\gamma^2\tau}\). The form error is globally mean zero; (6) bounds its heat convolution. For the complete declared interval \(0\le s\le5\), retain the exact rational bounds, with \(\bar\gamma\) the outward upper bound of \(\gamma\):

\[ Z=2q(1+\bar\gamma)3^{20},\qquad R=2q+24\bar\gamma Z,\qquad \|z\|_2\le Z<10^{-60},\quad \|r\|_2\le R<10^{-60}. \tag{8} \]

Here \(2\gamma^2\tau=4s\le20\) and \(e<3\). The factor 24 is \((8/4)/(\lambda_2(L)/4)\le24\). These are bounds on all original fine perturbations about a moving reference, not a symmetry assumption on the actual source. Their smallness comes from the already required recovery; no original allowance or dwell is changed. Tiny exact quantities remain rational rather than being rounded to zero on the interval grid.

docs.title: 3. Whole-source entry and child retention
docs.text:
Let \(a=1+2\varepsilon\), with \(0<\varepsilon<10^{-7}\). For each equation (5), the region

\[ 0<D\le d,\qquad 0\le Y\le aD \tag{9} \]

is invariant. At its upper sloped boundary, \(\varepsilon(Y-aD)_s\le(1-a+\varepsilon a^2)D<0\); at \(Y=0\), the derivative is nonnegative. In particular \(D\) decreases and stays positive, with \(D(s)\ge d e^{-as}\). Since \(D\le1/2\), \(\sin D\ge(23/24)D\). The exponential convolution for \(Y\) and monotonicity of \(\sin D\) along the trajectory give

\[ Y(s)\ge\sin D(s)(1-e^{-s/\varepsilon}),\qquad d e^{-as}\le D(s)\le d\exp[-(23/24)(s-\varepsilon)]. \tag{10} \]

The right inequality integrates \(D_s/D\); dropping the positive \(\varepsilon e^{-s/\varepsilon}\) term only enlarges the bound. At the fixed deadline it implies

\[ B(4)<1/64,\qquad \Delta(4)>1/1200. \tag{11} \]

These strict elementary inequalities are checked with outward exponential bounds. For example \(e^{4+8\varepsilon}<60\), using \(e<11/4\) and \(e^{8\varepsilon}\le(1-8\varepsilon)^{-1}\), gives the second inequality. Both gaps keep decreasing in the continuation.

At release every actual intraparent same-slot gap is at least \(1/2-2q>1/4\). Thus the entire source initially lacks parent identity. Throughout passage, every oriented internal edge has its continuous branch in \([\alpha-2Z,\alpha+2Z]\subset(0,\pi/2)\). The closing edge retains its original branch integer, and the residual differences telescope to a total \(2\pi\). Every child keeps winding one on \(0\le s\le5\).

Use the residual convention of repeated composition: subtract the actual parent form mean from form, and subtract the winding carrier \(\psi_j\) and actual parent phase mean \(\Phi_g\) from phase. Thus \(r_\theta=\max_{g,a,j}|\theta_{g,a,j}-\psi_j-\Phi_g|\), not the distance of all primitive phases from a common phase. The carrier has zero mean, so the mean of phase offsets equals the mean of these declared phase lifts. For every \(4\le s\le5\), the fine residual sup norms satisfy

\[ r_\theta\le B(4)/2+2Z<1/128+2Z<1/100, \quad r_x\le\bar\gamma(1+2\bar\varepsilon)B(4)/2+2R<1/100, \tag{12} \]

where \(\bar\varepsilon\) is an outward upper bound of \(\gamma^2\). Every actual intraparent same-slot gap is smaller than \(1/64+2Z<1/4\). This proves entry by the fixed time and subsequent maintenance on the declared interval, for the entire source, while all four child identities remain intact.

docs.title: 4. Predictive use from the reached state
docs.text:
The outer current on the moving separated reference is exactly \(\sin\Delta\), although its children still have different origins. Both parents carry the same internal mode \(B\), so the actual port association matters. Bound (8) retains its perturbation during the whole slow interval. Membership in the parent residual ball alone does not prove this long prediction: the older generic theorem has horizon one in \(\tau\), not one in \(s\).

First initialize the nonlinear four-coordinate parent law from all four actual observations at \(s=4\): \((X_0,X_1,\Phi_0,\Phi_1)\). There is no replacement by zero forms or the original Delta=1/20. The two-node version of (7), with Laplacian norm two, implies over the following slow unit

\[ |\Delta_{\rm actual}(s)-\Delta_{\rm parent}(s)| \le 2Z+e^{s-4}(2Z+2\bar\gamma R) <8Z+6\bar\gamma R. \tag{13} \]

The first term compares the actual fine state with the original moving reference; the second carries the reduced predictor's true initial discrepancy. Thus the controlled parent dynamics keeps actual forms and means, with a quantitative source-specific error rather than an exact quotient.

An explicit forecast for the selected observation uses

\[ F(A)=2\arctan(e^{-1}\tan(A/2)),\qquad A=\Delta_{\rm actual}(4). \tag{14} \]

This is the time-one map of \(D_s=-\sin D\), a declared approximation. Its error is justified from the full retained history. For the nominal outer mode, write \(h=Y-\sin D\). Variation of constants in (5) gives

\[ h(s)=-\sin(d)e^{-s/\varepsilon} +\int_0^s e^{-(s-t)/\varepsilon}\cos D(t)Y(t)dt. \tag{15} \]

For \(s\ge4\), \(e^{-s/\varepsilon}\le\varepsilon/4\), while \(Y\le ad\) and \(d=1/20\). Therefore \(|h|\le d\varepsilon(1/4+a)<\varepsilon/10\). The positive small-angle gradient flow is nonexpansive; its comparison with the nominal pendulum for one unit costs at most \(\varepsilon/10\). The initial and final actual-gap errors each cost at most \(2Z\). Hence

\[ |\Delta_{\rm actual}(5)-F(\Delta_{\rm actual}(4))| \le\bar\varepsilon/10+4Z<10^{-5}. \tag{16} \]

The observed initial gap is not a nominal reset. Forms and source history enter the lag bound (15); (14) by itself certifies neither that history nor a universal phase-only law.

The readout is resolved, not merely enclosed near zero. On \([4,5]\), (10) implies \(Y>(3/4)D\), so \(D(5)<e^{-3/4}D(4)<D(4)/2\). Using (11) and retaining both fine errors proves

\[ \Delta_{\rm actual}(4)-\Delta_{\rm actual}(5) >1/2400-4Z>1/2500>10^{-4}. \tag{17} \]

The forecast error bound is independent of evaluating a reduced or full trajectory. This is a finite analytic prediction about the declared source family, without a sensor or laboratory-time interpretation.

docs.title: 5. Preparation and attachment work
docs.text:
The four isolated phase translations preserve internal storage. At attachment, both sets of new contacts contribute their actual instantaneous storage jump:

\[ W=\sum_{\text{new }\{i,k\}} [\tfrac12(x_k-x_i)^2+1-\cos(\theta_k-\theta_i)]. \tag{18} \]

At the nominal source, \(W^*=18[1-\cos(1/2)]+18[1-\cos(1/20)]>2\). All first-order potential corrections cancel by the original childwise zero sums, despite nonzero nominal contact currents. The contact Laplacian has norm four, and \(\|r(0)\|_2,\|z(0)\|_2\le2q\). Taylor's second-order bound gives

\[ 0\le W-W^*\le16q^2. \tag{19} \]

The lower bound uses convexity along the acute initial contact gaps; the upper bound includes both form and phase terms. Likewise, \(0\le H(0)-[36(1-\cos\alpha)+W^*]\le32q^2\), using \(\|L\|_2\le8\). These exact tiny corrections are retained separately from nominal irrational intervals. The support event requires external work; prior continuous loss is not reused as an undeclared reservoir. Source storage, acquired registration and positive dissipation do not establish a physical binding energy.

docs.title: 6. Acquired-source antipodal nonentry control
docs.text:
Keep the same matching support and complete law. Within each parent choose two identical copies of an actual recovered child state, and translate one copy's phase by exactly \(\pi\). Fix their supplied origins as \(\phi^\pi_{g,a}=(2g-1)/40+(2a-1)\pi/2\), retaining the outer nominal gap \(1/20\). Thus

\[ x_{g,1,j}=x_{g,0,j},\qquad \theta_{g,1,j}=\theta_{g,0,j}+\pi. \tag{20} \]

This is a correlated source subset with genuine nonzero fine residuals allowed. Intraparent form and sine currents vanish; internal cycle currents and same-child outer currents are identical in the two copies. Both evolution rows preserve (20) by uniqueness. Consequently every intraparent gap remains antipodal for all future time, and parent registration never enters its quarter-radian identity domain. This uses the exact circular identity \(\sin\pi=0\), not the sine of a floating-point approximation to pi.

The same global perturbation bound around the antipodal moving reference preserves each child's winding through \(s=5\). No all-future winding claim or independently perturbed nonentry neighborhood follows. Its nominal work is \(W^*_{\pi}=36+18[1-\cos(1/20)]\), with correction in \([0,8q^2]\). This is a different preparation and work budget, not an equal-work comparison. It proves that the admitted law and acquired children alone do not force every registration to organize; relative preparation remains consequential.

docs.title: 7. Evidence and scope
docs.text:
The detached assessor re-admits all primitive allowances before rebuilding the four isolated recoveries. It reuses the existing matching geometry and shared outward arithmetic, retaining source admission separately from conditional bounds. The independent controls check fine and separated rows, both clocks, spectral bounds, every strict entry/readout margin, work corrections, primitive rejection and the antipodal symmetry. The forecast arithmetic helper supplies only (14), not an acquisition certificate for an arbitrary supplied observation.

The result supplies acquired parent registration and a resolved subsequent interaction from the original uncertain children under one supplied law and support. The inherited long recovery dwell and the slow structural horizon remain mathematical preparation premises. Autonomous preparation, contact selection, structural separation resistance, indefinite maintenance, other constitutive laws and physical identification require their own arguments. The matching support is symmetric under exchange of its two binary factors; their nominal modes obey the same relaxation law. The different initial amplitudes and the marked grouping do not select a unique hierarchy or a separation of internal and external timescales.

The separate restoring-response admission carries this reached source through one supplied internal phase intervention, accounts for its work and tests finite recovery and sufficient predictive state. It does not extend this theorem's unchanged-source prediction to an intervened state without that additional argument.

docs.title: Collective actuation with unresolved fine state
Fixed observation, input and response question
docs.text:
This analytic question reduces the information and input authority of the full-state construction. The actual acquired state is retained; projecting its observations constructs a reference and never resets a fine coordinate. The declaration below fixes one input recipe and its response budgets before their assessment.

Item Fixed choice Source The same four independently uncertain recovered C9 children, each with original form and phase allowances 1e-10, carried through the unchanged parent acquisition to actual z4=(x4,theta4) at absolute slow time s=4 Complete law Matching 36-node support with all 72 unit edges, held unit capacities; x_tau=(-Lx+gamma*S(theta))/4+Gamma_tau, theta_tau=gamma*Lx/4, gamma=1/(1023*pi) Clock and duration tau=(1023/1024)*t, s=gamma^2*tau/2; forcing runs from s=4 to s=8, with fixed elapsed duration h=4 Available observations Exactly the four actual child form means X[g,a] and four actual mean lifted phase offsets Phi[g,a]=mean_j(theta[g,a,j]-psi[j]) at s=4, with psi[j]=(2*pi/9)*(j-4). No individual fine coordinate or later observation is supplied to the input or predictor Reference initialization Repeat each observed form mean within its marked child; initialize reference phases as psi[j]+Phi[g,a]. Retain the common form and phase means Input Apply the previously fixed cubic recipe to this reference, using the same displacement k[0,a,j]=(2*a-1)/4, zero on parent one. Supply its resulting form input identically to all nine nodes of each child: four input channels, no fine feedback, phase input, support event or capacity change Actual endpoint At s=8, require ||x8-x4||_2<=1e-7 and ||theta8-theta4-k||_2<=1e-7, using the declared continuous lifts. These are separate form and phase budgets; no exact fine-state endpoint is assumed Work Actual signed net input work integral (Lx)^T*Gamma_tau d(tau)<=3 over the forced interval; include actual storage change and continuous loss Release and predictor Set Gamma=0 at s=8 without a state jump. Continue the exact eight-coordinate child-constant law from (X4,Phi4+k_child), already determined by the initial observations; no measured release state initializes this prediction Readout At s=9, each of the four actual child form means and four lifted phase-offset means differs from that predictor by at most 1e-6, separately in each channel Identity Preserve every marked child's winding one throughout 4<=s<=12. Parent zero must lose registration at release; both parents must recover it at s=12, with every intraparent same-slot circular gap strictly below 1/4 in magnitude Decision Admit the original source, four-channel realization within endpoint and work budgets, child retention, disruption, recovery and predictive accuracy, or a scoped obstruction. A failed sufficient estimate remains unavailable

Let P be the orthogonal projection that replaces each nine-node block by its mean, applied to forms and carrier-subtracted phase lifts. With the fixed L, k and h, the input is precisely equation (1) of the full-state construction initialized at (P*x4, psi+P*(theta4-psi)). It is supplied as a function of the eight initial observations and time, independently of the subsequently evaluated response. Its uniformity within each child is a proof obligation, not an additional approximation of that recipe. The inherited four-child law retains denominator four and both original clock transformations; its two external neighbors do not renormalize the law.

Compare actual and reference flows under this same input. The earlier comparison of two different state-dependent inputs cannot establish the new error bounds. Endpoint mismatch must enter release, work and prediction; the earlier exact-endpoint handoff cannot be assumed. Initial observation accuracy is exact in this question; noise, finite precision, actuator tracking and distribution errors require their own admission.

Marked children, continuous phase lifts, fixed support and capacity, supplied timing and uniform actuation remain premises. Signed net work does not bound positive-only supply, amplitude or bandwidth. No registered operator runtime, autonomous occurrence, universal quotient, physical measurement bridge or optimal control is claimed. No source refinement, trajectory, duration scan or new numerical campaign is activated.

The declaration above was committed as a5fe8f3a before the following assessment. The original source, four-unit input duration, endpoint budgets, readout budgets and work budget remain unchanged. The result is a conditional input and prediction theorem, without a numerical response trajectory.

docs.title: 1. Observation, invariant reference and four input channels
docs.text:
Let \(\Pi\) denote the blockwise orthogonal projection called \(P\) in the declaration. Write the actual initial observation and its lifted reference as

\[ X_{g,a}=\frac19\sum_j x_{4,g,a,j},\qquad \Phi_{g,a}=\frac19\sum_j(\theta_{4,g,a,j}-\psi_j),\qquad \bar x_4=\Pi x_4,\quad \bar\theta_4=\psi+\Pi(\theta_4-\psi). \tag{1} \]

The phase observations use the supplied continuous lifts and marked winding carrier, not a circular average inferred from an arbitrary representative. The observation is assumed exact here. Its physical measurement, noise and the selection of the child marks are not derived.

On the matching graph, \(\Pi L=L\Pi\). The child-constant subspace is invariant under \(L\), and its restriction is the square Laplacian \(\mathcal L\) on the four child indices. For a phase field \(\psi_j+\Phi_{g,a}\), the two internal cycle currents cancel exactly. Each matching external contact has the phase difference of its two child offsets. Hence its complete sine current is also constant within each child.

The eight-coordinate reference equations, including the supplied input, are

\[ X_\tau=\frac{-\mathcal LX+\gamma\mathcal S(\Phi)}4+G_\tau, \qquad \Phi_\tau=\frac{\gamma\mathcal LX}4,\qquad \mathcal S_c(\Phi)=\sum_{d\sim c}\sin(\Phi_d-\Phi_c). \tag{2} \]

There are two square neighbors per child, but the denominator remains four. The original node degree, capacities and complete law have not been replaced by a newly normalized degree-two model.

Apply the frozen cubic recipe to \((\bar x_4,\bar\theta_4)\). Its form, form derivative, Laplacian and sine current are all constant within each child. Therefore its input has exactly four values \(G_{\tau,g,a}\), each supplied to all nine nodes of that child. The input depends only on (1), the fixed model and time. The actual flow receives these same functions; no unknown fine coordinate is used to recompute or correct them.

At slow time eight the reference is exactly \(T(\bar z_4)=(\bar x_4,\bar\theta_4+k)\). Set the common input to zero thereafter. The autonomous version of (2), initialized from \((X_4,\Phi_4+k_{\rm child})\), is the declared predictor. It remains an exact invariant-family solution of the fine law. No measurement at release or at readout enters its initial state.

The actual trajectory generally leaves that family. In particular, later fine errors need not keep zero mean within each child. Predicting those means requires a comparison theorem; exact reference closure is not exact closure of the actual observed state.

docs.title: 2. Same-input comparison for all original fine directions
docs.text:
The fresh acquisition supplies its existing reference \(z_4^*\), whose form and carrier-subtracted phase are child-constant, and its full error bounds

\[ \|x_4-x_4^*\|_2\le R,\qquad \|\theta_4-\theta_4^*\|_2\le Z,\qquad R,Z<10^{-60}. \tag{3} \]

These are the original independently uncertain recovered children, with all 64 fine source directions, the same allowances and the same recovery times. Orthogonality of \(\Pi\) gives

\[ r_0=x_4-\bar x_4,\quad \zeta_0=\theta_4-\bar\theta_4,\qquad \|r_0\|_2\le R,\quad \|\zeta_0\|_2\le Z. \tag{4} \]

Both initial errors have zero mean within every child and hence globally. The full source has not been reset to its projection. Nor is the projected state asserted to be another autonomously acquired source.

Compare actual and reference states under the identical supplied input, including their identical zero input after release. Their differences obey

\[ r_\tau=-\frac14Lr+\frac\gamma4\Delta S,\qquad \zeta_\tau=\frac\gamma4Lr,\qquad \Delta S=S(\theta)-S(\bar\theta). \tag{5} \]

The forcing cancels exactly. The global form-error mean remains zero, since both \(Lr\) and the pairwise sine-current sum have zero global mean. The Laplacian and sine map satisfy the already admitted bounds \(\lambda_2(L)>1/3\), \(\|L\|_2\le8\) and \(\|\Delta S\|_2\le8\|\zeta\|_2\), without an acute-domain assumption. The heat-integral argument therefore gives

\[ \begin{split} \zeta(\tau)={}&\zeta_0+\gamma(I-e^{-L\tau/4})r_0\\ &+\frac{\gamma^2}{4}\int_0^\tau (I-e^{-L(\tau-u)/4})\Delta S(u)\,du,\\ \|\zeta(\tau)\|_2&\le(Z+\gamma R)e^{2\gamma^2\tau}. \end{split}\tag{6} \]

For elapsed slow horizon \(H\), \(2\gamma^2\tau\le4H\). Define exact rational upper bounds, using outward \(\underline\gamma,\bar\gamma\), by

\[ Z_H=(Z+\bar\gamma R)3^{4H},\qquad R_H=R+24\bar\gamma Z_H,\qquad H\in\{4,5,8\}. \tag{7} \]

The phase bound uses \(e<3\); the form convolution uses the global spectral gap and factor 24. Thus \(\|\zeta\|_2\le Z_H\) and \(\|r\|_2\le R_H\) throughout each respective interval. The switch to zero input causes no state jump and does not change (5). This is a same-input comparison, not the polynomial difference formula for two distinct state-dependent inputs in the previous construction.

For orientation, the existing coarse source bounds, \(\bar\gamma<1/3200\), \(3^{16}<10^8\), \(3^{20}<4\cdot10^9\) and \(3^{32}<2\cdot10^{15}\) already give

\[ \begin{array}{c|cc} H& Z_H\text{ upper bound}&R_H\text{ upper bound}\\ \hline 4&2\cdot10^{-52}&2\cdot10^{-54}\\ 5&5\cdot10^{-51}&4\cdot10^{-53}\\ 8&3\cdot10^{-45}&3\cdot10^{-47}. \end{array}\tag{8} \]

These are deliberately loose consequences of the unchanged source, not new preparation tolerances. The implementation retains the sharper exact bounds.

docs.title: 3. Actual endpoint, whole-path identity and eight-coordinate readout
docs.text:
Projection commutes with the fixed child-uniform phase displacement. At release the reference equals \(T(\bar z_4)\), whereas the target is \(T(z_4)\). Consequently the actual endpoint errors are

\[ x_8-x_4=r_8-r_0,\qquad \theta_8-\theta_4-k=\zeta_8-\zeta_0. \tag{9} \]

Both discarded initial residuals must be retained. The sufficient budgets are

\[ E_x:=R_4+R,\qquad E_\theta:=Z_4+Z,\qquad \|x_8-x_4\|_2\le E_x<10^{-7},\quad \|\theta_8-\theta_4-k\|_2\le E_\theta<10^{-7}. \tag{10} \]

This is approximate full-state realization. No exact return of unknown fine forms or phases has been inferred from their means.

For the reference, every internal C9 edge stays on its original winding branch with gap \(\alpha=2\pi/9\), throughout forcing and the autonomous continuation of (2). Equation (7) at \(H=8\) confines every actual internal edge gap to

\[ [\alpha-2Z_8,\alpha+2Z_8]\subset(0,\pi/2). \tag{11} \]

The closing edge retains its integer lift correction. The continued gaps sum to \(2\pi\), so every actual child retains winding one for the complete absolute interval \(4\le s\le12\). This conclusion needs no later parent-recovery verdict or acute premise in the comparison equation.

At absolute time nine the common-input comparison has elapsed horizon five. The Euclidean norm of a nine-node mean functional is \(1/3\). Thus for each child, with the reference evolved by (2) from the fixed projected target,

\[ |X_c(9)-\bar X_c(9)|\le R_5/3<10^{-6},\qquad |\Phi_c(9)-\bar\Phi_c(9)|\le Z_5/3<10^{-6}. \tag{12} \]

These are separate form and lifted-phase budgets for all eight coordinates. The predictor consumes only the eight initial observations. The estimate does not reuse the earlier scalar parent-gap forecast as if it covered every coordinate, and does not consume an unprovided release observation.

docs.title: 4. Actual signed work under the shared input
docs.text:
For both actual and reference trajectories, the complete input balance is

\[ W_{\rm in}=\Delta H+\frac14\int_0^{T_\tau}\|Lx\|_2^2d\tau,\qquad H=\tfrac12x^TLx+\sum_{\{i,j\}}[1-\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)]. \tag{13} \]

The actual endpoint storage in this identity is evaluated at its actual approximate endpoint. It is not replaced by the hybrid-map storage jump. To bound its work, instead compare the power integrals directly:

\[ W_{\rm in}-\bar W_{\rm in} =\int_0^{T_\tau}(Lr)^T\Gamma_\tau\,d\tau. \tag{14} \]

This identity is valid because both trajectories receive exactly the same input. It accounts for actual endpoint and loss differences together.

The projected initial state remains within the same \(R,Z\) bounds about the acquisition reference, since projection contracts those errors. The static cubic path and endpoint-work estimates from the full-state construction can therefore be rederived for that projected state. They require those bounds, not a claim that the projection was acquired. In particular, with \(h=4\), \(A=1+2\bar\gamma^2\) and \(K=9/8>\|k\|_2\), put

\[ M=3hA(\overline B_4+\overline\Delta_4) +\frac{4hR}{\underline\gamma}<\frac14. \tag{15} \]

This bounds \(\|hL\bar x_4/(2\gamma)\|_2\). The reference endpoint work has the same nominal expression and signed error at most \(18Z\), and its polynomial loss is at most \((2/h)[(6/5)(9/8)+(2/5)KM+M^2/5]\). In particular \(\bar W_{\rm in}<5/2\).

To control (14), the square's nonconstant eigenvalues are two and four, so \(\|L^+k\|_2\le K/2\) and \(\|\bar x_4-\operatorname{mean}(\bar x_4)\mathbf1\|_2\le\gamma M/h\). The fixed cubic derivatives satisfy \(|P'|\le3/2\), \(|Q'|\le1\), \(|P''|,|Q''|\le6\). Its reference sine current has norm at most 12: the internal currents cancel and each of the 36 nodes has at most two unit external sine contributions. The explicit input formula therefore gives

\[ \|\Gamma_\tau\|_2\le G:= \frac{3\bar\gamma^3}{h^2}(K+M) +\frac{\bar\gamma}{4h}(3K+2M)+3\bar\gamma <4\bar\gamma. \tag{16} \]

Using \(\|Lr\|_2\le8R_4\) and \(T_\tau=2h/\gamma^2\), define

\[ E_W:=\frac{16hR_4G}{\underline\gamma^2},\qquad |W_{\rm in}-\bar W_{\rm in}|\le E_W. \tag{17} \]

For example \(\underline\gamma>1/5000\), the existing \(\bar\gamma<1/3200\) and (8) give \(E_W<4\cdot10^{-48}\). Thus the actual work satisfies \(W_{\rm in}\le\bar W_{\rm in}+E_W<3\). The detached calculation retains the sharper reference work upper bound and correction (17). This is the actual signed net budget. It does not certify a bound on total positive supply, amplitude or bandwidth.

docs.title: 5. Disruption and recovery with the actual endpoint mismatch
docs.text:
Let \(z^\dagger(u)\) be the already admitted autonomous restoring response started from the actual target \(T(z_4)\), with elapsed slow time \(u=0\) at the new release instant \(s=8\). The actual release state differs from that target by at most \(E_x,E_\theta\) in (10). Both subsequent flows have zero input, the same support, capacities, complete law and clocks. Their global form means agree because the prescribed input and the target preserve the actual original mean.

Reapplying the same-input argument for the next four slow units gives

\[ Z_{\rm rel}=(E_\theta+\bar\gamma E_x)3^{16},\qquad R_{\rm rel}=E_x+24\bar\gamma Z_{\rm rel}. \tag{18} \]

These bounds apply to actual-minus-\(z^\dagger\), not to a reset source. The coarse bounds above imply \(Z_{\rm rel}<4\cdot10^{-44}\) and \(R_{\rm rel}<4\cdot10^{-46}\). Parent identity concerns the phase gaps; the form comparison is retained as part of the complete-state handoff.

At release the nominal target's parent-zero same-slot gap is \(B_4+1/2\). The admitted actual target differs by at most \(2Z\) per gap, and the new endpoint adds at most \(2E_\theta\). All these gaps remain on the same principal branch. Hence the strict disruption margin is

\[ \underline B_4+\frac12-2Z-2E_\theta-\frac14>0. \tag{19} \]

At elapsed time four the prior target-response theorem supplies a uniform bound \(U_{\rm old}<1/4\) on every intraparent same-slot gap. Transporting the actual endpoint mismatch changes each gap by at most \(2Z_{\rm rel}\). For the unchanged source its admitted return margin gives

\[ U_{\rm old}+2Z_{\rm rel}<\frac14. \tag{20} \]

The old bound is well inside the threshold (its derived nominal return sum is below \(1/50\), with its separately retained tiny fine correction). Thus both actual parents recover the declared registration at \(s=12\). This is a perturbed release theorem. The exact-endpoint handoff of the full-state construction has not been assumed.

docs.title: 6. Evidence and limits
docs.text:
The detached assessor rebuilds the original source from all eight primitive allowances. Static reference-work coefficients, actual same-input errors, the four input channels and the new readout budgets have separate owners within that calculation. No cached exact-realization or future-response verdict substitutes for a new forced-path premise. Parent recovery consumes the old admitted return bound only after propagating the new mismatch.

The input evaluator accepts only the four form and four lifted phase means plus time. Evaluating the invariant reference is neither measurement of the actual response nor execution of a live controller. The independent controls check the block projection, matching fine and quotient rows, uniform input, clock transformations, full-norm endpoint error, every readout coordinate, work correction and release margins.

The theorem reduces information and input channels for this unchanged source and fixed protocol. It establishes neither an exact quotient for arbitrary fine states nor recovery from an arbitrary error ball of the same displayed endpoint radius. The full carried error bounds, not only that radius's budget label, enter (18). Marked children, exact initial observations, phase lifts, fixed capacities/support and supplied actuation timing remain premises. There is no autonomous occurrence law, physical observation bridge, optimal control claim or additional chronological no-actuation comparison.

The separate autonomous reservoir question adds an explicit source state and reciprocal exchange law. Its two network inputs can differ under joint-state perturbation, so its error proof and response decision do not follow from the identical-input estimate above.

docs.title: Constructive continuous realization of the acquired-parent phase event
Fixed path and realization question
docs.text:
The one-unit obstruction remains unchanged. This separate analytic question fixes one longer path before assessing its work and identity bounds. Its purpose is to prove existence under the same input channel and budget, not to optimize the obstruction or select a controller from a scan.

Item Fixed choice Source The same four independently uncertain acquired C9 children, each with original form and phase allowances 1e-10, carried to actual z4=(x4,theta4) at absolute slow time s=4; retain every fine coordinate and actual reached velocity Target Exactly T(z4)=(x4,theta4+k), with k[0,a,j]=(2*a-1)/4 and all other entries zero; restore every form and every unaffected phase lift Complete law Fixed matching 36-node support, all 72 unit edges, held unit capacities; x_tau=(-Lx+gamma*S(theta))/4+Gamma_tau, theta_tau=gamma*Lx/4, with gamma=1/(1023*pi) Duration and clock Elapsed slow duration h=4; tau=(1023/1024)*t, s=gamma^2*tau/2, so elapsed T_tau=2*h/gamma^2. A failed sufficient bound for this chosen path is unavailable

Write c=mean(x4), r=x4-c*1, and let L^+ be the inverse of L on its mean-zero subspace, zero on the constant mode. For the supplied displacement, L^+k=(2*a-1)/16-(2*g-1)*(2*a-1)/32 at node (g,a,j). With b=h*L*x4/(2*gamma), fix

\[ \begin{split} P(v)&=3v^2-2v^3,\qquad Q(v)=v-3v^2+2v^3,\\ \theta(v)&=\theta_4+kP(v)+bQ(v),\\ x(v)&=c\mathbf1+\frac{2\gamma}{h}L^+kP'(v)+rQ'(v),\\ \Gamma_\tau(v;z_4)&=\frac1{T_\tau}\frac{dx(v)}{dv} +\frac{Lx(v)-\gamma S(\theta(v))}{4}. \end{split}\tag{1} \]

This is a supplied input recipe depending on initial complete state and marked targets. Its all-node actuation authority and initial-state knowledge are premises. It does not infer pressure from an evaluated response, realize a named operator automatically, select its occurrence, or establish optimal work. No numerical trajectory, duration scan or source refinement is activated.

The declaration above was committed as 2f0eab07 before the bounds below were assessed. The duration remains four slow units and the signed input-work budget remains three. The construction supplies one state-dependent recipe, not one input independent of the initial state: for every admitted actual z4, that state's prescribed input realizes its own exact target.

docs.title: 1. Complete rows, regularity and exact endpoints
docs.text:
Index the nodes by \((g,a,j)\in\{0,1\}^2\times\{0,\ldots,8\}\), and write \(\sigma_g=2g-1\), \(\sigma_a=2a-1\). On the fixed matching support, the child and mixed vectors obey

\[ L\sigma_a=2\sigma_a,\qquad L(\sigma_g\sigma_a)=4\sigma_g\sigma_a,\qquad k=\frac{\sigma_a-\sigma_g\sigma_a}{8}. \tag{2} \]

Thus the expression for \(L^+k\) in the declaration is exact. It does not require a numerical inverse, an inferred support or removal of a fine-state coordinate. The connected graph's sole Laplacian kernel is the constant mode; \(\mathbf1^Tk=0\) admits the inverse on its complement.

The endpoint identities for the fixed polynomials are

\[ \begin{gathered} P(0)=0,\quad P(1)=1,\quad Q(0)=Q(1)=0,\\ P'(0)=P'(1)=0,\qquad Q'(0)=Q'(1)=1. \end{gathered}\tag{3} \]

Consequently (1) gives \((x(0),\theta(0))=(x_4,\theta_4)\) and \((x(1),\theta(1))=(x_4,\theta_4+k)\), for every complete actual initial state. Every form, including fine errors and the common mode, returns to its starting value. Every unaffected phase lift also returns exactly. The endpoint phase velocities are the inherited ones, not zero velocities: \(\theta_\tau(0)=\theta_\tau(T_\tau)=\gamma Lx_4/4\).

Indeed \(d v/d\tau=1/T_\tau=\gamma^2/(2h)\), so

\[ \theta_\tau =\frac{\gamma^2}{2h}(kP'+bQ') =\frac\gamma4\left(\frac{2\gamma}{h}kP'+Lx_4Q'\right) =\frac\gamma4Lx. \tag{4} \]

The last row of (1) then supplies the form row exactly. Its derivative is explicit:

\[ x_v=\frac{2\gamma}{h}L^+kP''+(x_4-c\mathbf1)Q'',\qquad \Gamma_\tau=\frac{\gamma^2}{2h}x_v+\frac{Lx-\gamma S(\theta)}4. \tag{5} \]

The path is polynomial and the input is smooth on the finite forcing interval, since the fixed sine currents are smooth. In particular the input is finite and integrable. The resulting initial-value problem has a unique solution, and direct substitution proves that it is this prescribed path. No solver residual or measured-response reconstruction is used in (5). All-node actuation and exact initial-state knowledge are supplied premises; the recipe does not give a controller using only parent observations.

Both means are retained: \(\mathbf1^T\theta(v)=\mathbf1^T\theta_4\), \(\mathbf1^Tx(v)=\mathbf1^Tx_4\), and \(\mathbf1^T\Gamma_\tau=0\). For the original acquired source the form mean is zero, but it has not been discarded from the realization. Under the original clock \(e=1023/1024\), the input is \(\Gamma_t=e\Gamma_\tau\); under elapsed slow time \(\sigma=\gamma^2\tau/2\), it is \(\Gamma_\sigma=2\Gamma_\tau/\gamma^2\). Transforming both rows therefore gives the same input-work integral in all three clocks.

docs.title: 2. Exact continuous loss and the original-source work budget
docs.text:
Retain the complete storage \(H=\tfrac12x^TLx+\sum_{\{i,j\}}[1-\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)]\). The input balance applies to this smooth realization:

\[ W_{\rm in}=\Delta H+\mathcal D,\qquad \mathcal D=2\int_0^h\|\theta_\sigma\|_2^2d\sigma =\frac2h\int_0^1\|kP'+bQ'\|_2^2dv. \tag{6} \]

Here \(\Delta H=H(x_4,\theta_4+k)-H(x_4,\theta_4)\) is the same actual endpoint storage change as in the hybrid theorem. No preceding loss is credited as a work reservoir. Since \(Q'=1-P'\), integration gives

\[ \int_0^1(P')^2dv=\frac65,\qquad \int_0^1P'Q'\,dv=-\frac15,\qquad \int_0^1(Q')^2dv=\frac15. \]

Thus the loss is known exactly for every supplied actual state:

\[ \mathcal D=\frac2h\left[ \frac65\|k\|_2^2-\frac25 k^Tb+\frac15\|b\|_2^2\right] =\frac2h\left[\|k\|_2^2+\frac15\|k-b\|_2^2\right], \qquad \|k\|_2^2=\frac98. \tag{7} \]

This includes the cost of matching the actual endpoint velocities. It is not the unattainable constant-phase-velocity substitution from the earlier necessary bound, and no minimum-work claim is made.

Fresh acquisition admission supplies the same reference at slow time four, with

\[ \begin{gathered} x_4^*=\tfrac12(\sigma_g U_4+\sigma_a V_4),\qquad U_4=-\gamma Y_\Delta,\quad V_4=-\gamma Y_B,\\ 0\le Y_\Delta\le A\Delta_4,\quad 0\le Y_B\le AB_4,\quad A=1+2\bar\gamma^2,\\ \|x_4-x_4^*\|_2\le R,\qquad \|\theta_4-\theta_4^*\|_2\le Z, \qquad R,Z<10^{-60}. \end{gathered}\tag{8} \]

The bars denote outward bounds, not a changed law. These are the original 64 independent fine source directions, after the same isolated recovery and acquisition; neither the allowances nor a dwell time is reduced. In particular the actual four child means and forms need not equal the reference.

Using \(\|L\|_2\le8\), orthogonality of the two reference modes and \(\|\sigma_g\|_2=\|\sigma_a\|_2=6\), a convenient uniform bound is

\[ \|b\|_2\le M :=3hA(\overline B_4+\overline\Delta_4) +\frac{4hR}{\underline\gamma}. \tag{9} \]

The admitted bounds \(B_4<1/64\), \(\Delta_4<1/500\), \(A<1001/1000\) and \(\gamma>1/5000\) already imply \(M<1/4\) at the frozen \(h=4\). Since \(\|k\|_2=\sqrt{9/8}<9/8\), (7) gives the sufficient upper bound

\[ \mathcal D\le\frac2h\left[ \frac65\frac98+\frac25\frac98 M+\frac15M^2\right] <\frac{59}{80}. \tag{10} \]

The source-dependent endpoint work has the already proved signed correction

\[ \begin{split} W_*&=9[\cos B_4-\cos(B_4+1/2)] +18\cos\Delta_4[1-\cos(1/4)],\\ |\Delta H-W_*|&\le18Z,\qquad 1<W_*<225/128. \end{split}\tag{11} \]

The correction is linear and signed; acquired child means have not been reset to recover an inapplicable quadratic remainder. Equations (10)-(11) give, uniformly over the complete admitted original source,

\[ 0<W_{\rm in} <\frac{225}{128}+\frac{59}{80}+18Z =\frac{1597}{640}+18Z <\frac52<3. \tag{12} \]

The detached assessor can retain the sharper outward version of (9)-(11). The coarse rational margin already proves the frozen signed net budget. It does not establish a bound of three on total positive supplied work, input amplitude or bandwidth. A negative power segment, if present, is accounted for as extraction in the signed balance; no actuator or reservoir realizing such exchange has been derived.

docs.title: 3. Whole-path child identities with every fine direction retained
docs.text:
Write \(r_4=x_4-x_4^*\), \(z_4=\theta_4-\theta_4^*\), and apply the same recipe to the reference in (8). Both \(k\) and \(b^*=hLx_4^*/(2\gamma)\) are constant within each C9 child. Therefore the reference path has the original winding carrier \(\psi_j=(2\pi/9)(j-4)\) plus a time-dependent uniform child offset. Its internal circular gaps remain exactly \(\alpha=2\pi/9\).

The actual path difference is exactly

\[ x(v)-x^*(v)=r_4Q'(v),\qquad \theta(v)-\theta^*(v)=z_4+\frac{h}{2\gamma}Lr_4Q(v). \tag{13} \]

The source form error is globally mean zero, so no extra common term enters (13). The exact polynomial bounds are \(\max|Q|=1/(6\sqrt3)<1/10\) and \(-1/2\le Q'\le1\). Consequently, throughout the full forcing interval,

\[ \|x-x^*\|_2\le R,\qquad \|\theta-\theta^*\|_2\le Z_{\rm path} :=Z+\frac{2hR}{5\underline\gamma}<10^{-55}. \tag{14} \]

This is an exact source-dependent path comparison, not an unforced stability estimate applied to a forced trajectory. In particular the long structural duration does not license resetting errors to a symmetric family.

Every oriented child gap on its original winding branch lies in \([\alpha-2Z_{\rm path},\alpha+2Z_{\rm path}]\subset(0,\pi/2)\). This includes the closing C9 edge with its original integer lift correction. No gap crosses a circular branch boundary, and the sum of the continued principal gaps remains \(2\pi\). All four winding-one child identities are therefore retained for every actual source state along the entire path. The parent registration is allowed to fail, as required by the target; no preservation of its identity throughout the intervention is claimed.

docs.title: 4. Release into the already admitted autonomous response
docs.text:
Forcing starts at absolute slow time four and ends at absolute time eight. Set \(\Gamma=0\) at the latter instant, with no state jump. The input may have a finite discontinuity when switched on or off; the state remains continuous and the phase velocity remains continuous because form does. Such a switch remains within the integrable input contract.

By (3), the release state is exactly the previous theorem's actual post-event state \(T(z_4)\), not an interval-reset substitute or a state whose parent means merely agree. The fixed support, capacities, complete sine law and clocks are identical. Uniqueness of the autonomous flow then identifies every subsequent state with the restoring response translated by four slow units. Its finite child retention and parent recovery apply through absolute time twelve; its actual-state eight-coordinate prediction applies at absolute time nine. No additional acquisition interval or tighter source is required for this handoff.

The previous paired no-kick comparison, if used, must likewise be initialized from its original actual state \(z_4\) at the translated release origin. It is not automatically a comparison against a second system evolving freely from absolute time four throughout this forcing interval. No such new chronological control is proved here. Nor does translating a finite theorem establish indefinite maintenance or autonomous event occurrence.

docs.title: 5. Evidence, implementation and scope
docs.text:
The detached implementation re-admits the eight original primitive source allowances and rebuilds the acquired state and release premises. Its path arithmetic evaluates (1) on admitted complete state; it does not install an input in a live network or certify that arbitrary supplied vectors belong to the acquired family. Conditional path/work bounds and source-dependent admission remain separate. A failed source or sufficient estimate is unavailable, not a proof of nonreachability.

The independent controls check the exact polynomial integrals, endpoint and phase-row identities, signed storage balance, circular child branches and whole-source bounds. The result is an explicit mathematical realization under supplied full-node actuation and complete initial-state knowledge. It preserves the one-unit impossibility result, without claiming optimal duration, optimal work, a registered operator's runtime admission, a selected natural forcing law or a laboratory actuator and clock.

The separate collective actuation theorem uses eight initial child means and four uniform input channels. Its endpoint is approximate, and its same-input error, actual work and perturbed release require new bounds. That reduction leaves the exact construction above intact.

Fixed realization question
docs.text:
The restoring-response theorem admits a supplied hybrid phase map and its subsequent unforced response. This question tests a different premise: finite-duration realization of that same endpoint map through an added form input. The preceding work-balance review motivates an obstruction test; this is an analytic admission, not a blind experiment or a new response trajectory.

Item Fixed choice Actual source The same four independently uncertain acquired C9 children, with original form and phase allowances 1e-10, carried to the actual state z4=(x4,theta4) at slow time s=4; no nominal reset or smaller error family Target The actual mapped endpoint T(z4): restore every form to x4, shift every phase of child (0,0) by -1/4 and child (0,1) by +1/4, and return all other phases to their original declared lifts Fixed substrate Original matching 36-node support, all 72 unit edges, held unit capacities, signed real forms and primitive circular phases with their continuous lifts Complete forced law dx/dtau=(-Lx+gamma*S(theta))/4+Gamma_tau, dtheta/dtau=gamma*Lx/4; no phase forcing, support event, capacity change or intermediate hybrid jump Input class Any integrable Gamma_tau on the finite interval, with absolutely continuous form and the stated rows almost everywhere; this includes continuous inputs and excludes impulsive resets. The target is the exact hybrid-map endpoint of the state at s=4, reached after one elapsed slow unit. It is not the unforced evolution of that endpoint over the same interval. Prescribed phase lifts make the displacement explicit; any extension to a circular-only endpoint must account for possible winding increments separately. The declaration above was committed as be66de2d before its certificate was assessed. The obstruction below concerns that unchanged input class, endpoint, duration and budget. No input is fitted or simulated.

docs.title: 1. Complete forced rows, regularity and clocks
docs.text:
Let the local actuation interval start at the actual acquired state \(z_4=(x_4,\theta_4)\). Use elapsed structural time \(\tau\) and write \(T_\tau=2h/\gamma^2\). On the unchanged matching support, the forced initial-value problem is

\[ x_\tau=\frac{-Lx+\gamma S(\theta)}4+\Gamma_\tau, \qquad \theta_\tau=\frac{\gamma Lx}4, \qquad S_i(\theta)=\sum_{k\sim i}\sin(\theta_k-\theta_i). \tag{1} \]

Admit \(\Gamma_\tau\in L^1([0,T_\tau];\mathbb R^{36})\). The sine currents are smooth and bounded on the fixed finite graph; the form diffusion is linear. Solutions have absolutely continuous form, and the phase row gives a continuously differentiable real lift because form is continuous. The equations and storage balance hold almost everywhere. On this compact interval the state is bounded, the loss is finite and the input power is integrable. These regularity premises include continuous inputs and measurable inputs with finite integral. They do not admit a Dirac impulse or an intermediate state reset.

The obstruction does not restrict which nodes may be forced, the input's amplitude or bandwidth, or whether it was obtained through open-loop design or feedback. Every resulting input and trajectory in the stated class is covered. Retaining the live form source is essential: it is not absorbed into an unforced certificate or reconstructed as a pressure after observing motion.

For \(e=1023/1024\), the original clock obeys \(\Gamma_t=e\Gamma_\tau\). In elapsed slow time \(\sigma\), with \(d\sigma/d\tau=\gamma^2/2\), put \(\Gamma_\sigma=2\Gamma_\tau/\gamma^2\). Both rows become

\[ x_\sigma=\frac{-Lx+\gamma S(\theta)}{2\gamma^2} +\Gamma_\sigma, \qquad \theta_\sigma=\frac{Lx}{2\gamma}. \tag{2} \]

The local interval is \(0\le\sigma\le h\); its absolute slow-time origin is the already reached \(s=4\). Input and loss integrals transform with their clocks. These are structural clocks, without a laboratory-unit identification.

docs.title: 2. Actual endpoint storage and input-work balance
docs.text:
Let \(k\in\mathbb R^{36}\) be the fixed lifted displacement:

\[ k_{g,a,j}=\begin{cases}(2a-1)/4,&g=0,\\0,&g=1.\end{cases} \qquad \mathbf1^Tk=0,\qquad \|k\|_2^2=18/16=9/8. \tag{3} \]

The target is exactly \((x_4,\theta_4+k)\). In particular, every form must return to its actual starting value, and every unaffected lifted phase must return to its original value. Evolving the hybrid endpoint freely for one slow unit would give a different target and is not substituted here.

The complete storage and its gradients are

\[ H=\tfrac12x^TLx+\sum_{\{i,j\}}[1-\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)], \qquad \nabla_xH=Lx,\qquad \nabla_\theta H=-S(\theta). \]

Substituting (1), the reciprocal terms cancel, leaving

\[ H_\tau=-\tfrac14\|Lx\|_2^2+(Lx)^T\Gamma_\tau. \tag{4} \]

Hence every admitted realization of the specified endpoint satisfies the exact accounting identity

\[ W_{\rm in}=\Delta H+\mathcal D, \qquad \Delta H=H(x_4,\theta_4+k)-H(x_4,\theta_4), \qquad \mathcal D=\tfrac14\int_0^{T_\tau}\|Lx\|_2^2d\tau. \tag{5} \]

The endpoint term is the actual hybrid-map storage jump. It is independent of the path chosen to realize that endpoint. The previous event-work proof rebuilds it from the original uncertain acquired source:

\[ \begin{split} W_*={}&9[\cos B_4-\cos(B_4+1/2)] +18\cos\Delta_4[1-\cos(1/4)],\\ |\Delta H-W_*|&\le18Z_{\rm pre},\qquad 1<W_*<225/128. \end{split}\tag{6} \]

Here \(B_4,\Delta_4\) are the original reference's reached phase gaps, and \(Z_{\rm pre}\) bounds the actual phase error at that time. The signed linear correction is retained: acquired child-mean errors are not reset to zero. Fresh source admission and these static work bounds suffice; no verdict about the later restoring trajectory is required.

The input work in (5) is signed. If some part of an input extracts storage, that contribution remains negative in the balance. Total positive supplied work is at least signed work, so a bound on the former cannot bypass the obstruction established for the latter.

docs.title: 3. A necessary loss for the prescribed phase transport
docs.text:
The unchanged phase row fixes \(Lx=4\theta_\tau/\gamma\). Substitution into the loss, followed by the integral Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, gives

\[ \begin{split} \mathcal D &=\frac4{\gamma^2}\int_0^{T_\tau}\|\theta_\tau\|_2^2d\tau\\ &\ge\frac4{\gamma^2T_\tau} \left\|\int_0^{T_\tau}\theta_\tau d\tau\right\|_2^2 =\frac4{\gamma^2T_\tau}\|k\|_2^2 =\frac9{4h}. \end{split}\tag{7} \]

Equivalently, in the slow clock, (2) gives \(\mathcal D=2\int_0^h\|\theta_\sigma\|_2^2d\sigma\). The same inequality is then \(\mathcal D\ge2\|k\|_2^2/h\). The cancellation of \(\gamma\) reflects the prescribed slow duration; it does not identify a physical constant or eliminate clock dependence.

This bound is global. It assumes no small-angle approximation, invariant family, monotone path, controlled trajectory, or intermediate child identity. Even paths that temporarily lose all the organizational identities must pay this loss if they satisfy the phase law and the prescribed endpoints. Thus proving the impossibility does not first require a retention certificate for every candidate path.

Both common modes are harmless to the bound. The lifted phase mean is conserved because \(\mathbf1^TL=0\), and the displacement (3) respects that requirement. Arbitrary common form motion or a common component of the input does not change \(Lx\), phase velocity or the loss. Returning every form also requires the net common form input to vanish, but imposing that additional necessary condition cannot lower (7).

docs.title: 4. Decision for the fixed one-unit realization
docs.text:
Combining the exact endpoint work and the necessary loss yields

\[ W_{\rm in}\ge\Delta H+\frac9{4h}. \tag{8} \]

For the frozen \(h=1\), (6) alone already gives

\[ W_{\rm in}>\frac{13}{4}-18Z_{\rm pre}>3. \tag{9} \]

The last margin is \(1/4-18Z_{\rm pre}>0\) for the complete original source. The detached certificate may use the sharper outward lower endpoint of (6) plus \(9/4\), while preserving the same decision and budget. Consequently no admitted form input can realize the fixed actual endpoint within one slow unit and three structural work units. This is an obstruction for the entire declared input class and original uncertain family, not a failed controller, a solver failure or the absence of one attempted path.

There is therefore no need to construct a forcing or evolve a driven path for this gate. An unavailable original-source or endpoint-work admission would instead leave the decision unavailable; cached status labels alone are not evidence for (9).

docs.title: 5. Equality, alternative lifts and limits of the conclusion
docs.text:
Equality in (7) requires a constant lifted phase velocity almost everywhere, \(\theta_\tau=k/T_\tau\). Since \(x\) is continuous and the phase row is unchanged, this also requires \(Lx(0)=4k/(\gamma T_\tau)\), with the same condition at the final endpoint. It is not enough to draw a straight phase path while choosing unrelated endpoint forms.

For the acquired source, equality is impossible. Define the mixed form projection \(m(x)=\frac1{36}\sum_{g,a,j}(2g-1)(2a-1)x_{g,a,j}\). Its graph mode has Laplacian eigenvalue four. The acquired reference has \(m(x^*)=0\), and its actual fine form deviation gives \(|m(x_4)|\le R_{\rm pre}/6\). In contrast, the constant-velocity condition at \(h=1\) would require

\[ m(k)=-1/8,\qquad m(x_4)=-\gamma/16, \tag{10} \]

whose magnitude exceeds that source-error allowance. This nonattainment does not establish an additional uniform positive gap above (7). No amplitude or bandwidth bound has been imposed, and no sharp infimum or optimal input has been constructed. The necessary bound, without such an optimization claim, already resolves the fixed budget.

The protocol specifies continuous lifts. If one separately weakens only the endpoint phase condition to equality modulo \(2\pi\) at every marked node, each continuous path instead has displacement \(k+2\pi n\) for an integer vector \(n\). Since every \(|k_i|\le1/4<\pi\),

\[ \|k+2\pi n\|_2^2\ge\|k\|_2^2. \tag{11} \]

The conserved lifted mean additionally requires \(\sum_i n_i=0\). The periodic storage endpoint is unchanged. Thus extra full turns cannot reduce this particular work-duration lower bound. This argument concerns the same complete nodewise circular endpoint; targeting only a winding, parent mean, approximate endpoint or another observation is a different problem and inherits no such conclusion without its own admission.

The obstruction leaves the hybrid map and its restoring-response theorem valid under their original premises. It also leaves open a longer duration, a different work budget, an admitted phase input or another complete law. Passing a necessary bound in one of those alternatives would not certify a realizing path, retained child identity or autonomous event occurrence.

docs.title: 6. Evidence and ownership
docs.text:
The detached assessor rebuilds the eight primitive source allowances and the actual acquired-state evidence before computing the fixed displacement, endpoint-work enclosure and loss lower bound. The shared signed event-work calculation retains the source's linear uncertainty correction. No incoming restoring-response verdict, force callback, numerical path or frozen response is needed to establish the obstruction.

The independent controls check the forced storage identity, clock transformations, the exact displacement norm, source association, signed work correction and strict rejection margin. They validate the implementation of the conditional theorem; a finite collection of force samples would not prove its universal input quantifier. Structural work and duration retain their declared units, without a sensor bridge, material interpretation or uniquely selected law.

The separate constructive-actuation theorem uses a frozen four-unit path to establish a sufficient realization with the same source, target, input channel and net work budget. Its actual path and child-retention proof are additional evidence; the one-unit obstruction above and its frozen protocol remain unchanged.

docs.title: Autonomous exchange with a finite auxiliary reservoir
Fixed joint model and prospective question
docs.text:
The collective construction still supplies its input as a function of time. This separate question fixes one autonomous joint law and a finite reservoir preparation before assessing its response. docs.title: 1. Complete joint balance, clocks and reference restriction
docs.text:
The original structural clock is absolute: the new comparison starts at \(\tau_0=8/\gamma^2\), corresponding to \(s=4\). A subscript zero below denotes this initial state, and elapsed slow time is \(h=\gamma^2(\tau-\tau_0)/2=s-4\). Write \(q=Lx\). The autonomous equations are globally well posed on finite intervals: the sine map is smooth and globally Lipschitz, and every other term is linear in the declared state. The global form mean and lifted phase mean are conserved because \(\mathbf1^Tb=0\). No auxiliary phase is needed. With unit auxiliary capacity in the normalized clock, its independently supplied pressure is \(p_r=-b^TLx-\lambda r\).

The complete storage derivative is

\[ \begin{split} H_\tau&=-\tfrac14\|Lx\|_2^2+(Lx)^Tbr,\\ (r^2/2)_\tau&=-r b^TLx-\lambda r^2,\\ (H+r^2/2)_\tau&=-\tfrac14\|Lx\|_2^2-\lambda r^2. \end{split}\tag{1} \]

Thus the network's signed net input work through any finite time is

\[ W_{\rm net} =\frac{r_0^2-r(\tau)^2}{2}-\lambda\int_{\tau_0}^\tau r(u)^2du \le\frac{r_0^2}{2} \le\frac{(12/5+10^{-10})^2}{2}<3. \tag{2} \]

The network's initial acquired storage remains part of the joint preparation. It is not included in the three-unit added-reservoir budget. Equation (2) allows the network to charge the reservoir; it is not a bound on cumulative positive-only supply. The finite reservoir is an actual coordinate of this supplied model, not a reinterpretation of previously dissipated storage.

Every row transforms under \(\tau=e t\), \(e=1023/1024\), by multiplication by \(e\). Under elapsed slow time \(h=\gamma^2(\tau-\tau_0)/2\), the complete equations become

\[ x_h=\frac{-Lx+\gamma S(\theta)}{2\gamma^2} +\frac{2b}{\gamma^2}r,\qquad \theta_h=\frac{Lx}{2\gamma},\qquad r_h=-\frac{2b^TLx}{\gamma^2}-r. \tag{3} \]

These are structural clocks. The rate units of \(b,\lambda\), pressure and storage are those fixed in the declaration; no laboratory clock is inferred.

The exact child-constant restriction retains all four forms \(X_c\), four lifted offsets \(\Phi_c\), and \(r\). Let \(\mathcal L\) be the square Laplacian, \(\beta_c=\gamma\sigma_a/12\), and \(\mathcal S_c=\sum_{d\sim c}\sin(\Phi_d-\Phi_c)\). Then

\[ X_\tau=\frac{-\mathcal LX+\gamma\mathcal S(\Phi)}4+\beta r,\qquad \Phi_\tau=\frac{\gamma\mathcal LX}4,\qquad r_\tau=-9\beta^T\mathcal LX-\lambda r. \tag{4} \]

The factor nine in the reservoir row counts the fine nodes of each child; the network denominator remains four. Internal C9 sine currents cancel, and matching contacts preserve the winding carrier. Both facts hold for arbitrary child offsets in this invariant family.

For the acquired reference write

\[ x^*_{g,a,j}=\frac{\sigma_g U+\sigma_a V}{2},\qquad \theta^*_{g,a,j}=\psi_j+\frac{\sigma_g\Delta+\sigma_a B}{2}. \tag{5} \]

The auxiliary input preserves this separated subfamily. With \(\varepsilon=\gamma^2\), \(u=U/\gamma\) and \(v=V/\gamma\), its exact slow equations are

\[ \begin{gathered} \Delta_h=u,\qquad \varepsilon u_h=-u-\sin\Delta,\\ B_h=v,\qquad \varepsilon v_h=-v-\sin B+r/3,\qquad r_h=-6v-r. \end{gathered}\tag{6} \]

In particular \(b^TLx^*=3\gamma V\). All acquired reference velocities are retained. At the new initial time, the acquisition proof gives \(0<B_0<1/64\) and \(-(1+2\varepsilon)B_0\le v_0\le0\); neither coordinate is reset. The reference reservoir starts at the particular actual \(r_0\) in the frozen interval. Uniform bounds below retain that entire interval.

The reference storage, apart from its constant internal-cycle contribution, is \(9\varepsilon(u^2+v^2)+18(1-\cos\Delta)+18(1-\cos B)+r^2/2\). Its slow derivative is \(-18(u^2+v^2)-r^2\). These balances check the coefficients in (6); they alone do not establish the reserved response. Replacing the middle equation by \(v=-\sin B+r/3\) would instead be a singular reduced model, and is not used in the proof.

docs.title: 2. A new joint-state error estimate
docs.text:
Let \(R,Z<10^{-60}\) be the freshly rebuilt acquisition's full form and phase error bounds at absolute slow time four. They retain the original 64 fine source directions. Compare each actual connected state with the reference (5) initialized with its same actual \(r_0\). Write the form, phase-lift and reservoir differences as \(\xi,\zeta,\rho\). Initially \(\|\xi_0\|_2\le R\), \(\|\zeta_0\|_2\le Z\), \(\rho_0=0\). The independent reservoir uncertainty has not been replaced by its midpoint or folded into a smaller fine-state allowance.

The deviations satisfy

\[ \xi_\tau=-L\xi/4+\gamma\Delta S/4+b\rho,\qquad \zeta_\tau=\gamma L\xi/4,\qquad \rho_\tau=-b^TL\xi-\lambda\rho, \quad \Delta S=S(\theta)-S(\theta^*). \tag{7} \]

The two network inputs differ whenever the reservoir errors differ. Thus the previous identical-input theorem cannot be invoked. Instead use the positive comparison quantity

\[ \mathcal V=\tfrac12\xi^TL\xi+\tfrac12\rho^2+4\|\zeta\|_2^2. \tag{8} \]

It is an error estimate, not an additional physical reservoir. The global form-error mean stays zero because the coupling vector is mean zero. The fixed graph has \(\lambda_2(L)>1/3\), \(\|L\|_2\le8\), and \(\|\Delta S\|_2\le8\|\zeta\|_2\), globally in the lifted phases. The reciprocal reservoir terms cancel exactly:

\[ \begin{split} \mathcal V_\tau &=-\tfrac14\|L\xi\|_2^2-\lambda\rho^2 +\tfrac\gamma4(L\xi)^T(\Delta S+8\zeta)\\ &\le\frac{\gamma^2}{16}\|\Delta S+8\zeta\|_2^2 \le16\gamma^2\|\zeta\|_2^2 \le4\gamma^2\mathcal V. \end{split}\tag{9} \]

Since \(\mathcal V_0\le4(R^2+Z^2)\), slow time gives \(\mathcal V(h)\le\mathcal V_0 e^{8h}\). For either horizon \(H\in\{1/2,8\}\), the convenient rational bounds are

\[ Z_H=(R+Z)3^{4H},\qquad R_H=6Z_H,\qquad Q_H=4Z_H, \tag{10} \]

and throughout that interval \(\|\zeta\|_2\le Z_H\), \(\|\xi\|_2\le R_H\), \(|\rho|\le Q_H\). Here \(e<3\), the graph gap controls the mean-zero form, and the integer constants conservatively dominate the square-root coefficients from (8). In particular \(Z_{1/2}<2\cdot10^{-59}\) and \(Z_8<4\cdot10^{-45}\).

The same estimate applies to the disconnected branch with \(b=0\). Its reference and actual reservoir both decay as \(r_0e^{-h}\), while the network follows the original unforced law. No assertion that a connected reservoir initialized at zero stays zero is required.

docs.title: 3. Cooperative bounds for the fixed connected response
docs.text:
The following comparison treats the finite \(\varepsilon\) equations directly. Define

\[ p=r+6B,\qquad y=v+4B. \tag{11} \]

Then (6) is equivalent to

\[ B_h=y-4B,\qquad \varepsilon y_h=-(1-4\varepsilon)y +(2-16\varepsilon)B-\sin B+p/3,\qquad p_h=6B-p. \tag{12} \]

Its off-diagonal derivatives are nonnegative: in particular the derivative of the second numerator in \(B\) is at least \(1-16\varepsilon>0\). The nonnegative orthant is invariant, using \(\sin B\le B\) for \(B\ge0\). The initial state lies there because \(y_0\ge[4-(1+2\varepsilon)]B_0>0\) and \(p_0=r_0+6B_0>0\). Standard componentwise differential comparison therefore applies; no prior assumption that \(r\) stays positive is needed.

Put

\[ d=1/64,\qquad c=9/10,\qquad r_+=12/5+10^{-10}, \qquad \begin{split} \bar B(h)&=d+\tfrac14(1-e^{-4h}),\\ \bar y(h)&=1+4d,\\ \bar p(h)&=6d+\tfrac32+(r_+-2)e^{-h}+\tfrac12e^{-4h}. \end{split}\tag{13} \]

These coordinates dominate \((B_0,y_0,p_0)\). The first and third equations in (12) hold exactly. For the second, the required residual is

\[ \begin{split} &\varepsilon\bar B_{hh}+\bar B_h+\sin\bar B+2\bar B-\bar p/3\\ &\quad=\sin\bar B+(1/3-4\varepsilon)e^{-4h} -(r_+-2)e^{-h}/3\\ &\quad\ge cd+c/4+(1/3-c/4-4\varepsilon)e^{-4h} -(r_+-2)e^{-h}/3>0. \end{split}\tag{14} \]

Indeed \(0<\bar B\le17/64\), and \(1-(17/64)^2/6>c\) gives \(\sin\bar B\ge c\bar B\). Both \(1/3-c/4-4\varepsilon\) and \(cd+c/4-(r_+-2)/3\) are strictly positive for the unchanged \(\varepsilon<10^{-7}\). Thus \(0\le B(h)\le\bar B(h)\le17/64\).

At the frozen half-unit readout, \(e^2<8\) gives the useful strict margin

\[ B(1/2)\le\frac1{64}+\frac14(1-e^{-2})<\frac{15}{64}. \tag{15} \]

This evaluates the declared candidate, without a parameter scan or a replacement of its deadline. It is a genuine upper bound below the desired disruption threshold, not the failure of a lower-bound method.

For the later registered deadline, the preceding global bound admits \(\sin B\ge cB\) along the actual reference. Replace the second row's sine term by that lower linear bound. The resulting linear system is again cooperative. A supersolution is

\[ \widehat B(h)=\tfrac13e^{-h/5},\qquad \widehat y(h)=(4-1/5)\widehat B(h),\qquad \widehat p(h)=\tfrac52e^{-h/5}. \tag{16} \]

Its initial values dominate the reference, in particular \(p_0<r_++6/64<5/2\). Its first and third rows are exact, and its second-row residual is \((\varepsilon/25+1/5)\widehat B>0\). Therefore

\[ 0\le B(8)\le\tfrac13e^{-8/5}<\frac1{12}, \tag{17} \]

where \(e^{8/5}>4\) follows already from its first four Taylor terms. No small-\(\varepsilon\) replacement of the acquired velocity was used in either comparison.

docs.title: 4. Actual identities, control and decision
docs.text:
In the reference, both parents have the same internal child-registration gap \(B\). The actual deviation of any same-slot gap is at most \(2Z_H\). At the reserved readout, (15) and the new joint estimate give

\[ |\theta_{g,1,j}-\theta_{g,0,j}|_{\rm circ} \le\frac{15}{64}+2Z_{1/2}<\frac14 \quad\text{for every }g,j. \tag{18} \]

The displayed bound is within the principal circular branch. Both connected parents therefore retain registration at the time when the frozen criterion requires every one of their gaps to exceed \(1/4\). The complete original source and the full reservoir interval are covered. This excludes the specified registration-loss discrimination for this fixed candidate.

For the disconnected control, the original acquired reference's unforced cone gives \(0<B(h)\le B_0<1/64\). Applying (10) shows its actual parents retain registration at the same readout, and also at the deadline. This is the declared \(b=0\) control with the same preparation; it is not a claim about a connected zero-initial-reservoir preparation.

Equation (17) gives, for the connected branch at the deadline,

\[ |\theta_{g,1,j}-\theta_{g,0,j}|_{\rm circ} \le\frac1{12}+2Z_8<\frac14. \tag{19} \]

This establishes registration at that deadline. Since the prescribed loss criterion failed, it is not reported as a demonstrated loss-and-return cycle. The proof has not excluded a transient threshold crossing at every other time between the two readouts.

In either reference branch, each child remains a winding carrier plus a uniform offset under its exact inherited dynamics. The full error bound confines every actual oriented internal edge gap, including the closing edge with its retained integer lift, to

\[ [\alpha-2Z_8,\alpha+2Z_8]\subset(0,\pi/2),\qquad \alpha=2\pi/9. \tag{20} \]

Their sum stays \(2\pi\), proving winding one for all four original children through the full eight-unit elapsed interval in both branches.

The result is therefore a source-inclusive negative decision for the frozen registration-loss readout, with an admitted autonomous balance, finite net reservoir work, child retention and registered deadline. No source allowance, coupling coefficient, preparation or readout has been moved. A different port, reservoir, horizon or complete law is a distinct question and is not excluded by this result.

docs.text:
The detached implementation admits all eight network-source allowances and the reservoir allowance before rebuilding the original source and assessing the strict response margins. The scalar response bounds are prospective consequences of the fixed law, not sampled trajectories. An unavailable source or sufficient margin is reported separately from the proved negative decision.

The independent controls check the full and inherited rows, factor-nine reservoir reaction, all clock conversions, storage power, finite reservoir budget, joint-error cancellation, comparison supersolutions and circular identity margins. The original full fine uncertainty and independent reservoir interval remain explicit throughout.

The auxiliary scalar, its pressure and storage, the reciprocal coupling and their joint preparation remain supplied premises. A successful balance does not derive their occurrence or identify the scalar as a formed NFR. Conversely failure of this fixed response does not invalidate the existing organized objects, supplied-input constructions or every autonomous source mechanism. No unique fundamental law, material property or physical measurement bridge has been selected.

docs.title: Retained reservoir information and local organized equilibria
Declared comparison and mathematical question
docs.text:
The fixed reservoir experiment failed its prescribed disruption readout. This separate analytic question keeps that result and its protocol unchanged. It asks whether retained auxiliary state can change stable geometry, and what reservoir leakage changes.

Item Declared scope Fine support The same 36-node matching product C9 x K2 x K2, with 72 unit edges, node 18*g+9*a+j, and held unit network capacities Complete law x_tau=(-Lx+gamma*S(theta))/4+b*r, theta_tau=gamma*Lx/4, r_tau=-b^T*Lx-lambda*r, with gamma=1/(1023*pi) and unchanged b[g,a,j]=gamma*(2*a-1)/12 Compared laws Only lambda=0 and the original lambda=gamma^2/2; no coupling scan or change to the sine law Auxiliary state and units Signed real form r, held unit capacity in tau, independently supplied pressure -b^T*Lx-lambda*r, storage r^2/2 in the existing normalized units; no auxiliary phase is consumed Clock tau=(1023/1024)*t, s=gamma^2*tau/2; a local stability problem has no new finite readout or source dwell Common modes Fix sum(x)=0 and a continuous phase lift with sum(theta)=0; arbitrary common modes are outside this declared representative Phase chart Write theta[g,a,j]=psi[j]+delta[g,a,j], psi[j]=2*pi*(j-4)/9, with real mean-zero delta. On each oriented child edge j -> (j+1) mod 9, the adjusted gap is 2*pi/9+delta[next]-delta[j], including its fixed closing-edge turn. A parent is registered when all its intraparent same-slot circular gaps have magnitude strictly below 1/4; equality is a boundary, not registration Perturbations Admit all fine form and phase directions compatible with the fixed means and chart, and independent auxiliary perturbations. Use the original joint storage H_joint=x^T*L*x/2+sum_edges(1-cos(gap))+r^2/2. Derive every elimination, balance, domain and stability claim for the actual complete law.
