docs.title: 1. Fine law, normalization and attachment storage
docs.text:
Let \(H\) denote the original 36-node host, \(D\) the donor C9, and \(B\) the nine new edges. Each internal cycle has nine unit edges; the four original matching child interfaces contribute 36 more, and the donor interface contributes nine. Thus the enlarged support has 45 nodes and 90 edges. Its degrees are those in the declaration, rather than a common degree four. With \(e=1023/1024\), its complete rows are

\[ \begin{split} S_i(\theta)&=\sum_{k\sim i}\sin(\theta_k-\theta_i),\\ x_\tau&=\tfrac14[-Lx+\gamma S(\theta)],\qquad \theta_\tau=\tfrac\gamma4Lx,\qquad \tau=e t . \end{split}\tag{1} \]

The uniform mobility \(1/4\) is a supplied coefficient. It is not the reciprocal of each new degree, a changed capacity, or an inference from the nodal identity. Both original-time rows are \(e\) times (1). For unit capacity the independently declared pressure is the form row in the selected clock, with the corresponding structural units. There are no continuous external inputs after the supplied attachment. These equations are the detached comparison law, not the native resultant-direction pressure or an operator word.

Use continuous phase lifts, retaining the original closing-edge branch on each child when reading its winding. Sine and cosine are periodic, so the vector field itself is independent of those branch representatives. It is globally Lipschitz on the finite-dimensional lifted state: the linear form rows and globally bounded sine derivatives give a unique complete solution for every finite initial state. This is existence of the specified law, not an assertion of future identity.

The actual storage and its derivative are

\[ \begin{split} H_{45}(x,\theta)&=\tfrac12x^TLx+ \sum_{\{i,k\}}[1-\cos(\theta_k-\theta_i)],\\ (H_{45})_\tau&=-\tfrac14\|Lx\|_2^2,\qquad (\mathbf1^Tx)_\tau=(\mathbf1^T\theta)_\tau=0 . \end{split}\tag{2} \]

Indeed \(\nabla_xH_{45}=Lx\) and \(\nabla_\theta H_{45}=-S\); substitution of both rows cancels the reciprocal products. Symmetry and oddness cancel every edge in the two sums. The phase sum refers to the declared continuous lifts, not a circular mean or phase-resultant angle.

For each new edge put

\[ u_j=x_{36+j}-x_j,\qquad \delta_j=\theta_{36+j}-\theta_j,\qquad H_B=\sum_{j=0}^8[\tfrac12u_j^2+1-\cos\delta_j]. \tag{3} \]

The attachment changes no state coordinate. Consequently \(H_{45}^+-H^- = H_B\), where \(H^-\) includes both the actual host and donor internal storage. Each edge is counted once. In particular, the contact form storage depends on a difference of two existing forms; no independent \(r^2/2\) storage has been added. Positive \(H_B\) requires a supplied structural-work source. Past dissipation is not a declared reserve, and (3) supplies neither funding nor event occurrence.

docs.title: 2. Actual boundary channels, reaction and regional balance
docs.text:
Let \(L_H,S_H\) contain only the original host edges and \(L_D,S_D\) only the donor cycle. A selector \(E\) inserts a nine-vector at the host slots \(j=0,\ldots,8\). Define the two vector channels

\[ f_j=\frac{u_j+\gamma\sin\delta_j}{4},\qquad g_j=-\frac{\gamma u_j}{4}. \tag{4} \]

The full law splits exactly as

\[ \begin{array}{ll} (x_H)_\tau=(-L_Hx_H+\gamma S_H)/4+Ef, &(\theta_H)_\tau=\gamma L_Hx_H/4+Eg,\\ (x_D)_\tau=(-L_Dx_D+\gamma S_D)/4-f, &(\theta_D)_\tau=\gamma L_Dx_D/4-g . \end{array}\tag{5} \]

The source reacts in both channels, with the opposite currents under this common mobility. Its boundary values are evolving fine state; they are not a prescribed waveform. The host's two charge rates are \(\sum_j f_j\) and \(\sum_j g_j\), while the donor rates are their negatives. A zero form gap removes the instantaneous phase channel, but it does not remove the dependence of the form channel on phase.

To make the regional work explicit, write \(a_H=L_Hx_H\), \(a_D=L_Dx_D\), \(b_H=-S_H\), \(b_D=-S_D\), and let \(H_H,H_D\) denote the respective internal storages. Direct differentiation gives

\[ \begin{split} (H_H)_\tau&=-\tfrac14\|a_H\|_2^2+ (E^Ta_H)^Tf+(E^Tb_H)^Tg,\\ (H_D)_\tau&=-\tfrac14\|a_D\|_2^2-a_D^Tf-b_D^Tg,\\ (H_B)_\tau&=\sum_j[u_j(u_j)_\tau+ \sin\delta_j(\delta_j)_\tau],\\ (H_H+H_D+H_B)_\tau&=-\tfrac14\|Lx\|_2^2 . \end{split}\tag{6} \]

These supplies depend on internal form pressures and phase gradients. They are not form times form input alone. The sum of the two isolated losses is generally not the complete loss; differentiating the contact storage restores precisely (2). This is the same component-balance method as the earlier causal composition, with the present support, mobility and nine actual channels re-derived.

docs.title: 3. Exact ten-coordinate restriction
docs.text:
Let \(c=0,1,2,3\) label the original children and \(c=4\) the donor. The interchild edge set and its unweighted Laplacian are

\[ \begin{split} \mathcal E_C&=\{\{0,1\},\{2,3\},\{0,2\},\{1,3\},\{0,4\}\},\\ K&=\begin{pmatrix} 3&-1&-1&0&-1\\ -1&2&0&-1&0\\ -1&0&2&-1&0\\ 0&-1&-1&2&0\\ -1&0&0&0&1 \end{pmatrix}. \end{split}\tag{7} \]

On the declared family \(x_{c,j}=X_c\), \(\theta_{c,j}=\psi_j+\Phi_c\), the two internal cycle sine currents cancel and internal form currents vanish. Every matching edge has the same form and phase gaps at every slot. Both fine rows are therefore constant within each child. Smooth uniqueness proves invariance, and substitution gives all ten rows:

\[ q=KX,\qquad s_c(\Phi)=\sum_{b:\{c,b\}\in\mathcal E_C}\sin(\Phi_b-\Phi_c), \qquad (X_c)_\tau=(-q_c+\gamma s_c)/4,\quad (\Phi_c)_\tau=\gamma q_c/4 . \tag{8} \]

Writing \(R=X_4\), \(\Psi=\Phi_4\), \(u=R-X_0\), \(\delta=\Psi-\Phi_0\), the donor and its increments to the original host child-zero rows are in particular

\[ \begin{array}{ll} F=(u+\gamma\sin\delta)/4,&G=-\gamma u/4,\\ R_\tau=-F,&\Psi_\tau=-G=\gamma u/4. \end{array}\tag{9} \]

Thus the constituent supplies a closed two-coordinate reaction on this family. The ten coordinates include both the donor and the host; the port has not counted the source again as an independent force. Every carrier child keeps its winding one because its internal gaps remain \(2\pi/9\). This exact statement on the carrier does not prove retention for acquired transverse errors.

The inherited storage is the pullback, not a postulated source energy:

\[ \begin{split} H_{10}={}&45(1-\cos\alpha)+\frac92X^TKX +9\sum_{\{c,b\}\in\mathcal E_C}[1-\cos(\Phi_b-\Phi_c)],\\ (H_{10})_\tau={}&-\frac94\|KX\|_2^2, \qquad \alpha=2\pi/9 . \end{split}\tag{10} \]

For example the new contact term is exactly \(9[u^2/2+1-\cos\delta]\). The donor's internal carrier storage \(9(1-\cos\alpha)\) is independent of its two common coordinates. This does not make its interaction storage or reaction independent of them. Equations (8)--(10) use the actual common factor \(1/4\); the final-degree normalization of the separate pair inheritance model would instead define a different complete law here.

docs.title: 4. Conserved preparation information and the scalar obstruction
docs.text:
The carrier totals

\[ T_x=\sum_{c=0}^4X_c,\qquad T_\phi=\sum_{c=0}^4\Phi_c \tag{11} \]

are conserved. They are the whole fine sums divided by nine because \(\sum_j\psi_j=0\). If all eight host child coordinates and both initial totals are retained, then at every time

\[ R=T_x-\sum_{c=0}^3X_c,\qquad \Psi=T_\phi-\sum_{c=0}^3\Phi_c . \tag{12} \]

Substitution into the first eight rows of (8) is an exact autonomous eight-coordinate law on that fixed information leaf. Summing those rows reproduces both donor rows, so the reconstruction remains valid. No extra evolving donor scalar is required there. The two constants retain initialization information; they are not inferred from current host observations and do not become an additional force. Changing phase representatives requires transporting the retained lift and its total.

For the separately declared scalar comparison, hold the host state, original host support subtraction and clock fixed, and let \(R,\Psi\) vary independently in an open contact chart with \(|\delta|<\pi/2\). The derivative of the complete port output (9) is

\[ D_{(R,\Psi)}(F,G)= \begin{pmatrix}1/4&\gamma\cos\delta/4\\-\gamma/4&0\end{pmatrix}, \qquad \det D(F,G)=\gamma^2\cos\delta/16>0 . \tag{13} \]

If a continuously differentiable scalar observation \(r=h(R,\Psi)\) and continuously differentiable output maps reconstructed both channels, their derivative would factor through a one-dimensional space and have rank at most one. Equation (13) is a contradiction. The obstruction also holds for arbitrary single-valued output maps: (13) makes the port locally injective, whereas a continuously differentiable scalar cannot be injective on an open two-dimensional neighborhood. A nonzero scalar gradient gives a nontrivial local level curve by the implicit-function theorem; if the gradient vanishes throughout a ball, the scalar is constant there. In either case identical scalar observations would have to reconstruct distinct port values. Thus no such scalar closes even the instantaneous complete port on this open domain, and hence it cannot provide a complete smooth autonomous representation there. This excludes a regular scalar reduction, not discontinuous encodings, a fixed curve, special singular points or a model retaining additional preparation constants.

For the particular observation \(r=R\), two donor origins with the same form give different \(F\) whenever their sine gaps differ. If the phase total and all host coordinates are separately retained, the donor phase can instead be recovered and \(R\) suffices. If only the form total is retained, donor phase is a sufficient remaining coordinate. With both totals, (12) applies. These distinctions prevent a dimension claim from silently discarding available initialization.

The old auxiliary law adds \(b r\) only to the host form row and leaves its phase row unchanged. Relative to precisely that unchanged host and clock, the organized-source port changes the phase row by \(-\gamma u/4\) at every contacted slot. For any \(u\ne0\), no choice of the old scalar reproduces this row. Even at an instantaneous \(u=0\), the form current depends on the donor phase and its subsequent reaction. A coincidence at a selected state is not equivalence of complete laws on an open domain. This is a scoped nonrealization of that auxiliary port, not a universal obstruction to other reductions, different interfaces or separately admitted controlled channels.

docs.title: 5. Fine means do not remove contact correlations
docs.text:
For arbitrary fine states define the same child means, and write \(\theta_{c,j}=\psi_j+\Phi_c+\eta_{c,j}\), with \(\sum_j\eta_{c,j}=0\). All matching form sums reduce exactly to mean differences. The actual mean rows are consequently

\[ \begin{split} (X_c)_\tau&=\tfrac14[-(KX)_c+ \gamma\sum_{b:\{c,b\}\in\mathcal E_C}J_{cb}],\\ (\Phi_c)_\tau&=\tfrac\gamma4(KX)_c,\\ J_{cb}&=\frac19\sum_j \sin(\Phi_b-\Phi_c+\eta_{b,j}-\eta_{c,j}). \end{split}\tag{14} \]

The two totals still reconstruct donor means, but generally not the currents \(J_{cb}\). For an explicit matched-observation witness, take all forms zero and all host offsets zero, with donor origin \(\delta=1/10\). In state A all residuals vanish; in state B give the donor the offsets \((h,-h,0,\ldots,0)\), \(h=1/100\), keeping every host fine coordinate unchanged. Both states have the same ten means, both totals, all child windings and the same host registration. All internal donor gaps remain acute: their deviations from \(\alpha\) have magnitude at most \(2h\). The donor contact current is nevertheless

\[ J_{04}^{A}=\sin\delta,\qquad J_{04}^{B}=\sin\delta\frac{7+2\cos h}{9},\qquad (X_0^B-X_0^A)_\tau= \frac{\gamma\sin\delta}{18}(\cos h-1)\ne0 . \tag{15} \]

The last notation compares their rates at these initial states, not a subtraction of evolved trajectories. The witness also works for any sufficiently small positive \(h\). It proves lack of exact closure on fine neighborhoods; it does not assert that these particular states are reached by the fixed acquired source. Fine correlations require retained coordinates, a justified approximation, or causal elimination with complete initial state. An earlier model's memory coefficients cannot be transferred merely because this port also has two channels.

docs.title: 6. Actual donor preparation, host handoff and event work
docs.text:
Re-admit the original class-one primitive preparation, independently of any stored recovery verdict:

\[ \begin{split} m&=(2046/9)(355/113)^2,\\ x_j(0)&=m(j-4)+\xi_j^x,\qquad \theta_j(0)=\xi_j^\theta,\\ |\xi_j^x|,|\xi_j^\theta|&\le10^{-10},\qquad \sum_j\xi_j^x=\sum_j\xi_j^\theta=0 . \end{split}\tag{16} \]

These are signed forms and primitive lifted phases on the original ordered unit C9, with held unit capacities, sine potential and the same \(\gamma\). The shared acquisition and recovery owner rebuilds all consumed source norms, nonlinear capture and recovery from those primitives at deformation zero. The original donor vector field has factor \(1/2\) in both rows. If its elapsed clock is \(v\), then the new isolated solution is exactly

\[ z_{\rm new}(\tau)=z_{\rm old}(\tau/2),\qquad v=\tau/2 . \tag{17} \]

The chain rule applies to both form and phase, with unchanged initial state; uniqueness proves the identity. It does not replay an old trajectory or transplant a coefficient into the enlarged support. The donor therefore acquires winding one by new elapsed time 200, and at new elapsed time \(2(100+10^{13})\) its reached residuals obey

\[ \|x_D\|_2\le q,\qquad \|\theta_D-\psi\|_2\le q,\qquad q=10^{-70}, \tag{18} \]

with their exact zero means retained. No coordinate is reset. The new original-clock duration is \((1024/1023)2(100+10^{13})\), not the old preparation duration. The donor's full initial storage is bounded by

\[ B_1=36m^2+32m\,10^{-10}+36\,10^{-20}<10^9 . \tag{19} \]

The nine edge differences of the nominal ramp give the first term; the actual form and phase errors give the remaining terms. Its isolated law dissipates this storage at its own declared speed. At the recovered endpoint, stationarity of the winding-one target and \(\|L_{C9}\|_2\le4\) bound its storage above by \(9(1-\cos\alpha)+4q^2\). This reached bound does not remove the initial cost or imply that lost storage can fund attachment. Its excess above \(9(1-\cos\alpha)\) is also nonnegative: the segment between the reached phase and the winding target remains in the acute fixed-winding chart, where the phase Hessian is a positive weighted Laplacian; the target is stationary and the form term is nonnegative.

Separately rebuild the host's actual acquisition at its unchanged \(s=4\), using all four independently uncertain sources and the host handoff proof. Its reference uses gaps \(B,\Delta\) and forms \(v=-\gamma Y_B\), \(u=-\gamma Y_\Delta\), where \(0\le Y_D\le(1+2\gamma^2)D\). At \(s=4\), retain

\[ B<1/64,\quad \Delta<1/640,\quad \|x_H-x_H^*\|_2\le R<10^{-60},\quad \|\theta_H-\theta_H^*\|_2\le Z<10^{-60}. \tag{20} \]

The same upper exponential factor bounds both gaps, whose initial values are \(1/2\) and \(1/20\); hence the second bound follows by using the host proof's common factor below \(1/32\). No proportionality of their actual nonlinear trajectories is assumed. In particular the child-zero reference phase offset is \(-(B+\Delta)/2\), and its form is \(\gamma(Y_B+Y_\Delta)/2\).

The four host primitive costs, their original 36-contact work and subsequent loss retain that owner's accounting. Together with (19), the five original isolated source budgets sum to at most \(5B_1\); the host assembly work is a separate supplied term. At the new contact, the pre-event storage is exactly \(H_H(x_H(s=4),\theta_H(s=4))+H_D(x_D,\theta_D)\), not five target storages. The independent preparation starts may be offset to reach their declared endpoints at the same attachment time. No extra waiting or unproved frozen state is inserted.

Translate the actual disconnected donor phase origin by \(1/8\) as declared. This is a symmetry of its isolated dynamics and storage; once contact is added the relative origin is consumed by the interaction. Both source residuals and all host coordinates are retained. Set

\[ b=11/1280,\qquad e_\theta=Z+q,\qquad e_x=R+q, \quad d_+=1/8+b+e_\theta,\quad u_+=\gamma(1+2\gamma^2)b+e_x . \tag{21} \]

The actual host keeps its zero global form and lifted-offset sums, and the donor's translation changes only its phase mean. Consequently this entire prepared family has \(T_x=0\), \(T_\phi=1/8\). These constants reconstruct its donor means from host means, but (14) still retains the actual fine contact correlations.

Every actual contact gap and form difference obeys \(1/8-e_\theta<\delta_j<d_+\) and \(|u_j|\le u_+\). They use the full independently uncertain sources; no matching residual is assumed. The elementary cosine bound and positivity on this contact chart then give

\[ \frac1{16}< 9\left[\frac12(3/25)^2-\frac1{24}(3/25)^4\right] <H_B\le\frac92(d_+^2+u_+^2)<\frac1{10} . \tag{22} \]

For the lower bound, (20) gives \(\delta_j>3/25\), while \(\delta_j<1/4\); \(1-\cos\delta\) is increasing there and its quartic Taylor lower bound applies. The upper bound uses \(1-\cos\delta\le\delta^2/2\), \(\gamma<1/3000\), and the retained tiny errors. These rationally separated constants are event work bounds, not a prediction of subsequent disruption.

All five marked windings are initially admitted by their actual source proofs. The event changes only support, so it preserves those instantaneous windings and the host's acquired registration. The exact port identity (5) then applies to the full reached state, whereas (8) is exact only on the carrier. No finite post-attachment identity, capture, lifetime or response follows from the event budget or carrier invariance alone.

docs.title: 7. Scope of the admitted mechanism
docs.text:
The organized constituent supplies two coupled boundary channels and their reaction, with storage inherited from the same fine configuration. On the compatible carrier its own form and phase suffice; with all eight host coordinates and both conserved totals, they can instead be reconstructed. Fine states additionally retain contact correlations. The complete port excludes the old form-only auxiliary law under the fixed host subtraction and clock, and excludes a smooth scalar port on the stated independent two-coordinate donor domain.

The primitive preparation, positive loss, relative origin, uniform mobility, unit capacities, matching interface and attachment occurrence remain supplied premises. The source is not a new fundamental state coordinate, and the result selects neither those premises nor a physical reservoir. It establishes no new finite response or maintenance outcome for the enlarged support. Any such claim requires its own admitted source, horizon, work and transverse-error argument in the sole execution plan.

docs.title: 8. Shared implementation and verification boundary
docs.text:
The shared detached owner builds the declared support, observes both complete fine rows and regional accounts, evaluates the exact carrier restriction, and reconstructs donor means from eight host coordinates plus two admitted totals. Its attachment assessment re-admits primitive allowances and rebuilds the existing host acquisition and isolated donor recovery before applying (17) and the new contact bounds. An incoming report or cached verdict is not source evidence.

The contract tests compare the fine rows and storage with independently constructed graph calculations, retain both clocks and reaction channels, exercise the carrier and conserved-information reconstruction, and verify the matched-mean fine counterexample and invalid scalar/vector admission. Source and contact checks retain the complete preparation budgets and actual reached errors. These tests establish implementation behavior; the invariance, closure obstruction and source transfer arguments are the conditional proofs above. No observer installs the support, chooses an event or evaluates a post-attachment trajectory.

docs.title: 9. All-duration obstruction to the fixed Emission endpoint
docs.text: Conditional theorem. The unchanged attached source cannot realize the nonclipped default Emission (AL) form increment at all nine constituents of host child zero at any finite elapsed time. A bound on their mean already excludes that necessary condition, allowing the donor and all other coordinates to evolve. The result concerns this preparation, support, complete law and fixed amplitude; it does not exclude other Emission gains or identify a universal activation mechanism.

docs.title: Fixed comparison and evidence boundary
docs.text:
The analytical comparison retains the preceding actual acquired host and recovered donor, all ten original 1e-10 error allowances, attachment and continuous lifted law (1). Time zero below is the actual attachment state, not an earlier nominal carrier or a reset after interaction. The observation is

\[ X_0(\tau)=\frac19\sum_{j=0}^8 x_j(\tau). \]

The fixed target is nine constituent Emission increments with the shared default positive AL_boost, denoted \(b_{\rm AL}\), on the hard in-rail branch. No aggregate operator inheritance is assumed. Its necessary form condition is

\[ x_j(T)=x_j(0)+b_{\rm AL}\quad(0\le j<9) \quad\Longrightarrow\quad X_0(T)-X_0(0)=b_{\rm AL}. \tag{23} \]

For an instantaneous event, the direct glyph holds capacity, phase and stored pressure. A finite-duration comparison instead refreshes pressure with the same complete law at the AL endpoint. That refreshed pressure need not equal the pre-event stored value. Full realization additionally requires the appropriate phase, capacity, grammar and lifecycle conditions; the obstruction below relaxes all such conditions and excludes even (23). It therefore does not manufacture failure by freezing the donor or by requiring fresh constitutive pressure to behave like a stored event value.

The horizon is every elapsed \(\tau\ge0\); the positive original-clock rescaling gives the same reachability conclusion. The calculation uses exact rational bounds, the shared 128-bit outward trigonometric intervals, and the exact represented default boost. There is no selected response time, amplitude search, gain change, numerical trajectory or frozen-producer replay. Source bounds are rebuilt from admitted primitive allowances.

docs.title: A gap for the actual fine support
docs.text:
The 45-node support is the Cartesian product of the unit C9 and the five-child graph with Laplacian \(K\) in (7):

\[ L=K\otimes I_9+I_5\otimes L_{C9}. \]

The child graph has diameter three. For any nonconstant mean-zero real five-vector \(v\), let \(r=\max v-\min v\). The elementary variance bound and a shortest path between its extremal nodes give

\[ \|v\|_2^2\le\frac54r^2,\qquad r^2\le3\sum_{\{a,c\}\in\mathcal E_C}(v_a-v_c)^2. \]

Thus its positive spectral gap is at least \(4/15\). The variance inequality follows from \((v_i-\min v)(\max v-v_i)\ge0\), summation and \(-\min v\max v\le r^2/4\); the path inequality is Cauchy--Schwarz. For C9 the smallest positive eigenvalue is \(2-2\cos(2\pi/9)>1/3\), certified with the shared outward cosine interval. The product eigenvalues are sums, so on the full mean-zero fine space

\[ x^TLx\ge\lambda_*\|x\|_2^2,\qquad \lambda_*=4/15. \tag{24} \]

This includes all internal fine modes, not only the ten-coordinate carrier. The actual degrees are nine copies of five, 27 of four and nine of three. Therefore the complete sine current obeys

\[ \mathbf1^TS(\theta)=0,\qquad \|S(\theta)\|_2^2\le\sum_i d_i^2=738<28^2 \tag{25} \]

for every phase configuration. No short-arc or retained-winding assumption is needed for this bound. The separate capture theorem remains valid on its own premises but is not used to suppress possible transients here.

docs.title: Retaining the actual preparation in an all-time envelope
docs.text:
Write \(\bar\gamma\) and \(\bar\eta\) for the outward upper bounds on \(\gamma\) and \(\gamma^2\). Rebuild the host's gap bounds \(\bar B,\bar\Delta\), form error \(R\), and donor radius \(q\) from the original preparation. Each host reference form has absolute value at most \(\bar\gamma(1+2\bar\eta)(\bar B+\bar\Delta)/2\). There are 36 host coordinates, so the full initial form satisfies

\[ \|x(0)\|_2\le R_0 :=3\bar\gamma(1+2\bar\eta)(\bar B+\bar\Delta)+R+q <\frac1{50000}. \tag{26} \]

This uses \(\bar B<1/64\), \(\bar\Delta<1/640\), \(R<10^{-60}\), \(q=10^{-70}\), \(\bar\gamma<1/3000\), and the rebuilt outward square bound \(\bar\eta<10^{-7}\). It does not replace the reached forms by zero or discard independent source errors. Exact zero total form is retained from both preparations and is conserved by (1).

Variation of constants for the full form row gives

\[ x(\tau)=e^{-L\tau/4}x(0)+\frac\gamma4 \int_0^\tau e^{-L(\tau-s)/4}S(\theta(s))\,ds. \]

Both terms are in the mean-zero space. Using (24)--(26), set \(A=28\bar\gamma/\lambda_*<7/200\) to obtain

\[ \|x(\tau)\|_2 \le e^{-\tau/15}R_0+(1-e^{-\tau/15})A \le M:=\max\{R_0,A\}<\frac7{200}. \tag{27} \]

The phase evolution and donor reaction remain those of the coupled law; only their universally bounded sine contribution was relaxed. This is a uniform transient estimate, which the separate asymptotic convergence \(x\to0\) would not by itself supply. The quarter row factor sets the decay rate and cancels from the steady forcing allowance. A clock change must transform both rows, but cannot increase this all-duration envelope.

The child-mean observation has Euclidean norm \(1/3\). Hence for every elapsed time, including all possible endpoint choices,

\[ |X_0(\tau)-X_0(0)| \le\frac{M+R_0}{3} <\frac{1751}{150000}<\frac1{80} <\frac1{16}<b_{\rm AL}. \tag{28} \]

The last inequality is checked against the resolved represented default, approximately \(0.07957747\); it is not inferred from an operator name or a supposed universal constant. The initial target coordinates and their default AL proposals are well inside the hard rails because \(|x_j(0)|\le R_0\) and \(R_0+b_{\rm AL}<1\). Clipping cannot remove the specified increment in this comparison. Thus (23) fails for every finite duration, proving the stated obstruction. A nonzero instantaneous jump also cannot be the continuous observation of this smooth unforced flow under a regular clock; finite-duration reachability is the stronger substantive comparison tested here.

docs.title: Implementation, controls and scope
docs.text:
The existing detached source owner reuses primitive attachment admission and derives the product gap, form envelope and fixed default-Emission comparison. Candidate bounds remain distinct from an admitted-source verdict. Neither an input report nor its cached status substitutes for rebuilding the consumed preparation.

The realization controls independently reconstruct support, spectra and degree bounds; check the source-inclusive envelope, scalar comparison and mean observation; and exercise default-operator, invalid-domain and unavailable-source boundaries. The existing source-port and capture controls retain their earlier evidence. These are detached analytical assessments and static controls, not executed continuous responses or proof that a runtime word occurred.

The conclusion permits the already-proved source interaction, identity maintenance and joined registration. It excludes one stronger claim: that this unchanged source supplies the specified default Emission endpoint. It establishes no necessary minimum Emission amplitude, no universal failure of smaller gains, and no rejection of canonical operator semantics. A bound that allows another endpoint would still not prove its realization, grammar admission or occurrence. Native saturation belongs to a different complete law and is not a premise of this proof.

docs.title: 10. No fixed-duration constant Emission map on an open leaf domain
docs.text:
Conditional theorem. For every fixed finite duration T>0 and every fixed positive gain b, the unchanged 45-node autonomous law cannot produce the nonclipped Emission (AL) increment b at all nine child-zero constituents on any nonempty open subset of its complete conserved leaf. Even their necessary mean increment cannot hold on such a subset. Donor reaction and all collateral endpoint coordinates remain unrestricted in this obstruction.

This is a reusable-map question. It differs from the preceding bound on one acquired family and one default gain: no small-source allowance, default amplitude, spectral gap estimate or capture conclusion is needed here. It also has a different limitation: it excludes an open full-state domain, not every individual endpoint or every constrained preparation family.

docs.title: Fixed law, observation and complete domain
docs.text:
Keep the actual support, quarter mobility, held unit capacities and both rows of (1), with gamma=1/(1023*pi) and elapsed structural clock tau. There are no new inputs, events, controllers or support changes. Write theta[c,j]=psi[j]+delta[c,j] on continuous real lifts as before. The conserved state domain is the affine leaf

\[ \mathcal M=\{(x,\delta)\in\mathbb R^{45}\times\mathbb R^{45}: \mathbf1^Tx=0,\quad\mathbf1^T\delta=9/8\}. \tag{29} \]

These are raw sums; the corresponding sums of five child means are zero and 1/8. Eliminating the last coordinate of each vector identifies M with R^88, so it is connected. The observation remains the actual linear child mean X_0=sum_(j=0)^8 x_j/9, with all other fine coordinates retained in the flow. A mean observation does not assert mean-only closure.

The comparison asks for a nonempty relatively open U in this leaf on which the same pair (T,b) satisfies

\[ x_j(T;z)-x_j(0;z)=b\quad(0\le j<9) \quad\Longrightarrow\quad h_T(z):=X_0(\Phi_T(z))-X_0(z)=b . \tag{30} \]

Strict in-rail and scalar admission conditions may restrict U, but must leave it open in the full leaf for this theorem to apply. The continuous law itself has no hard form rails or runtime grammar/history coordinates. Same-law pressure refresh, grammar and lifecycle completion remain separate from this necessary form condition. No aggregate AL inheritance is assumed.

docs.title: Analytic flow and the equilibrium obstruction
docs.text:
The field is linear in form and a finite sum of sines of affine phase differences. It is real analytic on the entire lifted state. Its real derivative is globally bounded: the actual support has maximum degree five, so both L and the sine-current Jacobian have operator norm at most ten. Consequently the full field is globally Lipschitz and has a complete real flow; edge cancellation preserves (29).

For every fixed finite T, the flow is real analytic in its initial state. One justification uses the local holomorphic extension of the linear and sine rows: on a small complex neighborhood of a real orbit segment, the Picard construction converges uniformly and gives holomorphic dependence. Cover the compact real segment from zero to T by finitely many such intervals and compose their local maps. Restricting back to the real affine chart proves the claimed local analyticity at every initial state in M. This argument requires no complete complex flow and no analytic continuation in time to infinity.

The existing joined equilibrium belongs to this same leaf:

\[ x^*=0,\qquad \delta^*_{c,j}=1/40. \tag{31} \]

Internal cycle sine currents cancel pairwise, matching currents vanish, and L*x_star=0, so both complete rows vanish. In particular h_T(z_star)=0 at every fixed finite duration. The analytic realization criterion now applies to the linear observation X_0. If (30) held on any nonempty open U, analyticity and connectedness would force h_T=b everywhere on M, including (31), a contradiction. Thus the realization set has empty interior for every such (T,b).

The continuation is an identity in initial state, not a simulated path through intervening preparations. No initial member of U is assumed to reach the equilibrium; no invariance of U or of its winding chamber is required. The smooth law is defined beyond those chambers, and it is that law which extends h_T. The argument does not assert that AL is admissible or executed outside U, including at the equilibrium. A constant positive clock rescaling only changes the quantified duration; it cannot remove the contradiction when both evolution rows transform together.

The same criterion's countable sampling corollary also excludes choosing the completion time from any prescribed countable schedule, such as the multiples of one sampling interval, for the same fixed gain on an open leaf domain. Every fixed-time equality set is closed with empty interior; their countable union cannot cover that domain. The selector may depend arbitrarily on the initial state. This concerns observing the unchanged continuous flow at selected times, not a native step that intervenes with hybrid operators, adaptation or other distinct laws. It does not exclude continuously state-dependent stopping times or approximate matches.

docs.title: Boundaries that permit different realization questions
docs.text:
The actual acquired-source family retains at most 80 independent original preparation directions, not an open 88-dimensional leaf domain. The theorem therefore does not extend the preceding default-gain exclusion to every smaller gain on that family. It also does not classify which isolated or lower-dimensional state sets can meet a fixed endpoint.

The following auxiliary countermodels clarify the hypotheses; none is a new TNFR law, source or installed operator mechanism:

Changed hypothesis Exact comparison Constrained domain The analytic oscillator u_dot=v, v_dot=-u has quarter-period map (u,v)->(v,-u). On the line v=u+b, its u increment is b; this line has no interior in the two-dimensional state space. Smoothness without analyticity Put r(s)=exp(-1/s) for s>0 and zero otherwise, and sigma(s)=r(s)/(r(s)+r(1-s)). The smooth field x_dot=b*sigma(x) has an equilibrium at zero and equals b on x>=1. At fixed duration one it translates every x in (2,3) by b. Its flat transition prevents real analyticity. State-dependent duration The analytic field x_dot=x has an equilibrium at zero, but for x>0, T(x)=log(1+b/x)>0 gives x(T(x))=x+b. That is a stopping map, not one fixed-duration flow map. Zero increment A full-period oscillator map is the identity, compatible with an open domain and an equilibrium; the criterion requires b!=0.

Even in the actual conserved leaf, a hypothetical nine-target form increase with an equal opposite change at the nine donor slots preserves total form. Thus conservation alone would not exclude the requested increment. It is the analytic fixed-duration realization that fails.

The static map controls check the complete leaf chart and compensated target, then the stated countermodels with a fixed rational gain and closed-form maps. They reuse the existing equilibrium/law owners and block native execution, numerical flows and frozen producers. Finite algebraic checks are not a numerical proof of the analytic identity theorem. No new runtime API or boolean registry substitutes for the proof above.

State-dependent stopping, restricted actuator preparation, nonanalytic observation and approximate realization remain distinct questions. Each requires its own state, clock, admission and occurrence argument. This result does not choose among them or change the declared canonical event semantics. In particular it does not imply that interacting NFRs cannot have reusable behavior under other justified realization contracts.

docs.title: 11. Regular stopping cannot realize Emission on an open leaf domain
docs.text: Conditional theorem. The unchanged law (1) cannot realize a regular near-identity Emission (AL) family on any nonempty relatively open subset of the complete conserved leaf (29), even when its duration depends on the initial state and gain. Preserving the nine target phases imposes nine independent form constraints before a duration can be chosen. The exact first-order compatibility locus is nonempty, but membership alone does not realize the operator: the explicit state below fails at second order.

docs.title: Ideal primary action and complete comparison
docs.text:
Retain all 90 fine coordinates, the same 90 unit edges, held unit capacities, quarter factor, positive gamma and clock tau. Let P select child zero's nine coordinates. For every z in the proposed domain and all sufficiently small positive gains b, the endpoint requirements are

\[ P[x(T(z,b);z)-x]=b\mathbf1_9,\qquad P[\theta(T(z,b);z)-\theta]=0, \quad T(z,0)=0,\quad T(z,b)>0. \tag{32} \]

Require C1 dependence on gain at zero, with a finite derivative. Circular phase equality is equivalent to the displayed lifted equality locally: continuity and T->0 exclude a nonzero 2*pi turn. The domain may impose strict in-rail conditions but must remain open in the full 88-dimensional leaf. Donor and all other endpoints may react freely. Pressure is refreshed by the same law at the endpoint, not held equal to the pre-event value.

These are necessary primary-channel conditions for the ideal nonclipped Emission map. The formal b=0 identity is not a zero-gain AL invocation. The implementation admits positive represented gains and materializes bounded floating-point proposals; arbitrarily small exact increments are not a claim about binary64 execution. Grammar, history, activation metadata and lifecycle completion have separate obligations. Capacities are already held by this comparison law; no auxiliary controller or phase clamp is added.

docs.title: Exact first-order locus and open-domain obstruction
docs.text:
Write a(z)=partial_b T(z,0). The regular stopping criterion gives a>0 and, using both actual rows,

\[ a\,P[-Lx+\gamma S(\theta)]/4=\mathbf1_9, \qquad a\gamma\,PLx/4=0 . \tag{33} \]

Consequently the exact first-order compatibility locus is

\[ \mathcal C=\{(x,\delta)\in\mathcal M: PLx=0,\quad PS(\psi+\delta)=s\mathbf1_9 \text{ for some }s>0\},\qquad a=\frac4{\gamma s}. \tag{34} \]

Conversely, every point in this locus supplies the displayed positive a and satisfies (33). This equivalence concerns first-order equations only, not existence of a stopping family satisfying (32). It retains individual target currents, not merely their average. No global independence or codimension is claimed for the nonlinear current-equality constraints. Intersect this algebraic locus with the declared strict in-rail domain when comparing an admitted Emission action.

The nine linear form constraints are independent even after enforcing zero total form. Let e_i be the fine coordinate vectors and put

\[ v_j=e_{9+j}-e_{27+j},\qquad PLv_j=-e_j \quad(0\le j<9). \tag{35} \]

Each v_j has zero sum. Child zero is linked to child one at the matching slot and has no link to child three; its internal edges meet neither coordinate in v_j. This proves (35) directly from the actual support. Thus PL has rank nine on the 44-dimensional zero-sum form space; its kernel has dimension 35. Including the 44 phase-offset directions gives a proper 79-dimensional affine constraint set inside the 88-dimensional leaf. The locus (34) lies within it and has no relatively open full-leaf domain. This proves the obstruction without a trajectory, source-bound estimate or equilibrium argument.

The previously acquired family has at most 80 original preparation directions; neither dimension count identifies its nonlinear image or which of its members satisfy (34). This gate does not replace those preparations by a convenient constrained state.

docs.title: A tangent-admitted state still fails to preserve phase
docs.text:
Consider the following exact static comparison state on the same leaf:

\[ x=0,\qquad \delta_{c,j}=0\ (c<4),\qquad \delta_{4,j}=1/8. \tag{36} \]

It is a supplied carrier state, not the earlier acquired source or a new formation result. Put q=sin(1/8)>0, and let w be one at the nine target slots, minus one at the nine donor slots and zero elsewhere. Internal cycle currents cancel and only the donor interface contributes, so

\[ S=q w,\qquad PS=q\mathbf1_9,\qquad PLw=4\mathbf1_9. \tag{37} \]

The target form velocity is gamma*q/4 and every phase velocity is zero. This admits the unique tangent duration derivative a=4/(gamma*q). However, differentiating the complete phase row gives

\[ P\theta''(0)=\frac\gamma{16}PL[-Lx+\gamma S] =\frac{\gamma^2q}{4}\mathbf1_9>0. \tag{38} \]

For any regular candidate duration with that derivative, the local phase displacement is therefore

\[ P[\theta(T(z,b);z)-\theta] =\frac{2}{q}b^2\mathbf1_9+o(b^2), \tag{39} \]

which contradicts (32) for sufficiently small positive gains. No second gain derivative of T was assumed: T=a*b+o(b) suffices. More generally, any exact candidate in (34) must also satisfy PL[-Lx+gamma*S]=0; that additional constraint has not been classified as a sufficient condition. The uniform carrier makes the target form rates equal, but does not supply an independent means of holding their phases.

docs.title: Evidence and remaining scope
docs.text:
The static stopping controls use the shared complete-state port observer and exact support multiplication to check the rank witness, currents and nonzero phase acceleration. They also retain a regular auxiliary stopping success and a singular boundary: x'=x, phi'=0 permits T=log(1+b/x) on x>0; the analytic system x'=2v, v'=1, phi'=0, from x=v=0, permits T=sqrt(b) while the hidden coordinate reacts. The latter has no finite derivative at zero. Neither auxiliary field is installed as a TNFR law. Frozen producers, native calls and numerical flow evaluation remain blocked in these controls.

The result closes the stated regular open-domain gate and rejects one explicit constrained candidate beyond first order. It does not classify all constrained preparations, singular durations, isolated finite-gain hits, long excursions or approximate maps. In particular it preserves the source's earlier interaction and collective-identity results. The failure belongs to this exact primary-action realization under this supplied complete law; it neither changes canonical Emission semantics nor excludes other justified TNFR laws. Solving an endpoint equation would still supply no occurrence rule, grammatical admission or physical identification.

docs.title: 12. Local classification of phase-stationary carrier motion
docs.text: Conditional theorem. Near the joined equilibrium, every trajectory of the exact carrier law (8) that keeps child zero's phase constant on a time interval belongs to the two-dimensional antisymmetric family defined below. Its target form is also constant at zero. Other children can move, but that motion cannot realize a positive Emission (AL) increment at child zero. This classifies the nearby constrained states, rather than testing further isolated candidates from the first-order locus (34).

docs.title: Fixed leaf and an exact invariant family
docs.text:
Keep the actual five-child graph, both rows (8), held unit capacities, gamma=1/(1023*pi) and clock tau. The ten carrier coordinates lie on

\[ \sum_cX_c=0,\qquad \sum_c\Phi_c=1/8,\qquad m=1/40. \tag{40} \]

This is an eight-dimensional affine leaf. Every point lifts to the fine state x[c,j]=X_c, theta[c,j]=psi[j]+Phi_c; its invariance was proved in Section 3. The independently acquired fine source is not projected onto this family. The equilibrium is X=0, Phi=m*1_5.

Consider the embedded two-dimensional family

\[ X=(0,u,-u,0,0),\qquad \Phi=(m,m+a,m-a,m,m). \tag{41} \]

On the actual support, KX=(0,2u,-2u,0,0) and s(Phi)=(0,-2*sin(a),2*sin(a),0,0). Substitution into both rows gives

\[ u'=-\tfrac12[u+\gamma\sin a],\qquad a'=\tfrac\gamma2u . \tag{42} \]

All remaining coordinates in (41) have zero derivative, proving invariance by uniqueness. In particular X0=0 and Phi0=m at every time, although u or a can change. This is internal motion under the supplied law, not formation of a new organization or a selected operator occurrence.

The same cancellation is visible in the inherited storage (10). After subtracting its constant internal-cycle value,

\[ H_{10}-45(1-\cos\alpha)=18u^2+36(1-\cos a),\qquad H_{10}'=-18u^2. \tag{43} \]

Thus the fixed target can coexist with changing, dissipative internal state. The state and net rows of child zero do not observe this motion; its individually marked interfaces to children one and two generally do. Their opposing currents cancel in the net row. This is not invisibility to a complete boundary observation or a closed target-only state model.

docs.title: Finite rank certificate at the equilibrium
docs.text:
Let f be the actual analytic carrier field on (40), h=Phi0, and freeze the six-output map

\[ G=(L_fh,L_f^2h,\ldots,L_f^6h),\qquad L_fg=Dg\,f. \tag{44} \]

At the equilibrium z_star, f=0. With A=Df(z_star) and c=dh, induction gives d(L_f^j h)(z_star)=c*A^j: the differentiated higher-order terms multiply f(z_star) and vanish. Thus the Jacobian of the nonlinear map (44) can be computed from the linearization, without substituting a linear law for the nonlinear trajectory or expanding a nonlinear Lie tower.

Use symmetric coordinates (X0,Xs,X3,Y0,Ys,Y3), where Xs=(X1+X2)/2, Yc=Phi_c-m, Ys=(Y1+Y2)/2, and antisymmetric coordinates u=(X1-X2)/2, a=(Y1-Y2)/2. The totals determine X4=-X0-2*Xs-X3 and Y4=-Y0-2*Ys-Y3. At equilibrium the symmetric block is

\[ B=\begin{pmatrix}4&0&1\\-1&2&-1\\0&-2&2\end{pmatrix},\qquad A_s=\frac14\begin{pmatrix}-B&-\gamma B\\\gamma B&0\end{pmatrix}, \qquad c_s=(0,0,0,1,0,0). \tag{45} \]

The matrix B is the actual K restricted to the sum-zero symmetric subspace. The two antisymmetric columns of DG vanish because (41) has constant output. Direct polynomial elimination of the six symmetric rows gives the exact determinant

\[ \det\begin{pmatrix}c_sA_s\\c_sA_s^2\\\vdots\\c_sA_s^6\end{pmatrix} =\frac{16000\gamma^{15}}{4^{21}}P(\gamma^2),\qquad P(\eta)=4489\eta^3-2453\eta^2+435\eta-25. \tag{46} \]

Here 21=1+...+6 retains the quarter factor in every row. As an independent coordinate check, eliminating child four in the first-four-child chart and choosing columns (X0,X1,X3,Y0,Y1,Y3) gives the same polynomial with prefactor 4000 instead of 16000; the symmetric chart doubles two columns. This is exact algebra, not a numerical singular-value threshold.

For the actual parameter, 0<gamma<1/3000, hence 0<eta<10^-6. Dropping the negative quadratic term bounds

\[ P(\eta)<-25+435\,10^{-6}+4489\,10^{-18}<-24. \tag{47} \]

The determinant is therefore nonzero. The six-output Jacobian has rank six on the eight-dimensional leaf, with precisely the two antisymmetric directions in its kernel. The small determinant does not indicate a zero rank, and no claim is made for arbitrary substituted parameters or for numerically stable recovery from noisy phase derivatives.

docs.title: Nonlinear local classification and realization consequence
docs.text:
Write the leaf coordinates as (y,u,a), with y the six symmetric coordinates in (45). The invariant family (41) is exactly y=0, and G(0,u,a)=0 for all its states. By (46), D_yG is invertible at the equilibrium. The implicit-function theorem supplies a neighborhood in which the zero set is a unique graph y=chi(u,a). The known solutions y=0 force chi=0. Thus, in some open neighborhood U of the equilibrium,

\[ G(z)=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad z\text{ belongs to (41)}. \tag{48} \]

An interval of constant target phase makes all six derivatives vanish at its initial state. For an initial state in U, (48) therefore puts the whole trajectory on the invariant family, with target form identically zero. Conversely every member of that family has constant target phase. This proves the stated local classification for the nonlinear law. The neighborhood is existential; no quantitative radius or inclusion of the earlier prepared-source bounds has been certified.

There is also a small-time endpoint consequence beyond differentiable stopping. At a fixed initial state in U, the target phase is analytic in time. If distinct positive durations tending to zero preserve that phase, its difference from the initial phase has accumulating zeros and vanishes on an interval. Circular equality reduces to equality of the continuous lift near time zero. Equation (48) again forces the target form to remain zero. Consequently no positive-gain Emission family with completion times tending to zero is possible there, even with singular gain dependence. A single finite phase return, distant initial states and arbitrary fine perturbations are outside this local conclusion.

docs.title: Static verification and scientific boundary
docs.text:
The carrier persistence controls derive the matrices from the actual support, verify the exact symbolic family and determinant, and compare fine and collective observer rows with independent fixed controls. They keep the two antisymmetric kernel directions, the sign-certified polynomial and all clock factors. The proof of a neighborhood comes from the implicit-function theorem, not from sampled states, numerical rank or a simulated trajectory.

The complete law and registered Emission semantics are unchanged. The result identifies a persistent cancellation mechanism and excludes a specific primary action locally on the carrier; it does not derive an event selector, a grammar word, a universal TNFR restriction or a physical particle. docs.text: Conditional result. docs.title: Frozen preparation and observation
docs.text:
The comparison retains all 45 nodes, 90 unit edges, held unit capacities, quarter mobility, gamma=1/(1023*pi) and structural clock tau. There are no inputs, events or support changes. Both initial forms are zero. With m=1/40, epsilon=1/100 and v=(1,-1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0), set a_j=epsilon*v_j. The control has every offset equal to m; the second state has

\[ \delta_{1,j}=m+a_j,\qquad\delta_{2,j}=m-a_j,\qquad \delta_{c,j}=m\quad(c=0,3,4),\qquad x=0. \tag{49} \]

These are supplied static states, not the previously acquired source. The zero sum of v preserves every child offset mean and the full totals sum x=0, sum delta=9/8. The lifted internal cycle increments are alpha, or alpha +/- (a_(j+1)-a_j), where alpha=2*pi/9 and indices are cyclic. Their perturbations have magnitude at most 2/100, so all increments lie strictly in (0,pi/2) and sum to 2*pi on each child. Every initial winding is therefore one. Matching-edge gaps have magnitude at most 1/100. Initial admission supplies no finite retention interval or inclusion in the image of an acquired preparation.

The observations are the nine target forms and primitive phases, their net rows, the slot-zero-minus-slot-one contrasts and the child means. At the target, the child-one and child-two matching sine currents are sin(a_j) and -sin(a_j), and all internal currents cancel. Thus the target current is zero, as in the control. Since all forms are zero, every phase velocity is zero as well. The target state and both net rows match exactly. Its change and the initial offset contrast are zero.

docs.title: Differentiating both actual rows
docs.text:
For any admitted fine state of this fixed model, write q=Lx, J(theta)=DS(theta). Differentiation, with primes in tau, gives

\[ q'=Lx',\qquad S'_i=\sum_{k\sim i}\cos(\theta_k-\theta_i) (\theta'_k-\theta'_i),\qquad x''=(-q'+\gamma S')/4,\quad\theta''=\gamma q'/4. \tag{50} \]

The source reacts through these same rows. In (49), theta'=0, so S'=0, x'=gamma*S/4 and

\[ x''=-\gamma LS/16,\qquad\theta''=\gamma^2LS/16. \tag{51} \]

Define d_j=a_(j+1)-a_j and r_j=cos(d_j)-cos(d_(j-1)). The matching currents of children one and two cancel in their sum. Their internal currents instead satisfy the exact identity

\[ S_{1,j}+S_{2,j}=2\sin\alpha\,r_j. \tag{52} \]

For example, their forward contributions sum to sin(alpha+d_j)+sin(alpha-d_j)=2*sin(alpha)*cos(d_j); the backward contributions subtract the same expression at j-1. Since target and donor currents vanish initially, the target component of LS is the negative of (52). Consequently

\[ x''_{0,j}=\frac{\gamma\sin\alpha}{8}r_j, \qquad\theta''_{0,j}=-\frac{\gamma^2\sin\alpha}{8}r_j. \tag{53} \]

This term is the even-in-profile part of the actual sine interaction on the nonzero winding background. It introduces no additional force, pressure law or event. Its cyclic sum vanishes, explaining why the mean readout misses this fine response through second order.

For the frozen profile, every child's mean also agrees with equilibrium through that order: internal currents telescope, sum_j sin(a_j)=0, and the means of LS are K times the means of S. This stronger all-child statement uses the particular opposed two-slot values, not merely a zero arithmetic mean for an arbitrary internal profile.

For the frozen profile, let D=cos(epsilon)-cos(2*epsilon)>0 and E=1-cos(epsilon)>0. Direct substitution gives

\[ r=(-D,D,E,0,0,0,0,0,-E),\qquad (x_{0,0}-x_{0,1})''=-\frac{\gamma\sin\alpha}{4}D<0, \quad(\theta_{0,0}-\theta_{0,1})''= \frac{\gamma^2\sin\alpha}{4}D>0. \tag{54} \]

Taylor's theorem therefore gives a negative form contrast and a positive change in primitive phase contrast at sufficiently small positive times; their leading coefficients are one half the accelerations in (54). This is a local existence-of-separation result. No numerical duration, finite reading margin, observed trajectory or sustained response is certified. The derivative budget ends at order two; zero mean derivatives alone do not prove all-time constancy. The separate symmetry proof in section 14 supplies that result for this preparation and its declared reflection sector.

There is a broader algebraic boundary within the same opposed-profile, zero-form class. If every cyclic increment has abs(d_j)<pi, vanishing of all target accelerations in (53) implies that all cos(d_j) are equal. Cosine is injective in abs(d_j) on this domain, so all magnitudes equal one value d. The nine signed increments sum to zero. An odd number of terms each equal to +d or -d cannot have zero sum unless d=0. Thus only a spatially constant opposed profile cancels all nine target accelerations in this class. This corollary uses the same second-derivative identity; it is not a new preparation scan or a classification of arbitrary nonzero-form fine states.

docs.title: Why the actual tangent does not predict this response
docs.text:
At the joined equilibrium, the fine phase stiffness is

\[ H=K\otimes I_9+\cos\alpha\,I_5\otimes L_{C9},\qquad A=\frac14\begin{pmatrix}-L&-\gamma H\\\gamma L&0\end{pmatrix}. \tag{55} \]

The internal cosine factor is essential: H is not the bare support Laplacian L. Let b=(0,1,-1,0,0); then Kb=2*b. Both L and H preserve the fine subspace b tensor R^9. The initial perturbation in (49) belongs to that subspace in phase and is zero in form. The complete linearized evolution therefore stays in the same subspace in both channels, and its target components vanish for every time. This is an exact invariant-subspace argument, not a finite sample of a linear solver. It does not exclude the nonlinear term (52), which is quadratic to leading order in profile amplitude and has nonzero target acceleration.

docs.text:
The source-port owner provides _observe_organized_source_acceleration(form=..., phase_offsets=...). docs.title: 14. An exact nonlinear state with constant child means
docs.text: Conditional representation. The signed-reflection sector containing (49) admits forty independent real coordinates that reconstruct both complete nonlinear rows. docs.title: Declared real lifts and the exact symmetry
docs.text:
Let r(j)=(1-j) mod 9, with pairs (0,1),(2,8),(3,7),(4,6) and fixed slot 5. Let P reflect every child by r, psi_j=alpha*(j-4) and eta=delta-m. The selected sector is

\[ x=-Px,\qquad \eta=-P\eta,\qquad \theta=\psi+m\mathbf1+\eta. \tag{56} \]

In particular, x_(c,5)=eta_(c,5)=0. This is a sector of the declared continuous real offsets, not a choice of wrapped representatives on every circular phase orbit. Define b_j=1 at slots zero and one, and zero at the other seven slots. Direct substitution gives

\[ \psi_j+\psi_{r(j)}=2\alpha-2\pi b_j,\qquad \widetilde\theta_{c,j}=2m+2\alpha-\theta_{c,r(j)}-2\pi b_j. \tag{57} \]

The affine reflection of primitive phase therefore has common circular origin m+alpha, with two nonzero lift branches. Omitting these full turns would give a false real-lift identity. Equation (57) is exactly tilde delta=2m-P delta; since b_r(j)=b_j, it is an involution. The circular fixed-point equation also allows an antipodal choice at slot five; (56) selects the component and lifts used here.

The actual support consists of internal cycles and matching slots, so P is its weighted automorphism and LP=PL. Sine is odd and ignores integer turns. Hence

\[ L(-Px)=-PLx,\qquad S(\widetilde\theta)=-P S(\theta). \tag{58} \]

Both rows, including theta'=gamma*Lx/4, are equivariant under the same affine map. The field is globally Lipschitz on the finite-dimensional real lift: its form dependence is linear and its sine derivatives are bounded. Existence and uniqueness of the complete flow therefore preserve the fixed set (56) for every time. This transfers the signed-reflection proof method after rebuilding this support and lift; no coefficient, source enclosure or maintenance certificate from that different model is transferred.

docs.title: Reconstruction and both reduced rows
docs.text:
For one child use representatives (0,2,3,4) and define

\[ E_9q=(q_0,-q_0,q_1,q_2,q_3,0,-q_3,-q_2,-q_1)^T, \qquad E=I_5\otimes E_9,\qquad x=Eu,\quad\delta=m\mathbf1+Ea. \tag{59} \]

Here u,a each have twenty coordinates, ordered by child then representative. Let R select those representatives. Then RE=I_20, E^T E=2I_20, and ER is identity on the odd subspace. Restriction of phase coordinates first subtracts m. Lift and restriction are inverse on (56); restriction outside that sector is undefined. Averaging an arbitrary fine state into this chart would discard information and is not this operation.

With the actual five-child Laplacian K from section 3, edge incidence gives

\[ A_r=RLE=K\otimes I_4+I_5\otimes B,\qquad B=\begin{pmatrix}3&1&0&0\\1&2&-1&0\\0&-1&2&-1\\0&0&-1&2\end{pmatrix}, \qquad LE=EA_r. \tag{60} \]

For a child's four phase deviations, its internal current on the representatives is

\[ J(a_c)=\begin{pmatrix} \sin(\alpha-2a_{c,0})-\sin(\alpha+a_{c,0}+a_{c,1})\\ \sin(\alpha+a_{c,2}-a_{c,1})-\sin(\alpha+a_{c,0}+a_{c,1})\\ \sin(\alpha+a_{c,3}-a_{c,2})-\sin(\alpha+a_{c,2}-a_{c,1})\\ \sin(\alpha-a_{c,3})-\sin(\alpha+a_{c,3}-a_{c,2}) \end{pmatrix}. \tag{61} \]

Add sum_(d~c) sin(a_(d,k)-a_(c,k)) at every representative k, using exactly the child matching edges, to obtain j(a). Equations (58) and (61) give S(psi+m+Ea)=E j(a), including the zero fixed-slot current. Consequently the autonomous reduced law is exactly

\[ u'=\frac{-A_ru+\gamma j(a)}4,\qquad a'=\frac{\gamma A_ru}4. \tag{62} \]

Lifting (62) reconstructs every fine form and phase row, not just the selected representatives. This is a nonlinear intertwining on the whole sector, not a tangent reduction or a finite trajectory fit. Both rows retain the factors 1023/1024 for original time and 2/gamma^2 for slow time. The positive off-diagonal entries and nonzero row sums of B also matter: these twenty signed coordinates are not twenty ordinary NFR nodes with an ordinary positive-conductance graph Laplacian.

docs.title: Storage, means and the retained response
docs.text:
Let W(a) be the original ninety-edge cosine potential evaluated at (59). The inherited storage and balance are

\[ H_r(u,a)=u^TA_ru+W(a),\qquad \nabla_a W=-2j(a),\qquad H_r'=-\frac12\|A_ru\|^2. \tag{63} \]

The factor two follows from E^T E=2I, and (63) equals the original -||Lx||^2/4 exactly. It introduces neither a new reservoir nor an event passivity premise. The cosine potential and all marked interfaces remain those of the fine state.

Every column of E_9 sums to zero, and the winding background psi has mean zero. Invariance of (56) therefore proves all five child form means zero and all five lifted phase and offset means m for all time. The frozen profile (49) is represented by a_(1,0)=epsilon, a_(2,0)=-epsilon, with every other coordinate and every form zero. Its locally nonzero target contrasts (54) thus coexist with exactly constant means. docs.text:
The existing source-port owner provides _lift_organized_source_reflection, _restrict_organized_source_reflection and _observe_organized_source_reflection. This is a sufficient state on a declared symmetry sector, not a minimum dimension theorem or a projection of the acquired-source family. docs.title: 15. Reception on the retained reflection state
Fixed event question and numerical boundary
docs.text:

docs.title: Ideal primary action, same-law refresh and event work
docs.text:
Let beta be the resolved mixing fraction interpreted as a real number, with the runtime admission 0 < beta <= 1. An ideal evaluation of that coefficient is distinct from the successive rounded runtime operations. Write q=Lx and e=e_0-e_1. Each target has five bare neighbors, including the other target, so its unclipped change from the common snapshot is -beta*q_i/5. In the reflection sector q_1=-q_0; hence

\[ x^+=x+d e,\qquad d=-\frac{\beta q_0}{5},\qquad \delta^+=\delta. \tag{64} \]

Only reduced form coordinate u_(0,0) changes. The reflected neighbor sets have equal size, and a common mix and symmetric hard clipping are odd under form sign reversal. Thus the primary action preserves the sector whenever both targets are independently admitted. Inputs inside [-1,1] give convex proposals inside those rails, so clipping is inactive on the domain of (64). This argument does not prove universal strict-pressure or grammar admission, nor symmetry of arbitrary kind/source/history records. Those records are retained as contextual state, not compressed into the forty physical coordinates.

For any actual form endpoints with phase, support and capacity held, let z=x^+-x. The unchanged sine current gives

\[ q^+=q+Lz,\qquad p_\tau^+-p_\tau=-\frac14Lz,\qquad \theta_\tau^{\prime+}-\theta_\tau'= \frac\gamma4Lz. \tag{65} \]

Here p_tau=(-q+gamma*S)/4 is the specified pressure law; at unit capacity it equals the form row. This is fresh constitutive pressure in the declared clock, not the stored field retained by the EN jump. Both rows change. In particular, the unchanged-pressure result of the separate conservative Reception model does not transfer to this diffusive form law. Untargeted neighbors can change both rates without any form or phase jump of their own. Rate differences transform by the first-order clock factors from section 14; the event itself has no inferred duration.

The exact storage jump, independently of how the endpoints were obtained, is

\[ \Delta H=q^Tz+\frac12 z^TLz. \tag{66} \]

The phase potential cancels because the same lift is retained. For this pair, e^T L e=12: the shared edge contributes the cross term missing from a sum of two isolated-target calculations. Inserting (64) yields

\[ \Delta H=2q_0d+6d^2 =-\frac{2\beta}{5}\left(1-\frac{3\beta}{5}\right)q_0^2 \leq0. \tag{67} \]

It is strictly negative when q_0 is nonzero. This theorem applies to the admitted, unclipped, unit-weight pair, rather than arbitrary weighted Reception or out-of-rail states. The jump account is separate from the continuous loss H'=-||Lx||^2/4; no dissipated quantity is assigned to an undeclared event reservoir.

For the frozen forms, set h=1/64 and r=1-6*beta/5. The atomic ideal endpoint is (r*h,-r*h). The corresponding ideal serial zero-then-one endpoint is instead

\[ (x_0^+,x_1^+)_{\rm serial} =\left(rh,-rh-\frac{6\beta^2h}{25}\right). \tag{68} \]

The nonzero pair sum leaves the exact sector; its child-zero form mean is -2*beta^2*h/75. This is a different read schedule, not a different Reception formula. Fine-state continuation remains defined outside the sector, while a strict chart restriction must reject it. Neither schedule has a universal form-total conservation contract.

Equations (56), (64) and (67) also give a conditional hybrid composition result without another response experiment: any finite sequence of such independently admitted ideal atomic stages interleaved with this exact continuous flow preserves the physical reflection sector. If every event's inputs remain inside the rails, storage is nonincreasing across events and along the flows. Stage times, grammar, consumed metadata and any future admission remain explicit premises. docs.text:
