Both actual endpoints agree with their respective ideal formulas within the declared conservative 1e-17 absolute allowance. The fixed normal-range operations admit a roundoff budget below 5*2^-53/64 < 1e-17, including propagation of the first serial error; the allowance is not fitted to the evaluated discrepancy. This is a finite represented control, not universal floating-point equivariance. All represented forms are re-admitted before endpoint work or fresh rates are calculated.

The serial public control has the predicted negative pair sum and fails the exact chart check. The full fine observer still admits it. Its actual work is also negative in this control; storage decrease alone therefore does not imply preservation of the reflection sector. Both controls retain the declared phases, capacities, support and structural time. The immediate phase windings are unchanged at Reception; later retention is a separate flow question.

The stage records both ordered five-neighbor inputs, their actual means, unchanged common kinds and empty tracked-source records. Each target's history advances from AL -> IL to AL -> IL -> EN, with ordinal two to three, zero debt and prior coherence retained. Untargeted histories and the supplied zero stored derivatives are unchanged. The stage's sealed Reception observations describe its accepted endpoint; they do not certify future stability. Built-in metrics read the old stored pressure before the explicit callback writes fresh projected pressure. The serial second call instead consumes the pressure refreshed after its first event. Second-target form, pressure and grammar rejections restore the complete atomic graph-owned state. A rejected second public call leaves its already accepted first event in place; separate calls are not one transaction.

The shared source-port owner now supplies _observe_organized_source_form_jump(form_before=..., form_after=..., phase_offsets=...). It admits all primitive endpoint vectors before any fine-law observation, rebuilds both states, and retains the exact form displacement, gradient change and storage jump (66). Correlated rate differences use the unchanged sine current in (65), with both channels in all three clocks. This avoids subtracting independent phase-current bounds for a quantity that cancels exactly. The same calculation accepts a serial endpoint outside the reflection sector; it does not silently project it.

The helper takes one declared held phase lift and the fixed support and unit-capacity model. It does not authenticate an event or inspect a graph. An execution consumer must first verify those held-field premises and the represented-phase association, as the fixed control does. Stored pressure, operator names, cached bounds and grammar labels cannot replace these checks. No new Reception implementation or pressure law was introduced.

docs.title: 16. Joint winding and form-rail maintenance
docs.text: Conditional result. One explicit domain containing the section 15 preparation preserves all five winding-one cycles and the form limits needed by the ideal paired Reception action. It is invariant under the unchanged continuous law and any finite list of independently admitted ideal atomic Reception stages on (0,1). This joins the continuous and event arguments without assuming in advance that future forms stay inside the rails. The statement is about maintenance of a supplied organization; stage occurrence, full grammatical completion and formation remain separate.

docs.title: The domain is an intersection, not an energy test alone
docs.text:
Keep the exact reflection sector of section 14, the full support, held unit capacities, declared clocks and the fixed continuous phase lifts. Let A be the acute cell of the same-support boundary proof: every internal angle is alpha+delta_(c,j+1)-delta_(c,j), including the fixed closing-edge turn, and every matching angle is the corresponding offset difference. All ninety angles must lie strictly in (-pi/2,pi/2). The internal sums then remain 2*pi, so each marked cycle has winding one. Define

\[ H_*=45(1-\cos\alpha),\qquad E=H-H_*,\qquad \mathcal D=\{(x,\delta)\text{ in the reflection sector and }\mathcal A: E<1/100\}. \tag{69} \]

On the closed acute cell, Jensen's inequality on each nine-edge cycle gives phase storage at least H_*. Matching storage is nonnegative. Writing F=x^T Lx/2, this proves 0<=F<=E on that cell. The full boundary bound requires E>=beta_face>6/25 at every phase face. These geometric facts use the actual ninety-edge support. They do not require replaying or importing the different acquired source from that earlier capture study.

Every part of (69) is necessary for this certificate. In particular, the winding-zero stationary state from section 14 has H-H_*<0 outside the declared acute cell. Small storage excess alone does not certify winding identity. Nor does a failed sufficient check demonstrate identity loss.

docs.title: A form bound before invoking event passivity
docs.text:
The reflection sector fixes x_(c,5)=0. Every other slot in its own C9 connects to that slot along a path of at most four unit edges. Telescoping and Cauchy's inequality give

\[ |x_{c,j}|^2 \leq4\sum_{\text{path}}(x_a-x_b)^2 \leq8F\leq8E<\frac{2}{25}<\left(\frac3{10}\right)^2. \tag{70} \]

Thus every form in D has abs(x)<3/10<1. This bound follows from the state domain, before applying Reception. All inputs to the pair's convex mixture therefore lie strictly inside the hard rails [-1,1]; its ideal proposal is unclipped. The event-work theorem (67) is now applicable without assuming the very rail retention it is meant to help establish.

docs.title: Entry of the fixed preparation
docs.text:
For h=1/64, epsilon=1/100 and the section 15 phase profile, form storage is 6*h^2. Only children one and two have nonuniform internal phase increments. Their combined excess is the even-in-profile term below; the four host matching interfaces contribute eight nonzero single-slot costs. The donor contact contributes zero at this preparation. Consequently the full initial excess is

\[ E_0=6h^2+2\cos\alpha\bigl[(1-\cos2\epsilon) +2(1-\cos\epsilon)\bigr] +8(1-\cos\epsilon). \tag{71} \]

Using 1-cos(t)<=t^2/2 and cos(alpha)<=1 gives the prospective rational bound

\[ E_0\leq6h^2+10\epsilon^2 =\frac{631}{256000}<\frac1{100}. \tag{72} \]

The preparation has the exact reflection constraints. Its internal angles lie between alpha-2*epsilon and alpha+2*epsilon, within (0,pi/2); matching gaps have magnitude at most epsilon. It therefore belongs to the intersection (69), rather than merely passing its energy inequality. All fine coordinates are retained. This is a static admission of the declared preparation, not new formation or acquired-source evidence.

docs.title: Flow, events and finite composition
docs.text:
Start in D. Sector invariance and H'=-||Lx||^2/4<=0 preserve the reflection constraints and initial excess along an exact flow segment. A first exit through an acute face would require excess above 6/25, contradicting E<1/100. Thus the phase cell remains intact, and (70) continues to bound every form.

At the next requested ideal pair-Reception stage, independent live policy and grammar admission are still required. If admitted, the already proved rails make (64) unclipped. The pair preserves reflection, holds phases and decreases or preserves storage by (67). Its successor is again in D. Induction covers any finite number of these events and intervening exact flows, followed by all future flow after the final event. In particular,

\[ \operatorname{wind}(C_9^{(c)})=1\quad(c=0,\ldots,4), \qquad |x_i|<3/10, \qquad E(\tau)\leq E(0)<1/100 \tag{73} \]

hold throughout such a continuation; the frozen preparation has E(0)=E_0 from (71). This does not assert universal acceptance of future requests: stored pressure, grammar context and source metadata are separate consumed state. Infinite or accumulating event schedules, arbitrary additional operators and changed capacity laws are outside this theorem.

After the last event, the same-law convergence argument also applies: the trapped sublevel is compact on the fixed-mean leaf, the acute phase storage is strictly convex there, and the largest invariant zero-loss set is x=0, delta=m. Thus the remaining exact flow converges to that target while retaining all five windings. Persistent winding identity does not mean persistent nonzero motion. This supplies no finite settling time and does not extend convergence to an infinite event schedule.

For a represented event, the ideal theorem alone is insufficient. Its actual successor requires verification of the unchanged phase-lift, support and capacity association with this model. Given that association, it can re-enter the argument after checking exact sector preservation and nonpositive actual work, or by directly re-admitting that successor to D. Raw-vector admission alone cannot authenticate the runtime graph. Section 15 supplies those checks for its one frozen atomic control. No further runtime event is executed or inferred here, and the serial control has no exact-sector certificate.

docs.title: Shared admission and meaningful unavailable outcomes
docs.text:
The capture owner provides _assess_organized_source_reflection_retention(form=..., phase_offsets=...). It first normalizes the raw vectors and applies the strict reflection restriction. Invalid primitives and off-sector states reject. It then rebuilds the source-free boundary and full fine storage, checks every fixed-branch angle and compares the full excess upper bound with the frozen 1/100 ceiling. No incoming report, cached certificate, attachment producer or acquisition calculation replaces those premises.

An admitted report carries conditional winding and form bounds. A valid sector state outside the acute cell or above the sufficient ceiling gives unavailable, retains its calculated evidence and supplies explicit unmet conditions; its future winding and form bounds remain absent. A small negative lower interval endpoint near equilibrium is ordinary enclosure dependency and does not imply negative physical excess inside the cell. The domain test uses the upper bound without silently clipping its evidence.

The independent controls derive the entry cost, actual grounded paths, Cauchy bound and ideal pair work. They also distinguish low storage outside the acute cell, excessive form storage inside it, and states outside the exact reflected lift. They invoke neither numerical flow nor another runtime event. The claim is a conditional maintained organization under a specified hybrid model, not physical identification, an autonomous controller or a completed NFR occurrence law.

docs.title: 17. Transferring maintenance through a capacity change
docs.text: Conditional specialization of established exchange geometry. The reciprocal form/phase balance already covers a common diagonal mobility in both rows, including form dissipation. The common exchange family also distinguishes that balance from selection of a unique constitutive law. The task here is to transfer section 16's particular reflected maintenance domain to changed capacities on its actual support, not to rediscover the form/phase relation. The sine coefficients and quarter normalization remain those of this owner; native pressure and degree-normalized comparison coefficients cannot replace them.

docs.title: Complete continuation and the supplied phase premise
docs.text:
Silence (SHA) preserves form, phase, stored pressure and support at its primary jump, while attenuating capacity. Keep this model's independent pressure p_tau=(-q+gamma*S)/4, with q=Lx on the ninety unit edges. Write D=diag(nu) for the normalized capacities held during a continuous segment. The selected pair reset has nu_0=nu_1=kappa, other capacities one, and 0<kappa<1; one is the no-reset baseline and zero is a separate boundary considered below. The form row must now be

\[ x_\tau=Dp_\tau=\tfrac14D[-q+\gamma S(\theta)]. \tag{74} \]

This is the same declared pressure map, not pressure reconstructed from the response. It contains no capacity-contrast channel. Native pressure generally does contain such a channel: after this local reset it need not vanish and is even under the reflection, unlike q and S. Substituting that different pressure would change both the model and its symmetry argument.

Keeping the old phase row theta_tau=gamma*q/4 is a possible complete law, but its storage derivative is

\[ H_\tau=-\tfrac14q^TDq+\tfrac\gamma4S^T(D-I)q. \tag{75} \]

In contrast, the established reciprocal continuation specializes to

\[ x_\tau=\tfrac14D[-q+\gamma S],\qquad \theta_\tau=\tfrac\gamma4Dq,\qquad \nu_\tau=0, \qquad H_\tau=-\tfrac14q^TDq\leq0. \tag{76} \]

The block cancellation proof in the linked exchange owner applies with mobility K=D/4, e=beta=1 and a=b=gamma. This is substitution into its algebra, not identification of the actual unequal degrees with four. All rows use the declared tau clock; original-time rates multiply by 1023/1024 and slow-time rates by 2/gamma^2. A local capacity change is not a common reparameterization of time.

Equation (76) supplies the phase premise explicitly. Neither the nodal product nor the Silence label uniquely imposes it. For example, a phase row gamma*Dq/4+R changes the balance by -S^T R; exact preservation of the same loss only constrains S^T R=0. Regularity, symmetries, retained coordinates and event compatibility impose further independent obligations. This freedom does not invalidate the earlier conditional exchange results.

docs.title: Why an unchanged phase row cannot inherit the loss theorem
docs.text:
The failure of automatic cancellation in (75) has a witness inside the maintained domain, rather than merely outside its hypotheses. Let v=e_0-e_1, delta=m*1+epsilon*v, x=h*v. Define

\[ A(\epsilon)=\sin(\alpha+\epsilon) -\sin(\alpha-2\epsilon)+3\sin\epsilon. \]

The actual support gives q_0=6h, q_1=-6h, S_0=-A, S_1=A and q^TDq=(72*kappa+8)*h^2. Thus (75) becomes

\[ H_\tau=-(18\kappa+2)h^2 +3\gamma(1-\kappa)hA(\epsilon). \tag{77} \]

For any fixed 0<kappa<1, sufficiently small positive h makes this positive whenever A is positive. The static control fixes, before evaluation, epsilon=1/100, h=1/10^7, kappa=1/2. On these angles cos>1/2 and sin(epsilon)>epsilon/2, so A>3*epsilon; also gamma>1/4000. Consequently

\[ H_\tau>\frac9{800000}h-11h^2>0. \tag{78} \]

Both vectors satisfy the exact reflection constraints. Internal angles are alpha, alpha-2*epsilon or alpha+epsilon, and matching gaps are zero or +/-epsilon, all acute. At the target, grad V=0 and Hess V<=L, since every cosine weight is at most one. Along this phase segment Taylor's integral identity therefore gives V-V_*<=epsilon^2*v^TLv/2=6*epsilon^2. The entry excess obeys E<=6*h^2+6*epsilon^2<1/100. This is an admitted small-state failure of nonpositive storage rate for the unchanged phase row. It does not prove eventual winding loss or absence of some other maintenance certificate. Under (76), the same state instead has H_tau=-11*h^2.

docs.title: What transfers, and the zero-capacity boundary
docs.text:
The pair capacity matrix commutes with the reflection P. Section 14's odd q and S therefore stay odd after multiplication by D: both versions of the phase row preserve the exact sector, although only (76) has the established nonpositive storage balance. For (76), the same geometric phase-face barrier and grounded-path form bound apply without alteration. The intersection D_domain in (69) is invariant, all five windings remain one and every form stays below 3/10 in absolute value. No source acquisition or new trajectory is needed for this transfer.

A capacity-only jump has Delta H=0, because H depends on form, phase and support, which are held at this event. It also leaves the domain's entry state unchanged. This statement requires those actual held-field associations; a runtime label or latent-form record does not establish them.

For fixed strictly positive kappa, q^TDq>=kappa*||q||^2. The compact trapped sector and strict acute phase convexity from section 16 then give the same limiting target x=0, delta=m. No uniform convergence rate as kappa tends to zero is asserted. Generic fine states have different conserved leaves: during each fixed positive-capacity segment of (76),

\[ \mathbf1^TD^{-1}x=\text{constant},\qquad \mathbf1^TD^{-1}\delta=\text{constant}. \tag{79} \]

These are raw weighted sums of continuous offsets, not circular means or the old sum-of-child-means normalization. A capacity jump changes their weights and can change their values without changing form or phase. On the reflected sector, every ordinary child form mean remains zero and offset mean remains m directly by symmetry; no inverse-capacity argument is needed for that fact.

At kappa=0, (76) is still a regular finite-dimensional law with nonpositive storage rate. The reflection, winding and form-rail certificate survive. The targeted form and phase-offset coordinates are then frozen. For a nonzero targeted form, convergence to the previous zero-form target is impossible; the positive-capacity convergence theorem cannot transfer. Inverse-capacity totals are unavailable. With the other phase premise, zero capacity freezes only the unforced form row. Freezing phase is a property of (76), not a consequence of the nodal product alone.

docs.title: Shared observations and the execution boundary
docs.text:
The source-port owner adds _observe_organized_source_capacity(form=..., phase_offsets=..., capacities=..., phase_mobility=...). The required phase selector is shared_capacity for (76) or unit_capacity for (75). All primitive vectors and nonnegative capacities are admitted before fine observation. Fresh currents, pressure, both rows, all clocks and the storage cross term are rebuilt; zero capacities are not divided out. The nested unit_capacity_reference retains its explicit original-law meaning and must not be read as the new continuation's rates or conserved totals.

The capture owner adds _assess_organized_source_shared_capacity_retention(form=..., phase_offsets=..., pair_capacity=...). It reuses the raw reflected domain check and rebuilds the actual common-capacity rows. The pair value is admitted in [0,1]; the selected law is explicit in the function's name. Valid states outside the sufficient domain remain unavailable. At zero, an available retention certificate does not populate target convergence. Neither reader authenticates a runtime graph or installs a law.

The independent controls check both balances, the fixed counterexample, actual edge currents, weighted versus ordinary totals, clock changes, strict admission and the zero-capacity boundary. They execute no Silence event, grammatical suffix, continuous trajectory or frozen producer. The declared EN -> IL -> SHA suffix remains unperformed: this capacity-law admission neither bypasses Coherence nor supplies its phase work or live grammatical context.

docs.title: 18. Coherence preserves the ideal domain but fails default pair admission
docs.text: Two distinct conclusions. The ideal common-snapshot Coherence (IL) phase map preserves the entire reflected domain (69), for every common phase-locking coefficient in [0,1]. This specializes the existing local-resultant method and simultaneous shared-edge work identity to the present degree-five pair. However, the current strict default form policy cannot admit both reflected targets. The mathematical jump theorem therefore does not execute the pending word step or authorize bypassing its live guard.

docs.title: Actual phase map and a whole-domain local bound
docs.text:
For targets zero and one, use the same immutable pre-event state and define their relative, bare-neighbor resultants

\[ z_i=\sum_{j\sim i}e^{i(\theta_j-\theta_i)},\qquad R_i=|z_i|,\qquad a_i=\operatorname{Arg}z_i, \qquad d_i=\lambda a_i,\quad0\leq\lambda\leq1. \tag{80} \]

The ideal event holds forms, capacities and support, contracts each target's stored pressure by the independently resolved IL factor, and adds d_i to its continuous phase lift. Its stored circular representative may wrap. The public/staged phase map is different from the pressure-only low-level glyph. The ordinary phase coefficient is read from the shared kernel's DEFAULT_PHASE_LOCKING_COEFFICIENT, whose represented value is 0.3; the proof covers its whole admitted interval.

Let u_e=delta_b-delta_a on an oriented edge. For an internal edge, the target angle is alpha and the actual fixed-branch angle is alpha+u. Concavity of cosine throughout the acute interval gives the integral Taylor bound

\[ \begin{split} B_\alpha(u) &=\cos\alpha-\cos(\alpha+u)-\sin\alpha\,u\\ &=u^2\int_0^1(1-s)\cos(\alpha+su)\,ds \geq\frac{\cos\alpha}{3}u^2\geq\frac14u^2. \end{split} \tag{81} \]

Here cos(alpha)>3/4; the last bound also holds at u=0. Indeed the concavity chord bounds the integrand cosine below by (1-s)*cos(alpha)+s*cos(alpha+u), with the endpoint cosine nonnegative. For matching edges the same argument starts at zero and gives 1-cos(u)>=u^2/3. Internal linear terms cancel on every marked cycle. Since form storage is nonnegative, every state in (69) satisfies

\[ \sum_{e\in E}u_e^2\leq4(H-H_*)<\frac1{25}. \tag{82} \]

At the target, either node has two cycle neighbors and three matching neighbors, so z_*=3+2*cos(alpha)>9/2. The elementary phasor difference bound and Cauchy's inequality now give, for either actual five-neighbor set,

\[ |z_i-z_*|\leq\sum_{j\sim i}|\delta_j-\delta_i| \leq\sqrt5\left(\sum_{j\sim i}|\delta_j-\delta_i|^2\right)^{1/2} <\frac{\sqrt5}{5}<\frac12. \tag{83} \]

Consequently Re(z_i)>4, R_i>4 and abs(a_i)<atan(1/8)<1/8. The local argument is unique and excludes zero-resultant fallbacks. These constants have been re-derived on the actual ninety-edge support; the earlier degree-seven contact bounds were not imported. Global phase resultants need not define an angle here.

docs.title: Reflection, joint work and the jump path
docs.text:
The reflected neighbor sets and the primitive-phase turn relation (57) give z_1=conjugate(z_0). On the regular local branch this implies a_1=-a_0, and hence d_1=-d_0. Adding the two opposite increments preserves the exact lifted reflection sector and every child offset mean. It does not supply a symmetry theorem for arbitrary represented atan2, modulo or addition operations.

Reuse the established two-target identity with Delta=theta_1-theta_0:

\[ \begin{split} G_i&=R_i[\cos a_i-\cos((1-\lambda)a_i)],\\ C_{01}&=\cos(\Delta-d_0)+\cos(\Delta+d_1) -\cos\Delta-\cos(\Delta+d_1-d_0),\\ \Delta H&=G_0+G_1+C_{01}. \tag{84} \end{split} \]

The shared edge must occur once in the actual work. Its correction has abs(C_01)<=abs(d_0*d_1)<=(d_0^2+d_1^2)/2 and need not be negative. With R_i>4, abs(a_i)<1/8 and sin(s)>=3*s/4 on [0,1/8], the same integral argument as in the linked owner yields, for 0<lambda<=1,

\[ G_i\leq-\frac32\left(\frac2\lambda-1\right)d_i^2, \qquad \Delta H\leq-\left(\frac3\lambda-2\right)(d_0^2+d_1^2) \leq0. \tag{85} \]

Nonzero displacement gives strict decrease; lambda=0 gives an identity phase map. Neither case eliminates stored-pressure or contextual changes.

Endpoint nonincrease alone would not exclude a jump across an acute face. Consider the comparison path theta(s)=theta+s*d, 0<=s<=1. Every prefix is the same snapshot formula with coefficient s*lambda. Thus (85) bounds its storage without assuming that the path remains in the acute cell. A first boundary crossing would require excess above 6/25, in contradiction to the initial excess below 1/100. The whole path and endpoint therefore remain in (69), retaining all five windings and the form rails. The path is a proof device for the event, not a finite-duration pressure law or an executed numerical trajectory.

docs.title: Fresh rates and the frozen prefix
docs.text:
Coherence holds x, capacity and support, so q is unchanged. At unit capacity its complete-law handoff has

\[ \Delta p_\tau=\Delta x_\tau=\frac\gamma4\Delta S, \qquad\Delta\theta_\tau=0. \tag{86} \]

Every touched edge contributes to Delta S, including the shared target edge and the untargeted neighbors. Both clock conversions apply to the rate jumps. The contracted stored pressure is distinct from this fresh constitutive pressure; contracting a stored value does not change its declared law.

In the frozen section 15 profile, the opposed child-one and child-two phase deviations cancel each target's imaginary resultant; the cycle contributions cancel as well. Therefore a_0=a_1=0 and ideal IL makes no phase jump, even after Reception changes the forms. On this special profile fresh pressure returns to its old constitutive value after any stored-pressure contraction. The whole-domain proof above has nontrivial content beyond that quiet profile. The previously fixed local phase profile from section 17 supplies its nonzero-displacement control, with no new preparation search or trajectory.

docs.title: A strict-default admission obstruction
docs.text:
The strict IL validator requires EPI > min_epi and nu_f > min_vf. The threshold owner explicitly classifies these as selected policies and sets EPI_IL_MIN=0. For the reflected pair,

\[ x_0=-x_1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \neg(x_0>0\ \text{and}\ x_1>0). \tag{87} \]

The zero pair fails both strict inequalities. Thus no state in this reflection sector admits both targets under the current strict default form gate. In particular, the actual accepted Reception endpoint does not admit the pending paired IL step, despite its mathematical phase map being defined and domain-preserving. This is a live-policy obstruction, not a failure of grammar syntax, storage geometry, the nodal identity or numerical integration. No IL or SHA stage is executed here.

Negative EPI is valid signed form. Failure of this configured positive threshold does not show that a negative target has no structure. Changing the threshold, taking absolute values, adding a common form offset, disabling strict checks or invoking only the pressure glyph would change the admitted task. None is used to turn (87) into a successful execution. The policy's foundational justification and any general migration require their own contract assessment, preserving existing callers and evidence.

docs.title: Shared conditional assessment
docs.text:
The capture owner provides _assess_organized_source_reflection_coherence(form=..., phase_offsets=..., phase_locking_coefficient=...). It admits the coefficient and raw state, rebuilds (69), and calculates local resultants, joint work and both fresh rate changes. Invalid primitives and off-sector inputs reject; valid states outside the sufficient domain give unavailable endpoint and retention conclusions.

The ideal endpoint generally has transcendental offsets. Their outward intervals feed the shared admitted-edge algebra directly; interval midpoints are not converted into fictitious exact endpoints. The proved reflection relation preserves the correlation between the two phase increments. A conditional work upper bound of zero is distinct from a rounded interval enclosure that may straddle zero at a quiet profile. The assessment installs no law and asserts no live grammar or policy admission. Actual represented execution would require its own held-field, phase-lift association and successor checks.

The independent controls cover the actual resultants, shared-edge correction, whole endpoint work, all affected currents and clocks, the quiet and nontrivial profiles, invalid admission and the strict-default pair obstruction. They execute no operator stage, source producer or continuous flow. The result admits the ideal primary map while retaining the actual obstacle to completing the pending EN -> IL -> SHA word.

docs.title: 19. Represented Coherence handoff under explicit event-domain admission
Frozen preparation and separate observations
docs.text:
The general activity contract admits the signed targets through explicit event_domain without changing the event map or the default-policy rejection in section 18. This gate uses the frozen protocol. It declares one new atomic Reception prerequisite on the fixed section 15 input, then two atomic Coherence responses: one on that actual EN output and one on the previously fixed section 17 nontrivial phase control. The older Reception test producer is not invoked. Its original source, serial control and evaluated conclusions remain separate.

Both IL stages target (0,1) on the same ordered ninety-edge support, with unit capacities, the registered default pressure retention and represented phase coefficient 0.3. The complete declared word is EN -> IL -> SHA, with IL at index one. Initial AL -> IL history is supplied for the EN preparation; the other control supplies AL -> IL -> EN history at its two targets. Such supplied history is admission context, not evidence of those events. No Silence, serial alternative, flow step, acquired-source reconstruction, coefficient search or autonomous selector is part of this protocol.

The exact ideal offsets and runtime angles are distinct inputs. Initial angles are the specified binary64 rendering of alpha*(j-4)+delta_(c,j). For the runtime state, interpret every stored angle as its represented rational value on the mathematical circle of period 2*pi. The post-IL continuous lift uses turn minus one at the two targets and zero elsewhere; its nearest-lift admission is independently checked rather than inferred from the operator label.

The new shared _observe_organized_source_phase_state(form=..., phases=...) reader in the port owner re-admits all raw coordinates and reuses the admitted edge algebra with zero carrier offset. It computes the same declared full law directly from sin(theta_j-theta_i), not from offsets reconstructed with approximate pi. It shares form costs, row assembly and clock conversion with the ideal-offset reader. Thus stored-pressure contraction and the later raw-phase constitutive refresh remain separate observations. The callback records the contracted pressure before one refresh; metrics preceding that callback do not become fresh constitutive readings.

docs.title: Prospective error and scope boundaries
docs.text:
The immutable protocol fixes initial rendering error epsilon=2^-48, actual input phase-reset error b=2^-46, exact-source endpoint comparison B=2^-45 and pressure materialization error b in tau units. The existing bound_phase_reset rebuilds each relative resultant from the actual rational input angles with outward interval arithmetic. Its strict nearest-lift test and error criterion remain independent of grammar and future stability. An 80-decimal-digit oracle checks the finite interval calculations separately.

These budgets precede response evaluation. If every initial angle differs from its declared ideal lift by at most epsilon, each relative resultant differs by at most 10*epsilon. Since section 18 gives ideal magnitude above four, its argument changes by at most 10*epsilon/(4-10*epsilon) < 3*epsilon. With the declared coefficient below one third, initial-angle and ideal-reset errors contribute less than 2*epsilon; adding b stays below B. This comparison does not assume the represented input has exact reflected phase relations.

The nine touched edges are counted once. Their target incidences total ten and their untargeted incidences eight. The cosine Lipschitz bound therefore gives source-to-runtime work discrepancy at most 10*B+26*epsilon: eighteen initial incidences and eight held endpoint incidences consume epsilon. Relative to the ideal reset of the actual input, the work budget is 10*b. The moving control must have strictly negative represented work; the quiet control receives only an absolute error bound, never automatic nonincrease. Immediate winding/acute-cell membership, storage excess below 1/100, held fields, histories, and both fresh rows in all three clocks have their own checks.

An error bound is not exact reflection. Already before IL, two rational runtime angles cannot sum modulo 2*pi to the exact reflected value 1/20+4*pi/9 required for the first pair. The earlier EN result retained a separately declared ideal lift because EN held its rendering unchanged. After IL, bounded agreement with a new ideal endpoint does not identify the literal represented state with that endpoint. Neither averaging increments nor subtracting a binary64 alpha repairs this distinction. Exact reflected future maintenance remains unavailable without its own state association; an immediate geometric certificate is a different conclusion.

docs.title: Retained response and interpretation
docs.text:
The source receipt binds the complete current source tree, instrument and protocol to the source archive. The exclusive attempt retains ideal predictions before the three declared events. The response records their primitive before/after states and the pre-refresh callback boundary. These byte associations are not independent chronology or provenance authentication. No earlier producer was replayed or overwritten.

Both atomic IL stages passed the frozen reset, lift, work and immediate domain criteria. The table gives rounded displays of retained outward intervals, not replacement acceptance bounds:

Observation Actual Reception handoff Supplied moving control Maximum reset defect against the ideal map of the actual input 2.257e-16 4.305e-16 Maximum endpoint discrepancy against the separate exact source 1.971e-16 5.119e-16 Joint IL storage work approximately +4.096e-33 approximately -3.070111795e-4 Endpoint storage excess above H* approximately 0.001598573 approximately 0.000223437

All ninety fixed-branch angles remain acute, the five cycle windings remain one, total form is exactly zero and the form rails hold. The EN prerequisite retains two no-emission-source telemetry advisories: supplied history does not authenticate preceding Emission events or source selection. The quiet work enclosure is strictly positive at the represented endpoint. It satisfies the declared absolute comparison budget; it is not a finite nonincrease result. This closes the represented reset and immediate-domain question. docs.title: 20. Continuous maintenance from raw phase state without reflection
Fixed model and exact lift admission
docs.text:
This conditional theorem extends maintenance to the full zero-total-form leaf of the unchanged ninety-edge, unit-capacity model. It starts from primitive state, not an ideal reflected state associated within a tolerance. The support, the quarter factor in both rows, gamma, clocks and absence of later inputs or events remain the premises of section 1. In particular, pressure is freshly defined by the complete constitutive law; the binary64 stored-pressure snapshot is not assumed to satisfy that law exactly.

Let r_i be the finite raw phase coordinate and k_i its explicitly supplied integer turn. Retain the exact affine-in-pi lift and its mean:

\[ \Theta_i=r_i+2\pi k_i,\qquad \mu=\frac{\sum_i r_i+2\pi\sum_i k_i}{45}. \]

No rational offset is reconstructed by subtracting an approximate carrier angle. For every oriented actual edge a -> b, use

\[ a_e=(r_b-r_a)+2\pi(k_b-k_a+c_e), \qquad c_e=\begin{cases}1&\text{on each internal closing edge }8\to0,\\ 0&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases} \]

Cancel the integer differences before interval evaluation. Each marked cycle then has exact sum 2*pi. If all ninety angles are strictly acute, these are its principal edge differences and its winding is one. The connected fixed-branch cell is convex. The future solution uses the initial lift continuously; it does not select new integer turns at later snapshots. Its equilibrium has Theta_(c,j)=psi_j+mu, where psi_j=(2*pi/9)*(j-4) and the carrier sum over all nodes is zero.

The admitted domain is

\[ \mathcal D_0=\{(x,\Theta):\ \mathbf1^Tx=0,\quad |a_e|<\pi/2\ \text{for every edge},\quad E=H-H_*<1/100\}. \]

It imposes no childwise form mean, fixed reflection origin or antisymmetry. Finite scalars and exact zero total form are necessary domain admissions. Wrong local turns can leave the acute cell even when sine currents and physical storage are unchanged. Small storage alone cannot replace the fixed-branch check: the winding-zero equilibrium has negative excess relative to this different winding-one reference.

docs.title: Barrier, form rails and all-future winding
docs.text:
On the closed acute cell, the existing cycle Jensen inequality gives F=x^T Lx/2 <= E. The actual full-graph spectral bound (24), which includes all fine modes, therefore yields

\[ \|x\|_2^2\le\frac{2F}{4/15}\le\frac{15}{2}E <\frac3{40}<\left(\frac3{10}\right)^2. \]

This derives abs(x_i)<3/10<1 without a reflection-fixed zero slot. The zero-total premise is essential for this estimate: a common nonzero form is invisible to Lx and can have arbitrarily large magnitude at the same form-storage cost. No centering or projection silently removes it.

Edge cancellation in both complete rows conserves sum x and sum Theta. The inherited identity H_tau=-||Lx||^2/4 makes E nonincreasing. Every acute-cell face requires E>=beta_face>6/25, by the same full-support boundary proof. A first exit from a state in D_0 would contradict the strict separation E<=E_initial<1/100<beta_face. Global existence follows from the finite dimensional globally Lipschitz complete vector field. Thus the solution remains in D_0 for all future tau, all five marked windings remain one, and every form remains within the stated rails.

This is a domain theorem, not a verdict inferred by sampling a trajectory. Positive rescalings to original time t and slow time s preserve the conclusion while transforming both rows and the storage rate together. The reported form bound is sufficient and deliberately not claimed sharp.

docs.title: Full-state asymptotic limit and its scope
docs.text:
The conserved phase mean is the actual mu above, rather than 1/40 supplied by the earlier ideal reflection chart. Connected support and bounded fixed-branch edge differences bound all phase coordinates at fixed mean. The form estimate and strict boundary separation make the trapped sublevel compact. Its phase Hessian is a connected graph Laplacian with weights cos(a_e)>0, positive definite on the fixed-mean tangent space. Hence the phase potential is strictly convex there, and psi+mu is its unique stationary point: internal currents cancel and matching currents vanish.

In the zero-loss set, Lx=0 and the zero total imply x=0. The phase row then vanishes, and invariance of this set further requires S(Theta)=0. The largest invariant subset is the single equilibrium on this mean leaf. The existing compact-sublevel argument therefore gives

\[ x_i(\tau)\longrightarrow0,\qquad \Theta_{c,j}(\tau)\longrightarrow\psi_j+\mu. \]

No finite settling time or permanent nonzero motion follows. Individual child means may vary. This convergence and winding retention concern the ideal continuous complete law starting from the represented endpoint; they do not certify native time stepping or numerical error for future times. Nor do they derive source formation, autonomous event selection or physical identification.

Arbitrary later Reception stages do not inherit the earlier reflected hybrid theorem. Outside that sector a pair can change total form by -beta*(q_0+q_1)/5, where beta is its mixing factor and q=Lx. Silence changes capacity and therefore requires a separately declared complete continuation law and its own admission. Neither event follows merely because its predecessor belongs to D_0.

docs.title: Shared certificate and retained-endpoint result
docs.text:
The capture owner provides _assess_organized_source_raw_retention(form=..., phases=..., phase_turns=...). The independent controls derive a positive rational LDL certificate for L-(4/15)I on the entire 44-dimensional zero-sum fine space, including its nonorthonormal basis metric. docs.title: 21. Silence suffix and positive-capacity continuation
Weighted-leaf transfer of the existing reciprocal law
docs.text:
Silence (SHA) changes capacity at its jump. Continue with the explicit shared_capacity law (76), the same ninety unit edges and no later input or event. This is the phase premise already studied in section 17, now applied to raw phases without an exact reflection assumption. It is not selected by the nodal identity or by the name of the closing operator.

For positive held capacities write D=diag(nu), w_i=1/nu_i, and retain the raw lift Theta_i=r_i+2*pi*k_i from section 20. The independent pressure and complete rows are

\[ p_\tau=\tfrac14[-Lx+\gamma S(\Theta)],\qquad x_\tau=Dp_\tau,\qquad \Theta_\tau=\tfrac\gamma4DLx,\qquad \nu_\tau=0. \]

In this particular pressure law, changing capacity leaves p unchanged while changing both rates. A callback storing the new form rate as pressure would multiply by capacity again at the next nodal step. Pressure must be evaluated from its independent formula, never reconstructed from that step.

The existing exchange cancellation and edge sums give

\[ H_\tau=-\tfrac14(Lx)^TD(Lx),\qquad (w^Tx)_\tau=0,\qquad (w^T\Theta)_\tau=0. \]

Ordinary totals need not remain constant after a nonuniform reset. Require w^T x=0 explicitly, every fixed-branch angle acute, and E=H-H_*<1/100. The same phase barrier proves all-future acute-cell and winding retention. For the form bound, put y=x-mean(x)*1 and rho=nu_max/nu_min=w_max/w_min. Weighted centering and the full spectral gap (24) imply

\[ w_{\min}\|x\|_2^2\le\sum_iw_i x_i^2 =\min_c\sum_iw_i(x_i-c)^2 \le\sum_iw_i y_i^2\le w_{\max}\|y\|_2^2, \qquad \|x\|_2^2\le\rho\,\frac{15}{2}F\le\rho\,\frac{15}{2}E <\rho\,\frac3{40}. \]

Here F=x^T Lx/2=y^T Ly/2. This bounds the full form, not just its centered component. Geometric maintenance does not depend on the bound being less than one; an explicit unit-rail claim does. A capacity ratio whose sufficient bound fails that rail test is not evidence of actual exit.

The phase origin of the limiting carrier is

\[ c_D=\frac{\sum_iw_i(\Theta_i-\psi_i)}{\sum_iw_i},\qquad \psi_i=\frac{2\pi}{9}(i\bmod9-4). \]

Subtract the carrier before taking this weighted mean: sum(w_i*psi_i) need not be zero. Preserve its exact affine-in-pi numerator sum(w_i*r_i) + pi*(2*sum(w_i*k_i) - (2/9)*sum(w_i*(i%9-4))). A capacity jump can change c_D even though no phase moves at that instant.

Positive held capacity makes the zero-loss set Lx=0. The weighted-zero form leaf then forces x=0. Connected acute geometry and the fixed weighted phase total make the trapped sublevel compact. The phase Hessian is positive on the weighted-mean tangent space. At a constrained critical point, S=c*w; its zero ordinary sum implies c=0, since sum(w)>0. The unique stationary carrier translate is therefore psi+c_D. The same invariance argument yields x->0 and Theta->psi+c_D. No uniform settling rate as capacity approaches zero, or future numerical trajectory, is certified.

Zero capacity is a separate boundary and cannot enter these inverse-capacity totals. The existing observer still admits its finite complete rows. The unit_capacity phase alternative retains the cross term (75); it cannot borrow this theorem merely because the nodal form row agrees. Both complete rows and storage rates transform under all three declared clocks.

docs.title: 22. A complete word on an open form-and-phase domain
Arbitrary conserved form means
docs.text:
Reception (EN), Coherence (IL) and Silence (SHA) need not preserve the zero-weighted-form condition used in section 21. That condition therefore cannot define a neighborhood allowing independent form perturbations. For the same positive held-capacity reciprocal continuation, retain instead

\[ m_D=\frac{\sum_i w_i x_i}{\sum_i w_i},\qquad z=x-m_D\mathbf1, \qquad w_i=1/\nu_i. \]

The edge sums still give m_D'=0. Centering is a proof coordinate, not a replacement for the supplied state: the observer continues to consume raw x. Since Lz=Lx and sum(w*z)=0, the weighted least-squares and spectral argument from section 21 yields

\[ \|z\|_2^2\le\frac{2\rho}{\lambda_2}F \le\frac{2\rho}{\lambda_2}E(0),\qquad |x_i(t)|\le |m_D|+\sqrt{\frac{2\rho}{\lambda_2}E(0)}. \]

An outward upper bound on initial excess can replace E(0). The strict acute-cell energy ceiling still guarantees geometric retention. A separate mean-plus-radius test is needed to certify unit form rails; failure of this sufficient bound does not prove an exit. On the invariant zero-loss set, Lx=0 gives x=m_D*1. Invariance then requires LDS=0, so S=c*w; the ordinary sum of S is zero, hence c=0. The previous compactness and strict-convexity argument gives

\[ x(t)\longrightarrow m_D\mathbf1,\qquad \Theta(t)\longrightarrow\psi+c_D\mathbf1 . \]

The phase origin c_D retains the weighted carrier subtraction from section 21. The additive _assess_organized_source_weighted_mean_retention reader implements this domain; the older weighted-zero reader keeps its original rejection contract and serialized results.

docs.title: Fixed execution context and the open domain
docs.text:

\[ |x_i-x_i^0|<r,\qquad |\Theta_i-\theta_i^0|<r,\qquad r=10^{-5}. \]

This is an open subset of ninety real coordinates. All nodes have the same nonempty organized-source kind and supplied AL, IL history, ordinal two, zero debt and prior Coherence. docs.title: Compositional bounds from primitive state
docs.text:
The detached _assess_organized_source_word_domain reader reconstructs the exact primary-map center. Reception is the unweighted convex neighbor blend; at the targets,

\[ \bar x_i=(1-\beta)x_i^0+ \frac{\beta}{d_i}\sum_{j\sim i}x_j^0, \qquad d_i=5. \]

Other forms are held. With admitted Reception form defect e_x, the full successor form differs from this center by at most A=r+e_x. This includes the two-stage binary64 mean/blend error if a represented execution is being assessed; a represented matrix multiplication is not substituted for that kernel.

For Coherence, rebuild the relative center resultant Z_i^0=sum_j exp(i*(theta_j^0-theta_i^0)). An independent input phase perturbation changes it by at most 2*d_i*r. Require M_i=Re(Z_i^0)-2*d_i*r>0. Every segment between the center and perturbed resultant remains in that right half-plane; integrating the derivative of Arg therefore gives

\[ |\operatorname{Arg}Z_i-\operatorname{Arg}Z_i^0| \le\frac{2d_i r}{M_i},\qquad B=\max_{i\in\{0,1\}}\left(r+\lambda\frac{2d_i r}{M_i}\right)+e_\theta . \]

The center phase after IL is its initial lift plus lambda*Arg(Z_i^0) at each target. B bounds all final lifted-phase deviations, including an admitted IL lift/reset defect e_theta. Untargeted phases retain their input deviation r. SHA holds form and phase; its unit input capacities make the represented output exactly kappa,kappa,1,...,1.

Let W=sum_edges weight=90 and V_x=sum_edges weight*abs(bar_x_j-bar_x_i). The exact quadratic form storage and the global Lipschitz constant one of cosine imply

\[ E_{\rm successor}\le \bar E+2A V_x+2A^2W+2BW=:E_{\max}. \]

Here the interval center excess bar E is rebuilt from primitive forms and phases and the exact primary maps. It is not a cached historical verdict. The reader also checks every initial edge angle enlarged by 2r and every final center edge angle enlarged by 2B against the acute boundary. Integer turn differences cancel before interval construction.

For the EN pressure precondition, its independent constitutive formula gives abs(p_i-p_i^0)<=d_i*(r+gamma*r)/2+e_p, where e_p bounds stored-pressure materialization. The signed upper ceiling is checked with that bound; pressure is never recovered by dividing a measured form rate by capacity. IL's finite pressure contraction and each subsequent refresh are separate runtime obligations; they do not alter the geometric estimates above.

Finally, with the exact center weighted mean bar m_D,

\[ |m_D|\le|\bar m_D|+A,\qquad |x_i(t)|\le|\bar m_D|+A+ \sqrt{\frac{2E_{\max}}{\kappa\lambda_2}},\qquad \lambda_2\ge4/15. \]

All these are joint sufficient bounds on the whole box. They do not infer entry by intersecting unrelated marginal state budgets.

docs.text:
At r=10^-5, the rebuilt ideal center and resultant bounds give B<0.000016620, E_max<0.004593 and an all-future absolute form bound below 0.194. Every initial and final edge remains acute, and both signed EN admission margins are strict. The whole ideal primary word is therefore admitted on this initialized domain; all five windings persist under the declared subsequent continuous law.

The same conclusions follow with the independently declared defect budgets e_x=e_theta=e_p=2^-46; the energy and rail bounds remain below the same rounded upper limits. These are conditional defect-transfer statements. The degree-five IL runtime uses ordinary platform phasor/trigonometric operations, not the certified two-neighbor branch. An independent analytic check avoids reliance on the calculated center: the original four offset deviations have amplitude a=1/100 and total edge squared difference 20*a^2. The carrier's linear potential term cancels, so their phase excess is at most 10*a^2. The ideal quiet IL center has zero phase displacement. With h=1/64, EN center form storage is at most 6*h^2=3/2048. The retained raw-center rendering error is at most epsilon=2^-48. Put eta=r+epsilon; then the looser bounds B<=2*eta+e_theta and

\[ E_{\max}\le3/2048+1/1000+360hA+180A^2+180B<7/1000 \]

\[ m_D=\frac{\beta\delta}{5(43\kappa+2)}\ne0 . \]

Independent incidence and high-precision map checks verify this control, the full box bounds and invalid-domain rejection. It exhibits a permitted asymmetric word whose eventual form differs from zero while its geometric organization remains retained.

docs.title: 23. Complete-word passivity and finite reuse
docs.text:
Reception (EN), Coherence (IL) and Silence (SHA) can be composed repeatedly on a larger ideal domain than the reflected source sector. This result uses the same ninety unit edges, targets (0,1), primitive phase law and declared clocks as sections 21–22. It neither selects these events nor changes the held inter-event capacity law. The exact primary maps, the scalar rounded capacity recurrence and a complete represented execution have separate obligations.

The detached _assess_organized_source_word_passivity re-admits every form, phase, lift turn, positive capacity and event factor. docs.title: Joint work without reflection
docs.text:
Write q=Lx, beta=EN_mix and a=beta/5. Reception proposes x'=x-a*P*q, where P retains only the two target coordinates. Their principal Laplacian block is [[5,-1],[-1,5]]; both targets read the same snapshot. For Q=q_0+q_1 and R=q_0-q_1, direct expansion gives

\[ \begin{split} \Delta H_{\rm EN} &=-a(q_0^2+q_1^2) +\frac{a^2}{2}\{5(q_0^2+q_1^2)-2q_0q_1\}\\ &=-\frac a2\{(1-2a)Q^2+(1-3a)R^2\}\\ &\leq-a(1-3a)(q_0^2+q_1^2)\leq0 . \end{split} \]

This holds for every admitted 0<beta<=1, without symmetry or a mean constraint. Replacing beta by s*beta gives the same sign for each reset prefix, 0<=s<=1. The phase is held, and the convex Reception map also preserves the instantaneous form extrema. The two loss modes must remain distinct when budgeting subsequent mean drift.

The local-resultant proof (81)–(83) also does not require reflection. On each marked cycle the linear term cancels around the cycle; matching edges have zero carrier gap. Consequently the unrestricted acute excess still implies sum(u_e^2)<=4E<1/25, Re(z_i)>4 and abs(Arg(z_i))<1/8 at both targets. Only the separate claim z_1=conjugate(z_0) in section 18 needed reflection.

Let a_i=Arg(z_i) independently and d_i=lambda*a_i, with 0<=lambda<=1. Keep both actual increments and the shared-edge correction in (84). The same isolated-work and mixed-edge bounds yield

\[ \Delta H_{\rm IL} \leq-\lambda(3-2\lambda)(a_0^2+a_1^2)\leq0 . \]

There is no projection to opposite increments or discarded mean phase. Lambda zero is an identity phase map; otherwise a nonzero angle gives strict decrease. Replacing lambda by s*lambda bounds every comparison prefix without assuming it stays acute. The first acute boundary would cost more than 6/25, whereas the initial excess is below 1/100. Thus the entire comparison path stays in the same cell and retains all five windings. This is an event proof, not a finite-duration flow.

Silence holds form, phase and support, so DeltaH_SHA=0. It multiplies both target capacities by the declared 0<kappa<1. Stored pressure and latency metadata have their own event contracts; they are not terms in H. Between complete words, the declared reciprocal continuation gives H_tau=-q^T D q/4<=0 with positive held D. Any finite admitted ideal composition with arbitrary finite waiting intervals therefore retains E<1/100 and the five winding identities.

This conclusion does not turn the earlier tiny positive represented Coherence work into exact nonincrease. Actual rounded words need their own stage/lift defects and cumulative work budget. The frozen responses and their verdicts are unchanged.

docs.title: A joint mean budget that survives capacity contrast
docs.text:
Geometric retention alone does not bound absolute form. For reuse, impose equal target capacities v_j=v_0*kappa^j, with all other capacities one. Let u=(x_0+x_1)/2, b=sum(x_2,...,x_44)/43 and

\[ m(v)=\frac{x_0+x_1+v\sum_{i=2}^{44}x_i}{2+43v} =c(v)u+(1-c(v))b,\qquad c(v)=\frac2{2+43v}. \]

This is the actual inverse-capacity weighted mean. It is conserved during each held-capacity flow interval, changes during Reception and Silence, and is held by Coherence. There is no centering of the raw form. Reception and Silence have the exact resets

\[ \Delta m_{\rm EN}=-\frac{aQ}{2+43v},\qquad \Delta m_{\rm SHA}=[c(\kappa v)-c(v)](u-b), \]

where the latter consumes the post-Reception form. The support diameter is seven: the C9 distance is at most four and the child-graph distance at most three. Along a shortest path, with form storage F=x^T Lx/2,

\[ |x_i-x_j|\leq\sqrt{14F}\leq\sqrt{14E_0}=B , \]

when the initial excess is bounded by E0. The phase excess is nonnegative in the retained cell. Hence abs(u-b)<=B, and every positive weighted mean lies in the form's convex hull. This bound has no inverse minimum capacity factor.

All Reception losses together are at most E0: the same storage budget pays for every passive event and continuous loss. Applying Cauchy's inequality to the exact Q-mode loss above gives, for N words,

\[ \begin{split} A_N&=\left\{\frac{2aE_0}{1-2a} \sum_{j=0}^{N-1}(2+43v_0\kappa^j)^{-2}\right\}^{1/2},\\ \sum|\Delta m_{\rm EN}|&\leq A_N,\\ \sum|\Delta m_{\rm SHA}|&\leq[c(v_N)-c(v_0)]B,\\ |x_i(t)|&\leq |m(v_0)|+A_N+[1+c(v_N)-c(v_0)]B . \end{split} \]

The c increments telescope even though the forms at successive events differ: their common range bound is B. The last line covers every intermediate stage and flow interval through word N, and all future held-capacity flow after it. It does not spend E0 independently at every stage or combine overlapping marginal budgets.

The shared _assess_organized_source_reuse_budget retains the admitted (v_0,kappa,N) that define the finite sum and computes outward rational-interval bounds. It avoids constructing that sum's large common denominator. The graph diameter is derived from shared support. The word count is an explicit finite work budget, not event admission.

For the registered default Reception factor beta, a<1/20. With v_0=1, N<=56, E_0<=1/100 and actual initial excess strictly below 1/100,

\[ A_N<1/8,\qquad B<3/8,\qquad c(v_N)-c(1)<43/45. \]

Thus abs(m(1))<1/30 suffices for abs(x_i(t))<107/120<0.9<1. This proves both unit rails and the stricter signed Reception form ceiling with margin. It includes the open source neighborhood of section 22. Its sharper evaluated finite-sum bound is available from the shared reader; the simple constants above provide an independent proof.

Fresh target pressure also remains bounded without a mean assumption. Each target has degree five, so

\[ |q_i|\leq\sqrt{10E_0},\quad |S_i|\leq5,\quad |p_{\tau,i}|\leq\frac{\sqrt{10E_0}+5\gamma}{4} <0.081<0.15 . \]

These comparisons retain the strict represented EN policy ceilings from section 22. The pressure bound applies only when the stored pre-Reception pressure is actually associated with this independent law and clock; pressure contraction by IL or stale storage is not that association.

docs.title: Finite capacity admission and contextual grammar
docs.text:
Under the present law capacity is held between events. Repetition supplies no replenishment. With initial unit targets, the registered default represented factor is exactly

\[ \kappa=\frac{518151819521135}{562949953421312}. \]

For the enabled inclusive SHA pre-call floor represented by 0.01, kappa^55 is approximately 0.010454378039190186 and kappa^56 is approximately 0.009622445068245949. Therefore 56 ideal SHA calls satisfy that gate; the next call fails it. The last accepted jump may end below the floor because admission checks the pre-state.

The separate _assess_organized_source_reuse_capacity re-admits represented initial capacity, factor and floor. It distinguishes exact products from sequential correctly rounded binary64 multiplication. The latter also permits 56 calls for these parameters, ending at approximately 0.009622445068245946. This is a scalar calculation, not 56 executed words. For other parameters rounding can change the count; underflow rejection, represented stagnation and exhausted finite budgets are explicit outcomes, not unlimited-reuse certificates.

The bound of 56 is specific to the declared factor, floor, enabled policy and held-capacity model. It is neither a universal TNFR constant nor evidence that the organization disappears at that boundary. The final positive capacity still admits the stated unforced continuation. H contains no capacity-storage term: attenuation is not expenditure of H, and zero H work of a pure capacity reset does not derive its supply. Removing the floor would not prove sustained activity as capacities tend to zero; limits for positive held capacities do not automatically transfer to a changing-capacity law with finite accumulated activity. The capacity-horizon distinction remains. Moreover, EN and IL of request 57 could execute before SHA rejects. Each stage is atomic separately; a word is not a rollback transaction.

Reuse retains section 22's supplied established-form history, prior Coherence, zero destabilizer debt, common kind, explicit IL event_domain and absent optional controllers. Core contextual grammar admits the SHA-to-EN boundary, including zero instantaneous form with nonempty established history. Its finite repeated-word check is separate from live state checks. The optional legacy preference discourages immediate EN-to-SHA; it does not forbid SHA-to-EN or EN-to-IL-to-SHA. Reception does not erase Silence's latency fields; latency is not a freezing law. Continuous phase lifts accumulate actual increments across wrapped representatives, rather than retaining invalid fixed turns.

The resulting domain supports finite ideal reuse with explicit geometry, form, pressure and capacity limits. A prescribed schedule still supplies occurrence. Renewing capacity would require an additional admitted event or continuous law and its full work, grammar and state consequences; continuous loss alone is not a replenishment reservoir.

docs.title: Conditional non-selection of the first word's time
docs.text:
The preceding bounds imply a limited occurrence statement without another trajectory or a new selector. They admit more than one timing of the same word; they do not determine its time. This is a corollary of the ideal domain, not a new empirical result or a certificate for rounded executions.

Fix one common initial state in the section 23 domain with initial unit capacities, E(0)<1/100 and abs(m(1))<1/30. Retain all ninety raw form and lifted-phase coordinates, their node/port associations, the same ninety edges, targets (0,1), factors and structural clock tau. Stored pressure is associated with the independent formula in section 21. Give both alternatives the same section 22 context: common kind, established AL, IL history, ordinal two, zero debt, prior Coherence, core grammar and explicit IL event_domain policy. Keep the same represented Reception ceilings and inclusive Silence capacity floor. No controller, custom monitor, expiry rule or additional event is present.

Waiting means the exact reciprocal flow of section 21 with capacity held. It advances tau and the continuous phase lifts, without generating glyphs or changing the supplied grammar context. Before admission, pressure is evaluated from its own law. A timestamp or a held stale pressure value does not substitute for that association. No rule in this selected EN/IL/SHA domain requires a maximum age of the supplied glyph history. This assertion does not extend to Mutation's measured temporal evidence or another action that consumes a different history.

For any two fixed finite times 0<=a<b, define two completions:

  1. Continue to tau=a, apply the three ideal maps Reception, Coherence and Silence in that order, then continue with the changed held capacities.
  2. Continue to tau=b, apply the identical word, then continue with its changed held capacities.

Each word has zero structural duration here; its three separately admitted stages remain ordered, without an intervening flow segment. It is not a single rollback transaction. Its actual context updates belong to the chosen maps. Silence's wall-clock telemetry is not the structural timing rule.

Both alternatives are admitted by the stated ideal domain. Before the first word, the unit-capacity flow preserves the mean and decreases excess, so waiting preserves geometric identity. The joint mean/form bound for one word applies to an arbitrary finite initial wait and all its reset prefixes; the independent fresh-pressure bound retains the strict Reception ceiling. Coherence uses the declared event-domain policy and the existing nonzero resultant bounds. Silence sees unit target capacities before its jump, above the inclusive floor. Waiting leaves the stipulated grammar context intact, and the admitted word supplies its successive updates. After the word the same estimates retain identity and form rails for all subsequent flow with positive held capacity. No infinite event sequence, limiting zero capacity, or renewal mechanism enters this argument.

The two full states differ at every time a<tau<b: target capacity equals

kappa = 518151819521135 / 562949953421312

in the first completion and one in the second. These are the same declared Silence multiplier and held-capacity laws used above; 0<kappa<1. Capacity is a retained state coordinate that enters both continued rows. The difference is therefore not merely a different event label or an unobserved history association. It proves that the shared continuous law, word maps, grammar admission and identity requirements do not uniquely determine occurrence, even from this fully specified common initial state.

The alternatives are different complete hybrid models, completed by their different supplied schedules. This does not establish two trajectories of one fully specified occurrence law, nor rule out an independently justified law that selects one schedule. The corollary says nothing yet about equality of later responses after both words have completed, or equality modulo a declared observation and symmetry. Ideal waiting and passivity also supply no new uniform floating-point defect certificate. The frozen represented handoffs, source archives and their verdicts remain unchanged.

docs.title: 24. Timing changes the response after both words have completed
docs.text: Conditional counterexample. Waiting before Reception (EN), Coherence (IL) and Silence (SHA) need not give the same later response as applying the word first and waiting under its successor capacity. The distinction survives common form and phase offsets and is present in both continuous rows. It holds on the ideal organized-source domain of section 23; it is not a numerical trajectory, a prescribed finite-horizon separation or a law selecting when an operator occurs.

docs.title: Fixed state, neighborhood and observation
docs.text:
Retain the 45 labeled nodes, ninety unit edges, targets (0,1), positive capacities, primitive phase lifts and structural clock tau from sections 21–23. Initially every capacity is one. The comparison uses one word, the shared default represented factors and the section 22 context: common organized-source kind, supplied AL, IL history, ordinal two, zero debt, prior Coherence, initialized core grammar, raise, hard unit rails and explicit IL event_domain policy. Retain the actual Reception ceilings and inclusive Silence floor. There is no extra controller, custom monitor, held-step nodal validator or state-mutating callback.

Write h=1/64, alpha=2*pi/9 and choose the exact primitive state

\[ x^*=h(e_0-e_1),\qquad \Theta^*_{9c+j}=\psi_j=\alpha(j-4),\quad 0\le c<5,\ 0\le j<9. \]

This is the winding-one organized carrier, not a globally constant phase. The closing-edge lift branches are those of the existing acute cell. Declare the open neighborhood, with the discrete context held fixed,

\[ U=\{(x,\Theta):\|x-x^*\|_\infty<\varepsilon, \|\Theta-\psi\|_\infty<\varepsilon\}, \qquad\varepsilon=10^{-5}. \]

The retained node/port associations are part of this comparison. Its coordinate symmetries are common form translation and common circular phase rotation, with the corresponding continuous lifts. They are used locally where admission holds; arbitrary translations need not preserve the absolute form rails. Do not rescale the structural clock or relabel ports to compare endpoints. Fix the observation

\[ \mathcal O(x,\Theta)= \bigl(x_8-x_2,\ (\Theta_8-\psi_8)-(\Theta_2-\psi_2)\bigr). \]

It removes both common offsets. The section 14 affine signed reflection also cannot remove the counterexample: the chosen state, both flows and the word remain in its fixed sector with offset origin zero.

At the center, S(psi)=0, E=6h^2=3/2048 and the form mean is zero. Each of the five cycles has its retained winding, and every marked angle is acute. The form edge differences obey sum_edges abs(Delta x*)=10h. For the whole box, quadratic expansion of form storage gives F<=6h^2+20h*epsilon+180*epsilon^2. The carrier phase is stationary: its linear phase terms telescope around each cycle and vanish on the matching edges. The second derivative of each cosine potential is at most one, so its excess is at most 180*epsilon^2. Hence

\[ E\le6h^2+20h\varepsilon+360\varepsilon^2<1/100, \qquad |m(1)|<\varepsilon<1/30. \]

Each marked edge angle differs from its carrier angle by less than 2*epsilon, retaining the acute branch. Thus U lies in section 23's larger domain. It is not the section 22 box centered on a frozen response; no historical response is needed to specify these primitives. Section 23 admits arbitrary finite initial waiting, the complete ideal word and its positive-capacity continuation with all geometric, form and fresh-pressure bounds. Silence initially sees unit capacities, above its floor. Each stage reads one common snapshot at its two targets; the stages are ordered and separately atomic, with no intervening continuous step.

docs.title: Complete local difference
docs.text:
Let L be the actual fine Laplacian, P the diagonal selector of nodes zero and one, a=beta/5, A=I-a*P*L and D=I+(kappa-1)*P. Set

\[ S_i(\Theta)=\sum_{j\sim i}\sin(\Theta_j-\Theta_i),\qquad z_i(\Theta)=\sum_{j\sim i}\exp(i(\Theta_j-\Theta_i)). \]

The complete primary word sends (x,Theta,1) to (Ax,C(Theta),D*1), where C_i(Theta)=Theta_i+lambda*Arg(z_i) on the targets and C is the identity elsewhere. On the admitted domain Re(z_i)>4, so this local lifted map is smooth. With J=DC(Theta), its actual derivative is

\[ (Jv)_i=v_i+\lambda\operatorname{Re} \frac{\sum_{j\sim i}e^{i(\Theta_j-\Theta_i)}(v_j-v_i)}{z_i(\Theta)} \quad(i=0,1),\qquad (Jv)_i=v_i\quad(i\notin\{0,1\}). \]

The two flows use the same independently defined pressure and both rows:

\[ F_D(x,\Theta)=\frac14 \begin{pmatrix}D[-Lx+\gamma S(\Theta)]\\ \gamma DLx\end{pmatrix}, \qquad\gamma=(1023\pi)^{-1}. \]

Here the flow parameter is elapsed structural time tau; capacity is held on each segment. Differentiate the two endpoints W(Phi_t(s)) and Phi_t^kappa(W(s)) at zero elapsed time. Their complete primary difference K=DW(s)F_1(s)-F_D(W(s)) is

\[ \begin{split} K_x&=\tfrac14\{(DLA-AL)x+ \gamma[A S(\Theta)-D S(C(\Theta))]\},\\ K_\Theta&=\tfrac\gamma4[J Lx-DLAx],\\ K_\nu&=0,\qquad K_{\rm clock}=0. \end{split} \]

In particular, Coherence's derivative cannot be replaced by the identity merely because its phase displacement vanishes at one state. The IL pressure retention factor b still has its specified stored-pressure event effect. Before continuation, refresh p=(-Lx+gamma*S(Theta))/4 from its independent law. It is an algebraic state association, not a freely chosen forcing or an extra pressure evolution law. If pressure is also retained as a refreshed derived coordinate, its difference is K_p=(-L*K_x+gamma*DS(C(Theta))*K_Theta)/4.

Do not center either endpoint. Its form mean is computed with its actual inverse capacities; its phase-origin mean first subtracts the carrier from the primitive lifts and uses those same weights. These are derived coordinates of the retained state, not disposable integration constants. The histories, ordinals and lifecycle records follow their separate update maps on the stipulated discrete context: both completed histories are AL, IL, EN, IL, SHA, with ordinal five. This tangent is taken on the primary continuous state; those record update maps remain separate. Silence's wall timestamp is not the structural clock.

docs.title: An exact projected coefficient
docs.text:
At the carrier put c=cos(alpha) and R=3+2c. Each target has two cycle neighbors and three matching neighbors, so z_0=z_1=R>9/2. Let L_c denote the Laplacian with cycle-edge weights c and matching-edge weights one. Although C(psi)=psi,

\[ J=I-\frac\lambda R P L_c. \]

For q=Lx*, the actual incidence gives

\[ \begin{gathered} q_0=6h,\quad q_1=-6h,\quad q_2=h,\quad q_8=-h,\\ q_9=q_{18}=q_{36}=-h,\qquad q_{10}=q_{19}=q_{37}=h, \end{gathered} \]

with all other coordinates zero. In particular P*L*q=40*x*. Write r=1-6a and T=(21+19c)/(3+2c). Then Ax*=r*x* and Jq=q-lambda*T*x*. The complete difference at this state is

\[ \begin{split} K_x&=\tfrac14[-6a q+\{40a-6r(1-\kappa)\}x^*],\\ K_\Theta&=\tfrac\gamma4[6a q+ \{6r(1-\kappa)-\lambda T\}x^*]. \end{split} \]

Both inverse-capacity form means, before and after the word at this center, are exactly zero, and both carrier-subtracted phase-origin means are zero. This does not impose a zero-mean restriction on U. The fixed observation yields

\[ D\mathcal O\,K=(3ah,-3\gamma ah),\qquad 3ah=\frac{815555754282159}{360287970189639680}>0, \]

using the shared represented default beta=271851918094053/1125899906842624. The other factors are lambda=5404319552844595/18014398509481984 and kappa=518151819521135/562949953421312; their target-row contributions were retained even though this observation eliminates them at the center.

Both flows and W are smooth locally. Their endpoints agree at t=0, and Taylor expansion therefore gives

\[ \mathcal O(W\Phi_t(s^*))-\mathcal O(\Phi_t^\kappa W(s^*)) =(3ah,-3\gamma ah)t+O(t^2). \]

The first component is strictly positive for all sufficiently small positive t. Both words have then completed, both capacities equal D and both structural clocks have advanced by the same amount. The difference is an internal contrast, not a common offset or the earlier interval's capacity mismatch. Continuity also retains a nonzero projected derivative on some neighborhood of the center inside U; no numerical size for that smaller neighborhood or time interval is asserted. The result does not claim persistent asymptotic separation or a finite observation margin.

docs.title: Detached implementation and scope
docs.text:
The private _assess_organized_source_carrier_timing reader computes the local difference at the exact carrier for admitted rational or represented form coordinates. It reuses the shared support, factor admission and rational interval arithmetic. It retains the exact form difference, the full phase difference as rational coefficients of cos(alpha), its outward enclosure, both form means and successor capacities. It does not approximate the carrier by binary64 phases or hold phases fixed during either hypothetical flow.

Independent tests rebuild the incidence, verify both rows and the nonidentity phase derivative, and exercise translation and zero-form controls, an asymmetric nonzero successor mean, invalid domains and prohibited runtime execution. No event, integrator, source producer or frozen response is evaluated. These checks support the algebraic implementation; smoothness and the admission proof above supply the local mathematical conclusion.

Thus event timing can be necessary predictive information even after the same complete word has occurred. The supplied state, continuous law and grammar do not select that timing. A quantified later response or an occurrence mechanism would need its own bounded question and premises; neither follows from this counterexample.

docs.title: Retained organized identity under sufficiently weak external contact
1. A controlled change of contact strength
docs.text:
The unit-contact problem leaves stationary stability in the original complete marked class unresolved. This result changes one supplied model parameter: all 45 external spokes have the same positive weight eta. It proves stationary existence and all-future identity retention for a declared weak-contact range, including the original acquired and observed source family. It is not a solution of the unit-weight stationary problem. An exact stationary continuation also identifies a strictly stable full-state branch and its collective fold. The larger branch interval gives local stability of that branch; the acquired-source inclusion retains its own smaller interval. Within that source interval, the full fine residuals decay exponentially and the actual collective rows approach the six-node wheel law with an explicitly bounded remainder. The original all-origin source family cannot, however, consist entirely of preparations converging to locally asymptotically stable equilibria: its retained relative-phase circle forces at least one exceptional origin for every fixed source member. At the fixed strength eta=1/100000, a separate transient estimate certifies five explicit donor-origin intervals selecting the five attractive relative registrations, while retaining every original source error and the complete observation history.

Item Declared model and scope Coordinates and graph The same 54 nodes (c,j), five host children c=0,...,4, donor c=5, and slots j=0,...,8; retain all signed forms and circular phases Old support All 99 old edges have weight one: six internal C9 cycles and nine host rim C5 cycles Changed support parameter Every same-slot host-donor spoke has weight eta>0; eta is dimensionless and distinct from the constitutive deformation parameter used elsewhere Complete law Both weighted Laplacian and weighted sine current consume the same eta. Held unit capacities, uniform quarter factors and the smooth full-circle phase domain remain supplied Clock Prime denotes the existing tau=(1023/1024)t clock; both rows transform together Means Work on the zero total form leaf and any declared conserved lifted phase mean, including the original donor origin beta Marked identity Six internal winding-one cycles, nine old rim winding-one cycles, and the original 32 independent zero mixed host periods; new spoke loops receive no prescribed winding Generic entry The initial old edges lie in their original acute fixed-branch cell and the full weighted storage is below the barrier in section 2 Source interval 0<eta<=1/100000, with all twelve original source allowances, all 96 relative directions and every supplied donor origin beta Certified source basins At fixed eta=1/100000, the five donor-origin intervals of half-width 3/5 centered at 2kpi/5 select the corresponding strict relative minima; the intervening gaps are not completely classified Events and execution The contact event changes weights/support only, with coordinates unchanged. No later forcing or event is supplied. This is a detached complete-law theorem, not native operator admission or an occurrence rule Evidence boundary Analytical inequalities and static algebraic controls; no stationary search, trajectory, source-producer replay, response fit or new physical record

Let \(E_{\rm old}\) and \(E_{\rm sp}\) denote the old edges and spokes. Define

\[ \begin{split} L_\eta&=L_{\rm old}+\eta L_{\rm sp},\\ (S_\eta)_a&=\sum_{b\sim a}w_{ab} \sin(\theta_b-\theta_a),\\ V_\eta(\theta)&=\sum_{E_{\rm old}}[1-\cos\delta_e] +\eta\sum_{E_{\rm sp}}[1-\cos\delta_e],\\ x'&=(-L_\eta x+\gamma S_\eta)/4,\qquad \theta'=\gamma L_\eta x/4,\qquad \gamma=1/(1023\pi). \end{split} \tag{1} \]

Here w=1 on old edges and w=eta on spokes. Changing only the sine term, only the form exchange or only a recorded storage cost would define a different model. Reciprocity gives the actual complete storage law

\[ H_\eta=\tfrac12x^TL_\eta x+V_\eta,\qquad H_\eta'=-\tfrac14\|L_\eta x\|_2^2,\qquad (\mathbf1^Tx)'=(\mathbf1^T\theta)'=0. \tag{2} \]

Eta is supplied contact strength, not a selected law, inferred physical constant or control inferred from dissipation. Eta=0 is a disconnected reference used in the proof; every dynamical conclusion below requires strictly positive eta.

docs.title: 2. The old marked cell retains its complete boundary barrier
docs.text:
Use the original lifted branches: internal closing edges and host rim closing edges receive their fixed 2*pi addition. Every old edge gap lies in (-pi/2,pi/2). The resulting cell preserves the complete marked class, including the zero mixed host periods, not just fifteen winding labels. Spokes are unrestricted.

Put

\[ \begin{split} V_n&=n[1-\cos(2\pi/n)],\\ b_n&=1+(n-1)[1-\cos(3\pi/(2(n-1)))],\\ V_*&=6V_9+9V_5,\qquad B=\min\{b_9-V_9,\ b_5-V_5\}>\frac7{500}. \end{split} \tag{3} \]

The strict rational lower bound is the existing cycle-face inequality. Its method applies here because the 99 old unit edges are partitioned into six C9 and nine C5 cycles. Convexity of 1-cos on the closed acute interval bounds their total phase cost below by \(V_*\).

On a positive face of an n-cycle, one angle equals pi/2 and the remaining angles sum to 3pi/2, giving \(b_n\) by Jensen. A negative internal face instead has remaining mean 5pi/16 and a larger cost. A negative rim face is empty: one angle -pi/2 and four at most pi/2 cannot sum to 2*pi. These cases cover all 198 signed old-edge faces: 54 positive and 54 negative internal faces, 45 positive rim faces and 45 empty negative rim faces. No joint attainability of separate cycle minima is assumed.

The weighted spoke potential and the full form storage are nonnegative. Consequently every actual boundary state satisfies

\[ H_\eta\ge V_*+B. \tag{4} \]

The old graph has two components. After fixing an origin in each, its closed acute cell is a bounded polytope of relative lifts. Restoring the relative host-donor origin on the circle makes its closure compact modulo common rotation. A fixed lifted mean does not require pretending that this relative origin is fixed.

Entry and retention theorem. If the initial old phases belong to this cell and \(H_\eta(0)<V_*+B\), no future old edge reaches an acute face under (1). A first exit would contradict (2)--(4).
