docs.text: This protocol evaluates the finite-transfer method on new complete-flow responses. Its preparation, clocks, sensor, numerical budget and stopping criteria are fixed before the first response. The existing held-clock records are not inputs to this evaluation. The exact-exposure theorem permits reuse of the unchanged structural-time producer; no new variable- time solver or approximate clock quadrature is introduced.

docs.title: F1-F2: shared preparation and three declared histories
docs.text:
Use the public budget (14), including the positive allowance \(\Lambda=2^{-22}\), and the same public geometry priors. Set the hidden original geometry to \(b=23/16\), \(c=4/5\), the held sensor gain to \(G=7/5\), and the target first-window mean to \(\bar\rho_1=9/8\). These are supplied software preparations, not parameters selected from an evaluated response. Both variable-clock cases share their entire original source and sensor, with offset \(O=5/13\) and the same four errors

\[ (\eta_0,\eta_{1/2},\eta_1,\eta_2)=2^{-91}(-1,1,-1,1). \tag{19} \]

For the eighteen nodes, use residual recipe \(r=4\):

\[ \widetilde u_i=\frac{(i+2)(r+2)}{2^{62}},\qquad \widetilde v_i=\frac{(5i+3r)\bmod23+1}{2^{62}},\qquad u=P_M\widetilde u,\quad v=P_M\widetilde v. \tag{20} \]

The nominal phase geometry and its full weighted centering retain the source owner. Add common form \(6/11\), common phase \(-6/13\) and the corresponding centered residual to each coordinate. Retain the exact arrays and outward mathematical-pi source box. Every residual entry is nonzero; weighted centering preserves the squared-norm bound, and \(40\cdot114^2/2^{124}<2^{-96}\) admits both source norms. The original actual long-arc mean is \(b-5/2^{65}\), since the first two phase residuals differ by \(5/2^{62}\). Source-box materialization must separately retain the declared norm bounds and this statistic.

The two variable clocks and one shared constant-mean reference are

\[ \rho_\pm(s)=\bar\rho_1\pm\frac{\Lambda}{2}(s-H/2),\qquad \rho_{\rm ref}(s)=\bar\rho_1. \tag{21} \]

All satisfy the global prior and derivative allowance. Their first-window means agree exactly. For \(\kappa=\pm\Lambda/2\), their three structural segment durations are

\[ \left(\bar\rho_1H/2-\kappa H^2/8,\quad \bar\rho_1H/2+\kappa H^2/8,\quad \bar\rho_1H+\kappa H^2\right). \tag{22} \]

These are positive exact rational exposures. The reference uses the same expression with \(\kappa=0\). Thus both nonconstant cases have strictly nonzero half-time and final exposure differences from the reference. Both rows of the complete autonomous law undergo the same time change; the reduction is exact, rather than freezing phase or using the mean rate separately in every actual segment.

An additional ambiguity control is the declared profile

\[ \rho_{\rm companion}(s)=\rho_+(s) +\epsilon\cos(4\pi s/H),\qquad \epsilon=\Lambda H/32. \tag{23} \]

Its derivative has magnitude at most \(\Lambda/2+\pi\Lambda/8<\Lambda\), and its distance from \(\bar\rho_1\) is at most \(25\Lambda H/32\), well inside the fixed global prior. Its three exposures equal those of \(\rho_+\), while every sampled instantaneous rate differs by \(\epsilon>0\). By (6), the same complete trajectory record encloses its sampled states. Retain this explicit association and the analytic exposure certificate; do not rerun an identical producer or count the association as a second independent numerical response. No profile is inferred from a mean-rate output.

docs.title: F3: exact exposure execution and separate public inference
docs.text:
Generate exactly three complete structural histories: the two clocks in (21) and their shared reference. Each uses the existing full-state producer with three sequential exposures (22), phase increments \((1/4,0,1/2)\), and all thirty-six endpoint intervals carried unchanged. The observation times remain \((0,H/2,H,2H)\). There is no event at the half-time sample and no state reset at either sample or the second phase jump.

Use one direct source-box order-four Taylor step per segment, its whole-tube fifth-order remainder, the fixed sixteen-attempt Picard budget, and shared outward dyadic-128 arithmetic. Retain all nine full certificates, their source associations, strict inclusion margins, achieved horizons and both global clock coordinates. Do not subdivide, increase precision, replace the source box by its midpoint or retry a failed budget. Each sensor reading must have numerical half-width at most \(\delta=2^{-90}\), separately from its physical-error allowance. Optional acute flags remain observations, not stopping requirements.

For each variable-clock case, pass only the eleven documented primitives to the isolated inverse worker. In particular, probe_duration is observed \(H\), and the clock inputs are the global prior and derivative bound. The source arrays, exact geometry, true gain, clock profiles, exposures, mean rate, reference trajectory and realized errors remain on the producer/evidence side. Retain allowlisted packets and hashes. The reference is used only for the independent transfer assessment, with no inverse evaluation. This is software information exclusion, not a secrecy or execution-authentication guarantee.

docs.title: Response-free signed separation budget
docs.text:
The transfer controls have a prospective finite-flow sign, not merely different clock formulas. Set \(T=4H\), \(Q_0=X+7gT\) and \(V=Y+2gTQ_0\). Equation (9) and the phase row give, throughout either pulse window and all comparison arcs,

\[ \|P_Mx\|_M\le Q_0,\qquad \|\theta-\theta_{\rm nominal}-m_\theta\mathbf1-a_jq\|_M \le V.\tag{24} \]

The centered nominal phase uses the same source convention as (20). At its pulse-shifted value, \(q^Tf=-F_j\), where \(F_j=2\sin(3a_j/2)\cos(b-a_j/2)>1/6\). For \(a_1=1/4\), use \(\sin(3/8)>1/3\) and the alternating cosine lower polynomial at \(21/16\), which exceeds \(1/4\). For \(a_2=3/4\), use \(\sin(9/8)>1/2\) and \(\cos(17/16)\ge223/512>1/6\). The sine map has weighted Lipschitz bound two, \(\|A\|_M\le2\), and \(1/3216<\gamma<g\). Consequently

\[ q^Tx_\tau<-m,\qquad m:=\frac1{6\cdot3216}-2Q_0-2gV>\frac1{20000}. \tag{25} \]

All bounds follow from the declared primitives and elementary inequalities; no reserved response or measured derivative is used.

The common sensor errors cancel between histories. Write \(D_{\pm,i}\) for the true variable/reference recorded difference. The half-time and final signs are

\[ D_{+,1}>0>D_{-,1},\qquad D_{+,3}<0<D_{-,3}, \tag{26} \]

with half-time magnitudes exceeding \(G\Lambda H^2/(16\cdot20000)=(14336/3125)\delta>4\delta\), and final magnitudes exceeding eight times that amount. Exact equality at \(0,H\) gives \(C_- - C_+>(57344/3125)\delta>16\delta\). An individual recorded interval of radius at most \(\delta\) has width at most \(2\delta\). Thus its variable/reference difference can extend at most \(4\delta\) beyond the true difference, and the two curvature intervals' difference at most \(16\delta\). The frozen numerical half-width criterion therefore suffices to retain all signs and the strict curvature ordering in the recorded intervals.

For containment, the actual gain and half-budget slopes yield \(|D_{\pm,i}|\le(7/20)b_i\), for \(i=1,3\). The derivative cap is the active term in (8), and \(b_1/\delta=2^{18}U>500\), with \(b_3=8b_1\). Hence the additional \(4\delta\) enclosure allowance is less than \((13/20)b_i\). The entire retained difference intervals must fit strictly inside the transfer bands whenever their individual reading-width criteria pass. Inverse availability and the complete validated horizons still require the declared executable checks.

docs.title: F4: fixed coverage, transfer and ambiguity criteria
docs.text:
The first evaluation passes only if all source/clock/sensor admissions, complete horizons, endpoint associations and numerical budgets pass, and:

  • Both public inverses return bounded_candidate, with source, drift transfer, finite curvature, rank and positive-division evidence admitted. Their necessary marginals cover the original nominal and actual angle, the retained initial actual-angle box, \(J_1=63/40\), \(G=7/5\) and \(\bar\rho_1=9/8\).
  • Strict widths are below 1/1024 for the actual original angle, 1/2048 for effective gain, 1/16 for gain and 1/80 for mean rate. Nonempty marginals do not imply joint realizability of every retained parameter tuple.
  • Each variable-clock half-time and final recorded interval has the strict signed separation (26) from its reference interval. The entire difference interval lies in the corresponding \([-b_i,b_i]\) from (10). At \(H\), every pair of actual/reference full-state coordinate boxes intersects, before and after the common phase event. This is numerical consistency with the exact theorem, not an overlap proof of equality.
  • The finite-curvature intervals have the strict ordering \(C_+<C_-\). Each uses the same four recorded readings and their original sensor errors, without an independently supplied derivative observation.
  • False global clock prior [25/32,13/16] and false gain prior [31/16,2] leave the corresponding coarse child available but produce a strict curvature exclusion. The false angle prior [11/8,353/256] is excluded; equal cumulative amplitudes (1/4,1/4) give the inherited rank abstention. These controls use the same actual readings with altered declarations.

docs.title: Geometry, sensor gain and a declared uncertain clock
Question and conditional result
docs.text:
The two-input inverse constrains an original source angle and held sensor gain under a known complete law and structural clock. Its reserved evaluation retains that premise. Here the conversion from the observation clock to structural time is an additional positive, unknown constant. The result is a necessary outer enclosure of geometry, an effective response scale, and separate gain/clock marginals. It neither proves that these marginals are jointly realizable nor determines an absolute physical clock.

Two distinctions matter. An unknown multiplier of every evolution row can be exactly confounded with clock conversion. An unknown sensor gain can instead compensate the clock in the leading short-time response, without preserving the full nonlinear response. An explicit curvature witness below proves that these are different statements.

This is a mathematical extension and implementation contract, not a new reserved experiment. It changes none of the earlier frozen protocols, source archives, responses or verdicts. docs.title: F1-F2: full source, observation clock and complete event law
docs.text:
Retain the eighteen-node support and full source family of the two-input owner: two unit C9 rings on 0,...,8 and 9,...,17, joined at (0,9) and (1,10). Let \(M\) be the degree matrix, \(L\) its graph Laplacian, \(A=M^{-1}L\), and \(q=e_4-e_5\). The source is

\[ x^-=m_x\mathbf1+u,\qquad \theta^-=m_\theta\mathbf1+\theta^0(b,c)+v, \tag{1} \]

where \(P_Mu=u\), \(P_Mv=v\), \(\|u\|_M\le X\), \(\|v\|_M\le Y\). The original priors obey

\[ [b_-,b_+]\subseteq[11/8,3/2],\qquad [c_-,c_+]\subseteq[2/3,1]. \]

The affine phase family, its single weighted centering, continuous lifts and original acute guard are unchanged. All thirty-six coordinates, including arbitrary common means and receiver geometry, remain in the model. An uncertain clock does not authorize a different preparation, recentered intermediate state or hidden clock-dependent residual.

In fast structural time \(\tau\), retain the complete supplied law

\[ \frac{dx}{d\tau}=-Ax+\gamma f(\theta),\qquad \frac{d\theta}{d\tau}=\gamma Ax,\qquad \gamma=\frac1{1023\pi},\qquad f_i(\theta)=\frac1{M_{ii}}\sum_{j\sim i}\sin(\theta_j-\theta_i). \tag{2} \]

Support, unit capacity and both coefficients are held premises of this normalized model. They are not inferred from the readings.

Let \(s\) be the declared observation clock, with common origin zero, and

\[ \tau=\rho s,\qquad 0<\rho_-\le\rho\le\rho_+<\infty. \tag{3} \]

The same constant \(\rho\) applies to both windows. Its units are structural-time units per observation-time unit. In fixed chosen units the equations consumed by an observation-clock trajectory are therefore

\[ \frac{dx}{ds}=\rho[-Ax+\gamma f(\theta)],\qquad \frac{d\theta}{ds}=\rho\gamma Ax. \tag{4} \]

Multiplying only the form row, changing \(\gamma\) alone, or treating \(\rho\) as a measured phase frequency gives a different model. The general clock owner also explains why state-dependent and varying conversions require further laws. They are outside this constant-conversion admission.

Supply cumulative amplitudes \(0<a_1\le a_2\le1\). Apply the phase jump \(a_1q\) at \(s=0\), evolve (4) until \(s=H>0\), then apply \((a_2-a_1)q\) and evolve until \(s=2H\). Both jumps leave form unchanged. There is no other forcing or support event. Their structural times are \(0,\rho H\); all three observation times are \(0,\rho H,2\rho H\). The full first endpoint starts the second window. Both common means remain conserved under these declared rows and events, irrespective of \(\rho\).

The three recorded scalars use one held sensor:

\[ r_j=Gq^Tx(jH)+O+\eta_j,\quad j=0,1,2,\qquad 0<G_-\le G\le G_+,\quad |\eta_j|\le\delta. \tag{5} \]

Here \(x(jH)\) means the solution in the observation clock. Reading intervals \([r_j^-,r_j^+]\) enclose those recorded values; their exact midpoints \(c_j\) and half-widths \(\epsilon_j\) differ from the sensor allowance \(\delta\). One offset \(O\) and one middle reading are retained. The units of \(G\) are readout units per form unit; \(J=G\rho\) has the additional clock-conversion factor and is not itself a calibrated sensor gain. No laboratory identification of \(s\), the input amplitudes or this affine sensor is supplied.

The gate admits any positive compact clock prior with

\[ h_*:=\rho_+H\le\frac12,\qquad T_*=2h_*\le1. \tag{6} \]

The range \([1/2,2]\), for example, is an admissible supplied uncertainty when \(H\le1/4\); it is not a measured clock range or a universal bound.

docs.title: F3: one uniform envelope for the entire uncertain history
docs.text:
For a structural window length \(0<h\le h_*\), write the earlier complete-flow bounds as functions of their duration:

\[ \begin{aligned} g&=1/3069>\gamma,\qquad D=4+4a_2+2Y,\\ Q(h)&=\frac{X+2ghD}{1-16g^2h^2},\\ E(h)&=2hQ(h)+2ghY+8g^2h^2Q(h). \end{aligned}\tag{7} \]

The denominator is positive on (6). The numerator is nonnegative and nondecreasing, while the denominator is positive and nonincreasing. Thus \(Q(h)\), and consequently

\[ \frac{E(h)}h=2Q(h)+2gY+8g^2hQ(h), \tag{8} \]

are nondecreasing. This is a bound on the complete original-source trajectory, including the first-window form and phase evolution carried into the second. It assumes neither a reset nor later acuteness.

For the actual \(h=\rho H\), put \(\xi=\rho/\rho_+\in(0,1]\). Monotonicity gives the useful normalized error bound

\[ \boxed{\ E(\rho H)\le\xi E(h_*)\ }.\tag{9} \]

The actual form and dynamical phase displacement on both windows obey \(\|P_Mx\|_M\le Q(h_*)\) and \(\|d\|_M\le4gh_*Q(h_*)\). In particular, the horizon used to bound all hidden evolution is the maximum structural horizon, not \(2H\) unless the chosen units make \(\rho_+=1\).

Let \(y_j=q^T[x(jH)-x((j-1)H)]\). The inherited finite response identity and (9) imply

\[ y_j=-\xi K_j^*\cos(b-a_j/2)+e_j,\qquad K_j^*=2\gamma h_*\sin(3a_j/2),\qquad |e_j|\le\xi E(h_*). \tag{10} \]

Consequently, with the auxiliary radial scale

\[ \ell=G\xi=\frac{G\rho}{\rho_+},\qquad \ell\in\left[\frac{G_-\rho_-}{\rho_+},\ G_+\right], \tag{11} \]

the true recorded increments satisfy

\[ r_j-r_{j-1}=-\ell K_j^*\cos(b-a_j/2) +\zeta_j+\eta_j-\eta_{j-1},\qquad |\zeta_j|\le\ell E(h_*)\le G_+E(h_*). \tag{12} \]

These are precisely the necessary algebraic inequalities consumed by the existing two-input enclosure, with duration \(h_*\) and radial prior (11). This justifies sharing that calculation. It does not assert that the actual readings were produced by another trajectory running at \(\rho_+\), by sensor gain \(\ell\), or by a newly prepared source. The auxiliary report is a constraint envelope with that explicit meaning.

For either exact row \(w=(w_1,w_2)\) of the inherited inverse matrix, the radius remains

\[ G_+E(h_*)(|w_1|+|w_2|) +(\epsilon_0+\delta)|w_1| +(\epsilon_1+\delta)|w_1-w_2| +(\epsilon_2+\delta)|w_2|. \tag{13} \]

The common offset cancels in exact midpoint differences first. The middle reading/error and the factor-based rank checks are unchanged. The original source acute guard is required to interpret its geometry; the sufficient whole-window guard at \(h_*\) stays optional.

docs.title: F4: necessary geometry, effective scale and quotient marginals
docs.text:
Apply the auxiliary two-input enclosure only after admitting the original primitives and (3), (6). It returns necessary bounds on \(b\), the original actual long-arc mean \(B=b-(v_1-v_0)/8\), and \(\ell\). The actual-angle expansion remains \(Y/8\), using the original phase radius, independently of the clock uncertainty.

If \(\ell\in[\ell_-,\ell_+]\) survives the auxiliary projection, then define an outward effective-scale enclosure

\[ J=G\rho\in[J_-,J_+]:=\rho_+[\ell_-,\ell_+].\tag{14} \]

Every compatible sensor gain and clock belongs to the necessary positive-product constraint

\[ \mathcal P=\{(G,\rho):G\in[G_-,G_+], \rho\in[\rho_-,\rho_+],\ G\rho\in[J_-,J_+]\}. \tag{15} \]

Its separate coordinate projections are

\[ \begin{aligned} G&\in[G_-,G_+]\cap[J_-/\rho_+,\ J_+/\rho_-],\\ \rho&\in[\rho_-,\rho_+]\cap[J_-/G_+,\ J_+/G_-]. \end{aligned}\tag{16} \]

The implementation retains outward bounds and the relation \(J=G\rho\). It does not fill the rectangle between these projections with compatible trajectories. Even \(\mathcal P\) discards correlations with geometry, the complete hidden state and the three errors. Nonempty marginal intervals prove no joint existence or exact point identification.

A narrow effective scale may coexist with wide gain and clock bounds. For example, even the exact product \(J=3/2\), combined only with \(G\in[1,2]\) and \(\rho\in[1/2,2]\), permits the entire positive-product curve with \(G\in[1,2]\) and \(\rho\in[3/4,3/2]\). docs.text:
A conditional arithmetic example shows that uncertain clock conversion need not erase all geometric information. Choose

\[ \begin{gathered} \rho\in[1/2,2],\quad G\in[1,2],\quad H=2^{-22},\quad (a_1,a_2)=(1/4,3/4),\\ X=Y=2^{-40},\qquad \delta=2^{-60},\qquad \epsilon_j\le\delta. \end{gathered} \]

\[ R=72000E(h_*)/h_*+144000\delta/h_*<1/3072. \]

The upper auxiliary gain remains two, so that radius calculation is unchanged. Its lower gain is now \(1/4\). For compatible readings the rectangle contains a true vector of norm at least \(1/4\), has diameter at most \(2R\), and therefore stays at norm at least \(1/4-2R>0\). It also stays in the first quadrant: the true first coordinate exceeds \(1/64\) and the second exceeds \(9/40\), both larger than \(2R\). The norm and argument gradient bounds consequently give

\[ \begin{aligned} \operatorname{width}(b)&\le\frac{2R}{1/4-2R}<1/383,\\ \operatorname{width}(B)&<1/383+Y/4<1/256,\\ \operatorname{width}(J)&\le4R<1/768<1/512. \end{aligned} \]

docs.title: Exact equivalence with a common multiplier of every row
docs.text:
Consider a separately specified extension of (2): a positive constant \(\lambda\) multiplies its entire vector field. If \(z=(x,\theta)\) and \(F\) denotes (2), the observation-clock model is

\[ \frac{dz}{ds}=\rho\lambda F(z).\tag{17} \]

Retain the same full source, support, held sensor \(G,O\), input amplitudes, and events scheduled at the same observation-clock times. Any two admissible parameter pairs with \(\rho_1\lambda_1=\rho_2\lambda_2\) have exactly the same right-hand side and initial state. Uniqueness gives identical full states up to the first event; the same jump map gives identical post-event states. Repeating this argument gives identical full histories and all noiseless readings. Coupling the same allowed additive errors preserves the recorded readings.

Equivalently, \((\rho,\lambda)\mapsto(k\rho,\lambda/k)\), for any positive \(k\) admitted by the respective priors, is an exact equivalence. Where a prior fiber contains multiple pairs, no observation of these identical state histories can distinguish its individual factors. The product \(\rho\lambda\) is an invariant of this equivalence; this proof does not establish that the selected scalar readings identify even that product. A singleton prior or an additional independent clock reference can alter the identification problem.

This argument requires the complete-row multiplier, common preparation and observation-clock event convention. Holding events at fixed structural times instead generally changes their observed schedule. A changed relative loss/exchange coefficient, capacity law, source, forcing or sensor is not covered by (17). The current inference API retains \(\lambda=1\); it must not interpret its fixed \(\gamma\) as a free global multiplier.

docs.title: Equal leading gain-clock products need not preserve the full response
docs.text:
Here is an exact counterexample inside the fixed-law source domain, with no numerical trajectory evaluation. Choose

\[ b=\pi/2-1/8,\qquad c=3/4,\qquad u=v=0, \qquad a_1=1/4. \tag{18} \]

The nominal donor short angle is \(4\pi-8b=1\); receiver long angles are \((2\pi-3/4)/8\) and the port origin difference is \(1/8\). Together with the stated long donor and short receiver angles these all lie strictly inside the original acute chart and priors. Common form and phase means can be arbitrary and equal in both compared preparations. Any later declared second event is irrelevant to this right-hand local calculation before \(H\).

Immediately after the first phase jump, write \(f=f(\theta^-+a_1q)\). The four local rows, all of degree two, satisfy

\[ \begin{aligned} f_3&=[-\sin b+\sin(b+a_1)]/2=0,\\ f_4&=[-\sin(b+a_1)+\sin(b-2a_1)]/2=-F_0/2,\\ f_5&=-f_4,\qquad f_6=-f_3=0,\\ F_0&=2\sin(3/8)\sin(1/4)>0. \end{aligned}\tag{19} \]

Other rows, including both ports and the receiver, retain their actual values; they are not set to equilibrium. Locality of \(A\) gives

\[ q^Tf=-F_0,\qquad q^TAf=-3F_0/2.\tag{20} \]

Since the initial form is constant, \(Ax(0)=0\), and the complete structural rows imply \(x_\tau(0^+)=\gamma f\), \(\theta_\tau(0^+)=0\), and \(x_{\tau\tau}(0^+)=-\gamma Af\). For the noiseless held readout \(r(s)=Gq^Tx(s)+O\), therefore

\[ r'(0^+)=-G\rho\gamma F_0,\qquad r''(0^+)=\tfrac32G\rho^2\gamma F_0. \tag{21} \]

These are derivatives on the actual complete flow after the event, not derivatives of a reduced fitted response or of the discrete sensor errors.

Compare \((G,\rho)=(3/2,1)\) with \((1,3/2)\), using exactly the same source, first jump and offset. Both pairs fit the priors \(G\in[1,2]\), \(\rho\in[1/2,2]\), have the same initial reading and slope, and satisfy \(G\rho=3/2\). The second pair's curvature exceeds the first by \(9\gamma F_0/8>0\). Its readout minus the first consequently has leading term \((9\gamma F_0/16)s^2\) as \(s\downarrow0\), so it is nonzero for every sufficiently small positive time before the second event. The product-preserving gain/clock change is not an exact response symmetry.

For this exact preparation with exact continuous derivative access, \(-2r''(0^+)/[3r'(0^+)]=\rho\). That observation is conditional on the known geometry and vanishing form residual; it does not provide a uniform clock estimator for uncertain sources or three noisy samples. Unknown initial form, phase residuals and later phase feedback enter the general curvature. The witness rules out an overly strong impossibility claim; it does not prove complete finite-record identifiability.

docs.title: 1. State and selected continuous law
docs.text:
Let U be a finite simple loop-free connected undirected support with at least two nodes. Retain signed scalar form x, primitive circular phase theta, finite nonnegative conductances W, held nonnegative capacities nu and a declared structural clock. Uniform-real BEPI uses the same signed scalar admission; complex/nonuniform BEPI and magnitude projection do not replace it. The shared weighted-form, bare-phase law is

\[ q=L_Wx,\quad S_i=\sum_{j\sim i}\sin(\theta_j-\theta_i),\quad d_i=|N_i|>0,\quad M=\operatorname{diag}(m_i),\quad m_i=\frac{\nu_i}{\pi d_i}, \qquad p_i=\frac{S_i}{\pi d_i},\qquad \dot x=MS,\quad\dot\theta=Mq. \tag{1} \]

Bare neighbors include supported zero-conductance edges. Pressure is specified before evaluating the form response. There is no forcing or continuous loss. The shared reader admits nonnegative capacities and conductances; positivity is an additional premise where an inverse-capacity mean or a nontrivial weighted coupling is needed. At zero capacity both rows of this particular completion vanish at that node; the general nodal identity alone would freeze only its form row.

With declared phase lifts, the selected storage is

\[ H=\frac12x^TL_Wx+ \sum_{\{i,j\}\in U}\bigl(1-\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)\bigr). \tag{2} \]

It is conserved by (1), since the form and phase work cancel. When all capacities are positive, both means with weights rho_i=d_i/nu_i are also conserved. These are mathematical storage and lifted-coordinate identities, not laboratory energy or a physical identification.

In addition to this physical state, THOL consumes target-associated temporal history, stored pressure, grammar context, hierarchy and child identifiers, configuration and execution order. docs.title: 2. Acceleration predicted by this law and acceleration actually observed
docs.text:
Let C(theta) be the bare cosine Laplacian: an edge has coefficient cos(theta_j-theta_i), irrespective of W. Direct differentiation of (1), with held capacity and support, gives

\[ \ddot x=-M C(\theta)M L_Wx, \qquad \ddot x_i=m_i\sum_{j\sim i}\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i) (m_jq_j-m_iq_i). \tag{3} \]

Thus the selected completion does have structural acceleration. It is neither an independently selectable extra state variable nor the cached acceleration telemetry. In any specified state,

\[ |\ddot x_i|\leq m_i\sum_{j\sim i}|\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)| (m_j|q_j|+m_i|q_i|). \tag{4} \]

There is no universal finite acceleration ceiling obtained from capacity alone on unrestricted signed form space. For a constructive example, take theta_i=0, every other phase phi with 0<phi<pi/2, and forms x_i=b+u, x_j=b elsewhere. If nu_i>0 and w_i=sum_{j~i}W_ij>0, then

\[ p_i=\frac{\sin\phi}{\pi}>0,\qquad \ddot x_i=-u m_i\cos\phi \left(d_i m_i w_i+\sum_{j\sim i}m_jW_{ij}\right). \tag{5} \]

The parent acceleration has either sign and exceeds any supplied finite magnitude threshold for a sufficiently large form contrast. A common shift b can independently place its form above a supplied minimum. All edges are initially acute; this is a zero-winding preparation, not the marked winding-one family. The strict inequality persists on a neighborhood of admissible positive-capacity/positive-conductance preparations. Finite form rails, specified mean or storage leaves and particular preparations require their own bounds; (5) does not show that they contain this example.

Smooth local flow through a state with abs(ddot x_i)>tau implies the existence of sufficiently short genuine three-sample windows with the same strict magnitude inequality. This follows from convergence of the three-point divided difference to the derivative. It supplies a compatibility theorem, not an executed window, recorded history, target selector or grammatical context. For one unit edge, capacities one, phase difference pi/3 and x=(3,1), equation (3) gives ddot x_0=-2/pi^2, whose magnitude exceeds 0.1. No trajectory is computed to establish this algebraic example.

Actual THOL uses the shared acceleration reader. For its last three active timestamped samples, it computes

\[ h_1=t_1-t_0>0,\quad h_2=t_2-t_1>0,\quad s_1=\frac{x_1-x_0}{h_1},\quad s_2=\frac{x_2-x_1}{h_2},\qquad \widehat A=\frac{2(s_2-s_1)}{h_1+h_2}. \tag{6} \]

The timestamped source is authoritative when selected; its endpoint EPI must match current signed form. Legacy histories instead use unit operator steps and do not authenticate the endpoint or a continuous-flow interval. Fewer than three active samples give explicit unavailability in the observation; the compatibility numerical function returns zero in that case. Neither this fallback nor a cached D2_EPI establishes observed zero acceleration.

The reader checks supplied sample values and ordering, not an independent live physical clock or producer provenance. A record can have a matching endpoint value while referring to a different interval. The execution protocol must supply temporal continuity, units, pressure law, event record and clock authority before (6) can be interpreted as evidence from (1). Operator-step records and a structural-time record are different inputs.

For endpoint errors bounded by epsilon_0,epsilon_1,epsilon_2 at fixed exact times, the observation error obeys

\[ |\delta\widehat A|\leq\frac{2}{h_1+h_2} \left(\frac{\epsilon_0+\epsilon_1}{h_1} +\frac{\epsilon_1+\epsilon_2}{h_2}\right). \tag{7} \]

Arithmetic and time/solver errors require additional budgets. Primitive nonzero values lost to materialization and nonfinite arithmetic are not evidence of a zero response. A computed threshold decision is not an exact derivative theorem; a strict true margin must dominate the observation error before its decision transfers.

docs.text:
The public proposal reads the active history and applies the checked stored-pressure jump

\[ p_i^+=p_i+a\widehat A_i,\qquad x_i^+=x_i,\quad \nu_i^+=\nu_i,\quad\theta_i^+=\theta_i, \qquad a=\mathrm{THOL\_accel}>0. \tag{8} \]

The configured default is 1/(4*pi). A supplied finite nonnegative threshold tau selects the child proposal only when abs(A_hat)>tau; equality produces no child. Reaching the configured hierarchy depth also suppresses birth while retaining (8). Missing acceleration gives the compatibility zero update if optional strict preconditions are disabled, without turning missing evidence into a measured zero. A graph-backed primitive dispatch performs this pressure proposal without hierarchy construction; a graphless primitive instead has an explicitly supplied acceleration contract. These routes are not interchangeable.

When enabled, the shared optional strict gate additionally requires admitted form and capacity minima, positive stored pressure, configured connectivity and at least three active samples. It does not require the birth threshold to be crossed. Full proposal validation separately checks hierarchy references, depth, child-domain bounds, metabolic configuration and representable outputs. Signed scalar admission is general; the configured nonnegative THOL minimum restricts the stricter execution domain without redefining signed EPI. The shared resolve_thol_min_epi policy resolver supplies both strict runtime and detached admission, with unchanged core default 0.2; a present invalid override rejects. The actual child's temporal result shows why above-threshold acceleration and positive fresh pressure do not replace this independent form requirement or acquired history.

Grammar is independent: THOL is a stabilizer, a bifurcation handler and a transformer that requires a recent destabilizer under U4b. It is not a closure. OZ -> THOL -> SHA is a valid complete word with existing nonzero form when its live conditions pass. This is an example, not a compulsory evolution law. The synthetic tests execute it on an independently prepared no-child case. Their manufactured temporal records are reader/event controls, not observations of a retained organization. Neither passing grammar nor (5) supplies those records to an actual research object.

The atomic stage proposes every target from one immutable snapshot, allocates collision-free child identities in snapshot-node rank and validates the merged hierarchy before committing. Histories and diagnostics retain requested target order. Public single-target execution has its own transaction; sequential public calls do not become one simultaneous stage. No callback external-effect rollback or future stability follows from graph-state atomicity.

docs.title: 4. Pressure-only continuation and its complete accounting
docs.text:
When no child is committed, all physical coordinates consumed by (1), bare support, conductances and capacities remain fixed. Consequently

\[ \Delta H=0,\quad\Delta\mu_x=\Delta\mu_\theta=0,\qquad p_{\rm fresh}^+=p_{\rm fresh},\quad \dot x_{\rm fresh}^+=\dot x_{\rm fresh},\quad \dot\theta_{\rm fresh}^+=\dot\theta_{\rm fresh}. \tag{9} \]

The mean statements require positive capacities. These identities hold for one or simultaneous targets, with no pressure cross term in H because H does not consume stored pressure. History, debt and diagnostics can still change; the contextual event is not the identity map on sufficient execution state.

The raw stored pressure in (8) generally lies off the constitutive relation p=S/(pi*d). Immediate selected-law refresh erases its direct contribution. Holding the changed pressure for a later interval instead changes the complete model: its form row is no longer the refreshed row of (1). Pressure-only event compatibility therefore includes an explicit handoff; it does not silently promote stored pressure to an independent evolving coordinate. A finite-duration held-pressure response would require its own law, clock, phase row and budget.

The separate scalar diagnostic satisfies

\[ \frac12\bigl[(p_i+a\widehat A_i)^2-p_i^2\bigr] =a p_i\widehat A_i+\frac12a^2\widehat A_i^2, \tag{10} \]

which can have either sign. THOL's stabilizer role is not universal pressure contraction. Subsequent OZ, SHA or other word stages have their own resets; (9) is the THOL stage budget, not a whole-word identity.

docs.title: 5. Child creation changes the state dimension and law domain
docs.text:
If its threshold, depth and proposal domains pass, public THOL adds a child c with the actual represented endpoints

\[ \nu_c^+=0.95\,\nu_i,\qquad \theta_c^+=\theta_i\pmod{2\pi},\qquad p_c^+=0, \qquad x_c^+=\mathcal B_i(x_i,\{x_j,\theta_j:j\sim i\}). \tag{11} \]

The products and wrapping denote the admitted runtime results, not exact decimal identities after binary64 evaluation. The amplitude map is owned by metabolism: before final configured child bounds, it clips 0.3*x_i + g*(mean_neighbor_x-x_i) + k*phase_variance to [0,1] when metabolism is enabled, and 0.3*x_i otherwise. Its inputs use bare neighbor multiplicities and circular phase variance; conductance-weighted averages and a simple cell graph do not substitute for them. The configured EPI interval must intersect [0,1]. Acceleration selects eligibility and is recorded; it is not a second amplitude multiplier.

The event writes the parent/child association, hierarchy path and level, sub_nodes, sub_epis and graph hierarchy. It leaves every old form, capacity, phase and edge unchanged. The child has a single legacy EPI sample, so it does not inherit the parent's observed acceleration. No parent amplitude is removed and no neighbor form is metabolically depleted; this construction is not an additive mass split. A common form shift need not commute with the bounded child construction, even though the old continuous law has that symmetry.

The whole-graph continuation obstruction is exact. THOL creates no edge. The child has d_c=0; the resulting graph is disconnected and the denominators in (1) are undefined there, even if its capacity happens to be zero. The existing shared sine reader correctly refuses this successor. The pressure value zero and nesting metadata do not resolve 0/0, provide a child phase law or create coupling. Optional strict THOL connectivity applies to the target before the event; it does not certify the newborn's continuous-law domain.

Restricting the actual successor to the old component gives exactly the same fresh (1), H and inverse-capacity means as before the event. This is a restriction result, not a whole-successor certificate. In particular a stage whose final callback demands the existing full-graph sine refresh rejects and rolls back the birth and contextual writes; it cannot return an admitted selected-law successor by silently ignoring the child.

docs.title: An explicit comparison extension, not an installed law
docs.text:
One mathematically consistent extension would declare (1) on every connected component of size at least two and, on each isolate, explicitly set

\[ p_c=0,\qquad\dot x_c=0,\qquad\dot\theta_c=0. \tag{12} \]

This is a supplied frozen-isolate completion, not a consequence of dividing by zero or an implementation change. It has a smooth vector field on each fixed-support stratum. Choosing the same edge-only storage (2) makes its old component conservation proof apply verbatim; isolates have no storage term. With that explicit convention, isolated birth has zero selected edge-storage jump and leaves the old component means fixed. Assigning an intrinsic child storage would change the birth budget and require its own premise.

For positive capacities, the old component weights remain rho_i=d_i/nu_i. Setting an isolate's weight to zero only defines an observation that ignores it; it is not a complete mean of the enlarged organization. Any additional positive fixed child weight kappa would also give a conserved weighted mean under (12), but birth shifts that mean by kappa*(x_c-mu_x)/(sum(rho)+kappa) for one child. No particular kappa is selected by (1). The frozen child's coordinates are independent constants, not a coupled higher-scale dynamical mode.

Other isolate laws or actual connections are possible supplied completions. They are not selected by the hierarchy record. Connecting a child changes degrees, both rows, phase pressure, edge storage and mean weights; it needs its own admitted support event and work accounting. The native birth/transport results cannot transfer their diffusion law or coefficients to this sine completion. This owner installs no extension or child-coupling policy.

The later hierarchy-to-contact composition explicitly selects this comparison for its intermediate prefix and supplies a separate shared detached reader. It retains the connected reader's rejection, the additional isolate-law premise and the absence of native flow dispatch. Its small connected source family does not establish birth or maintenance of the marked winding contact studied here.

docs.title: 6. Collective descent, U5 and clock compatibility
docs.text:
For the marked twenty-node, forty-five-edge contact, the contextual eleven-cell chart retains singleton ports 0 and 1 and nine physical twin pairs. It must also retain per-member temporal samples/units, grammar histories and debt, hierarchy and identifiers, support multiplicities, construction parameters, stored pressure, semantic data and ordered targets. A mean history or unordered list of histories does not determine which parent crosses tau or which child is constructed. The full form origin matters to the child amplitude.

Pressure-only events at these singleton ports leave physical twin equalities and the continuous reduction intact after refresh. Birth at both ports keeps the old twins but adds two associated singleton children: the physical chart has thirteen cells and twenty-six form/phase coordinates, plus its hierarchy and temporal context. Its support is disconnected; describing that chart is not admission to (1). More general twin-target events require compatible target sets, histories, configuration and child association before a descended event is defined. Physical equality alone is insufficient.

U5 has separate structural and numerical obligations. The proposal validates a coherent hierarchy record. The detached U5 assessment additionally compares C_parent >= alpha*sum(C_child) for an explicitly supplied alpha and tolerance. It requires explicit finite stored-pressure and change-rate inputs for every assessed parent and child; missing channels reject rather than become zero observations. A newly constructed child has no supplied change-rate observation, so birth alone does not establish a numerical U5 certificate. With actual or explicitly supplied diagnostic inputs, valid nesting can pass one alpha and fail another. Neither a single pass nor the variance-based sub-EPI amplitude alignment proves subsequent maintenance.

Under an affine clock change s=c*t+b, c>0, one way to retain the form of both rows in (1) is nu_s=nu_t/c, with pressure unchanged. Then

\[ \widehat A_s=\widehat A_t/c^2,\quad \tau_s=\tau_t/c^2,\quad a_s=c^2a_t. \tag{13} \]

Transforming capacity minima and all history timestamps consistently preserves the same event decision and stored-pressure increment. Keeping numerical tau and gain fixed instead defines a different policy. If capacity units are held fixed and pressure is instead rescaled, the phase row and gain need their corresponding transformations as well. A nonlinear time change also adds the usual acceleration term -xdot*s''/(s')^3; finite differences must be rebuilt from the transformed sample intervals. Synchronization or operator count does not supply such a clock transformation.

docs.title: 7. Verification and remaining scope
docs.text:
Independent synthetic controls exercise the complete no-child word, the two public branches and primitive distinction, actual metabolic multiplicities, unchanged old-component fields, isolated-child rejection and graph rollback, independent U4/U5 conditions, signed temporal evidence and affine clock scaling. The law-acceleration control compares independently differentiated edge equations with shared instantaneous fields. The supplied quadratic records are explicitly manufactured reader inputs; no continuous trajectory or retained research response is executed.

The shared history, proposal and transaction owners retain their broader tests; Testing owns selection. These contracts establish a scoped partial action and a precise complete-law obstruction. They establish neither an observed THOL birth under (1), autonomous occurrence, a recursively coupled organization, future maintenance nor physical identification.

docs.title: Identity through an admitted form-capacity transformation
docs.text: The directional result rejected retention of the original joint radius after a complete NUL/IL/SHA word. This owner identifies a weaker, independently defined organizational class that the word can preserve, and the larger state needed to predict its actual action. It instantiates the existing operator and grammar descent criteria for this contact; it introduces neither a replacement retention radius nor a new constitutive law. The research program owns subsequent work.

docs.title: 1. A marked phase class is not a sufficient state
docs.text:
Keep the existing twenty-node, 45-edge contact: two doubled C5 constituents, the internal edge {0,1}, and four cross edges between {0,1} and {10,11}. Nodes 0 and 1 remain individually marked ports. Let sigma fix those ports and exchange (2,3),...,(18,19). Require sigma to preserve the complete bare support, each actual edge conductance and each capacity. Equality of aggregate conductance sums alone is not the reused involution theorem. No exchange of the two marked ports is assumed.

Use the existing reference phase, increasing by alpha=2*pi/5 around each oriented constituent cycle. Choose an orientation of every fine edge and its reference integer k_ij so that

\[ g_{ij}=\theta_j-\theta_i-2\pi k_{ij}\in(-\pi/2,\pi/2). \tag{1} \]

The organizational class considered here is the marked contact in this acute phase sector, with positive capacities and the nine exact physical twin equalities. The reference sector fixes every cycle winding; in particular, both original oriented C5 windings are +1. On a fixed phase lift this sector is an open convex intersection of edge inequalities, with a free common phase origin. Its continuous paths cannot change the associated integers without leaving the sector. This is a topological/geometric classification, not a scalar macro-node or a claim that all its members have identical responses. The supplied support and constituent organization are not newly formed by this classification.

There are two distinct equivalences:

  • Same organizational class: membership in this marked acute sector, with its prescribed twin structure. Different internal shapes, form origins, positive capacities and admitted actual weights can belong to it.
  • Same predictive execution description: equality of the reduced physical coordinates and every retained associated input and context specified below. Equality of the winding labels alone does not imply this equality.

The old observation Z<1/16 remains a different, finer claim. Leaving it can coexist with membership in (1). Neither membership in (1) nor a passing U6 snapshot proves that the class will persist indefinitely.

docs.title: 2. A contextual chart for the exact twin stratum
docs.text:
The existing reduction retains eleven form values X and eleven lifted phase values Theta, with multiplicities (1,1,2,...,2). Retain their full common origins. Also retain:

  • actual support, conductances, geometric lengths, per-member bare counts, capacities, fine-node/cell association and marked targets (0,1);
  • the independently specified pressure law and the full consumed stored pressure, including raw-versus-refreshed provenance;
  • target-associated ordered histories, persistent grammar debt and prior coherence, lifecycle data and all other persistent records consumed or exposed by the chosen stage path;
  • fixed configuration, node and neighbor iteration order, target order, sequence context, supplied timestamp and structural clock;
  • each consumed U6 reference, its geometry and observation convention.

For a represented comparison, retain the admitted primitive representations and attribute associations as well. Do not identify circularly equivalent large floating-point angles, reordered sums or a scalar with a different runtime representation without a separate equivalence proof. No stochastic operation is selected by this word; a later randomized action would need its own retained random input/state.

Let Q record these data while suppressing the duplicate physical form/phase rows within the nine equal pairs. Its declared lift L expands those rows back to the same marked twenty-node preparation. Nonphysical per-member records remain associated with their member, even when they differ within a physical twin pair. This is a lossless chart of the selected physical stratum with retained context, not an eleven-node simple graph and not a quotient that identifies arbitrary runtime permutations. Recomputing degrees on an eleven-node simple graph would change the law.

For the deterministic, fixed configured stage path, equal Q records give the same lifted primitive inputs. Consequently admission, proposals, context updates and declared outputs agree. This is a concrete application of the existing partial-transition criterion, not a claim of a minimal context. Opaque callbacks or unrecorded process state are outside the comparison; rebuildable caches cannot serve as authoritative physical inputs.

The physical stratum is preserved by the chosen events: NUL and SHA change only singleton ports; IL changes only their phases and stored pressures. No paired form, phase or capacity is changed asymmetrically. A pressure-only refresh cannot break these physical equalities. Its represented per-member pressure rows need not be compressed or presumed bit-identical. After the word, the held-support conservative flow preserves the physical stratum by the already proved equivariance and smooth uniqueness. This statement retains the actual weights, capacities and law; it is not a robustness result for nonsymmetric fine preparations.

docs.title: 3. A positive-width, one-word admission domain
docs.text:
The following analytical subdomain makes the physical and phase claims explicit. It is not an inference from a successful nominal execution. Admit the support and symmetry above, old conductances one, and new conductances in (3/4,1]. Geometric lengths equal those conductances for the U6 comparison. On the exact twin stratum require

\[ 1/4<x_i<3/8,\qquad 3/8< u_0, u_1<5/8, \qquad 0< u_i\leq1\quad(i e0,1), ag{2} \]

and, for one retained common phase origin tau,

\[ heta_i= au+ heta_{*,i}+\eta_i,\qquad \max_i|\eta_i|<1/8. ag{3} \]

Condition (3) is a componentwise phase chart, not the old joint Z-ball. Its constant comes from the existing acute validation margin, and no trajectory response is used to choose it. It is only a source condition; the output need not satisfy the same box.

Use the selected conservative law, so initial stored pressure is the fresh value p_i=S_i/(pi*d_i). In particular |p_i|<=1/pi. NUL uses its default factor c, with 7/8<c<1, edge awareness enabled and hard EPI bounds [-1,1]. IL uses the selected phase coefficient 0<=lambda<=3/10 and pressure retention 0<=kappa<1; the configured binary64 0.3 satisfies the phase bound. SHA uses factor 1/2. Retain the selected thresholds: NUL requires capacity above 1/10, signed form at least 1/10, density at most 10; IL requires positive form and capacity; SHA requires capacity at least 1/8. These are configured admission policies, not deductions of universal constants from nodal flow.

The initial discrete context keeps history AL,UM,SHA,IL,OZ at port 0 and AL,AL,AL,UM,SHA,IL,OZ at port 1, each in a deque of maximum length eight, with persistent debt one and prior coherence present. Keep strict rejection, live precondition validation, atomic target order (0,1) and the actual ValidatedSequence context {"initial_epi_nonzero": true, "compatibility_profile": "core"}. For these three tokens, the discrete checks do not consume phase compatibility or temporal secants: U3 acts on coupling/resonance, and this word contains no mutation, bifurcation or recursive action. Its validated prefix context is retained rather than erased by starting a new word.

The physical margins follow directly. Initially NUL's density satisfies

\[ rac{|p_i|}{x_i}< rac4\pi<10. \]

NUL has no clipping on (2), and its ideal primary changes are x_i^+=c*x_i, nu_i^+=c*nu_i, p_store,i^+=p_i/c at each port. Hence x_i^+>7/32 and nu_i^+>21/64. IL leaves those two channels fixed, so its positive-state checks and the later SHA capacity check both hold strictly. SHA leaves capacity c*nu_i/2>21/128>0. At every stage the pressure refresh uses the declared independent law; the reciprocal stored-pressure write cannot substitute for that refresh. Untargeted form, phase and capacity stay fixed at the events; their fresh pressure can change after the IL phase reset.

NUL adds no U2 debt, IL discharges one unit, and SHA adds none. Thus the retained debt progresses 1 -> 1 -> 0 -> 0. Zero terminal debt is the selected whole-word postcondition. SHA alone is not a universal zero-debt gate: a different initial debt can leave different obligations even when the same physical word executes.

The successor domain consists of the three actual prefix images with their updated context, followed by the post-word continuous state with held support/capacity and the same law. It does not require the images to belong to the source box (2)--(3). At completion the port form lies in (c/4,3*c/8) and capacity in (3*c/16,5*c/16), and the phase bounds below replace (3). This proves one ordered transformation on a nonzero-width relative stratum. It does not admit repetition from the new history, every possible next operator, or generic perturbations breaking the twin equalities.

docs.title: 4. The ideal word stays in the original acute phase sector
docs.text:
At either marked port the reference neighborhood contains three zero-phase neighbors and four at reference angles +alpha or -alpha. Its complex resultant, after removal of tau, is therefore

\[ R_*=3+4\cos(2\pi/5)>4. \]

Under (3), the phasor Lipschitz bound gives a resultant perturbation smaller than 7/8. Its real part exceeds 25/8 and its imaginary part has magnitude less than 7/8. Its selected mean angle mu consequently satisfies

\[ |\mu-\tau|<\arctan(7/25)<7/25. \tag{4} \]

The target and mean differ by less than 1/8+7/25<pi, so IL's shortest circular update uses this same local lift. Simultaneous IL reads both means from one immutable source. Each port's new phase error satisfies

\[ |\eta_i^+|<(1-\lambda)/8+7\lambda/25 \leq343/2000. \tag{5} \]

All untargeted phase errors remain below 1/8. An old edge incident to a port therefore has error below 343/2000+1/8=593/2000<3/10<pi/10. An untouched old edge has error below 1/4, also below pi/10. Adding the reference principal magnitude 2*pi/5 leaves every old edge strictly below pi/2. The new edge {0,1} has error below 343/1000; each cross edge has error below 593/2000. Both are also acute. The straight phase interpolation between source and output preserves these inequalities, so no edge changes its reference integer in (1). NUL and SHA do not change phase.

Thus the ideal complete word deforms the organization within the same marked acute sector, including its two +1 constituent windings. It does not preserve the finer joint Z-ball, predict the subsequent sector lifetime, or select an autonomous occurrence of the word. The fine-to-collective continuous law and its sufficient state remain the existing twenty-two-coordinate model.

docs.title: 5. Ideal finite U6 bounds on the same domain
docs.text:
This result additionally uses the declared fixed geometric lengths and initially fresh stored pressure. It does not treat the original raw OZ snapshot as a fresh constitutive evaluation.

Write the canonical potential as Phi_s=B*p, where B_ij=1/dist(i,j)^2 for distinct nodes and the diagonal is zero. Every positive shortest distance is greater than 3/4. For any pressure difference,

\[ \frac1{20}\sum_i |(B\Delta p)_i| \leq\frac{76}{45}\|\Delta p\|_1. \tag{6} \]

The target phase displacement in IL is at most a=(3/10)*(7/25+1/8)=243/2000. Only the two ports, their four old neighbors 2,3,8,9, and cross neighbors 10,11 change fresh pressure. The sine Lipschitz bound and actual degrees give

\[ \|p_{\rm fresh}^+-p_{\rm fresh}\|_1 \leq \frac a\pi \left(2\frac87+4\frac12+2\frac13\right) =\frac{1053}{1750\pi}. \tag{7} \]

Equation (7) bounds both the completed IL stage and the completed whole word: NUL and SHA change no phase, and fresh pressure is independent of capacity and form in this selected law. NUL's raw reciprocal write instead changes only two stored pressures, with total change below 2/(7*pi). The IL raw pressure retention changes at most 2/pi; its subsequent refresh differs from that raw value by at most this amount plus (7). Therefore the largest of these conservative raw/refresh bounds is

\[ \frac{76}{45}\left(\frac2\pi+ \frac{1053}{1750\pi}\right) =\frac{346028}{78750\pi}<\frac32<\frac\pi2. \tag{8} \]

SHA does not change stored pressure before its refresh. Thus every selected ideal before/completed and raw/refreshed U6 comparison, including the fresh-source/complete-word comparison, passes the fixed pi/2 policy on this domain. These are finite snapshot bounds; they prove neither U6 confinement between later flow times nor the geometric Z-retention hypothesis. Changing the length convention, baseline, pressure law or threshold requires renewed admission. Represented fields and refresh residuals retain their own checks.

docs.title: 6. Represented controls and the frozen negative result
docs.text:
The analytical maps above use exact real arithmetic. Full runtime descent in the contextual chart instead concerns the actual configured operations on their admitted represented inputs. It preserves their exact decisions and results by the retained reconstruction; it does not make their rounded phase updates equal to the ideal formulas. A broad floating-point error bound is not inferred from the strict ideal margins.

The synthetic transition controls exercise the existing shared stages on independent preparations, retaining all live preconditions, context and U6 observations. Their controls distinguish raw pressure from refresh, and their counterexamples expose missing neighbor multiplicity, absolute form origin and persistent grammar debt. These controls establish implementation behavior, not a proof by sampling of the analytical domain. Neither the retained producer nor a new trajectory is executed by this analytical comparison.

The original represented preparation has a separate complete-word and validated-flow record. Its unchanged result certifies exit from Z<1/16 by elapsed 57/4, while every certified flow tube retains acute edges and both original windings through that time. That finite conclusion remains exactly as reported. The present contract explains how grammatical transformation and retained organizational class can coexist with that geometric departure; it does not relabel the failed prediction as successful maintenance.

The information boundary is substantive: dropping the common form origin fails through local NUL scaling, as already proved in the form-origin obstruction. On a broader raw-pressure execution domain, dropping member-associated stored pressure can change NUL density admission. In the initially fresh subdomain of section 3, that pressure is already determined by the retained phase, support and law; its explicit record is sufficient, not a minimal-state claim. Raw stages still need their declared refresh provenance and pressure map. Dropping persistent debt changes the outstanding grammatical obligations. Keeping only winding, means or unordered context inventories consequently cannot supply this collective execution map. Retaining the marked internal coordinates and their consumed context does supply the stated one-word map; physical identification, autonomous selection and unrestricted collective realization of all registered operators remain separate questions.

docs.title: Mutation action: phase work, contextual descent and geometric identity
docs.text:
ZHIR has a compatible conditional event map on the selected complete sine law. Its observed-growth gate does not determine the sign of its storage work, preserve every acute phase sector or select an occurrence time. The actual phase jump changes fresh pressure and form rates while retaining the phase-rate row. Associated histories, target marks, pressure branch and grammar remain necessary parts of collective execution state.

The admission owner establishes general temporal compatibility separately from one restricted NAV successor. This owner completes the event calculation on general admissible states. No retained research source is mutated and no continuous response campaign is evaluated. Runtime histories below are explicitly manufactured reader inputs, not observed responses of this law.

docs.title: 1. Complete law, event domain and actual action
docs.text:
Use a finite simple loop-free connected undirected graph with at least two nodes, positive conductances, signed real form x, circular phase theta and held positive capacities nu. On each continuous segment the selected law is

\[ q=L_Wx,\quad S_i=\sum_{j\sim i}\sin( heta_j- heta_i),\quad M=\operatorname{diag} rac{ u_i}{\pi d_i},\quad p_i= rac{S_i}{\pi d_i},\quad \dot x=MS,\qquad\dot heta=Mq. ag{1} \]

Here d counts distinct bare neighbors. Conductances enter q, not S or d. Pressure is independently specified by (1); it is not reconstructed from an observed response. The structural clock, unforced flow and fixed support are premises. The weighted-law owner provides its storage and support scope.

At a supplied event, retain target set A and the pre-event runtime pressure r, which can differ from the freshly evaluated p. The actual Mutation proposal chooses one of two phase branches:

\[ x_i^+=x_i,\qquad u_i^+= u_i,\qquad r_i^+=r_i,\qquad heta_i^+= heta_i+\delta_i\pmod {2\pi}, ag{2} \]

with delta_i=0 off A. On A the default branch uses delta_i=f*copysign(1,r_i)*pi/4; the canonical ideal f=1/pi gives magnitude 1/4 radian. An explicit ZHIR_theta_shift instead supplies the fixed shift. The factor owner admits the active finite factor and excludes a full-turn no-op. Its runtime arithmetic and modulo operations remain distinct from the ideal equations.

The default branch retains the sign bit at zero: positive and negative zero select opposite rotations. The fixed branch does not consume the dynamic direction or its inactive factor, but still requires the temporal gate. ZHIR consumes no random draw. It preserves support, conductances and EPI_kind; the latter is a semantic identity field, not a geometric proof.

Both branches require active capacity and an accepted live signed two-sample EPI secant strictly above xi, plus independent grammar context. Prior IL and a recent destabilizer are required; an instantaneous nu*r prediction cannot replace the secant. Histories and thresholds retain their time basis. Timestamped evidence ends at the current form, but the pure reader alone does not authenticate its last timestamp against an execution clock.

The atomic stage proposes every target from one immutable snapshot and returns target-associated decision observations, including admitted evidence, the actual phase map and recent context. It records grammar/lifecycle changes after commit. Quarter-circle regime labels and an acceleration-threshold flag are diagnostics. Two EPI samples suffice for the growth gate but not for a three-sample acceleration observation: its legacy numeric zero must not be interpreted as measured zero acceleration. Detection creates no child or support edge and proves no dynamical bifurcation.

docs.title: 2. Complete work and both refreshed evolution rows
docs.text:
For any declared real lifts, use

\[ H(x,\theta)=\frac12x^TL_Wx+ \sum_{\{i,j\}\in E}[1-\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)]. \tag{3} \]

Equation (1) conserves H between events because its two contributions are q^T MS and -S^T Mq. This auxiliary storage is not identified with a physical energy. Let g_ij=theta_j-theta_i and h_ij=delta_j-delta_i. Substitution in (2), with each undirected edge counted once, gives the exact ideal work

\[ \Delta H=\sum_{\{i,j\}\in E} [\cos g_{ij}-\cos(g_{ij}+h_{ij})]. \tag{4} \]

There is no form-storage jump, conductance factor in the phase term or capacity-storage term. Nevertheless the unchanged form contribution still uses the actual weighted Laplacian. Different source or target conductances cannot be replaced by the old unit graph when evaluating complete H.

For adjacent targets, (4) includes their common edge once. With equal shifts, that edge has zero work. Adding two isolated-target costs generally counts a change that never occurs in the joint event. At g_ij=0 with both shifts sigma, joint work minus the sum of isolated work is -2*(1-cos(sigma)). This is independent of the edge's conductance.

After constitutive refresh the exact changed rows are

\[ \Delta p_i=\frac1{\pi d_i}\sum_{j\sim i} [\sin(g_{ij}+h_{ij})-\sin g_{ij}],\qquad \Delta\dot x_i=\nu_i\Delta p_i,\qquad \Delta\dot\theta_i=0. \tag{5} \]

The last identity follows from unchanged x, capacity and support, hence unchanged Mq. Even untargeted neighbors can change pressure and form rate. Stored pressure is unchanged by the event itself; a refresh is a separate constitutive handoff. Continuing with held r instead of the new p is a different complete evolution model.

Set rho_i=d_i/nu_i and R=sum rho_i. The two continuous mean leaves use these weights. With the event lift explicitly chosen as theta^+=theta+delta,

\[ \Delta\bar x_\rho=0,\qquad \Delta\bar\theta_\rho=\frac1R\sum_i\rho_i\delta_i. \tag{6} \]

A principal circular coordinate alone does not define this lifted mean. Adding a full turn to a chosen event lift changes (6), although it does not change (4) or (5). The retained lift therefore belongs to any mean claim. A common shift of every node is an ideal global phase symmetry: storage, fresh pressure and both rows remain unchanged while the lifted phase mean changes by that shift. Runtime modulo rounding requires endpoint assessment.

Under an affine clock change s=c*t+b with c>0, scaling every capacity by 1/c scales both rows of (1) by 1/c while leaving p unchanged. Associated timestamps and xi must transform with their declared units, as in the admission owner. The angular shift, H work and normalized event means then stay the same. Keeping the numeric growth threshold while changing its time unit is a different admission policy.

docs.title: 3. Growth eligibility imposes no passivity theorem
docs.text:
Consider a target with phase zero, every neighbor at epsilon in (0,1/8), and the default positive shift sigma=1/4. Fresh pressure is positive and

\[ \Delta H=d_i[\cos\epsilon-\cos(\epsilon-1/4)]>0. \tag{7} \]

The event overshoots the neighbors: 1/4-epsilon>epsilon, and cosine strictly decreases with the magnitude of these small gaps. Take epsilon=1/10, nu_i=4 and xi=1/10. Then

\[ \dot x_i=\frac4\pi\sin(1/10)>1/10. \tag{8} \]

For example, sin(1/10)>1/10-(1/10)^3/6 and pi<22/7 prove the strict inequality. Any finite form is allowed. Smooth local backward flow exists, and continuity keeps the rate above xi on some short preceding interval. Integrating proves that genuine same-law positive secants can coexist with positive event work. No numerical trajectory is needed for this existence argument; no particular manufactured runtime record is authenticated by it.

Conversely, with every neighbor at 1/4 the same positive shift exactly aligns the target and gives Delta H=d_i*(cos(1/4)-1)<0. Capacity 4 also gives a strict rate margin above xi. Thus both signs occur inside regular acute zero-winding preparations with true short-secant compatibility. The observed growth test neither chooses a storage sign nor supplies an event reservoir.

At an exactly synchronized phase state, a default signed-zero direction instead yields positive work d_i*(1-cos(1/4)) at a single target. This additional implementation witness concerns the branch convention; it does not claim an accepted supplied history was generated from a stationary law.

docs.title: 4. Sufficient geometric preservation and an allowed obstruction
docs.text:
Fix principal edge representatives g_ij in an acute source sector. If

\[ |g_{ij}|+|\delta_j-\delta_i|<\pi/2\quad\hbox{for every edge}, \tag{9} \]

then the straight event interpolation theta+s*delta, 0<=s<=1, keeps every edge in the same principal chart and acute sector. The reference integers do not change, so each oriented cycle winding is preserved. This is a sufficient event condition; it establishes neither later maintenance nor confinement to an older joint form/phase ball.

One positive-width general domain has all phases in a common lift interval of width less than 1/4. Under arbitrary targeted default shifts of magnitude 1/4, the new interval has width less than 3/4<pi/2. This preserves the acute zero-winding class. During the actual phase-aligning IL stages, a defined neighbor resultant within an interval of width less than pi lies in that same interval; interpolation by lambda in [0,1] remains there. Consequently this phase-domain argument extends through admitted surrounding IL/OZ/SHA stages with the usual IL alignment factor: OZ and SHA do not change phase. All other state, history, capacity, grammar and U6 hypotheses still require their own admission; this phase argument does not replace them.

No unconditional acute-preservation claim holds even for default ZHIR and fresh pre-event pressure. A star with center phase 0, two leaves at 7/5 and one at -7/5 has all gaps acute. The center has

\[ p_0=\frac{\sin(7/5)}{3\pi}>0, \qquad\delta_0=1/4. \tag{10} \]

Its trailing gap becomes -7/5-1/4=-33/20, whose magnitude exceeds pi/2. At center capacity 1, the rate is also greater than xi=1/10, so the same local-flow argument supplies short genuine compatible secants. Strict source, rate and exit margins persist on a neighborhood. Valid runtime grammar and unchanged semantic kind therefore do not guarantee acute geometric identity. The star has no cycles: this example proves sector exit, not winding change. For the rate margin, the alternating lower bound through degree seven gives sin(7/5)>33/35, while 3*pi/10<33/35 follows from pi<22/7.

docs.title: 5. Collective descent and complete-word context
docs.text:
For a permutation-preserving support and capacity profile, the fine phase map is equivariant when targets, pressure directions/fixed shifts, configurations and consumed histories transform with their members. A retained contextual collective state containing that association therefore determines the event. On a twin-invariant stratum, an orbit-closed target set with equal shifts on each pair preserves the stratum. Targeting one member can leave it even while remaining acute. It then requires the larger fine state or a retained mark; the old reduced dynamics cannot be asserted for the new state.

The marked contact's eleven-cell reduction has two singleton ports and nine double cells. Acting on either singleton or on an entire double cell with equal shifts preserves its physical symmetry, conditional on the same associated context. Equal physical coordinates alone need not descend: one history can pass the live secant gate and another fail; a recent destabilizer can be present or missing. Even numerically equal +0/-0 stored pressure can choose opposite runtime shifts. The continuous mean or an unordered inventory of histories loses these distinctions.

The complete control word is

IL -> OZ -> IL -> ZHIR -> IL -> SHA.

Starting with initialized form and zero debt, its successive U2 debts are 0,1,0,1,0,0. The pre-ZHIR IL discharges OZ's debt while leaving OZ recent enough for U4b; the next IL handles ZHIR, and SHA closes the word. Every stage still needs live preconditions and its own actual observation. The shorter IL,OZ,ZHIR,IL,SHA is a valid grammar word but retains one unit of debt, so it does not satisfy the selected zero-terminal-debt condition. No initial stabilizer can prepay future destabilizations.

The synthetic complete-word control supplies timestamped EPI reader records before execution. All its chosen stages preserve form, so they do not create an EPI endpoint mismatch. They do not manufacture a new continuous response or turn operator steps into elapsed structural time. Local action controls use ZHIR's genuine validated-word step with an explicitly supplied matching live prefix context; they do not claim that such a prefix ran in that probe.

docs.title: 6. Execution evidence and remaining scope
docs.text:
The collective Mutation action controls reuse the actual public atomic stage and detached sine field owner. They check independent complete work, adjacent-target corrections, both work signs with strict nodal rate margins, raw versus refreshed pressure, both rows and lifted means, signed-zero/fixed branches, associated decision records, complete-word debt and finite U6, symmetry loss and the acute-exit counterexample. One invalid target rejects the whole phase stage before graph-owned commit. Actual represented endpoints are assessed separately from ideal arithmetic, with no second executor or new event policy.

These results complete ZHIR's bounded action compatibility under the stated law and execution premises. They do not derive occurrence, a preferred phase shift, universal collective closure, permanent identity or a physical particle. Other registered operators keep their own event and history contracts; the existing mechanism map and execution plan own cross-operator scope and subsequent work.

docs.title: Mutation compatibility: continuous rates, observed history and grammar
docs.text:
Compatibility of ZHIR with the selected complete law is a question about admissible states, temporal observations and execution context. It is not a requirement to execute every operator in one prescribed sequence. The EN/IL/SHA/NAV successor supplies a useful conditional control, while the law's larger state domain has different trigger possibilities.

This owner establishes a sharp general rate-admission condition and then separates three restrictions on that control: unavailable temporal evidence, recent-grammar rejection and a conditional continuous-rate obstruction. No trajectory, manufactured source history or Mutation event is evaluated. The research program owns subsequent investigation.

docs.title: 1. Complete law and the independent Mutation requirements
docs.text:
Use the selected weighted-form, bare-phase sine law on fixed finite simple connected undirected support, with at least two nodes, positive edge conductances, signed real form x, primitive circular phase and held positive capacities:

\[ q=L_Wx,\qquad S_i=\sum_{j\sim i}\sin(\theta_j-\theta_i),\qquad M=\operatorname{diag}\frac{\nu_i}{\pi d_i},\qquad p_i=\frac{S_i}{\pi d_i},\qquad \dot x=MS,\quad\dot\theta=Mq. \tag{1} \]

Actual conductances enter q; distinct bare neighbors define d and S. No forcing or continuous loss is present. The clock is the declared structural time. The general state domain below is not restricted to the old marked winding-one sector or to one event preparation.

The registered Mutation contract requires finite active capacity, an observed signed two-sample EPI secant strictly above its configured nonnegative threshold xi, and independent grammar context. The shared runtime gate and pure certificate separate the current nodal prediction nu_f*DeltaNFR from that observed secant. Neither an instantaneous prediction nor an acceleration diagnostic replaces the two-sample evidence. Prior IL and a recent destabilizer belong to U4b; capacity and the threshold comparison do not establish them.

The default represented ZHIR_THRESHOLD_XI=0.1 is an operational calibration, not a constant derived from (1). The following mathematical comparisons take its value and time basis as supplied. A different calibrated threshold can have a legitimate scope, but choosing one solely to force an execution would not establish a new property of this preparation.

docs.title: 2. Sharp general continuous-rate compatibility
docs.text:
Since each sine term lies in [-1,1], every state of (1) satisfies

\[ |\dot x_i|\leq rac{ u_i}{\pi}. ag{2} \]

For held capacity and an interval [t_0,t_1] of the same unforced law, with no intervening form jumps, its true signed secant satisfies

\[ r_i= rac{x_i(t_1)-x_i(t_0)}{t_1-t_0} = rac1{t_1-t_0}\int_{t_0}^{t_1}\dot x_i(t)\,dt, \qquad |r_i|\leq rac{ u_i}{\pi}. ag{3} \]

Thus nu_i<=pi*xi excludes the strict positive trigger for every such interval, without any acute-sector or winding premise. Equality is still excluded because ZHIR requires strict growth. This statement concerns true continuous-time evidence under the declared law, not every numeric history accepted by a record reader.

The capacity condition is sharp over the unrestricted phase domain. If nu_i>pi*xi, choose an angle 0<phi<pi/2 with sin(phi)>pi*xi/nu_i. Set the target phase to zero and every other phase to phi, so in particular each of its d_i neighbors contributes sin(phi). Then

\[ \dot x_i(0)= rac{ u_i}{\pi}\sin\phi>\xi. ag{4} \]

All edge gaps are zero or have magnitude phi, so this is a regular acute state, with zero cycle windings. It belongs to the complete law's state domain but not the preceding winding-one contact class. Finite signed form may be chosen independently, for example uniform form. The smooth finite-dimensional vector field has a local solution, and continuity preserves the strict rate margin on some nonzero time interval. Integrating there proves the existence of genuine short positive secants above xi.

Consequently, for a fixed nonisolated node with held positive capacity and xi>=0, there exists an admissible preparation and a short true continuous secant above xi if and only if nu_i>pi*xi. This is an existence theorem for temporal compatibility, not observed history from the retained source, grammar admission, a selected sampling interval or autonomous occurrence. It supplies no instruction to insert the constructed values into an execution record.

Positive local growth is consistent with the conserved weighted form mean: with rho_i=d_i/nu_i at positive capacities, reciprocal support gives sum_i rho_i*xdot_i=sum_i S_i/pi=0. Other nodes provide the compensating contribution. This balance does not impose zero growth at each node, and it does not prove that the constructed phase state is reachable from a particular preparation at its storage and mean values.

docs.title: 3. What the actual NAV successor does and does not supply
docs.text:
Keep the contextual Transition successor: the fixed twenty-node, 45-edge contact, its marked ports 0 and 1, nine physical twin pairs, actual weights, retained associated histories, and the selected latent NAV reset. Port capacities satisfy nu_i<3/8. The general bound (2) only gives |xdot_i|<3/(8*pi), approximately 0.1194. It does not exclude the default threshold for the entire capacity family. The lower-capacity part satisfying nu_i<=pi*xi is globally excluded by (3); no additional claim is inferred for the rest from that bound alone.

The earlier sector-specific bound has stronger hypotheses and conclusion. On the retained marked acute sector with constituent winding +1, every original forward C5 gap is positive. Its four original port neighbors contribute two positive and two negative sine terms, with total magnitude less than two; the other port and two cross neighbors contribute at most three more. Hence

\[ |S_i|<5,\qquad |\dot x_i|<B:=\frac{15}{56\pi}<\frac1{10}<\xi \quad(i=0,1), \tag{5} \]

where the final strict inequality uses the represented default 0.1. A true secant over an interval wholly in that sector, with the same held capacities, no form jumps and the same clock, obeys the same bound. Two acute endpoints do not prove intermediate-sector membership. The full earlier EN source contains a NAV sector-departure counterexample; it cannot inherit (5) merely because the word was grammatical or U6 passed. Conversely, leaving that sector does not prove that a threshold crossing will occur. The conditional obstruction and the general existence result in section 2 have different source premises.

At the actual immediate successor, two additional restrictions precede any proposed flow experiment:

  • The selected atomic EN/IL/SHA/NAV path supplies no two-sample continuous EPI history. Its form-changing jumps, stored pressure, glyph history and latency timestamps do not construct such observations. Missing evidence is unavailable, not a measured zero or a failed crossing.
  • The last three actual glyphs are IL,SHA,NAV, containing no registered destabilizer. Prior coherence and zero persistent debt do not replace this missing U4b condition. NAV is a generator/closure, not a destabilizer. The shared grammar therefore rejects ZHIR on that recent context.

These conclusions are independent. Supplying an otherwise valid crossing record to a separate synthetic control would not repair the actual recent grammar. Ordinary continuous flow or sampling does not append a destabilizing glyph, so waiting alone does not change this U4b result. Inserting an event solely to make the history pass would be a changed preparation and word, requiring its own scientific purpose and admission.

docs.title: 4. Sufficient temporal and execution state
docs.text:
The contextual collective chart must retain the data actually consumed by this operator. For each marked target, extend the physical state and associated execution context with:
