This result supplies a positive-width continuation criterion without assuming that an arbitrary environment is harmless.

docs.title: Conserved storage and backward time restrict acquisition claims
docs.text:
The full reference storage is H^*=V_5+5h. At the declared entry instant, the exact relation to an actual state is

\[ H-H^*=D+u\sum_{e\in C}\xi_e +\sin\phi\sum_{e\in C}\eta_e. \]

With the component error radii above, put

\[ L_0=|u|\sum_{\{i,j\}\in C}(r_i+r_j) +|\sin\phi|\sum_{\{i,j\}\in C}(p_i+p_j). \]

The whole declared entry box has the conserved-storage enclosure H in [H^*-L_0,H^*+L_0+D_0]. It stays valid along every covered trajectory because the full law conserves H.

If its upper bound is below 7/2, the phase-flat acquisition barrier excludes every phase-flat source from reaching this entry box. In the vanishing-width limit, a necessary compatibility condition is

\[ h\ge\frac{7/2-V_5}{5} =\frac{5\sqrt5-11}{20}. \]

This floor neither proves entry nor uniquely selects a pulse. The larger sector proof also excludes any initial zero-winding receiver from a target box whose conserved full storage is strictly below 7/2. Initial winding and the actual full budget remain separate admitted observations; a nonacute unit-winding source is not automatically covered by that particular zero-winding test.

A named acquisition source must also have a conserved storage compatible with the declared box. For example Section 38's private-leaf ramp x_(5+i)=-3omega(i-2) has exact full storage 45omega^2. Its large-rate acquisition cannot be joined to a small-error reference with h=1/50 and full storage near V_5+1/10: the budgets are disjoint. Discarding that discrepancy would remove the actual environmental state or silently introduce loss. Budget overlap is necessary, not sufficient, for a new favorable preparation to acquire into this neighborhood.

The error estimate also holds backward for the same finite duration. Every admitted entry-box state already had the acute identity over its certified preceding window. Hence this certificate cannot describe first appearance at the central instant; an initially identity-absent preparation must precede that window if the same support and law apply throughout. Formation followed by later stabilization remains a separate possibility.

The example u=1/5, phi=0, Gamma=1/4, rho_R=rho_C=1/10, T=5 and nodal form/phase error radii 1/1000 gives a nonzero-width finite retention certificate with a moving reference. These declared values illustrate the sufficient inequalities without optimizing a threshold or executing a new trajectory. Setting the reference pulse to zero gives a complementary low-storage control: maintenance can be certified while phase-flat acquisition is excluded.

assess_sine_moving_pattern_window rebuilds the declared reference and applies these independent chart, reference-motion, storage-growth and acquisition-budget checks. It also encloses full storage directly from the primitive edge uncertainty boxes. When the initial receiver chart is certified, the lower bound additionally retains its correlated cycle minimum V_5, rather than independently minimizing all five phase gaps. The primitive enclosure remains valid when the relative-storage certificate is unavailable. The contract and usage retain the distinction between a certified finite neighborhood and an independently demonstrated formation-to-retention handoff.

docs.title: 41. Actual contact motion can exchange storage with internal structure
docs.text: The contact pendulum of Section 39 conserves its own storage only on the exact compatible family. Away from that family, the same full nodal law supplies a correction from unequal contact phases. This identifies an actual exchange mechanism to examine, rather than adding a controller or assuming that a prepared compatible pattern has already formed.

docs.title: Mean-contact rows from the complete state
docs.text:
Keep the unchanged conservative unit C5/private-leaf support of Sections 39–40. Match receiver node r_i with its actual private leaf l_i. No uniformity of the observed forms or phases is assumed. Define

\[ a=\frac15\sum_i x_{r_i},\qquad b=\frac15\sum_i x_{l_i},\qquad u=a-b, \]

and, in declared continuous phase lifts,

\[ \phi_i=\theta_{l_i}-\theta_{r_i},\qquad \bar\phi=\frac15\sum_i\phi_i,\qquad \eta_i=\phi_i-\bar\phi,\qquad \sum_i\eta_i=0. \]

Internal cycle currents cancel in the receiver mean. Summing the complete phase rows cancels its internal form Laplacian as well. In tau=t/pi, the exact mean-contact laws are therefore

\[ \boxed{u'=\frac43\left\langle\sin\phi_i\right\rangle, \qquad \bar\phi'=-\frac43u,} \]

where brackets denote the mean over the five contacts. Equivalently, if Z=<exp(i eta_i)>, then u'=(4/3) Im[exp(i bar_phi) Z]. The contact deviations are live fine-state coordinates. Replacing Z by one recovers the exact compatible family, but it is not justified for an arbitrary acquired state.

Define the chart-dependent collective contact storage

\[ h_c=\tfrac12u^2+1-\cos\bar\phi. \]

Its exact derivative is

\[ \boxed{h_c' =\frac43u\left[ \left\langle\sin(\bar\phi+\eta_i)\right\rangle -\sin\bar\phi\right].} \]

Thus collective contact storage is not a second general invariant. Its exchange with the remaining structure can have either sign. The formula does not select an initial source, a direction of long-time transfer or a new constitutive law.

docs.title: The storage split retains its phase-lift dependence
docs.text:
Let d_i=x_(r_i)-x_(l_i), and use F_R,V_R for the actual internal receiver stores. Direct edge summation gives

\[ \begin{aligned} H&=5h_c+\mathcal R,\\ \mathcal R &=F_R+V_R+\frac12\sum_i(d_i-u)^2\\ &\quad+\sum_i\left[ U(\bar\phi+\eta_i)-U(\bar\phi) -\sin\bar\phi\,\eta_i\right], \qquad U(s)=1-\cos s. \end{aligned} \]

Consequently R'=-5h_c' because the full storage H is conserved. The remainder is signed in general. If all segments joining bar_phi to the five contact phases lie in one convex cosine-potential chart, its contact terms are nonnegative. Even in that chart, nonnegativity does not make the remainder an independently controlled reservoir or specify when it feeds the receiver. Its actual transfer remains fixed by the full rows.

The contact mean uses retained real lifts. Independently wrapping each contact and then averaging can change bar_phi, h_c and the signed remainder, while leaving the actual full storage unchanged. A single snapshot can declare a starting lift, but it does not reconstruct discarded phase history. These collective coordinates are not new globally intrinsic physical energies. The common-real-phase preparation below fixes their initial lift unambiguously, and the complete smooth phase rows continue it.

docs.title: A phase-flat preparation has a discriminating fourth derivative
docs.text:
At a preparation with one common real phase, set v_i=phi_i'(0), m=<v_i>=-4u/3, and delta_i=v_i-m. All form rates vanish initially. The first three derivatives of h_c are zero. Differentiating the exact transfer row gives

\[ \boxed{h_c^{(4)}(0) =\frac{16u^2}{3}\left\langle\delta_i^2\right\rangle -\frac{4u}{3}\left\langle\delta_i^3\right\rangle.} \]

To check the cancellation, write g=<sin(phi_i)>-sin(bar_phi). At zero phase, g=g'=g''=0, and g'''=-(<v_i^3>-m^3); mean higher phase jets cancel because bar_phi=<phi_i> exactly. Expanding <(m+delta_i)^3> gives the displayed variance and third-moment terms. This is a local derivative of the full law, not a finite-time approximation substituted for it.

docs.title: One phase-flat preparation above the necessary phase-path budget
docs.text:
On receiver nodes (0,...,4) and private leaves (5,...,9), supply

\[ u=\frac{119}{100},\qquad \epsilon=\frac1{20},\qquad x_{r_i}=\frac u4+\epsilon(\mathbf1_{i=0}-\mathbf1_{i=1}), \qquad x_{l_i}=-\frac{3u}{4}, \]

with all phases zero. The weighted form and phase means are zero. The initial receiver has zero winding, so the proposed acute unit-winding identity is absent. Exact edge summation gives

\[ H=\frac52u^2+4\epsilon^2 =\frac{14201}{4000}=3.55025. \]

This is above the necessary 7/2 phase-path barrier. It does not make Section 40's particular small-error reference box accessible. That box retains acute receiver winding, hence V_R>=V_5; its five contact form gaps are each at least 1/5-2/1000=99/500. Consequently every state in that box satisfies the sharper, correlation-aware lower bound

\[ H\ge V_5+\frac52\left(\frac{99}{500}\right)^2 =V_5+\frac{9801}{100000} >\frac{14201}{4000}. \]

An independent componentwise edge enclosure can overlap the source budget while forgetting this exact cycle constraint. Such outer-interval overlap is not accessibility. Conservation excludes a handoff to that fixed box; the control tests finite acute identity only. Any later maintenance neighborhood requires its own source-compatible storage admission, without post hoc damping or removal of environmental state.

Removing the transverse dipole gives an exactly invariant zero-winding contact-pulse control. The control is not claimed to have the same energy as the nonzero-dipole source. Its invariant geometry supplies the analytic comparison without a second numerical response or amplitude search.

For the nonzero dipole, the actual centered contact velocities are

\[ (\delta_0,\ldots,\delta_4) =\frac1{60}(-7,7,-1,0,1),\qquad \langle\delta_i^2\rangle=\frac1{180},\qquad \langle\delta_i^3\rangle=0. \]

Therefore h_c^(4)(0)=4u^2/135>0. Time reversal at common initial phase makes form even and phase odd, so locally

\[ h_c(\tau)=h_c(0)+\frac{u^2}{810}\tau^4+O(\tau^6). \]

The first nonzero transfer is toward the collective contact pulse. It does not give immediate transfer into the desired organized receiver. This also does not mean every receiver field is stationary: internal form and phase can exchange while the aggregate remainder decreases. That local result does not decide whether later modulation produces the target identity; the separate finite response below evaluates that question.

docs.title: Retained full-law control excludes acute winding on its declared horizon
docs.text:
One bounded control used exactly this preparation, unchanged law and support. Its declared original-clock horizon was t in [0,24], time step 3/32, Taylor order 12 and at most 256 steps. The observation asked whether acute receiver winding +1 or -1 holds for an original-clock duration of at least 1/2, with strict positive acute margin; the configured margin threshold is zero.

The declaration and frozen protocol preceded evaluation. Outward dyadic intervals contain the declared exact rational preparation; their centers do not replace it. The retained response completed all 256 steps without an evaluation error, covering the full original-clock interval [0,24]. Every whole-time tube certifies receiver winding zero. The verdict is therefore acute_winding_excluded_on_horizon, not incomplete or unresolved evidence. The source archive retains the evaluated implementation and preparation.

Initial regional storage is 3/400=0.0075; its final enclosure is contained in [0.0061989419859282,0.0061989419859330]. The endpoint full-storage enclosure contains the conserved exact value 14201/4000=3.55025. Thus exceeding the necessary phase-path budget and breaking the unseeded family's reflection symmetry did not produce the target identity in this control. The local fourth derivative did not supply that finite verdict; the whole-time proof did.

The exclusion concerns this source, complete law, support and horizon. It excludes neither later acquisition nor other admitted preparations. There is no response-driven retry, extended horizon, retuning or added loss. Even a positive acute-entry response would still need source-compatible full-state evidence for Section 40's subsequent maintenance window; this negative response supplies no such handoff.

observe_sine_collective_pulse in the shared partition owner rebuilds these actual-state means, feedback and optional flat-phase jet. It retains explicit integer contact-turn offsets and the signed remainder; it does not simulate the declared finite response. The contract and usage example describe its detached evidence and availability.

docs.title: A structural alternative separates storage release from acquisition
docs.text:
The same law admits a different initial transfer sign without changing its coefficients or waiting longer. Keep all receiver forms equal to a, all leaf forms equal to b, and all receiver phases equal. Write u=a-b>0 and supply contact lifts phi_i=gamma+eta_i, with mean(eta_i)=0. For a symmetric, nonconstant deviation multiset with abs(eta_i)<min(gamma,pi/2-gamma) and 0<gamma<pi/2, S=mean(sin eta_i)=0 and C=mean(cos eta_i)<1. Then

\[ h_c'(0)=\frac43u(C-1)\sin\gamma<0. \]

This is an exact release from collective contact storage into its signed remainder. It is not merely a different scalar bookkeeping observation: the full law also forces an internal receiver response. Put s_i=sin(phi_i) and let indices follow the C5 cycle. Initially,

\[ x_{r_i}'=\frac{s_i}{3},\qquad \theta_{r_i}'=\frac u3,\qquad \theta_{r_i}''=\frac{6s_i-s_{i-1}-s_{i+1}}9. \]

The receiver starts with zero internal form and phase storage. Direct differentiation of its edge sums gives

\[ F_R''(0)=\frac19\sum_i(s_{i+1}-s_i)^2,\qquad V_R^{(4)}(0)=3\sum_i (\theta_{r_{i+1}}''-\theta_{r_i}'')^2. \]

For phase storage all lower derivatives vanish: the initial relative phases and their first rates are zero. Both displayed quantities are strictly positive when s is nonconstant, since 6I-A_C5 has strictly positive eigenvalues and preserves the constant/nonconstant decomposition. Thus internal form grows at order tau^2 and internal phase storage at order tau^4 for a sufficiently short nonzero interval. No acute winding, directed full-cycle passage or finite-width handoff follows from that local onset.

In particular, choose 0<rho<min(gamma,pi/2-gamma) and the cyclic deviations (rho,-rho,-rho,rho,0). Reflection i -> 3-i (mod 5), including the matched private leaves, preserves this source. The complete law preserves that symmetry by the same equivariance and uniqueness argument, so the receiver cannot acquire nonzero winding whenever no receiver edge is antipodal; in particular, acute unit winding is excluded. Nevertheless this source has h_c'(0)<0 and both positive internal derivatives above. Permuting the same multiset to (rho,rho,-rho,-rho,0) removes that particular reflection obstruction while leaving the initial contact resultant, transfer rate and total storage unchanged:

\[ H=\frac52u^2+5-(1+4\cos\rho)\cos\gamma. \]

Removing a symmetry obstruction is not a formation theorem. This exact comparison explains the next admission question: which ordered contact geometry transfers into a directed receiver phase configuration while retaining a source-compatible full-state maintenance budget? A negative collective transfer rate or a growing internal store cannot answer it alone. These conditional preparations are not an additional scheduled response, parameter search or modification of the frozen control.

docs.title: 45. Complete contact feedback distinguishes cancellation from rigidity
docs.text: The relative-rate identity at the end of Section 44 gives an instantaneous condition. Its persistence depends on both the receiver's internal current and the actual contact response. The same conservative unit C5/private-leaf law supplies the needed derivatives and admits a precise classification of exactly rigid receiver geometry. A finite retained identity need not be rigid, so this classification does not replace the broader acquisition and retention question.

docs.title: The complete centered rows and their derivatives
docs.text:
Use L=L_R, the five-node cycle Laplacian, and let P remove the receiver mean. In matched receiver/leaf order put

\[ \vartheta=P\theta_R,\qquad q=Px_R,\qquad r=x_R-x_Q, \qquad u=\langle r\rangle,\qquad \phi=\theta_Q-\theta_R, \]

in continuous phase lifts. Let s=S_C5(vartheta) be the incoming internal sine current and f=sin(phi) componentwise. The full normalized rows give

\[ q'=\frac13(s+Pf),\qquad r'=\frac13s+\frac43f,\qquad u'=\frac43\langle f\rangle, \] \[ \boxed{\vartheta'=\frac13(Lq+Pr),\qquad \phi'=-\frac13(Lq+4r).} \]

All derivatives in this section use tau=t/pi. Differentiating the first phase row and retaining the actual contact current gives

\[ \boxed{\vartheta''=\frac19\bigl[(L+I_5)s+(L+4I_5)Pf\bigr].} \]

Define L_cos(vartheta) as the cycle Laplacian whose edge weights are cos(vartheta_j-vartheta_i). Since s'=-L_cos(vartheta)vartheta', one more derivative is

\[ \boxed{\vartheta'''=\frac19\left[-(L+I_5)L_{\cos}(\vartheta)\vartheta' +(L+4I_5)P\bigl(\cos\phi\mathbin{\odot}\phi'\bigr)\right],} \]

where odot denotes componentwise multiplication. None of these rows assumes that a small regional storage, a zero measured rate or a collective mean determines the environmental coordinates.

docs.title: Vanishing first and second rates do not imply a fixed geometry
docs.text:
Prepare receiver phases at a uniform unit twist, copy each phase to its private leaf, and choose any nonzero centered form vector q. Supply r=u*1-Lq; receiver and leaf forms can then be reconstructed with any declared common form origin. Initially s=0, phi=0, and

\[ \vartheta'=0,\qquad \vartheta''=0,\qquad \boxed{\vartheta'''=\frac19(L+4I_5)Lq\ne0.} \]

Both factors on the centered subspace are invertible. In particular, for q=kappa*(1,-1,0,0,0), the exact third derivative is

\[ \vartheta'''=\kappa(22/9,-22/9,1,0,-1). \]

The contact phase differences have rates Lq-4u*1/3 at that instant (the absolute leaf phase rates are Lq-u*1). Their subsequent sine currents break the initial compensation and produce the cubic receiver response. This is an initial derivative of the complete field, not a finite-time trajectory estimate. It excludes the inference that even simultaneous zero first and second relative rates prove rigidity.

docs.title: Exact rigidity has no additional moving compensation family
docs.text:
Suppose the receiver has a fixed relative phase geometry on a nonempty open time interval, so vartheta'=0 throughout that interval. The full finite sine vector field is real analytic, its solutions exist for all real time, and their storage is finite and conserved. The global bound |x_i'|<=1 and the linear phase row permit at most linear form growth and quadratic lifted-phase growth on finite intervals, precluding finite-time blowup in either direction. Consequently the analytic identity vartheta'=0 extends to the entire solution. In particular vartheta, and hence s, are constant.

The first two vanishing phase rows imply

\[ Pr=-Lq,\qquad Pf=-(L+4I_5)^{-1}(L+I_5)s, \qquad q'=(L+4I_5)^{-1}s. \]

Thus q' is constant. But the receiver form storage q^T Lq/2 is bounded above by the conserved full storage H; since L is positive definite on centered vectors, q is bounded for all real time. A nonzero constant q' is impossible. Therefore

\[ s=0,\qquad Pf=0,\qquad q=\text{constant},\qquad \phi_i'=a_i-4u/3,\quad a=Lq,\quad\sum_i a_i=0. \]

Every contact sine equals one common analytic function m(tau). For any pair of contacts the analytic identity

\[ 0=\sin\phi_i-\sin\phi_j =2\sin\frac{\phi_i-\phi_j}{2} \cos\frac{\phi_i+\phi_j}{2} \]

forces at least one factor to vanish identically: if one analytic factor is nonzero somewhere, the other vanishes on an open interval and hence everywhere. The corresponding continuous lifts either differ by a fixed multiple of 2pi, or sum to a fixed odd multiple of pi.

In the supplementary case, summing their phase rates gives a_i+a_j-8u/3=0, forcing u to be constant. Since u'=4m/3, this forces m=0 identically. If m is not identically zero, all contacts must instead agree modulo 2pi. Their equal derivatives imply that all a_i agree, hence a=0 and q=0. Both form blocks are uniform and all contact phases agree: this is precisely the moving compatible family of Section 39, with its actual contact pendulum.

If m=0 identically, each contact phase is a fixed integer multiple of pi. Its zero derivative gives a_i=4u/3 at every node, hence u=0, a=0 and q=0. All forms are equal throughout the full graph, and every phase is stationary. Individual contacts can be aligned or antialigned; these mixed-contact states are equilibria, not another moving compensation mechanism.

Finally, at an acute cycle critical point s=0 forces all oriented edge sines to agree. Sine is injective on the acute interval, so unit winding forces the uniform gaps +2pi/5 or -2pi/5. Thus an exactly rigid acute unit-winding receiver belongs either to the known uniform-block moving family or to a static equilibrium with zero contact torques. This classifies individual rigid trajectories, rather than only families required to close for every supplied collective state.

docs.title: A retained second-order description exposes the same feedback
docs.text:
The contact row also gives the exact equation

\[ \boxed{\phi''=-\frac19 [(L+4I_5)s+(L+16I_5)\sin\phi].} \]

Together with the displayed equation for vartheta'', this is a closed second-order description of four centered receiver phase coordinates and five contact phases. It retains nine initial velocities, rather than claiming a first-order closure from instantaneous phases alone. If v=vartheta' and c=phi', the original relative forms reconstruct exactly by

\[ Lq=Pc+4v,\qquad Pr=-Pc-v,\qquad u=-\frac34\langle c\rangle. \]

The inverse of L is restricted to the centered subspace. The two conserved degree-weighted form and lifted-phase means recover the common origins: if they are m_x,m_theta, the receiver form mean is m_x+u/4 and its phase mean is m_theta-<phi>/4. The leaf state then follows from x_Q=x_R-r and theta_Q=theta_R+phi.

These eighteen relative coordinates plus the two origins carry the same twenty fine form/phase coordinates. This is a support-specific instance of the exact form/phase representation, not an information loss, a new microscopic law or an additional research branch. It makes explicit where the environmental response re-enters a putatively compensated receiver.

docs.title: Consequence for the longer retention question
docs.text:
Exact entry from outside either rigid invariant family at a finite time remains excluded by uniqueness. That fact does not rule out acute identity with bounded internal evolution. In the compensated example with u=0, the full storage is V_5+13kappa^2; sufficiently small nonzero kappa gives H<B, where B=5-4cos(3pi/8) is the acute-face barrier. The regional barrier then protects its already prepared acute identity even though the nonzero third derivative proves it is not rigid. This is maintenance of an initially present identity, not formation from zero winding.

The prospective formation-to-retention requirement of a scaled duration at least one is not closed by these derivative or rigidity results. Its permissible targets can evolve internally. They still require actual full-state entry, bounded accumulated relative transport and compatible regional work over that duration. Instantaneous compensation is a useful quantity to inspect, but it is not a substitute for those interval bounds.

In particular, each target edge i->j needs a continuous lift satisfying

\[ \left|\delta_{ij}(0)+\int_0^s[v_j(\tau)-v_i(\tau)]\,d\tau\right| <\frac\pi2\qquad\text{for every }0\le s\le1, \]

with the declared winding sector and full-state uncertainty retained. Cancellation only at the endpoint cannot establish this prefix condition. The generic gap-acceleration bound of four gives a phase-error radius of two at this horizon, already greater than pi/2; that estimate alone cannot certify the required acute interval, even from zero initial relative rate. The actual restoring and contact feedback, or existing validated full-state enclosures, must supply tighter state-dependent control. These are consequences of the selected complete sine law, not a proof that it is the uniquely emerging law of TNFR.

docs.title: Collective IL/OZ actions and constitutive-pressure handoff
docs.text: This owner gives exact-real conditional identities, a simultaneous-IL maintenance theorem and a frozen represented handoff on the actual maintained count-three contact. The executed word retains the joint identity and exhibits the predicted OZ refresh equivalence. Its frozen per-target IL phase-error certificate was unresolved in the original report; a separate retained-input review now certifies the original error allowance. Direct endpoint and work checks have independent support. The research program alone selects further work; the result and its accuracy distinction remain here. No additional pressure law, event selector or research queue is introduced.

docs.title: 1. Consumed state and the selected complete law
docs.text:
Retain the actual twenty-node, 45-edge contact of SINE_PROXIMITY_CONTACT: forty old unit edges, the internal A0 edge and four A0--B0 edges. All actual weights remain attached to their endpoints and held fixed. The capacities are nu=1/2 on the two A0 targets and one elsewhere; bare degrees are seven on A0, six on B0 and four elsewhere. Use signed real form, primitive circular phase with its declared lifts, no forcing or continuous loss, and the original structural clock.

Write the consumed continuous state as y=(x,theta,nu,U,W), and put

\[ S_i(\theta)=\sum_{j\sim i}\sin(\theta_j-\theta_i),\qquad \Phi_i(y)=\frac{S_i(\theta)}{\pi d_i},\qquad M=\operatorname{diag}\frac{\nu_i}{\pi d_i}. \]

The law is independently specified by

\[ \dot x=MS(\theta),\qquad \dot\theta=ML_Wx. \]

The stored pressure p_store consumed by operators is a distinct channel. It need not equal the freshly evaluated constitutive pressure Phi. Keep execution state k as well: associated histories, grammar and lifecycle state, timestamps, policy inputs, random progress and required telemetry. Thus an operator acts on more than y, even when the subsequent continuous law consumes only y. The parameter foundation and form foundation own this distinction; no pressure is reconstructed from a measured form rate.

The continuous storage and mean weights are

\[ H(y)=\frac12x^TL_Wx+\sum_{\{i,j\}\in U}(1-\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)), \qquad \rho_i=\frac{d_i}{\nu_i}. \]

Here rho=14 on A0, six on B0 and four elsewhere, with totals rho_A=60,rho_B=44,rho_all=104. H and both global rho-weighted form and lifted-phase means are conserved between events. Stored pressure and execution state do not occur in this particular H or these flow rows.

Use the same common-aligned twist reference theta_* and joint observation

\[ Z^2=\|P_{20}x\|^2+\|P_{20}(\theta-\theta_*)\|^2,\qquad r=1/16. \]

The proved storage barrier is H-H_*>=Z^2/25 on Z<=r, with boundary value 1/6400. The maintained source and its independent-registration extension have Z<r and strict storage excess below that value. Those hypotheses, not a diagnostic coherence label, are used below.

docs.title: 2. Pressure refresh and the exact OZ projection equivalence
docs.text:
Let pi_c(y,p_store,k)=y denote projection onto the consumed continuous state. An admitted canonical OZ action, including its ordinary propagation or noise branch when enabled and finite, changes stored pressure and execution context while preserving x, phase, capacity, support and weights. Consequently

\[ \pi_c\circ J_{\rm OZ}=\pi_c,\qquad \Phi(\pi_c J_{\rm OZ}z)=\Phi(\pi_c z). \]

An immediate refresh that evaluates this specified Phi therefore assigns the same constitutive pressure with or without that OZ action. The complete fixed-law continuation from the projected state is identical in both cases for all time, provided no further events, controllers or inputs consume the changed execution state. OZ also has Delta H=0 in this model because H does not contain stored pressure.

These are projection and continuation identities, not equality of the full operator states. OZ can leave different grammar debt, lineage, history, propagation records, random progress or diagnostic flags. Those differences can affect later eligibility or execution. Removing OZ from a word requires a separate argument about those later consumers; it does not follow from its continuous-state neutrality.

The OZ mechanism includes multiplicative pressure amplification, a nonzero near-zero seed, optional jitter and signed accumulation of neighbor contributions. The default gain (pi+1)/pi is a supplied factor. The local amplification and final merged pressure are different observations; incoming positive contributions can cancel negative pressure. None of these branches supplies a pressure lifetime or a retained forcing term in the selected continuous model.

The mathematical projection above is not a new runtime operator. A detached weighted-field report evaluates Phi without mutating stored pressure. An executed refresh must use its declared callback boundary and selected-law writer; the default mixed-pressure callback is not this law. A held-pressure interval or an additional pressure-memory/input model would have different premises and does not inherit this equivalence automatically.

docs.title: 3. The full simultaneous IL action
docs.text:
The shared IL kernel contracts each selected stored pressure by its admitted retention factor. The ordinary default is pi/(pi+1). Unlike the pressure-only glyph, the public class and immutable snapshot stage also propose a phase change. For target i, define its unweighted old-neighbor resultant

\[ \mathcal R_i=\sum_{j\sim i}e^{i\theta_j}=R_i e^{i\mu_i},\qquad a_i=\operatorname{wrap}(\mu_i-\theta_i),\qquad d_i^{\rm IL}=\lambda a_i. \]

The event writes theta_i'=theta_i+d_i^IL modulo 2*pi and preserves x, nu, U and W. The admitted phase coefficient lies in [0,1]; its ordinary implementation default is 0.3. The theorem below covers this entire interval and selects no new coefficient. Both A0 targets read the same immutable snapshot. Neither proposal observes the other's new phase. The kernel also has declared isolated/zero-resultant fallbacks, although the maintained contact domain below excludes those cases locally.

Storage, identity and mean calculations retain the continuous endpoint lift theta_i+d_i^IL. A wrapped storage representative near 2*pi must not be mistaken for a large physical displacement from a nearby zero lift.

The default IL retention and OZ amplification are reciprocals only in their ideal scalar multiplicative branches. They are not inverse hybrid actions: IL can change phase, OZ has near-zero/propagation/noise branches, both change execution context, and a declared refresh can intervene. Even cancellation of two stored-pressure factors would not reverse IL's phase reset or erase its history.

The actual staged word still needs live input and grammar admission. This section defines the primary map conditional on admission; it does not claim that every point in a mathematical identity neighborhood has the history, stored pressure or active runtime settings required to execute that word. Represented trigonometric rounding is also distinct from the exact-real event considered in the proof.

docs.title: 4. Uniform local resultant and phase-displacement bounds
docs.text:
Let u and v be the adjacent A0 targets. Each has its partner, four old A1/A4 neighbors and two B0 neighbors. At the common-aligned reference, its neighbor resultant is

\[ R_*=3+4\cos(2\pi/5)=2+\sqrt5. \]

This is a local resultant. The whole doubled-twist reference has zero first circular resultant, so it does not define a global resultant angle. The proof instead uses the already declared continuous lifts.

For a state in Z<r, write theta=theta_*+c*1+eta, where eta=P_20(theta-theta_*) and ||eta||<r. On either seven-neighbor set, the elementary bound |exp(i*t)-1|<=|t| gives

\[ |e^{-ic}\mathcal R_i-R_*| \le\sum_{j\sim i}|\eta_j| \le\sqrt7\,\|\eta\|<\frac{\sqrt7}{16}<\frac16. \]

Since sqrt(5)>11/5, the real part of exp(-i*c)*Rcal_i exceeds 2+11/5-1/6>4, and its imaginary part has magnitude below 1/6. Hence

\[ R_i>4,\qquad |\mu_i-c|<\arctan(1/24)<1/24 \]

on the unique local direction near c. Each target's reference phase is zero, so |theta_i-c|<1/16. The shortest target displacement is unique and satisfies

\[ \boxed{|a_i|<\frac1{16}+\frac1{24}=\frac5{48}<\frac18.} \]

These bounds require neither equal target members nor equal boundary conductances. The phase mechanism uses bare neighbors; its local resultant is not weighted by the actual conductances.

docs.title: 5. Exact shared-edge correction for two simultaneous targets
docs.text:
For clarity put d_u=d_u^IL,d_v=d_v^IL in this section, and write delta=theta_v-theta_u. If only target i moved with its old neighbors fixed, its incident phase-storage change would be

\[ G_i=R_i\left[\cos a_i-\cos((1-\lambda)a_i)\right]. \]

Adding the two such expressions counts the shared edge as two independent single-target changes. The true simultaneous storage jump is instead

\[ \Delta H=G_u+G_v+C_{uv}, \] \[ \begin{aligned} C_{uv}={}&\cos(\delta-d_u)+\cos(\delta+d_v) -\cos\delta-\cos(\delta+d_v-d_u)\\ ={}&-4\cos\left(\delta+\frac{d_v-d_u}{2}\right) \sin\frac{d_u}{2}\sin\frac{d_v}{2}. \end{aligned} \]

All other edges are counted correctly in G_u+G_v; edges not touching u or v do not change. The form part of H is unchanged. The correction has coefficient one because the phase potential uses bare support, even though the internal edge's form conductance is the actual omega.

The correction has no general sign, but always obeys

\[ |C_{uv}|\le|d_ud_v|\le\frac12(d_u^2+d_v^2). \]

For example, on a graph consisting of one edge, full snapshot alignment with lambda=1 exchanges its two distinct phases. The true phase storage is unchanged although each separately evaluated single-target cost is negative. The correction supplies exactly the missing positive amount. Thus the existing single-target IL inequality cannot simply be summed for adjacent targets.

For the maintained contact, the local bounds in Section 4 give a uniform negative allowance that controls this correction. On 0<=s<=1/8, sin(s)>=3*s/4, since cos(s)>=1-s^2/2>3/4. For 0<lambda<=1,

\[ \begin{aligned} G_i &=-R_i\int_{(1-\lambda)|a_i|}^{|a_i|}\sin s\,ds\\ &\le-\frac{3R_i}{8}(2\lambda-\lambda^2)a_i^2\\ &\le-\frac32\left(\frac2\lambda-1\right)d_i^2. \end{aligned} \]

For nonzero d_i the last bound is strict because R_i>4. Combining both targets with the shared-edge correction yields

\[ \boxed{\Delta H\le-(d_u^2+d_v^2)\le0.} \]

The first inequality is strict whenever at least one displacement is nonzero. If both vanish, the phase-storage change is zero. At lambda=0 the primary phase map is the identity and the storage jump is exactly zero, while the stored-pressure and execution-context changes may remain. This proves conditional simultaneous passivity on this contact domain; it is not a universal theorem for arbitrary support or simultaneous IL stages, nor a strict-response lower bound for every admitted source.

docs.title: 6. The reset path preserves the existing joint identity
docs.text:
A nonpositive endpoint storage jump alone would not exclude jumping to a different geometric neighborhood. The actual finite phase displacement also has a continuous comparison path

\[ \theta(s)=\theta+s d^{\rm IL},\qquad 0\le s\le1, \]

with x, nu, U and W fixed. Every prefix uses the same snapshot resultants and equals the ideal simultaneous formula with coefficient s*lambda. The preceding work identity and estimate therefore give

\[ H(x,\theta(s))-H(x,\theta)\le -s^2(d_u^2+d_v^2)\le0. \]

This inequality is computed from the initial snapshot and does not assume that the whole path already lies inside the identity radius. Suppose the prestate has Z<r and H-H_*<1/6400, as every state on the proved maintained continuation does. If the reset path first reached Z=r, the existing boundary barrier would require H-H_*>=1/6400 there, contradicting its nonincreasing storage. Thus the entire path and the actual endpoint retain Z<r and the strict storage margin.

Restarting the same held weighted law from that endpoint preserves the identity for all subsequent structural time by the existing conservative barrier proof. An admitted OZ pressure-only action and the selected-law refresh do not alter this conclusion because they leave y fixed. This argument supplies no occurrence schedule or phase-flow law for IL: the path is a geometric certificate for a supplied jump, not an asserted finite-duration dynamics or an interpolation executed by the engine.

docs.title: 7. Mean leaves, fresh rates and sufficient collective information
docs.text:
IL leaves the global weighted form mean unchanged. Its global lifted-phase mean changes by

\[ \Delta\mu_\theta=\frac{14(d_u+d_v)}{104} =\frac7{52}(d_u+d_v). \]

Using the joined regional phase observations, the jumps are Delta Theta_A=7*(d_u+d_v)/30 and Delta Theta_B=0. The post-event continuous flow conserves these new means; it need not retain the pre-event phase-mean leaf. Translating the common reference phase to match the new global mean changes neither H nor Z.

The fresh continuous rows have distinct instantaneous behavior:

\[ \Delta(\dot\theta)=0,\qquad \Delta(\dot x)=M\left[S(\theta+d^{\rm IL})-S(\theta)\right]. \]

The first identity follows from unchanged x, W and nu. The second is the specified constitutive recomputation, not multiplication of the old form rate by IL's stored-pressure retention. Fresh pressure can change at the targets and their neighbors; OZ has zero changes in both fresh rows when y is unchanged. A nodal product built from stale stored pressure is a different observation and cannot replace these evaluated rows.

For the two IL phase proposals, the common external phasor from the six neighbors other than u and v, together with both target phases, determines both local resultants. That small description suffices for these primary phase proposals and their incident phase work. It does not replace the full fine state needed for subsequent motion, the separate A/B boundary associations needed for regional exchange, or the retained stored pressure and execution context needed for admission.

Any relabeling symmetry must transport target selection, node state, conductance endpoints, histories and rank-dependent policies together. A snapshot-equivariant primary formula does not create a pair-symmetric continuous quotient for generic actual weights. Neither a common phase mean nor an unordered multiset of independent histories proves descent of the complete word.

docs.title: 8. Reuse and memory boundaries
docs.text:
The complete reset accounting and identity-retention method provide the useful pattern: retain actual event work, sufficient endpoint state and an applicable barrier. The present proof re-admits their method on this support and corrects its overlapping IL edge explicitly. It does not transfer coefficients from an unweighted or dissipative comparison.

The memory owner, nonlinear constituent memory and ontology distinction separate eliminated dynamical state, supplied delayed history and operator execution context. Hidden fine initialization can affect a reduced future, and execution history can affect a later operator. Neither fact supplies an independent lifetime for an overwritten stored-pressure intervention. A history buffer or reciprocal scalar factor is not a realization of a derived memory kernel.

Even differentiating the selected constitutive pressure produces only a consequence on its own state constraint. With D_b=diag(d_i) and the bare phase Hessian K(theta)=L_(cos(theta_j-theta_i)),

\[ \dot\Phi=-\frac1\pi D_b^{-1}K(\theta)ML_Wx. \]

This follows by differentiating Phi=D_b^{-1}S/pi under the already specified complete law. It does not prescribe an independent pressure state away from p=Phi(y), authorize an arbitrary pressure reset there, or add a memory/source law. Any such extension needs its own hypotheses, initial-state admission and discrimination.

If a later study explicitly declares an interval that consumes stored pressure instead, put r_p=p_store-Phi(y) and retain the same phase row. The hypothetical form row and its exact storage balance would be

\[ \dot x=\operatorname{diag}(\nu)(\Phi+r_p),\qquad \dot H=(L_Wx)^T\operatorname{diag}(\nu)r_p. \]

Indeed, the q^TMS and -S^TMq terms still cancel, leaving precisely the displayed additional work. This identity specifies no law, duration or reservoir for r_p; even held stored pressure need not give a constant deviation from the evolving Phi. The THOL refresh analysis and held-pressure IL accounting explain why retention order matters. Their models and coefficients do not transfer here. The present gate introduces no such pressure-retention interval.

docs.title: 9. Scope of the preparatory theorem
docs.text:
The exact-real preparatory result establishes a model-specific OZ projection equivalence and a uniform simultaneous-IL work/identity theorem for the two existing A0 targets. It retains the complete IL phase action, the adjacent-edge correction, actual conductance associations and changed mean leaf. The whole allowed phase-coefficient interval is covered without choosing a coefficient to fit a response.

No IL/OZ word or trajectory was executed for this derivation. A concrete study separately needs its frozen preparation, actual live operator and grammar admission, declared selected-law refresh writer and callback schedule, retained context and represented output checks. These are separate obligations of the event contract, not consequences of the storage inequality. The retained execution supplies one bounded case with an explicitly unresolved phase-accuracy certificate. A rejected operation remains a rejection, and a detached field evaluation does not perform a refresh.

The maintained organization may realize these conditional actions while other operators, autonomous event selection, physical calibration and a uniquely selected fundamental law remain open. No additional pressure mechanism is inserted merely to make OZ change this particular continuation.

docs.title: 10. Execution and evidence preflight
docs.text: The following design assembles the owners used by the bounded study. The protocol froze its configuration, observations, arithmetic allowance and acceptance criteria before response evaluation; the resulting evidence is reported separately in section 13.

docs.title: Source, word and actual stage boundary
docs.text:
Reuse the positive pure-phase preparation from the existing registration protocol: a=0,g=3/4096, nominal split source, unchanged count-three contact word, seed, timestamps and histories. Its existing _registered_preparation((0, 1)) returns both detached observations and the full live runtime graph. Preserve the cached original and use a working copy of the latter. The detached graph used for field reports intentionally omits execution configuration; it is not an equivalent starting point for an operator word. The implemented copy uses the shared SDK copy_graph_state, with a bounded adapter retaining graph-instance event state and original neighbor order. It explicitly rebuilds registered runtime caches; a generic deepcopy of their locks is not this copy contract. Unknown instance state rejects instead of disappearing.

Use coherence,dissonance on the existing ordered targets (0,1), ValidatedSequence, truthful initialized-EPI context and the canonical core grammar profile with strict live rejection. Read executable tokens from the registry-backed TNFR.operators() interface. U1 admits this start only with its initialized context; terminal OZ requires the prior IL. The U2 debt and U4 handler checks still consume the actual histories. No AL/SHA padding, diagnostic waiver or replacement glyph is needed merely to validate the proposed word. Static word validity does not waive live source, branch or threshold admission.

The shared execute_network_operator_stage routes IL to immutable pointwise proposals and OZ to its all-target local/propagated pressure reduction. It does not forward arbitrary operator keyword arguments. Freeze its existing IL phase coefficient 0.3 explicitly; the full interval theorem above already covers it. Use OZ_NOISE_MODE=False, OZ_ENABLE_PROPAGATION=True, existing pressure gains and the default phase_weighted propagation mode. Resolve effective factors and Boolean settings before retaining their values. No dispatcher extension or parallel operator implementation is required for this design.

The uniform propagation name currently follows the same formula as phase_weighted; it is not an independent control law. The actual local proposal and the final overlapping neighbor reduction must remain distinct. Retain any unavailable acceleration observation as unavailable, with its history/clock convention; neither an OZ label nor a pressure change establishes a bifurcation or an observed second time derivative.

Use the typed observe_structural_acceleration observation from nodal_equation.py: glyph history and emission timestamps are not three EPI samples. The compatibility compute_d2epi_dt2 wrapper can return zero when that observation is unavailable, and OZ metrics still consume that scalar. Such a telemetry zero must not be reported as a measured zero acceleration or evidence against a bifurcation.

Shared admission rejects invalid primitives and nonzero inputs lost during materialization. It does not certify every subsequent floating-point product: propagation still evaluates products in float arithmetic, where nonzero increments can underflow. The bounded study must check its actual propagation arithmetic and residuals; primitive admission alone supplies no general no-underflow theorem.

docs.title: Three declared refreshes, with no intervening flow
docs.text:
Use an initial selected-law refresh before IL, then one after IL and one after OZ. The contact word's stored pressure is not presumed constitutive. Capture the full initial state, each raw post-operator/pre-refresh state, each refreshed state and each completed stage. The final stage capture is needed because schedule records can be appended after the callback returns. These are same-time event/refresh boundaries, not three elapsed-time steps.

There is no existing point-pressure writer for this weighted conservative comparison. Reuse bound_relational_sine_support_exchange to admit current primitives and enclose the independently specified Phi. For the bounded static study a narrow callback can materialize each pressure interval's midpoint through shared represented-real admission, then publish all admitted values with the shared pressure-alias writer. Retain the exact represented value and its residual enclosure

\[ \varepsilon_{p,i}\in\operatorname{point}(p_{i,\mathrm{float}}) -[\Phi_i(y)]. \]

This materialization is a declared numerical realization, not exact equality between a float and an ideal sine pressure. Admit every value before any live write; a nonzero midpoint lost to zero during conversion must reject. When claiming which ideal OZ branch applies, its pressure enclosure must resolve the fixed 1e-9 cutoff, with equality in the near-zero branch. The executed represented branch and an unresolved ideal branch are separate observations. Do not tune the preparation after seeing a boundary case.

A direct stage callback is opaque. Its stage transaction does not install the event-schedule executor's pressure-only guard or sealed refresh evidence. Check the callback's before/after snapshots explicitly: form, phase, capacity, support, every edge attribute, histories, clock and other execution state must be unchanged, apart from admitted pressure aliases/cache updates. Bind the callback implementation, source configuration, node order and arithmetic to the retained result. The event contract provides the preservation boundary, not a claim that a raw hook enforces it.

The whole event-schedule executor selects all nodes and has its own ordinary flow segments; it is not this two-target, two-row study. Native neighbor-argument pressure, default mixed pressure and the positive-loss, unit-capacity, rescaled sine-flow helper also have different premises. None may silently replace Phi or advance this comparison. No continuous trajectory is needed to classify these static handoffs.

docs.title: Evidence needed to connect the proof to execution
docs.text:
The comparison must retain, separately:

  • Actual word/live admission and all consumed context, including changed debt, lineage, history and propagation records. Equal continuous state is not equal execution state, and independent history multisets lose member associations.
  • IL's raw pressure contraction, complete simultaneous phase proposal, exact shared-edge work formula, changed mean leaf and represented endpoint defect. Re-admit the storage margin and identity on the captured output rather than inheriting an exact-real verdict from an operator name.
  • Fresh pressure and both complete rate rows before and after each refresh. Compare the OZ continuation with the post-IL state under the same law while preserving the different execution context. Stored products and instantaneous fields are not measured temporal response.
  • Source and code revision, complete settings, actual support/conductance, order, timestamps, seeds, precision, callbacks and arithmetic residuals. Unsupported affine EPI-jump certificates should abstain; their absence is not failure of the separate IL phase-work theorem.

docs.title: 11. Reused calculations and their transfer boundaries
docs.text:
This is a scoped dependency map for the handoff, not a new catalog or queue.

Existing owner Reusable contribution Boundary retained here Maintained contact Actual weighted support, complete source, local geometry, storage barrier and regional current identities Its initial response protocol does not evaluate IL/OZ. Re-admit event work and the new phase mean before continuation IL kernel and OZ stage kernel Existing snapshot proposals, local pressure branches and overlapping-target reduction The glyph, public class and full stage have different secondary effects; preserve the chosen route Weighted field reader Primitive admission, both ideal rate rows and storage with actual conductance Detached evaluation performs neither a refresh nor numerical evolution Collective context controls Same physical state with different grammar debt or earlier stabilization Current pressure and regional means cannot replace the context consumed by the next token THOL refresh accounting Why a held pressure increment can reach form before a later refresh Its source, default pressure and finite responses do not transfer to this conservative law Paired common-IL accounting Separation of generated pressure, retention, integration and arithmetic residuals It requires its own common source and held-pressure interval; it is not the present immediate-refresh map Constituent memory and linear memory owner Hidden initialization and causal kernels under declared elimination Neither installs a persistent OZ channel; support, capacity, loss and clock must match before coefficients transfer

The independent foundation controls check edgewise work, the full-swap counterexample, local resultant bounds and the all-coefficient inequality with exact interval/polynomial arithmetic. Their synthetic trigonometric cases are proof controls, not new contact-word responses. Existing IL/OZ tests separately cover snapshot order, propagation, invalid values and rollback. The testing owner gives the combined selection; an engine/API gate alone is not this research coverage.

docs.title: 12. Frozen bounded-word comparison
docs.text:
The machine-readable protocol fixes one positive phase-axis preparation, the existing count-three contact, ordered targets (0,1), and coherence,dissonance under the selected complete law. It admits no elapsed flow, parameter search or preparation adjustment. The initial refresh and both post-stage refreshes use the same constitutive pressure. The operator word's raw outputs, refreshed outputs and completed stage records remain distinct observations.

The prospective discriminators are actual admission without replacement, IL's phase/form-rate change and negative storage work with retained identity, OZ's raw pressure/context change followed by continuous-state equivalence, and explicit acceleration unavailability when no temporal EPI evidence exists. No neighbor propagation is required: the existing 0.05 policy may discard every candidate. Retain every candidate's arithmetic before classifying that outcome. A rejected word or unresolved ideal pressure branch remains a result.

The represented phase coefficient is the exact rational represented by binary64 0.3, not 3/10. For each target, use the report's relative resultant to enclose the ideal angle a_i, and choose the actual endpoint's continuous lift nearest the ideal displacement d_i=lambda*a_i. Keep the stored modulo angle and lift association separately. With represented lifted displacement dhat_i, the frozen numerical allowance is

\[ |\widehat d_i-d_i|\le 2^{-46}. \]

Each target has seven incident phase edges. The phase potential is separately 7-Lipschitz in each target angle, so

\[ |H_{\rm represented}-H_{\rm ideal}| \le7(|\widehat d_u-d_u|+|\widehat d_v-d_v|) \le14\,2^{-46}. \]

This bounds the bridge to the exact IL theorem; it does not itself prove strictly negative represented work near a zero displacement. Recompute the whole-edge storage difference and the shared-edge work identity with the actual lifted displacements. Separately require the represented endpoint's Z^2<1/256 and H-H_*<1/6400, where H_*=40*(1-cos(2*pi/5)). These are endpoint admissions for the existing barrier, not observed long-time motion.

Shared outward rational 128-bit intervals enclose pressures, rates and trigonometric work. Any independent high-precision cross-check uses 100 decimal digits. Pressure materialization and consumed propagation arithmetic use the fixed absolute allowance 2^-46; unchanged primitives require exact represented equality. The callback guard permits only pressure aliases and the pressure-maximum cache/witness, whose consistency is checked separately. No whole-cache exemption substitutes for that guard.

docs.title: 13. Retained represented result and original certificate limitation
docs.text:
The response contains nine full-state boundaries from one admitted IL/OZ word, the three refreshes, typed observations and both completed stages. The frozen report records eight passing checks out of nine, not an all-passing evaluation. The retained-evidence controls re-admit captured primitives and rebuild the relevant fields and work without invoking the producer or changing the frozen response.

Two earlier attempts stopped before any IL/OZ action: a generic-copy failure on a runtime-cache lock, then a serialization failure on the existing uniform-real BEPI representation. Its complex containers have zero imaginary part and pass the shared signed-form owner. The corrections change copying and lossless recording only. Both failed attempts, source archives and protocols remain intact; law, preparation, word, numerical budget and prospective predictions are unchanged. Their associations are recorded by the corrective freeze.

docs.title: Actual action and complete-law handoff
docs.text:
Both stages were admitted under strict live rejection. The inherited SHA-to-IL sequence emitted the existing advisory anti-pattern warning; it neither rejected nor replaced the action, and no waiver was installed. The captured IL phase changes modify the fresh form-rate row, leave the fresh phase-rate row unchanged, and have strictly negative whole-edge work:

\[ \Delta H_{\rm IL}\approx-2.71737569684\,10^{-7}. \]

These displayed decimals summarize retained rational enclosures. The shared-edge correction agrees with the independent full-edge difference, and the changed lifted phase mean is approximately 2.78994519689e-5. Direct endpoint admission gives

\[ Z^2\approx1.03208170158\,10^{-5}<1/256,\qquad H-H_*\approx1.03692602064\,10^{-5}<1/6400. \]

Thus this actual represented endpoint meets the existing continuous maintenance barrier independently of the unresolved ideal-phase accuracy comparison below. This supplies conditional continuation under the same held law, not an evaluated trajectory or autonomous occurrence.

OZ selected the amplification branch on both targets and changed raw stored pressure. All fourteen neighbor candidates were checked; none crossed the unchanged 0.05 propagation threshold. No consumed nonzero product vanished to zero. After the declared refresh, stored pressure, all consumed continuous coordinates and both complete rate rows equal the post-IL values exactly. Histories and stage records remain different. Acceleration is unavailable without the required temporal EPI evidence; compatibility zeros are not measurements. This confirms the model-specific projection equivalence.

docs.title: Preserve the unsuccessful certificate
docs.text:
The frozen compound IL check stopped at its first assertion: the per-target ideal-phase residual enclosures were not both contained in [-2^-46,2^-46]. The approximate bounds are:

Target Enclosed phase defect Frozen classification 0 [-1.91769e-16, 1.51906e-14] Unresolved at 2^-46 ≈ 1.42109e-14 1 [-1.48910e-14, 4.91012e-16] Unresolved at the same budget

Both boxes contain zero: neither establishes that the actual defect exceeds the budget. The saved, predeclared 100-digit cross-check estimates defects of about -4.25e-18 and 3.04e-16; those estimates do not replace the rigorous certificate. The width comes from the existing relative-resultant primitive's 12-term, 64-bit sine/cosine bounds. Subsequent 128-bit interval arithmetic does not sharpen inherited input enclosures.

The failed compound assertion did not run its later checks. Independent retained-state verification supplies the direct work, identity and mean claims above. The separately computed energy-work defect interval, approximately [-1.076742e-13,1.076765e-13], is inside the declared ±14*2^-46 allowance. No tolerance was relaxed, no precision increased and no IL/OZ response regenerated to change the frozen verdict.

The original bounded handoff therefore left a numerical subclaim unresolved; the separate review below resolves it without changing that evaluation. The separate pressure-completion analysis classifies the additional mean, storage and constitutive-invariance obligations of an independent pressure intervention. It consumes this saved endpoint only for a detached balance check; no pressure-retention law or reservoir is supplied by the word, and its original verdict is unchanged.

docs.title: 14. Separate correction of the retained phase certificate
docs.text:
The review protocol and freeze precede one read-only corrective evaluation of the same initial and IL_raw primitive snapshots. They retain the original represented coefficient, target order, phase-lift association, absolute allowance 2^-46 and independent 100-decimal-digit check. No operator, preparation, continuation or response producer is replayed. This is a retrospective numerical correction, not a new prospective physical prediction or a replacement for the frozen 8/9 report.

The shared detached calculator reconstructs each bare-neighbor relative resultant directly from the exact represented primitive phases. The existing outward 128-bit sine/cosine owner now encloses those inputs before the angle operation; the former 12-term, 64-bit resultant boxes are not promoted into narrower boxes. The principal actual displacement is accepted as the nearest lift to the ideal displacement only after proving that their entire difference lies strictly inside (-pi,pi). The actual ideal-displacement coefficient remains the rational represented by binary64 0.3.

The corrective response and report certify both defects inside the unchanged budget:

Target Approximate defect, summarizing its rigorous interval Interval width 0 -4.25252514856e-18 about 2.351e-38 1 3.03932787662e-16 about 2.351e-38

The independent high-precision values lie inside these enclosures. Independent retained-state work, identity and OZ projection checks also pass, and the later boxes of the original compound check meet their respective assertions. The scope is separate evidence for the formerly unresolved numerical subclaim; the historical report remains 8/9, with all its source artifacts intact.

Synthetic controls check angle/lift branches, tolerance classification and invalid domains. Read-only evidence controls bind the review to the retained bytes, rebuild primitive inputs and compare the certified intervals with the independent oracle. Neither a small phase error nor corrected arithmetic selects a pressure-memory law or an autonomous OZ occurrence mechanism. The constitutive-refresh equivalence in Section 2 and the conditional pressure-completion obstruction remain unchanged.

docs.title: Collective Reception on the weighted contact
docs.text: Reception has an admitted collective action on the existing marked contact: it mixes form over the actual bare incoming neighbors while retaining the physical twin stratum. Its event work depends on the separate conductance weights and need not be nonpositive. The selected conservative sine law leaves fresh pressure and the instantaneous form row unchanged at this event, but can change the phase-rate row. These are conditional analytical results, not an evaluation of a new retained-source word or trajectory. The research program alone selects any subsequent investigation.

docs.title: 1. Complete model and event boundary
docs.text:
Use the twenty-node, 45-edge contact and contextual eleven-cell chart of the identity-transition owner. Its two individually marked ports are 0 and 1; the remaining cells are the nine exact pairs (2,3),...,(18,19). Bare support is fixed and reciprocal, with forty original unit-conductance edges, the internal edge {0,1} and four edges between {0,1} and {10,11}. Retain every actual conductance, capacity, geometric length and member association. A connected eleven-node simple graph cannot substitute for this chart.

The selected complete law has signed scalar form x, primitive circular phase with declared continuous lifts, positive held capacities and the original structural clock:

\[ q=L_Wx,\qquad S_i=\sum_{j\sim i}\sin(\theta_j-\theta_i),\qquad M=\operatorname{diag}\frac{\nu_i}{\pi d_i},\qquad p_i=\frac{S_i}{\pi d_i},\qquad \dot x=MS,\quad\dot\theta=Mq. \tag{1} \]

Here d is the number of distinct bare neighbors, not a weighted degree. Conductances enter q and structural storage

\[ H=\tfrac12x^TL_Wx+\sum_{\{i,j\}\in U} (1-\cos(\theta_j-\theta_i)). \tag{2} \]

The model supplies these laws; neither the nodal identity nor the Reception name selects them. There is no forcing or continuous loss. Storage is not identified with a measured physical energy. The event has no inferred duration, and all rate comparisons below use the same structural clock.

The EN contract, shared read snapshot, neighbor kernel and atomic stage own the executed map. Admission uses shared signed-scalar form, including uniform-real BEPI. Nonuniform or genuinely complex BEPI and magnitude projection are outside this scalar model. Every consumed form must be explicit; no absent-input fallback is used in this analytical domain.

docs.title: 2. Actual incoming mixture and collective descent
docs.text:
For a nonempty incoming neighbor set N_i, write

\[ u_i=\frac1{d_i}\sum_{j\in N_i}x_j,\qquad b_i=u_i-x_i,\qquad h_i=m_i b_i. \tag{3} \]

In the ideal unclipped map, each selected target changes to x_i+h_i and all other forms remain fixed. The selected configuration uses one common mix m; allowing target-specific m_i in the algebra does not add such a runtime interface. All proposals in an atomic stage read the same immutable source. Serially updating one port before reading the other gives a different map and must not replace this simultaneous event.

Equation (3) uses no conductance, phase compatibility or emission-source ranking. Directed execution reads predecessors; the present contact is undirected. EN acts on existing edges and does not require or create a new edge. Its optional source discovery is retained telemetry, not the weights or a filter of the numerical mixture. Kind selection uses the shared unclipped proposal and the associated ordered neighbor kinds; it can change even when a coarse numerical summary is unchanged.

Number the eleven cells in their displayed order. Their multiplicities are (1,1,2,...,2), and the two port means are exactly

\[ u_0=\frac{X_1+2X_2+2X_5+2X_6}{7},\qquad u_1=\frac{X_0+2X_2+2X_5+2X_6}{7}. \tag{4} \]

In particular, averaging four adjacent cell values equally is wrong. The exact port input consumes each member of a size-two cell. The contextual chart retains ordered fine neighbors, representations, kinds, source metadata, histories, persistent debt, supplied configuration and every other consumed or exposed record. Its declared lift reconstructs those inputs before applying the existing stage. Equal complete chart records therefore give the same admissions, proposals, context updates and outputs. No second operator implementation or lossy macro-node law is needed.

Only singleton ports change form, so the nine physical twin equalities are preserved. Phase, capacity and support are held during EN. Thus the marked acute phase sector and its two constituent windings are immediately unchanged. This is event descent on the selected stratum, not a proof that generic perturbed twins reduce exactly or that the sector is maintained under subsequent flow.

The ideal numeric mixture commutes with a common form translation. This does not permit dropping the form origin from full execution: configured admission ceilings, clipping, magnitude-based kind selection and other operators can consume it. Preserve the existing contextual chart rather than inferring a stronger runtime quotient from (3).

docs.title: 3. Exact event work and its sign
docs.text:
For every admitted actual endpoint x^+=x+h with phase and support fixed, including a represented or clipped endpoint, direct expansion of (2) gives

\[ \Delta H=q^Th+\tfrac12h^TL_Wh =\sum_{\{i,j\}\in U}W_{ij} \left[(x_i-x_j)(h_i-h_j)+\tfrac12(h_i-h_j)^2\right]. \tag{5} \]

Thus the necessary and sufficient nonpositive-work criterion is q^T h <= -h^T L_W h/2. It is a condition on the full event, not an operator-name guarantee. This storage has no additional capacity term.

For one unclipped target, let s_i=sum_j W_ij>0 and let v_i=sum_j W_ij*x_j/s_i be its conductance-weighted neighbor mean. Then q_i=s_i*(x_i-v_i) and

\[ \Delta H=m_i b_i q_i+\tfrac12m_i^2s_i b_i^2 =\frac{s_i}{2}\left[(x_i+m_i b_i-v_i)^2-(x_i-v_i)^2\right]. \tag{6} \]

For m_i>0, this is nonpositive exactly when

\[ b_iq_i\leq-\tfrac12m_i s_i b_i^2. \tag{7} \]

The statement includes the zero-update case. When the update is nonzero, its direction must oppose q_i and its length must not overshoot the equal-storage endpoint about v_i. Reception moves toward u_i, whereas weighted form storage is minimized at v_i; these centers can differ.

With a fixed mix 0<m_i<=1, fixed positive incident weights and arbitrary target/neighbor forms in any nonempty open interval, single-target EN has nonpositive work for all such forms if and only if those weights are equal. For equal weights, u_i=v_i and (6) reduces to

\[ \Delta H=-m_i(1-m_i/2)\,q_i^2/s_i\leq0. \tag{8} \]

Conversely, unequal weights make the weighted and bare averaging linear functionals different. Choose neighboring forms within the interval for which u_i differs from v_i, and choose the target form x_i=v_i. Then q_i=0, the convex mixture stays in the interval and Delta H=m_i^2*s_i*(u_i-v_i)^2/2>0. The zero mix is the identity and is the explicit exception. This proves a universal-scope obstruction; a particular unequally weighted source can still satisfy (7).

This equivalence allows independent neighbor forms. If forms are constrained to be equal within fixed cells, equality of the two mean functionals instead requires, for every incident cell a with per-member bare count n_ia,

\[ \frac{\sum_{j\in a\cap N_i}W_{ij}}{n_{ia}}=\frac{s_i}{d_i}. \]

Only these per-cell average weights are then observable by the numeric mixture. The contact's admitted involution also makes the two weights from a port into each twin cell equal. Its old unit-weight cells and newly added subunit-weight cells can still violate this restricted condition, as the explicit witness below does.

For simultaneous targets T, let W_ij=0 for absent edges. Equation (5) can also be written

\[ \Delta H=\sum_{i\in T} \left(q_i h_i+\tfrac12s_i h_i^2\right) -\sum_{\{i,j\}\subset T}W_{ij}h_i h_j. \tag{9} \]

The final sum is the cross term omitted by adding isolated-target work. It is present at the actual internal port edge. Its sign depends on the two increments; single-target criteria do not decide a simultaneous stage. Whole-word work must additionally include IL's phase reset and any other actual intervening event, rather than attributing their sum to EN.

docs.title: 3.1 A positive-work witness on the actual contact class
docs.text:
Take the original forty weights as one and all five added weights as 7/8. Let a=19/64, b=21/64, set the four old port neighbors 2,3,8,9 to a, the cross neighbors 10,11 to b, and both ports to

\[ v=\frac{16a+7b}{23}=\frac{451}{1472}. \tag{10} \]

All other forms may equal a. This respects every physical twin equality and lies strictly inside (1/4,3/8). Use the reference phases, any admitted positive symmetric capacities and the retained discrete context. Both port gradients vanish:

\[ q_0=q_1=4(v-a)+\tfrac74(v-b)=0. \]

Nevertheless their bare mixtures give, for any common m>0,

\[ h_0=h_1=\frac{4m(b-a)}{161}=\frac m{1288},\qquad \Delta H=\frac{23}{4}\left(\frac m{1288}\right)^2>0. \tag{11} \]

The internal edge has zero form change across it. Equivalently, the two isolated terms in (9) sum to (53/8)*h_0^2, and the missing cross term is -(7/8)*h_0^2, leaving (23/4)*h_0^2. This is an algebraic source, not a re-evaluation or retuning of the historical retained preparation. It proves that the native unit-support passivity result cannot be transferred to this weighted-contact EN stage, even with convex mixing and a preserved organizational class.

docs.title: 4. Fresh rows, means and pressure provenance
docs.text:
At the EN event, support, phase and capacity are fixed. Hence the complete selected law gives

\[ p^+=p,\qquad \dot x^+=\dot x,\qquad q^+=q+L_Wh,\qquad \dot\theta^+-\dot\theta=M L_Wh. \tag{12} \]

An untargeted neighbor can acquire a different phase rate through the corresponding off-diagonal entry of L_W h. No phase jump is being inferred from this rate change. On this connected positive support, a nonzero increment supported on the proper port subset is not a constant vector, so L_W h is nonzero; positive capacities make the phase-rate change nonzero somewhere. Equation (11) therefore gives a nontrivial subsequent phase-rate response even though both port gradients were initially zero.

There is also a local consequence for form motion. Let C(theta) be the bare Laplacian with edge coefficients cos(theta_j-theta_i). On either smooth continuation with held support and capacity, differentiation of (1) yields

\[ \ddot x=-M C(\theta)M q,\qquad \ddot x^+-\ddot x=-M C(\theta)M L_W h. \tag{12a} \]

Within the acute connected sector, C has only the constant null direction. If the acceleration difference vanished, M L_W h would be constant. Since 1^T L_W h=0 and M is positive, that constant must be zero. Connected positive-conductance support then forces h to be constant. Thus a nonzero port-only h changes both the phase rate and the form acceleration, although it leaves the instantaneous form rate unchanged. These are local derivative identities, not a finite-horizon response or maintenance prediction.

The EN primary map leaves stored pressure and the stored dEPI channel unchanged; optional diagnostics are separate observations, not a new evolution row. If the source pressure was fresh, it remains fresh for (1). If the source pressure was stale, EN preserves that same discrepancy; an explicit refresh is still needed before claiming the constitutive row. This differs from the pure-EPI realization bridge, whose pressure depends on form and generally changes after EN. The bridge's numerical kernels can be reused; its pressure-manifold defect and diffusion stability certificate are not certificates for (1).

Let rho_i=d_i/nu_i and R=sum_i rho_i. Capacity and support do not change, so the two means obey

\[ \mu_x^+-\mu_x=\frac{\rho^T h}{R},\qquad \mu_\theta^+=\mu_\theta. \tag{13} \]

The continuing conservative law preserves its new form-mean leaf. Local Reception is not generally a mean-conserving transfer; no compensating source decrement, reservoir or autonomous event selector is installed by the blend. A supply interpretation must account separately for (5).

docs.title: 5. One grammatical word on a positive-width domain
docs.text:
Reuse the analytical source domain of the previous contextual word: old weights one, new weights in (3/4,1], the exact twin symmetry, 1/4<x_i<3/8, port capacities in (3/8,5/8), other positive capacities at most one, and

\[ \theta_i=\tau+\theta_{*,i}+\eta_i, \qquad \max_i|\eta_i|<1/8. \tag{14} \]

Set stored pressure initially to the independently specified fresh value in (1). At the reference phases S_i=0 for every node: old-cycle sine terms cancel and added edges have zero phase difference. The sine Lipschitz bound therefore gives

\[ |p_i|<\frac1{4\pi}<\frac3{20}. \tag{15} \]

This meets the selected default Reception pressure ceiling 0.15, and its form ceiling 0.9 is also strict. The ceilings are admission policies, not derived universal constants. Use the configured default EN mix 1/(pi+1); the ideal argument also holds for any fixed 0<=m<=1. Hard form rails [-1,1] are inactive, since every mixture remains in (1/4,3/8). IL consequently retains its positive-form admission; capacities remain in (3/8,5/8) until SHA, whose selected factor 1/2 leaves them in (3/16,5/16) after its live minimum-capacity check.

The complete selected word is EN -> IL -> SHA. Retain the original associated histories AL,UM,SHA,IL,OZ at port 0 and AL,AL,AL,UM,SHA,IL,OZ at port 1, each with maximum length eight, persistent debt one and prior coherence. Use strict rejection, live preconditions, atomic target order (0,1) and ValidatedSequence context {"initial_epi_nonzero": true, "compatibility_profile": "core"}. Existing nonzero form supplies the U1 start premise; EN is not assigned a generator or closing role. Its U2 debt progression is

\[ 1\xrightarrow{\mathrm{EN}}1 \xrightarrow{\mathrm{IL}}0 \xrightarrow{\mathrm{SHA}}0. \tag{16} \]

EN followed by SHA alone would retain the outstanding debt. The selected word uses neither coupling/resonance phase admission, temporal mutation evidence, bifurcation nor recursive actions. Passing these applicable finite grammar checks does not assert unrestricted U1-U6 stability.

EN leaves phase fixed, so the preceding owner's IL phase-sector proof applies unchanged with the same phase coefficient 0<=lambda<=3/10. Retain its pressure-retention premise 0<=kappa<1 and the declared refresh after each completed stage; the default configured IL factors meet these conditions. SHA also leaves phase fixed. Thus the ideal word retains the original acute sector and both constituent windings. The successor domain is its actual ordered prefix images, not a promise that the source box admits indefinite repetitions.

For the canonical finite U6 observations, retain geometric lengths equal to conductances, the same baseline convention and threshold pi/2. EN's before/raw/refreshed pressure comparisons vanish, because phase and stored pressure are held and initial pressure is fresh. The later IL/SHA raw/refresh comparisons inherit the existing bound strictly below 3/2. This covers only those ideal event snapshots. It is not a future potential, small-radius or all-time maintenance certificate.

docs.title: 6. Representation and verification boundaries
docs.text:
The ideal equations use exact real arithmetic. Runtime neighbor means, blends, BEPI scalarization and clipping have their declared represented arithmetic. A binary64 coefficient matrix is not automatically identical to the two-stage mean/blend computation. Use the actual endpoint h in (5), (9), (12) and (13); retain the difference from the ideal h in (3) when comparing those models. A shared numerical kernel does not make floating-point sums permutation invariant or authenticate their source.

The contextual reconstruction keeps per-member kind, source and history associations even where physical coordinates coincide. Lossless physical compression therefore does not eliminate the records consumed by grammar or exposed by execution. Synthetic controls of the shared runtime are separate evidence from the positive-width analytical proof. Neither those controls nor the work identity executes the historical frozen producer, selects event occurrence or establishes a physical interpretation.

The collective Reception controls exercise the existing atomic stage, immutable simultaneous reads, bare multiplicities, kind/source association, live rejection, exact weighted work and complete-word context. They compare independent edge accounting with actual endpoints, and keep ideal rational witnesses separate from their represented calculations. Testing owns the maintained verification selection.

docs.title: Recursivity: associated history and collective sine dynamics
docs.text:
REMESH has a precise conditional role on the organized sine objects. Its registered node-level action records an advisory; its separately invoked network map mixes each member's present form with that member's delayed forms. The latter is a genuine hybrid form reset, with a calculable effect on storage and subsequent phase motion. It does not derive a delay law from continuous nodal dynamics or automatically select when to apply it.

This owner specializes existing mechanisms to the weighted sine law and contextual collective chart. The research program owns task order; the runtime REMESH derivation and event contracts retain the general map, transactions, history advancement and recurrence results.

docs.title: 1. Three distinct operations and their admission
docs.text:
The public Recursivity(depth=...) operator and its atomic execute_recursivity_stage leave structural form, phase, capacity, pressure and support unchanged before any separately supplied refresh callback. They record the target's actual glyph/lifecycle context and one graph-level advisory per runtime ordinal (the legacy retained-sample index outside that runtime). Equal physical states with different histories or advisory ordinals therefore need not have equal execution descriptions.

REMESH is a registered generator/closure. Declared depth must be a positive integer; depth greater than one invokes the actual word's U5 stabilizer requirement. A validated word and live admission remain separate from the availability of delayed forms. Passing the advisory does not execute a temporal echo, create a child, prove fractal structure or select a delay. When the optional application precondition is enabled, REMESH_MIN_NODES is a strict nonnegative integer (default 2); zero remains an admitted configuration. Boolean, textual, floating or negative counts reject before the advisory writes. This uses the shared operator argument validator.
