The preparation owner uses the registered emission,silence actions, validated core grammar and the shared atomic stage dispatcher. Strict live preconditions and rejection remain enabled. Each word has fixed targets, supplied lifecycle timestamp 2030-01-02T03:04:06+00:00, no pressure-refresh callback and unchanged structural time. The timestamp is a declared event input, not acquisition chronology or a physical clock. Source configuration, histories and execution seed are retained.

Both donors initially have x=5/16, capacity 4 and empty glyph histories. SHA changes donor capacity to 2, preserves form and records latency/history. All other nodal coordinates and every edge remain unchanged. AL has positive form-storage work on all four branches. SHA has zero immediate storage work but changes both continuing rate rows. Keep each branch's own positive capacities. In the original clock the selected unforced law is

\[ \dot x_i=\frac{\nu_i}{\pi d_i}\sum_{k\sim i}\sin(\theta_k-\theta_i), \qquad \dot\theta_i=\frac{\nu_i}{\pi d_i}(L_Wx)_i. \]

Support, conductance and capacity are held; loss is zero and exchange and beta are one. The full twenty real coordinates evolve, with declared phase lifts. docs.title: 2. Finite observation and cancellation
docs.text:
Fix the structural duration h=1/256. Receiver 4 has unchanged mobility nu_4/d_4=13/32. Read its phase in calibrated radian units, with initial readings at each post-word boundary and final readings at h. Branch-constant additive offsets may differ: they cancel in each increment. Define

\[ q_j=[Y_{j,\mathrm{high}}(h)-Y_{j,\mathrm{high}}(0)] -[Y_{j,\mathrm{low}}(h)-Y_{j,\mathrm{low}}(0)]. \]

Within a nominal donor pair, initial phases and post-SHA capacities coincide, and the form difference is Delta a=1/1024 at that donor only. The initial phase-rate contrast is g_j=-(13/(32*pi))*W_4j*Delta a. The two pairs can have different capacity distributions; each difference bound uses its own full law. With W_40=2 and the actual W_45=w_A, their ideal ratio is r=g_5/g_0=w_A/2, with 9/20<r<1/2.

The two nominal form velocities agree initially, so the second derivative of their phase difference vanishes. Global bounds A=16/3 and B=48/5 apply to the two coupled rows: max nu=8, max(nu_i*s_i/d_i)<72/5 and pi>3. The shared initial-state envelope rebuilds tighter source-specific coefficients before these majorants are used. The general remainder then gives

\[ D=1-ABh^2=1279/1280,\qquad |q_j^{\mathrm{nominal}}-hg_j|\le R =\frac{\Delta a AB^2h^3}{6D}=\frac1{209551360}. \]

This is a full nonlinear finite-time statement. It uses neither a frozen phase nor a tangent trajectory. It identifies a relative interaction coefficient under the supplied law, not a spatial distance or a fundamental physical force.

docs.title: 3. Source, input, clock and reading errors
docs.text:
At each post-word continuation boundary, allow independent form error e=2^-39, decomposed into source and input allowances 2^-40 each, and phase error f=2^-40 at every fine node. These boxes are supplied boundary premises: the nominal executed words do not derive uncertain event selection or transport an arbitrary pre-word error box. Held support, conductance, capacity and law remain exact. Actual membership in these boxes is a separate obligation.

Let final reading time error be c=2^-40 structural units, readout error m=2^-40 radians per reading and numerical error n=2^-40 radians per reading. The initial reading is anchored at the event boundary. The same-law envelope through h gives, per branch,

\[ T=\frac{f+Bhe}{D}=\frac{43}{43946105372672}. \]

For timing, the perturbed form span through h+c is bounded by 33/512+2e+(16/3)(h+c), because |x_dot_i|<8/3. Multiplication by B/2 bounds every phase speed strictly below M=3/4. The receiver begins within f of zero, hence |theta_4(t)|<=f+M(h+c)<1/128. Its declared local lift (-1/128,1/128) is therefore unambiguous throughout the reading window.

The complete error in each paired increment includes both endpoint source errors, two final clock errors and four readout/numerical errors:

\[ E=R+2(T+f)+2Mc+4m+4n =\frac{67283469}{14062753719255040}<4.785\,10^{-9}. \]

Using pi<22/7 gives h|g_0|>91/92274688. Therefore h|g_0|-E>151813271921/154690290911805440>0, and

\[ \left|\frac{q_5}{q_0}-r\right| <\frac{3E/2}{91/92274688-E} =\frac{2220354477}{303626543842}<\frac1{128}. \]

The prospective finite-read prediction is consequently

\[ \boxed{\frac{283}{640}<\frac{q_5}{q_0}<\frac{65}{128}}. \]

It separates this ratio from the point reference 1. Excluding a complete equal-coupling alternative would require that alternative's own preparation, continuation and finite-error admission. A common nonzero readout gain or constant clock conversion cancels in the ideal ratio; the frozen errors are already expressed in calibrated structural phase/time units. An unknown unbounded gain does not convert raw sensor noise into this error allowance.

docs.title: 4. Identity throughout the admitted continuations
docs.text:
The original stored energy obeys H0<9/20. Its form span is 1/16 and each donor strength is below 12; a boost at most 1/512 adds no more than 12*(1/16)*(1/512)+6*(1/512)^2=195/131072. SHA adds zero storage. For the post-word uncertainty box, the nineteen edges have total conductance below 39; the additional storage is at most

\[ 39[2(33/512)e+2e^2]+38f<2^{-34}. \]

Thus every admitted branch has H<29/64. The fixed protected-star barrier is 35/64, leaving a margin greater than 3/32. The retention owner checks the actual support and positive capacities; its conserved-storage argument retains both original identities for all times under each unchanged law. This is conditional maintenance after supplied events, not autonomous formation, a newly formed parent NFR or a derived scale-selection rule.

docs.title: 1. Substrate, formation and identity
Research target: physical properties of collective patterns
docs.text:
The primary hypothesis is that material constituents and their observable properties could arise from interacting TNFR patterns. It does not require one microscopic EPI to be a voltage, temperature, concentration or particle attribute. A prospective generative chain is fine nodal state/law -> collective identity and effective dynamics -> physical observations. The fine state includes form, phase, capacity, support and any history actually consumed by the law. The effective object may carry properties of their joint configuration and trajectory which no individual node has.

The existing repertoire of collective properties is not assumed exhaustive. When a more complex organization becomes admissible, reassess its identity, sufficient state and effective dynamics: a lower-level description may omit new relational information. A proposed property needs a defined observation and a control that distinguishes organization-dependent behavior from what the prepared parts already possess. An effective law derived on that domain is compatible with an unchanged fine law; it does not by itself select a new universal microscopic law.

A common substrate could admit distinct, reproducible families of collective organization at different scales. This is stronger than a mere change of scale: the proposed families must have distinguishable dynamics, composition rules and observable responses. Sharing a substrate would not erase observed differences between material systems. Names such as hydrogen remain physical identifications to establish through those responses, not names for an assumed TNFR primitive. Neither a common substrate nor scale nesting alone derives the chemical elements.

Candidate particle species could be classes of stable or dynamically maintained organization under one complete law; treating number symbols as reductions of such organization is a further hypothesis. Each symbolic map must declare its retained and discarded information and prove the arithmetic relations it preserves. A claim of emergent physical constituents additionally needs a source/formation account, identity over the claimed lifetime and independently measured responses. The arithmetic-spectral scope retains supplied modular carriers and graph constructions; its conditional consequences do not derive those carriers or identify particle species.

The intended physical question is whether nodal organization can generate the effects attributed to material constituents, including bound composite structure and reproducible changes under interaction. A nucleus/electron picture is a possible explanatory target, not a partition or force law to insert into the engine. Atomic comparison would eventually require spatial measurement distributions, bound-state energies and transition responses; see the hydrogen-state calculation. A classical orbit, a graph cycle or a discrete winding label alone does not establish those observations.

The present persistent collective organization and restoring effective relation are reusable mathematical ingredients with different complete-law premises. Both retain supplied fine support. The collective mean-closure restriction explains why composing such organizations generally needs their internal information, even when their collective means coincide. This supports studying sufficient interaction state and inherited dynamics before physical naming; it does not derive an atom or a unique constitutive law.

The weighted-star state study makes this information obligation explicit for one marked organization and its retained dynamical boundary. Equal collective means and storage do not determine the collective response; adding a complex phase moment still leaves its derivative sensitive to internal form/phase association. An invertible chart retaining all internal deviations supplies a complete continuous state for that model. It proves neither a minimal collective state nor an autonomous organization without its boundary. Formation, finite-error maintenance and the histories/context consumed by canonical operators remain separate requirements. Linear transverse stability does not erase internal information or establish those requirements. A separate finite-amplitude identity certificate uses the same model's full storage to retain explicit internal form/phase margins for all time, including a nonzero neighborhood of the supplied coherent family. This proves maintenance under that law, not acquisition, tracking of one orbit or a universal definition of an NFR.

The two-star composition theorem then retains both marked identities under a supplied boundary connection, with nonzero exchange on an explicit open preparation set. Its guarantee uses the actual joined law, including changed boundary normalization and accounted support work. Separate isolated certificates do not supply that joint budget. This is conditional coexistence of interacting organizations, not derivation of the connection or acquisition of a new collective identity.

The canonical weighted-star contact separately admits a supplied grammatical word and its actual affinity-weighted support. A protected internal identity can survive while the new degrees and capacities destroy exact synchronized-family invariance. Thus perfect member equality is not required by this identity policy. The event still consumes declared preparation, context and invocation; compatibility does not select its occurrence or establish formation of another NFR. Its finite-response comparison also separates a center-leaf form contrast from the matched disconnected control at a fixed elapsed structural time. A whole-window nonlinear bound supports that conclusion; an initial tangent alone would not. Identity retention and an interaction-induced internal response therefore coexist under the same declared law, without discarding the internal coordinates. The exact contact state retains that internal contrast in five form/phase blocks. Its inherited law keeps cross-edge multiplicities, conductance sums and inverse-capacity mean weights separately. A collective block therefore cannot generally be substituted by a simple node with only a changed scalar capacity. This is an exact description of the admitted family, not a projection of arbitrary fine states, a physical mass identification or a newly formed NFR. The off-family robustness theorem also bounds every fine coordinate in a positive-width preparation box around the actual post-word sources. At the unchanged horizon, the internal contrast still separates attached and disconnected laws while both identities persist. This gives a finite domain of predictive usefulness beyond exact equality; it neither makes the perturbed state a member of the five-block family nor derives decay, uncertain event outputs or autonomous assembly. The preparation-to-flow admission separately retains live word/selector margins and the variation of generated conductances. Its exact-map theorem and conditional arithmetic allowance keep distinct scopes; represented controls admit their own raw outputs and exact integer phase lifts. A changed five-link law can preserve both identities and the finite response while losing the exact five-block family. This is compatibility of a supplied preparation/action path, not an autonomous choice of event or acquisition of a new collective identity.

The relative-origin tangent study then identifies an eight-dimensional minimal linear state for the two regional relative means under the nominal contact law near a uniform equilibrium. The disconnected means are constant. Internal distributions with identical regional means can therefore change the connected response; six additional linear coordinates retain that information. This minimum applies to arbitrary fine infinitesimal preparations within the stated law family, not to nonlinear finite-amplitude evolution or an already acquired composite identity. Eliminating those coordinates requires their hidden initialization and causal memory, rather than setting them to zero.

Its finite-amplitude validity theorem bounds both output errors throughout a declared window for arbitrary fine preparations in a small consensus box. Opposite internal phase patterns can nevertheless have the same complete eight-state linear observation, means and full storage while producing opposite nonlinear initial rates. Thus a useful predictor with a quantified error need not be a sufficient exact nonlinear state. The box is a separately declared preparation under the held law, not an acquired successor of the earlier word. Its retained constituent identities and interaction do not establish a new common identity.

The distinct-neighbor comparison supports nonadditive interaction of the prepared organizations under the supplied smooth-sine law. A separate storage theorem derives nonlinear storage and loss beyond the matched complete tangent model. Its negative excess is a signed combination of four histories and two models, not a negative binding potential or evidence of energetic attachment. It has not been independently observed through a storage measurement. Formation, retained identity and interaction remain steps toward an independently measurable collective property; none alone establishes a physical constituent.

These consequences do not select the microscopic law. The existing alternative-storage family preserves circularity, local reciprocal exchange, dissipation and the consensus tangent while changing nonlinear pressure and storage. Its protected geometry can also persist, without transferring another law's acquisition or response certificates. The constitutive admission must distinguish properties that survive this freedom from those requiring a particular law; passivity or a successful prepared response cannot supply that distinction by itself. Autonomous preparation, contact occurrence and scale selection remain separate obligations.

A useful open hypothesis is that some organized identities persist across an independently delimited class of complete laws. Shared attracting geometries would still require those laws to define trajectories, basins, rates and interactions. The target-matched comparison above already permits common identities with different nonlinear interaction signs. Extending robustness to every admissible TNFR law, or identifying it with a universal property of nature, requires an additional argument and independent physical evidence. A selected example does not establish that quantifier. The weak-contact constitutive comparison also separates the retained marked identity from its attracting relative geometry: changing the supplied law can change which registrations are stable on the same support. Its separate actual-source theorem retains the acquired organization and its complete history on declared origin intervals. A common primitive preparation interval has disjoint asymptotic registrations under the two laws, each with its own reached state and errors. This establishes constitutive dependence of the acquired outcome, not just stationary possibility. It supplies neither a physical observation nor a claim about every compatible law.

The constitutive transition also separates persistence at fixed contact from robustness across contact strengths. In its admitted small-contact regime, the deformation needed to change a registration's stability tends to zero cubically while the old marked identity survives. The new branches are conditional stationary organizations, not automatically acquired constituents or an autonomous operator occurrence. A comparison parameter is not an evolution law.

The same model's local dynamical reduction derives an inherited registration mobility and critical algebraic recovery from both complete rows. Its initialization retains the full form and phase state: equal initial phases can lead to opposite sides of the subsequent approach. This is a local effective description at each fixed positive contact, with stable transverse modes; it is neither a phase-only quotient of all states nor a law for arbitrary subsequent interactions. The marked boundary and any released collective means still need their own admission. For one marked contact to a further C9, the relative mean form and phase become dynamical alongside the critical coordinate. The neighbor changes its asymptotic relaxation coefficient through the joined mode geometry. Equal initial means and storage can still have opposite receiver transfer rates when the internal registration differs. This is a conditional interaction property with explicit contact work and local identity retention, not a new primitive law, autonomous attachment or a physical identification.

The boundary-constraint criterion separates a reusable local consequence from its constitutive premises. Given an admitted equilibrium, positive normal curvature and the specified complete kinetic rows, positive boundary curvature removes the old neutral motions that change its endpoint gaps. Normal compliance affects the restoring coefficient; elimination of evolving state retains memory and initialization. Neither the number of contacts nor connectivity supplies that curvature, critical tuning or nonlinear attraction. The matched-weight two-port control illustrates this distinction without selecting a universal law or deriving contact occurrence.

Within the specified complete laws, equal nominal collective means and storage can hide response-relevant internal information. The conservative persistence result establishes different finite responses while initially admitted patterns retain their geometry. The positive-loss acquisition result also connects initially zero-winding phases to a retained winding sector, with an inherited response on the same trajectories. Both cover full coordinate uncertainty; independently perturbed states need not remain energy matched. Their different complete laws keep separate coefficients and certificates. Support, preparation and constitutive law remain supplied, and the structured source information and storage remain preparation costs. Geometric retention with a finite response signature does not establish autonomous preparation, distinct persistent constituents or physical identification.

The two formed winding classes separately establish prepared acquisition of symmetry-inequivalent attracting geometries under one fixed support and complete law. Their source families retain all fine coordinates on a common conserved-mean leaf, with distinct preparation costs under one budget. A common supplied probe then distinguishes their actual form responses while both post-probe families recover their own geometry, retaining the original preparation uncertainty and accounting separately for the intervention's storage work. This gives a conditional example of acquired organization with a distinguishable interaction response. The separate quantitative return certificate extends that discrimination and geometric retention to every repetition of one fixed supplied probe schedule. It proves invariant neighborhoods with a finite common dwell, not a unique periodic orbit or a practical operating speed. Positive work per probe requires unbounded cumulative external work for indefinite repetition; exact target convergence applies when probes stop. These results derive neither the organized source preparation, autonomous probe selection nor a physical constituent identity.

The separate preparation-information theorem matches the complete initial phase state, conserved means and storage exactly between two correlated source families, yet proves acquisition of different winding magnitudes under one fixed positive-loss law. Fine form arrangement therefore carries mode-relevant information absent from those observations. The pairing retains all coordinates and uncertainty; independent errors would not preserve the equality. Its larger algebraic preparation and storage cost are explicit premises, not an autonomous selector or a probability of modes.

Along an exactly observation-preserving continuous preparation path, full-family bounds distinguish acute-cell capture from transient winding. One admitted interval has winding two at the declared observation time but storage below every critical state in the closure of that winding region; the same unforced trajectories must later leave it. This is a derived phase-passage consequence, not a scheduled hybrid event. It supplies neither the final mode nor a slip time, and does not identify the whole basin boundary.

For those same sources, terminal restrictions separate convergence from attraction: every trajectory has one complete equilibrium limit, while energy compatibility leaves both attracting and saddle configurations. Saddle-source sets have zero volume in each fixed parameter's full uncertainty chart; this supplies no probability law and does not exclude a saddle limit for a particular preparation. An attracting candidate becomes an acquired identity only through a source-specific capture argument.

That stronger capture argument is available for the original interior source corridor: its actual mixed form/phase state enters the winding-one storage trap, excluding all other energy-compatible candidates there, including the saddle exceptions. The result retains the same supplied law and full source uncertainty. The constitutive extension rebuilds force, passage, curvature and storage bounds for the declared potential family and proves the same capture uniformly over lambda in [0,1]. This formation outcome therefore does not distinguish those laws. Their different nominal nonlinear interaction onsets remain. The carried-state comparison now transfers that distinction to a finite raw-form observation of the original class-one ramp families, using each law's recovery, contact work and nonlinear remainder. It retains very small mathematical error allowances and a supplied observation map. The common-sensor theorem derives finite domain, gain, curvature and sensor-error conditions preserving that distinction. A common nonlinear observation can alter the mixed signs without erasing full-record separation; neither sign nor raw form is therefore a sensor-independent physical identity. Physical resolution and independent calibration of an apparatus remain open. These observation results do not transfer to the different Cayley source corridor.

The separate organized-inheritance theorem derives both collective rows for two prescribed interfaces between registered winding-one C9 organizations. Matching contacts preserve the complete law after a clock conversion. Three-offset contacts change the first harmonic relative to the ninth and eighteenth ones; equivalence requires an explicit form chart and changes to both the constitutive parameter and reciprocal coefficient. The fixed-coefficient family is therefore not closed under this composition, although a larger algebraic family represents the inherited law. Actual recovered sources retain their residuals, new support work and a separate full-state identity bound. Exact invariant-family motion, nearby finite approximation and local identity are distinct conclusions. Neither the enlarged parameters nor a ninth phase moment alone inherit the original source guarantees or recover discarded attachment registration.

The composition-compatible classification adds a distinct boundary: admitted nonsine analytic laws can match the same target storage, complete tangent and quadratic fields while preserving their own profile under both registered C9 interfaces. These requirements therefore do not select sine. Their harmonic information remains relevant even though the named interfaces act on it identically. The result concerns conditional organized targets; it transfers no source acquisition or contact identity to the new laws. The oriented-interface theorem then conditionally selects sine by requiring unchanged-profile inheritance throughout an open interval of weighted registered contacts. This stronger requirement is independently supplied; it is not derived from nesting or identity. Nonsine currents still give exact collective dynamics when their interface-dependent sine and cosine coefficients are retained. An effective NFR may carry that boundary information, internal coordinates or derived memory. Neither failure of a smaller description nor conditional selection under an extra premise invalidates those complete laws or independently selects a fundamental physical law.

The network compatibility theorem now separates pairwise equivalence from one simultaneous network chart. For the declared three-C9 contact cycle, an unshifted sine representation with positive node-form units, one clock and one reciprocal coefficient requires zero contact-cycle phase and equal inherited amplitudes. The fixed equal and unequal interior controls fail that phase condition; the unequal control also fails amplitude compatibility. Both nevertheless retain an exact six-coordinate law with their boundary data. This is information in the supplied relations, not a newly identified physical gauge field. The equal-control aligned state is stationary despite nonzero cancelling contact-current contributions; the unequal aligned state is not. The separate acquired-assembly proof now admits both full-state targets and carries the actual independently recovered sources into their respective joined identities. All three windings persist and the complete state converges modulo its conserved common origins; the unequal control changes the relative component origins. The containing phase sector does not require every transient edge to stay acute. Source residuals remain explicitly bounded and positive attachment work is supplied. This proves conditional composition from formed children, not passive or autonomous attachment, physical binding or a universal hierarchy.

The assembly-work theorem now admits a wider event endpoint class: arbitrary fine form, relative origins and internal phase shapes, provided every original child retains strictly acute internal gaps and winding one. Simultaneous internal reorganization still leaves a strictly positive required-work floor for both fixed contacts, after retaining the actual recovered-source excess. Cross-contact phases need not be acute. Passive intervening flow or actions cannot evade that complete endpoint balance. This is a scoped storage obstruction, not a sharp minimum or an exclusion of other source, support, identity or storage laws. Regional organization on fine support present from preparation is a distinct formation question. The joint-acquisition theorem now proves that the three primitive phase-flat ramp families acquire all three winding-one identities and enter the appropriate full-state capture region by the fixed structural time 200 on both connected supports. Their subsequent relative registration converges to the respective joined target. The proof retains every original error and pays all initial contact storage within the declared whole-network budget; it transfers no isolated-source recovery verdict. It therefore removes late attachment as a requirement for this conditional formation route. The marked partition, support, three structured form preparations and complete sine law remain supplied. No locally unprepared child's acquisition, autonomous source, primitive support birth or physical bound state follows.

The receiver mechanism removes the third local ramp while retaining the equal-weight support, complete law and original uncertainty. By structural time 200 the two prepared regions have winding one, while the receiver still has winding zero. A certified exclusion interval from preparation supplies a necessary first-acquisition timescale, separating initial form relaxation from possible acquisition by slow phase transport. At time 200 its noncentral mixed-coordinate currents point toward the donor ramp. Complete source storage, regional boundary work and the exact memory of the retained form are accounted for. Interaction-induced motion is therefore present without already establishing a new identity. Receiver acquisition, donor retention and entry to joined capture require separate evidence.

The slow receiver admission derives an exact second-order phase description on the conserved global mean-zero leaf. Its velocity retains the original form, and its structural energy is the original complete storage divided by four; this is a change of state description, not a new physical mass law. After structural time 400, a uniform bound controls the difference between the actual slow phase velocity and the descent field. At that time the receiver's actual noncentral phase rates point toward the donor ramp, with donor winding one and receiver winding zero. This strengthens the causal mechanism without establishing acquisition. The source-inclusive differential-inclusion contract retains donor branch margins and complete-state capture; the nominal reflection symmetry cannot remove the family's nonsymmetric perturbations.

The frozen full-source enclosure subsequently certifies loss of both donor windings while the receiver remains at winding zero throughout the validated interval. The regional retention theorem relates a first winding-boundary contact to accumulated regional work minus internal loss. A strict all-prefix budget suffices for retention; the original source exhausts both donor reserves. The same boundary phase admits opposite normal velocities at opposite forms, so a phase-only winding cell is not invariant over unrestricted forms. These results retain form and contact state as identity-relevant information; they neither forbid alternative preparations nor establish receiver acquisition, eventual regeneration or a physical identity.

The constitutive barrier comparison shows that the matched target, local fields and registered composition properties do not fix the minimum storage on an internal winding boundary. In the admitted comparison family, that minimum changes for donors and receivers together. Regional power can also change at identical complete state and storage while total instantaneous loss stays equal. These are independent nonlinear properties of the supplied law; neither a larger geometric barrier nor changed instantaneous work proves a changed formation or maintenance outcome for a prepared source.

The own-law source comparison rebuilds initial transport and retained velocity bounds across that fixed interval. Its residual comparison with the preserved reference certifies receiver winding zero throughout the same finite prefix for all original source errors and admitted laws. The donor endpoint is unavailable under the new bound. Thus this constitutive freedom does not produce receiver acquisition during that interval; no permanent nonformation, preferred law or restriction on other preparations follows.

Distinct internal geometries need not be distinguishable through every contact. The central-contact obstruction shows that the nominal formed C9 classes can remain invisible to the same receiver under an aligned supplied bridge. Interface symmetry and retained internal information are therefore part of an interaction claim.

A declared nonzero relative origin admits a different result: the two actually formed donors produce separated finite responses in one receiver class while both cycle identities remain retained under the complete joined law. Original source uncertainty, changed port degrees and contact work are included. This connects acquired internal organization to its effect on another organization, conditional on the supplied preparation, law and contact. Its conservative structural dwell and very small readout error establish no laboratory feasibility or physical identification.

A collective observation/measurement map is eventually needed to test that hypothesis, but it may act on a pattern and its interaction with a measurement system rather than on one primitive coordinate. Its latent-state assumptions and, where used, probability rule must be justified independently of the evaluated outcomes. Direct sensor-to-EPI transport experiments are supporting realizations; success there would not derive the sensor's material constituents.

Physical spin is a possible research question about such collective properties, not a proposed identification already established. A balanced configuration, phase rotation, winding integer or classical U(2)/Stokes representation is insufficient to establish physical spin. A spin claim would need the appropriate rotation action and quantitative measurement response, including the outcome statistics for the spin sector claimed; see the external spin-one-half reference. These are comparison obligations, not laws to insert into TNFR and then claim as derived. Equilibrium can also be relative or dynamical; a static balance alone does not prove reachability, robustness, composability or physical identity.

A physical property may therefore be a functional of a pattern's joint state and dynamics, including its internal motion and coupling to a retained environment. It need not be a primitive TNFR variable or a one-to-one relabeling of one. The intended explanation is generative: derive the organization, derive its interaction and observable response, then test that response against independent observations. Combining variables into a fitted expression for a known physical constant would not establish this chain.

The fundamental-phenomena comparison connects existing conservation, topology, pulse and interaction results to specific physical obligations. Its source/probe distinction matters: a property can be internally different yet invisible through a particular interface. Conversely, an observed difference can belong to the supplied interface rather than to an intrinsic identity. Neither finding licenses naming a pattern an electron. The execution plan selects work after its dependencies are identified; this comparison supplies physical obligations, not another campaign. Its charge and magnetic-response boundary separates conserved inventories and directional interactions from physical identification; its quantum-emergence boundary specifies the transformation and measurement laws still to derive.

The current engine assumes nodes, states and relations. That is the starting domain of this model, not evidence that the substrate is external to TNFR, nor a derivation of its own origin. A finer-scale TNFR realization would need the same explicit reduction obligations as any effective nodal description; see assumed substrate and emergence between scales.

The deeper target can therefore be a hypothetical relational substrate whose collective configurations supply both effective objects and their environment. This does not require a second medium outside that structure, but it does require sufficient state and complete laws. The environment/pressure admission shows why an unobserved background, zero EPI and zero pressure are not interchangeable notions of vacuum. Connected fine support and its global unity remain premises, not consequences of the effective-link proof. The current pressure is a state-dependent driving term; a pressure-based description must retain whatever coordinates or memory its closure needs.

docs.title: NFRs participate in the same structural configuration
docs.text:
The programme adopts participation in form as a constitutive requirement: an NFR is an organization of the same structural configuration in which it acts. Its identity and interactions must be represented within that configuration. This participation in form is not, by itself, evidence that an NFR has been identified with observed physical matter.

At an effective scale, write y=R(z) for the retained description of a pattern in the fine joint state z. On a smooth fixed-support interval, its rate must be inherited as y_dot=DR(z)*F(z). A closed law in y alone requires the existing closure conditions; otherwise retain boundary state, hidden coordinates or justified memory. Effective interaction must represent the same fine interaction, without counting it again as an independent force exerted by a second copy of the pattern. The collective interaction owner already shows why relations between patterns can carry necessary state. The reduced formed-class ports give a controlled approximation example: a smaller component state transfers to a different receiver with explicit finite error for discarded modes and initial uncertainty. This supplies neither an exact nonlinear quotient nor physical identification; the full-law identity proof remains separate.

The matrix-response comparison distinguishes a complete prepared collective law from a derived description of acquired constituents. Its retained form/phase state is sufficient for that law; using it for a finer organization still requires a reduction and own-law identity bounds. A static response matrix changes the joint storage/response contract without itself supplying temporal memory or a new primitive capacity.

A larger NFR would organize the internal nodes or patterns without erasing their existence or motion. The conservative sine replica calculation gives a restricted exact example of inherited influence: internal phase dispersion changes a group's phase-driven form response, and internal form contrast drives that dispersion. The full mean/internal coordinate change retains both fine nodes in each supplied pair. Synchronized pairs inherit the same nodal rows, but their means alone do not close the general nearby dynamics. This identifies information needed for a collective description; it does not prove that the partition or a new NFR has formed autonomously.

The exact unordered-pair state retains that internal influence in a closed collective description, removing only the interchangeable constituent labels. Its constrained coordinates keep the continuous degrees of freedom and do not derive spontaneous scale formation or a universally sufficient scalar macro-node.

The registered C9 composition adds an interface-dependent constitutive example: the internal pattern can filter distinct phase harmonics differently. Its four-coordinate law closes on a declared invariant family, while the actual acquired states require separate residual and identity bounds. That restriction does not eliminate the internal state of arbitrary neighboring configurations or select when the interface forms.

The predictive repeated composition extends this distinction to two marked parents under a fixed positive-loss sine law. A finite approximate parent response remains informative throughout its admitted fine-state neighborhood while child and parent identities persist. Separate unordered child states can still omit which states meet at the ports, preventing exact parent closure. The prepared registration, supplied contacts and finite error bounds do not establish formation of the parent identity.

The separate parent-registration acquisition starts with acquired children that lack that marked parent identity, proves entry while retaining their fine uncertainty and winding, and predicts a later interaction from the reached state. An antipodal correlated source under the same law never enters. Preparation therefore remains consequential; the marked grouping and symmetric support do not select an autonomous hierarchy or a separation of internal and external timescales.

The restoring-response theorem then disrupts that acquired registration through one supplied phase event. The children persist and parent registration returns within the declared finite horizon. Equal parent means at the event nevertheless produce different later parent interactions: an internal association mode carries information needed by the prediction. Eight child means, with carried fine-error bounds, retain it. The event itself descends to the identity on parent means; it is the subsequent dynamics that fails to close on those means alone. Restoring response under held contacts does not establish physical binding or autonomous event occurrence.

The continuous-actuation obstruction also distinguishes that hybrid map from a finite-duration realization through the form row. Under the unchanged phase law, the phase displacement requires continuous loss in addition to the endpoint storage rise. The original source cannot realize the same map in one slow unit within the three-unit work budget, even allowing arbitrary integrable form inputs. This restricts the declared input channel, duration and budget; it neither invalidates the supplied jump nor selects an autonomous event or another fundamental law.

The separate constructive realization supplies a four-slow-unit input that reaches the exact same endpoint within the net work budget and preserves every child throughout the path. Its input depends on actual initial complete state, including the reached forms, and assumes actuation at all nodes. The collective construction reduces initialization to eight child means and actuation to four uniform channels. It retains every fine coordinate, with a controlled endpoint error and separately justified recovery and prediction after release. The collective observations retain child association; they are not the four parent means. Exact initial observations, marked channels and supplied intervention timing remain premises, without autonomous event occurrence or physical identification.

The finite-reservoir extension replaces the prescribed time profile by a jointly evolving auxiliary form coordinate with its own pressure and storage. Reciprocal exchange supplies a complete loss balance and a finite net-work budget. The fixed model nevertheless fails its registration-loss readout for the entire declared source, while preserving the children. Thus autonomous exchange, energy consistency and a particular organizational response are distinct claims. The auxiliary scalar is supplied constitutive state; its formation as an NFR has not been derived.

The reservoir memory classification separates that auxiliary law from its retained preparation information. Without reservoir leakage, a conserved lifted quantity labels different locally attracting geometries on fixed information leaves. These include registered and unregistered parents with the same retained child winding. Original positive leakage admits local attraction to the registered equilibrium. The full-state traps are conditional initial neighborhoods, not capture of the earlier acquired source or emergence of the auxiliary scalar.

The organized C9 source port instead derives the interaction of an additional constituent under a supplied attachment. Its complete law changes both host channels and retains source reaction and contact storage. Conserved preparation totals can eliminate donor means on the exact carrier family; arbitrary fine states still retain correlations absent from all child means. The actual acquired host and recovered donor are admitted at attachment with unchanged residuals, not projected to that family. This source is not the previous auxiliary scalar law. Its default-Emission realization test retains all fine source errors and bounds form motion for every duration. Even allowing donor reaction and unrestricted collateral evolution, the contacted child's mean cannot acquire the fixed default Emission increment. Thus an interacting organization need not realize every configured operator amplitude. The obstruction concerns this source and complete law, not other gains or the existence of its already-admitted collective organization. The separate open-domain realization obstruction uses analyticity and the joined equilibrium to exclude any nonzero constant Emission increment at a fixed duration on an open complete-state leaf. Selecting among prescribed countably many durations cannot supply that exact map either. This does not exclude a constrained actuator preparation, continuous state-dependent stopping or approximate realization. An endpoint match and a reusable transformation have distinct evidence obligations. The regular stopping criterion further excludes a near-identity Emission family on an open complete-state domain when duration is differentiable in gain: the unchanged target phases require nine independent form constraints. The exact tangent locus is nonempty, but an explicit member fails at second order. Initial alignment with an operator's action therefore does not establish a persistent mechanism; restricted preparations and approximate actions retain separate questions. The local carrier persistence theorem classifies the nearby phase-stationary preparations on the exact carrier. Their antisymmetric internal motion leaves the target form fixed as well, excluding positive Emission there. Opposing marked interface currents can remain nonzero; this cancellation concerns the target's state and net rows, not a complete boundary observation. The proof gives no quantitative neighborhood or transfer to arbitrary fine internal profiles. The fine internal-response result then separates two admitted static preparations with equal target state and net rows: opposed nonuniform constituent phases generate a nonzero delayed fine response, while every child mean stays matched through the tested second order. The actual tangent predicts no target response. Retaining phase arrangement and reacting interfaces therefore matters beyond mean state or linearized behavior; the derived acceleration is neither measured history nor an executed operator. No finite observation window is certified by this result. The exact reflection representation retains forty coordinates and reconstructs both nonlinear rows on a declared symmetry sector containing that preparation. All child means remain constant for all time, although the fine contrasts can evolve. These means have closed trivial dynamics but do not determine the fine response. The signed coordinates retain the original support and lift; they are neither twenty bare NFR nodes nor a proof of winding retention. Events and their grammatical context require separate admission and successor checks. The mirror-complete Reception result supplies one such conditional action: the admitted atomic pair preserves the physical sector, and its in-rail ideal action has nonpositive event work. Both refreshed rows change under the same law. The actual represented control retains the sector, while serial public calls leave it. Thus read schedule, consumed context and endpoint admission belong to the hybrid description; forty continuous coordinates alone are not its complete execution state. The joint maintenance domain then derives both winding retention and form rails from the same acute-cell storage sublevel. It contains the fixed preparation and survives same-law flow and any finite schedule of independently admitted ideal paired Reception events. This is a conditional persistence result; event occurrence and the organization's formation are not supplied by the invariant domain. The capacity continuation specializes the established reciprocal form/phase balance to a mirrored capacity reset. With that explicit shared-capacity phase premise, the same geometric identity survives; positive held capacities also preserve target convergence. Zero capacity retains the geometric certificate but cannot inherit convergence in general. Keeping the old phase row instead can increase storage even inside this domain; neither outcome selects event occurrence or a unique constitutive phase law. The Coherence domain theorem preserves the same reflected organization under the ideal simultaneous phase map, including its shared-edge work. Yet strict default IL requires positive signed form at both targets, which an opposite-form pair cannot satisfy. Thus a mathematically compatible map can lack admission under a configured runtime policy. This obstruction concerns execution of the pending step; it neither removes the organized state's identity nor completes its word. The general activity audit derives an explicit event-domain alternative from the same pressure/phase map: signed or zero form and zero capacity need not prohibit that instantaneous action. The historical positive-threshold policy remains the default. Neither policy admission nor a nontrivial event derives occurrence, satisfies missing grammar context or certifies the organized-source word's execution. The separately frozen represented handoff executes Reception followed by Coherence on its actual output, with an independently supplied moving control. Both endpoints retain immediate acute geometry, winding and bounded storage. The moving control loses storage; the quiet control has a tiny positive represented work within its declared error budget. These finite results preserve the distinction between a valid event, an organized endpoint and future identity. They do not identify raw rational phases with an exact reflected lift or complete the remaining word. The separate raw-state theorem then establishes conditional continuous maintenance for both saved endpoints from exact zero total form and the full acute energy domain. Reflection is unnecessary for their winding retention and form rails; convergence uses the actual lifted global mean. This broader state domain still presupposes the same complete law and does not select another event or derive formation.

Collective identity needs its own formation and maintenance argument. In the organized-source model, all five acquired child windings persist while the connected source converges to a common registration; separately conserved component means exclude that alignment for the same source without the donor contact. In the distinct five-child product model, all nine outer cycles acquire an initially absent winding and subsequently retain it while preserving all five constituent windings. All eighty original relative preparation directions are carried. The paired source without child-common form differences remains outer-unwound. These results retain supplied preparation and contact work; they establish neither finite settling time nor autonomous contact or hierarchy selection.

Identity, response and sufficient state are different obligations. The finite outer-response comparison resolves different incremental responses to the same probe despite equal constituent winding labels and global means. Its full nonlinear bounds retain actual fine errors, background motion and signed event work. The additional information is relational state, not another independent force assigned to the same constituents. Winding alone does not determine every response, prove a resonance spectrum or establish fractality at arbitrary scales.

Observation can identify that relational identity without reconstructing the complete state. The matched-source inverse and single-history inverse infer outer winding without supplied child phase origins under their respective preparation and error contracts. The latter carries background evolution, probe backaction and cumulative work through one continuing object. Reversing a phase command does not restore an earlier state. Their common initial class contains the earlier acquired sources; generic members are not thereby proved formed, and a singleton necessary sector does not authenticate arbitrary records or prove their joint realizability.

The five-child organization can therefore be described as a collective NFR with declared membership, acquired identity and interaction, retaining its constituent and boundary state. Its inferred winding is not an endpoint reconstruction or a complete scalar EPI description. docs.title: Localized identity and transport on a supplied support
docs.text:
A basic NFR is the lowest retained level of a declared model, not an established ultimate constituent. The substrate foundation already permits that distinction. Conditional research can ask whether interactions on a supplied support sustain a localized organization that moves across it while retaining a reproducible identity. This capability does not require prior unique law selection or physical identification.

Transport of a pattern changes which fixed sites carry it. It differs from internal phase rotation, oscillation within fixed constituent pairs, a redrawn graph layout, relabeling sites or creating a child node. A supplied cycle's winding and a moving maximum are not sufficient identity tests. Formation and transport also differ: transporting a prepared organization does not show its formation from a class lacking that identity.

An admissible transport claim declares the following before its response:

  • Law and background. Retain every consumed coordinate, the full support, capacities, clock, inputs and events, with a specified reference background. An observation window does not remove interactions with its complement. Define a support metric separately from conductance; graph-layout positions have no dynamical meaning without a declared geometric model.
  • Localization. Define a nonnegative observation of departure from the background, its units, spatial width/tail criterion and a nonvanishing signal floor. This observation does not replace signed form in the law or turn a signed storage remainder into a positive local energy. State how multiple peaks, splitting and unavailable centers are handled.
  • Displacement and identity. Use one fixed support reference and a predeclared identity comparison with error bounds over the entire interval. If translations are used as exact dynamical equivalences, verify that their maps preserve support, coefficients and complete dynamics. Profile alignment used only as an observation must retain any mismatch and its error bounds. Preserve displacement in the record. Common phase-origin freedom is not spatial translation. Retain the internal and boundary state needed to distinguish continuing transport from decay followed by unrelated excitation elsewhere.
  • Preparation and robustness. Declare whether the initial class already contains the identity, any supplied directional asymmetry and independent disturbances. Symmetry of both the law and preparation cannot be discarded by a numerical tie-break and then called autonomous direction selection. Admit finite transport, persistent motion and collision as separate claims.

The finite prepared-transport theorem meets these obligations for one positive-loss normalized-sine law on a fixed unit cycle. A tube in the complete form and lifted-phase state follows a prescribed moving reference throughout a finite interval, retaining its internal rotation and a nonvanishing signal floor. Localization and direction are already present in the supplied initial class. The result therefore establishes robust prepared transport, with distinct endpoint windows, rather than acquisition of that organization. Integer cycle translations are exact symmetries; the reference's fractional center is an observation coordinate. The private scalar budget reader neither authenticates a source nor evaluates a trajectory.

The phase-uniform source obstruction excludes that directional carrier identity for a bounded real-form preparation class and its admitted full-state errors over a finite interval. Its actual damped tangent preserves equal opposite-band norms, even for spatially asymmetric form; the nonlinear transfer retains a separate error budget. The reflection obstruction instead excludes majority localization in either of two disjoint reflected windows for exactly reflection-symmetric preparations, including their retained real phase lifts, under the full law. These statements leave bilateral mobile organization and other source classes open. A source may lack the directional identity while already being localized.

The joint band-identity theorem carries two prepared opposite-carrier patterns through a finite encounter, retaining a joint full-state tube and localization of each projected component. These spectral projections are neither closed nonlinear subsystems nor a spatial partition of the actual state; the reference tubes do not prescribe exact constituent trajectories. The interaction defect compares joint evolution with separate histories sharing the same preparation primitives; their linear evolution cancels. The retained endpoint result certifies a nonzero nonlinear defect for the exact nominal preparations within the frozen numerical budget, with both prepared band identities retained. The original shared-source-family bound remains unresolved. This conditional mathematical result establishes nonadditivity, not a common composite identity or a physical observation.

The interacting patterns could reorganize into a common composite NFR whose identity depends on their relative position, phase and dynamics. Their shapes and trajectories may change; a finite-lived composite may move or oscillate jointly. This remains a hypothesis. Its independently defined actual-state identity must be absent initially with a margin, then form and persist beyond what linear overlap explains, with relevant constituent and boundary state retained and a later interaction or response criterion. A nonzero superposition defect or extra Fourier modes may describe small deformation or radiation without this joint retention. Repeated composite formation could support a hierarchy, but does not guarantee increasing complexity.

The same complete fine law may govern the incoming patterns and a common organization. A single-pattern retention argument does not thereby prove retention of their relation. Two spatial lobes within one carrier band are not independent dynamical constituents merely because an envelope is written as their sum; a collective description must retain the relative and boundary information its identity and evolution consume.

The relative-capture proof supplies an actual-state geometric test: the original pair enters and leaves majority coincidence, as do the passage controls. It excludes specified compact/prolonged retention while preserving all preparation uncertainty. These observed distributions and centers are not independent constituents or a sufficient collective state. Their exclusions leave shorter-lived, wider and internal phase/response identities open; coincidence entry itself is not the formation of a common NFR.

The actual relative-rate theorem also excludes a halt, reversal or locking of the original family's registered relative center throughout its original transport interval. The separate C12 witness has identical band intensities and distinct rates under the same complete law: the sine pressure consumes form/phase information those intensities discard. It proves general observation insufficiency outside the original source family. Both witness rates still describe passage; a nonlinear slowing is neither a restoring relation nor an acquired composite identity.

The carrier-compatibility control separates an initially absent common-window screen from an organizing mechanism. Equal group velocity alone does not establish a restoring relative phase, and its restricted stationary-profile exclusion does not exclude finite-lived full-state organization. Distinct spatial and temporal harmonics must remain separate when deriving a collective approximation.

The same-band source and work control uses two initial concentrations of one total field, with no independent nonlinear constituent identity. Paired phase preparations match exact initial resources and can reverse an instantaneous nonlinear regional contribution. Linear interference also transports regional signal. A source-absent screen and necessary accumulated-work condition therefore retain separate entry, maintenance and response obligations; neither a lobe nor a signed rate is an acquired NFR.

The envelope mechanism admission identifies a possible retained relation between shape, width, amplitude and internal phase in an auxiliary modulation equation. Its full-state reconstruction and error budget must be validated under the actual positive-loss law before it is a maintained nodal pattern. Supplying such a profile would still supply the relation initially. Formation from two patterns additionally requires a compatible relative preparation, initial absence and a discriminating acquisition argument. A focusing comparison equation alone establishes neither a composite NFR nor a physical particle.

The zero-sector basin theorem places the entire original mobile-pair source family in an invariant acute phase domain; each state converges to consensus on its actual conserved mean leaf. It excludes winding generation and a nonuniform stationary limit from that family, while leaving finite-lived organization open. Small storage alone is insufficient: a separately supplied acute winding-one twist on the same cycle is stationary below the same storage threshold, outside the required zero-lift chart.

Geometry and formation therefore require distinct tests. Support and conductance enter this law; an embedding or independent edge length alone does not. A proper localized cycle window induces a path, so the winding identity of a supplied C9 constituent does not transfer to that window. Neither geometric compatibility nor an invariant collective chart establishes actual entry and retention.

Existing positive-loss exclusions constrain recurrence on their finite closed complete laws; their hypotheses do not exclude every finite displacement. The replica pulse supplies internal activity on fixed constituents, not this transport property. Using a conservative completion instead retains that different loss premise; removing damping to obtain a desired trajectory is not a derived mechanism. The regional balance and memory owner retain the boundary and hidden-state obligations. A time-dependent membership additionally needs its own transport accounting; a fixed-region identity is not that formula.

This conditional finite theorem is not a particle definition or a permanent transport claim. Physical displacement, mass, charge, spin and measurement statistics retain the independent obligations in the physical atlas. The execution plan alone owns admission of a preparation and mechanism for interaction-generated organization; the frozen endpoint result authorizes no retuning or replay.
